text: Nahibaluan nga missing in action si Dela Rosa halin sang Nobyembre 2025.
english: Dela Rosa is missing in action from November 2025.

text: Nag-umpisa ini matapos gin-anunsyo ni Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla nga nakit-an na sini ang ginaalegar kopya sang alleged warrant of arrest halin sa International Criminal Court (ICC) batok kay Dela Rosa.
english: It started after Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla announced that he had found the alleged copy of the alleged warrant of arrest from the International Criminal Court (ICC) against Dela Rosa.

text: Ginhingadlan ang amo nga senador (nga former PNP chief) bilang alleged co-conspirator sa crimes against humanity case nga ginapangatubang ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The senator (former PNP chief) was named as an alleged co-conspirator in the crimes against humanity case facing former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Apisar nga wala ginkumpirma sang ICC kun ano ka matuod ang claim ni Remulla, wala na nagpakita si Dela Rosa sa tanan nga official activities, hearings, kag sessions sang Senado apisar nga nagabaton gihapon ini sang iya nga sweldo.#
english: Although the ICC did not confirm the truth of Remulla's claim, Dela Rosa did not appear in all official activities, hearings, and sessions of the Senate despite still receiving his salary.

text: GOOD to know nga sa COP27 nabaton na gid man sang mga “developed” kag manggaran nga mga pungsod nga ang kabangdanan sang Climate Crisis indi tungod lang sa naturalisa nga mga hitabo.
english: GOOD to know that at COP27 the “developed” and rich countries have finally accepted that the cause of the Climate Crisis is not just due to naturalized events.

text: Kundi kahimuan man sang katauhan, kon diin mayor nga mabasol sila diri tungod sang ila masanyog nga “industrialization” nga gina-drive sang fossil fuel (oil, natural gas, coal).
english: But it is also the work of mankind, where they are mainly to blame for their rapid industrialization driven by fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal).

text: Indi mabali ang kamatuoran nga ang paggamit sang fossil fuel sa mga salakyan kag mga makinarya sang “industrialization” nakatuga sang makahalalit nga polusyon.
english: There is no denying the fact that the use of fossil fuels in the vehicles and machinery of “industrialization” has caused harmful pollution.

text: Mayor sini ang gina-emit nga  greenhouse gas (GHG) nga nagatuga sang “disastrous” nga Climate Change, nga gina-experyensyahan na gani naton.
english: The main of these is the emission of greenhouse gases (GHG) that cause “disastrous” Climate Change, which we are already experiencing.

text:
***

Ang pangako sang COP27 nga bulig para sa mga “vulnerable” nga mga pungsod, lakip ang Filipinas, ginpasalig pa ugaling sa palaabuton nga COP28 nga hiwaton sa United Arab Emirates sa 2023.
english:
***

The COP27 pledge of assistance for “vulnerable” countries, including the Philippines, was however reassured at the upcoming COP28 to be held in the United Arab Emirates in 2023.

text: Kay wala pa sing lubos nga kaathagan kon ano gid nga bulig ang mabaton nila, ano naman ayhan, in the meantime, ang mahimo sang tagsa-tagsa?
english: Because it is not yet clear exactly what help they will receive, what, in the meantime, can each one do?

text: Kon ano gid ya ang mahimo sang Filipinas, masandig ina seguro sa kon ano gid nga mga problema ang ma-anticipar naton.
english: What the Philippines can do will probably depend on what problems we can anticipate.

text: Ang nagligad nga tatlo ka bagyo may ginbilin nga leksyon sa aton.
english: The past three hurricanes have left us with a lesson.

text: Ining tatlo ka bagyo – Yolanda, Odette kag si Paeng – nag-utas sang madamo nga kabuhi.
english: These three typhoons – Yolanda, Odette and Paeng – claimed many lives.

text: Nagbilin man ini sang makahalawhaw nga mga kahalitan sa palapangabuhian, puluy-an, eskwelahan kag iban pa nga infrastruktura katulad sang taytay, edificio pampubliko kag pribado, kag iban pa.
english: It also left huge damage to livelihoods, homes, schools and other infrastructure such as bridges, public and private buildings, and others.

text: Diri kinahanglan naton ang daku nga kantidad agud masabat ang kasubong nga mga trahedya kag agud mapabangon ang marusdak nga ekonomiya.
english: Here we need huge sums to respond to such tragedies and to revive the crumbling economy.

text: Indi man maayo ang padayon nga pagpangutang naton.
english: It is not good for us to continue to borrow.

text: Kag malayo sa tigi nga makaganar kita sing maayo sa Sovereign Wealth Fund kay indi gid maayo mag-invest sa panahon nga ini nga sobra ka taas ang inflation.
english: And it is far from certain that we will make good profits from the Sovereign Wealth Fund because it is not good to invest in this time of high inflation.

text: Laban-laban ma-purdoy gid gani ang ining Maharlika Fund kon matabo.
english: Laban-laban ma-purdoy gid gani ang ining Maharlika Fund kon matabo.

text: Dapat isalig na lang naton anay ang ano man nga ma-earn ta halin sa mapautang sang Bangko Sentral sa mga pribado nga negosyo.
english: We should just rely on whatever we earn from the Central Bank's loans to private businesses.

text: Mas ma-abilidad ini sila kon paano mapalago ang negosyo ulayhon sa paglago man sang ekonomiya.
english: They will be more skilled in how to grow the business along with the growth of the economy.

text: Daku man nga buhis ang ma-earn naton sa ila.
english: We can also earn a lot of taxes from them.

text: Nada man ina nga isalig naton ang investment sa negosyo sa kamot sang bantog sa pagka-corrupt nga gobyerno.
english: It is also wrong to entrust business investment to the hands of a notoriously corrupt government.

text:
***

Indi man kita dapat malipat nga daku ang aton pagkakinahanglan sa bastante nga enerhiya indi lang sa subong kundi sa palaabuton man.
english:
***

We must also not forget that we have a great need for sufficient energy not only now but also in the future.

text: Indi forever ang fossil fuel, may pagkaubos ini.
english: Fossil fuels are not forever, they are finite.

text: In fact, sa estimate sang mga expert tubtub na lang ini sa 50 tubtub 100 anyos.
english: In fact, experts estimate that it is only 50 to 100 years old.

text: In other words kinahanglan na naton nga makaangkon sing “sustainable”, ukon wala pagkaubos kon pwede lang, nga energy supply, nga makuha naton sa mga “renewable” katulad sang hydropower, solar kag wind energy.
english: In other words, we need to have a “sustainable”, or inexhaustible if possible, energy supply, which we can get from “renewable” sources such as hydropower, solar and wind energy.

text: Although meantime, panginpuslan ta anay ang fossil fuel samtang gina-ideyahan man kon paano ini mangin mas “efficient” kag mapanubo ang GHG sini sa bulig sang aton mga siyentipiko.
english: Although meantime, let's take advantage of fossil fuels while thinking about how to make them more efficient and reduce their GHG emissions with the help of our scientists.

text:
***

Pero, ano gid ka-urgent nga likawan ta na ang paggamit sang fossil fuel?
english:
***

But, how urgent is it that we stop using fossil fuels?

text: Makatuon kita diri sa Saudi Arabia.
english: We can learn here in Saudi Arabia.

text: Wala ini sa listahan sang 10 ka pungsod nga nagpahayag sang ila kabalaka sa madasig nga pagnubo sang ila oil reserve.
english: It is not on the list of 10 countries that have expressed concern about the rapid decline of their oil reserve.

text: In fact, ang Saudi Arabia No.
english: In fact, Saudi Arabia’s No.

text: 3 sa top 10 oil producing countries, sunod sa Estados Unidos kag Russia tungod man sa daku nila nga reserba.
english: 3 in the top 10 oil producing countries, followed by the United States and Russia due to their large reserves.

text: Pero nagapaniguro na ini nga indi mawad-an sang energy supply bisan damo pa ang ila fossil fuel.
english: But it is already making sure that it does not lose energy supply even if they have a lot of fossil fuels.

text: Yara sa Vision 2030 sini ang goal agud ma-eliminate na ang oil sa iya power production model.
english: Its Vision 2030 includes the goal of eliminating oil from its power production model.

text: Plano sini sa pag-generate sang 50% halin sa renewable kag 50% sa natural gas.
english: It plans to generate 50% from renewable and 50% from natural gas.

text: Plano man sini ang pag-develop sang green hydrogen facility powered sang solar kag wind energy.
english: It also plans to develop a green hydrogen facility powered by solar and wind energy.

text: Wala pa sing 10% ang produksyon sang Filipinas sing fossil fuel kag dapat mas pursigido gid kita sa pag-angkon sang “sustainable energy” paagi sa mga “renewable”, nga sa 2030 ang target naton mga 35% lang sini.
english: The Philippines produces less than 10% of fossil fuels and we must be more determined to achieve sustainable energy through renewables, which by 2030 we target only about 35%.

text: Ano abe kon mapataas ta pa ang renewable energy production naton kay nagapuyo kita sa isa ka mainit (tropical), mahangin kag maulanon nga pungsod?
english: What if we could increase our renewable energy production because we live in a tropical, windy and rainy country?

text: Tungod sini, dapat gani mas masulhay ang pag-producir diri sa aton sang hydropower, solar kag wind energy.
english: Because of this, it should be easier to produce hydropower, solar and wind energy here.

text: Dapat mapasanyog pa gani naton diri ang pagtukod sang “renewable energy companies” kon diin makabulig ang friendly foreign investments.
english: We should even promote the establishment of renewable energy companies where friendly foreign investments can help.

text: Tutal indi man sila covered sa 60-40% sharing pabor sa Filipinas sa idalom sang aton Konstitusyon, indi bala?/PN
english: After all, they are not covered by the 60-40% sharing in favor of the Philippines under our Constitution, right?/PN

text: Patay ang 27-anyos nga asawa matapos ginhatok-hatok buno sang bana sa sulod sang ila balay sa Davao City.
english: A 27-year-old wife was stabbed to death by her husband inside their house in Davao City.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nadiskubre sang bana nga may gina-chat nga iban nga lalaki ang iya asawa.
english: According to the investigation, the husband discovered that his wife was chatting with another man.

text: Samtang tulog ang biktima, didto ini ginbuno sang suspek sang makapila ka beses.
english: While the victim was sleeping, the suspect stabbed her several times.

text: Nakabugtaw ang asawa kag nakadalagan pa pa-gwa sa ila balay apang natumba ini.
english: The wife woke up and ran out of the house but fell.

text: Nadala pa siya sang iya ginikanan sa ospital apang gindeklara nga dead on arrival.
english: He was rushed to the hospital by his parents but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Mangin ang iloy sang biktima nga nagtuyo magtambag ang nabun-an man.
english: Even the victim's mother who tried to give advice was also stabbed.

text: Nadakpan naman ang suspek kag pasakaan sang kaso nga parricide kag frustrated parricide.
english: The suspect was arrested and charged with parricide and frustrated parricide.

text: Indi na standardized recipe ang i-promote sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa traditional Filipino dishes kaangay sang adobo.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) will no longer promote standardized recipes in traditional Filipino dishes such as adobo.

text: Kasunod sang asud-asud nga pagpakamalaot nga nabaton halin sa publiko, ginpahayag ni DTI Secretary Ramon Lopez nga baseline guide na lang ang ila nga i-promote.
english: Following the condemnation received from the public, DTI Secretary Ramon Lopez said they will only promote the baseline guide.

text: Paathag ni Lopez, ang baseline traditional recipe ang magaserbe lamang bilang guide kag indi mandatory.
english: Lopez explained that the baseline traditional recipe will only serve as a guide and is not mandatory.

text: Suno sa tiglikom, hilway ang mga tawo kun ano man ang ila nga himuon sa sini nga baseline recipe kag indi man magpahilabot ang DTI sa ila nga style sa pagluto.
english: According to the secretary, people are free to do whatever they want with this baseline recipe and the DTI will not interfere in their style of cooking.

text: Liwat nga ginpaathag sang DTI nga ang pagtukod sang technical committee nga amo ang maga-establisar sang baseline traditional recipes para sa mga pagkaon kaangay sang adobo ang magaserbe lamang bilang guide agud ma-promote ang mas creative nga exports sang pagkaon.
english: The DTI reiterated that the establishment of a technical committee that will establish baseline traditional recipes for foods such as adobo will only serve as a guide to promote more creative food exports.

text: Kabahin man ini suno sa iya sa recovery efforts gikan sa epekto sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: He said this is also part of the recovery efforts from the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Nanindugan ang suspek sa pagpangluthang-patay sa karelasyon sang iya live-in partner sa Barangay Purok 4, Pavia, Iloilo, nga self-defense lang ang iya ginhimo.
english: The suspect in the shooting death of his live-in partner's boyfriend in Barangay Purok 4, Pavia, Iloilo, insisted that he was acting in self-defense.

text: Ang suspek amo si Arnold Mamon, 41-anyos sang Barangay Cabugao Norte, Pavia kag isa ka utility worker.
english: The suspect was identified as Arnold Mamon, 41, of Barangay Cabugao Norte, Pavia and a utility worker.

text: Ang biktima amo si Joven Galvez Job, 35-anyos sang Barangay Sapal, San Lorenzo, Guimaras kag isa ka construction worker.
english: The victim was identified as Joven Galvez Job, 35, of Barangay Sapal, San Lorenzo, Guimaras and a construction worker.

text: Natabo ang krimen sa salon nga ginatiniran ni Joylen Bayona Padernal, 39-anyos nga amo ang live-in partner sang suspek.
english: The crime occurred in the salon where Joylen Bayona Padernal, 39, who is the live-in partner of the suspect, was staying.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mamon, iya ginpahayag nga antes natabo ang krimen kahapon, Domingo, nakaistoryahanay na sila ni Job sang Sabado sa salon sang nag-abtanay sila nga duha kag didto ginpaandaman sang suspek ang biktima nga palayuan na ang iya live-in partner kag ang ila kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mamon said that before the crime happened yesterday, Sunday, he had a conversation with Job on Saturday at the salon when they met and the suspect warned the victim to stay away from his live-in partner and their children.

text: Si Job ang may yara man sang kabataan apang patay na ang iya asawa.
english: Job also had children but his wife was dead.

text: Suno sa suspek, kahapon, sang nagbalik ini salon, naabtan niya liwat nga yara pa ang lalaki rason nga ginkompronta niya ini kag sang liwat nga ginsukmaan niya si Job, namalibad ini nga palayuan si Padernal.
english: According to the suspect, yesterday, when he returned to the salon, he found the man still there so he confronted him and when he again scolded Job, he refused to leave Padernal.

text: Pahayag ni Mamon, sa tunga sang ila pagkomprontahanay, didto nagtuyo nga magkuha sang kutsilyo si Job rason ng gin-gabot niya ang iya dala nga pusil kag gintiro ang biktima.
english: Mamon said that in the middle of their confrontation, Job tried to get a knife and pulled out his gun and shot the victim.

text: Nahibaluan nag 14 ka tuig ang relasyon ni Mamon kag Padernal kag sang nagligad lang nga Hunyo sang nagsugod nga wala na sila nagaupdanay bangud sa indi nila paghangpanay.
english: Mamon and Padernal have been in a relationship for 14 years and it was only last June that they started to break up due to misunderstandings.

text: Gindugang naman ni Mamon nga nagakabalaka man siya nga may matabo nga indi maayo sa iya anak nga babaye bangud kun kaisa, nagakadto si Job nga hubog sa salon.
english: Mamon added that he is also worried that something bad will happen to his daughter because sometimes, Job goes to the salon drunk.

text: Gin-ako man sang suspek nga madugay na niya nga nahibaluan nga may iban nga karelasyon ang iya live-in partner.
english: The suspect also admitted that he had known for a long time that his live-in partner had another relationship.

text: Nasaksihan naman sang tatlo ka kabataan sang suspek ang krimen.
english: The suspect's three children witnessed the crime.

text: Preso subong ang suspek sa Pavia Municipal Police Station.
english: The suspect is currently detained at the Pavia Municipal Police Station.

text: Nakaabot na sa Papua New Guinea si Pope Francis para sa second leg sang iya nga apostolic trip subong nga Septyembre.
english: Pope Francis has arrived in Papua New Guinea for the second leg of his apostolic trip this September.

text: Gin-abi-abi ang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa paagi sa cannon salute kag marching band sa paluparan sang kapital nga Port Moresby matapos ang anum ka oras nga flight halin sa Jakarta, Indonesia.
english: The 87-year-old Pope was greeted with a cannon salute and marching band at the capital's Port Moresby airport after a six-hour flight from Jakarta, Indonesia.

text: Sa welcome ceremony, nadulaan sang balanse ang Pope samtang nagasaylo halin sa wheelchair pakadto sa bangko apang madasig siya nga nabuligan sang iya nga security guards.
english: During the welcome ceremony, the Pope lost his balance while moving from a wheelchair to a bench but was quickly helped by his security guards.

text: Samtang nagabyahe naman si Pope pakadto sa Papua New Guinea, ginkumpirma man sang mga pulis sa Indonesia nga pito gid ka mga tawo ang ila gin-detain sa Java kag Sumatra regions bangud sa suspetsa sa paghimo sang pamahog sa social media nga magpatigayon sang suicide bombings kadungan sang papal events kag gub-on ang security protocol para sa Santo Papa.
english: While the Pope is traveling to Papua New Guinea, Indonesian police also confirmed that they have detained seven people in the Java and Sumatra regions on suspicion of making threats on social media to carry out suicide bombings during papal events and violating security protocols for the Pope.

text: Ginsiling sang elite counterterrorism squad nga Aswin Siregar nga publicity-seeking exercise ukon pasapak-sapak lamang ang amo nga mga pamahog apang padayon nila ini subong nga gina-imbestigaran.
english: Elite counterterrorism squad Aswin Siregar said the threats were a publicity-seeking exercise but they are still investigating.

text: Sa Papua New Guinea, kabahin sang agenda ni Pope ang naangot sa social justice priorities.
english: In Papua New Guinea, part of the Pope's agenda is related to social justice priorities.

text: Ini nga Commonwealth nation ang puluy-an sa masobra 10 million ka mga tawo kun sa diin kadam-an amo ang subsistence farmers.
english: This Commonwealth nation is home to more than 10 million people, most of whom are subsistence farmers.

text: (Photo: Guglielmo Mangiapane/Reuters)
english: (Photo: Guglielmo Mangiapane/Reuters)

text: Nagapreparar na si Senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr nga magpasaka sang kaso batok sa mga indibidwal nga yara sa likod sang online posts nga ginapatihan sang iya kampo nga rason sa iya kapierdihan sa 2025 midterm elections.
english: Senator Ramon “Bong” Revilla Jr. is preparing to file a case against the individuals behind the online posts that his camp believes are the reason for his defeat in the 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Alfredo Arungayan, Bombo Abogado, iya ginpahayag nga antes paman nga nagpabutyag sang amo nga tikang si Sen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Alfredo Arungayan, Bombo Abogado, said that even before Sen.

text: Revilla, tuig 2019, may mga kapareho na nga mga posts nga nagalapta online.
english: Revilla, in 2019, there are similar posts circulating online.

text: Suno kay Arungayan, ang ginadepensahan diri ni Revilla amo ang kaso sini nga pagpangawat sang pondo sang publiko nga anay na nga na-dismiss sang korte sang 2018.
english: Arungayan said Revilla is defending his case of theft of public funds which was previously dismissed by the court in 2018.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga luyag ni Revilla nga paguwaon nga indi siya makawat.
english: He also explained that Revilla wanted to be released so that he would not steal.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Atty. Raymond Fortun, legal counsel ni Revilla, nga tuyo sang senador nga maproteksyunan ang reputasyon sini kag sang iya pamilya sa gina-alegar nila nga malisyoso nga pagpang-atake sa social media kag iban pa nga digital platforms.
english: Meanwhile, Atty. Raymond Fortun, Revilla's legal counsel, said the senator's intention is to protect his and his family's reputation from what they allege is malicious attacks on social media and other digital platforms.

text: Si Revilla, isa ka beterano nga mamalidha kag anay aktor, napaslawan nga makakuha sang seat sa Senado matapos nga nagtapos sa ika-14 nga pwesto sa bag-o lang natapos nga eleksyon.
english: Revilla, a veteran lawmaker and former actor, failed to win a Senate seat after finishing 14th in the recently concluded election.

text: Magatakop na karon sa gab-i ang halos duha ka semana nga Tokyo 2020 Paralympics sa diin nagpasundayag ang mga atleta nga may kasablagan sa lawas halin sa nanuhay-tuhay nga bahin sang kalibutan apisar sang pagpanghangkat nga dala sang COVID-19.
english: The nearly two-week Tokyo 2020 Paralympics will end tonight where athletes with disabilities from around the world have performed despite the challenges posed by COVID-19.

text: Suno kay Bombo Samurai International Correspondent Josel Palma, direkta sa Japan, patigayunon ang closing ceremony sa National Stadium umpisa las 7:00 – 9:30 pm (oras sa Pilipinas).
english: According to Bombo Samurai International Correspondent Josel Palma, live in Japan, the closing ceremony will be held at the National Stadium from 7:00 – 9:30 pm (Philippine time).

text: “Harmonious Cacophony” ang mangin konsepto sang Closing Ceremony.
english: “Harmonious Cacophony” will be the concept of the Closing Ceremony.

text: Ini nga konsepto ang nagakilala sang unity ukon pag-isa sang kada indibidwal sa pihak sang ila differences ukon kinalain.
english: This concept recognizes the unity of each individual despite their differences.

text: Patigayunon ang seremonya nga wala sang audience, sa diin ang magatambong lang amo ang pila ka mga opisyal nga ginalakipan nanday Japanese Crown Prince Fumihito kag Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike.
english: The ceremony will be held without an audience, with only a few officials including Japanese Crown Prince Fumihito and Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike in attendance.

text: Nahibaluan nga 4,400 ka mga atleta halin sa 162 ka pungsod kag rehiyon, ang naghampang sa Paralympics halin sang Agusto 24.
english: It is known that 4,400 athletes from 162 countries and regions, have competed in the Paralympics since August 24.

text: Lakip man sa mga atleta nga nagpasundayag amo ang duha ka Afghan national nga gin-evacuate halin sa Afghanistan — pungsod nga subong ginasakop na sang Taliban militants.
english: Also among the athletes who performed were two Afghan nationals who were evacuated from Afghanistan — a country now occupied by Taliban militants.

text: Bangud sa multinational effort, ”safe” nga na-evacuate ang duha ka atleta padulong sa Tokyo agud matiglawas ang ila nga pungsod.
english: Thanks to a multinational effort, the two athletes were safely evacuated to Tokyo to represent their country.

text: Matandaan nga madamo ang nagprotesta bangud sa pihak sang nagataas nga kaso sang COVID-19 sa Japan, nadayon ang pag-host sang pungsod sang Olympic kag Paralympic games.
english: It can be recalled that many protested because despite the increasing cases of COVID-19 in Japan, the country continued to host the Olympic and Paralympic games.

text: Agud malikawan ang paglapta sang virus, ginmanduan ang kada delegasyon kag foreign participants nga istrikto nga magtinir lang sa athletes’ village kag sports venues kun kinahanglan, kag sa tion nga matapos ang final events nga ginpasakupan sang mga atleta, gina-require man ang mga ini nga magbalik gilayon sa ila tagsa ka pungsod.
english: To prevent the spread of the virus, each delegation and foreign participants were instructed to strictly stay in the athletes' village and sports venues if necessary, and once the final events in which the athletes participated, they were also required to return immediately to their respective countries.

text: Ginhingyo ni former Philippine National Police Chief Nicolas Torre III nga indi siya pagkaluoyan matapos ginkakas sa posisyon bilang hepe sang organisasyon.
english: Former Philippine National Police Chief Nicolas Torre III asked for no mercy after he was removed from his position as head of the organization.

text: Sa iya ginpagwa nga pahayag apat ka adlaw matapos ang pag-relieve sa iya, ginsiling ni Torre nga ang dapat kaluoyan amo ang mga pumuluyo nga biktima sang mga pagbaha.
english: In a statement issued four days after his relief, Torre said the people who deserve mercy are the victims of the floods.

text: Gin-athag man niya nga wala siya sang kalain sang buot kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: He also clarified that he has no grudge against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa tanan nga nagsuporta sa iya kag ginpahayag nga magapadayon siya sa pagserbisyo bilang katapo sang Philippine National Police.
english: He also thanked everyone who supported him and said he will continue to serve as a member of the Philippine National Police.

text: Nakuhaan sang video ang pagsulod sa atmosphere sang Earth ang Asteroid 2024 RW1.
english: Asteroid 2024 RW1 was captured on video entering the Earth's atmosphere.

text: Natabo ini sa 12:39 sang kaagahon.
english: It happened at 12:39 am.

text:
Suno sa netizen nga si Marvin Coloma sang Tuguegarao City, Cagayan, segundos lang ang pagsiga sang langit bangud sa pagtupa sang ‘fireball.’

Kasunod sini, may yara naman sang mga magagmay nga meteorites sa duta kag sa dagat.
english:
According to netizen Marvin Coloma of Tuguegarao City, Cagayan, the sky lit up for only seconds due to the fireball.

This is followed by smaller meteorites on land and in the sea.

text: Nagalaum ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga mabayluhan sang positive growth sa ekonomiya ang pag-umpisa sang second quarter subong nga tuig.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) hopes that the start of the second quarter of this year will be replaced by positive growth in the economy.

text: Suno kay DTI Secretary Ramon Lopez, kinahanglan nga ma-improve ang mga economic indicators kaangay sang exports , manufacturing activity kag foreign direct investments para mapasangkad pa ang ekonomiya sag pungsod.
english: According to DTI Secretary Ramon Lopez, economic indicators such as exports, manufacturing activity and foreign direct investments need to be improved to further expand the country's economy.

text: Matandaan nga ang Pilipinas ang nagapabilin sa recession sang first quarter sa diin ang gross domestic product ang yara lang sa 4.2 percent.
english: The Philippines remained in recession in the first quarter with gross domestic product at only 4.2 percent.

text: Sa pihak sang vaccination rollout sa pungsod pahayag ni Lopez, nangin mahinalungon sa gihapon ang gobyerno sa liwat nga pagbukas sang ekonomiya agud malikawan ang gulpiyada nga pagtimbuok sang kaso sang COVID-19.
english: Despite the vaccination rollout in the country, Lopez said the government has remained cautious in reopening the economy to avoid a sudden surge in COVID-19 cases.

text: Nagalaum ang tiglikom nga antes pa man magtakop ang tuig 2021, malab-ot sang Pilipinas ang population protection kag herd immunity.
english: The secretary hopes that before the end of 2021, the Philippines will achieve population protection and herd immunity.

text: Nagpaathag sang dugang si former Punong Barangay Rex Teves sang Divinagracia, La Paz, Iloilo City matapos nagtaas gid ang tingog sini sang bakbakon kuntani ang baral ukon sagang sang drainage system pasulod sa ila nga barangay.
english: Former Punong Barangay Rex Teves of Divinagracia, La Paz, Iloilo City explained more after he raised his voice when he tried to break the barrier of the drainage system into their barangay.

text: Kaangot ini sa ila nga kumprontasyon sang chief of staff sang City Engineer’s Office nga si Mr. Joel Gerasmia sang nagligad nga Mayo 29.
english: This is in connection with their confrontation with the chief of staff of the City Engineer's Office, Mr. Joel Gerasmia last May 29.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Teves, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang husto nga koordinasyon sa barangay, kag wala nahangpan sang mga personnel nga kun buksan ang drainage, wala ini sang guwa-an sa punta sang Divinagracia bangud makipot ang kanal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Teves said there is no proper coordination in the barangay, and the personnel do not understand that if the drainage is opened, there will be no exit at the end of Divinagracia because the canal is narrow.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginbutang ang baral sang iya pa termino agud madependaran sang ila barangay, Barangay Aguinaldo, kag Barangay Alalasan bangud isa sila sa mga ginakonsiderar nga manubo nga areas kun sa diin kun magbaha, apektado ang ila lugar.
english: He said the barrier was placed during his term to depend on their barangay, Barangay Aguinaldo, and Barangay Alalasan because they are one of the considered low-lying areas where if there is a flood, their area is affected.

text: Ginklaro man sini nga wala sang siya sang ginkadol nga personnel, kundi ginpikpik lang sini ang isa ka tawo nga naga-obra agud nga mapaiway anay ang pagbakbak sang baral.
english: He also clarified that he did not hit any personnel, but he just patted a person who was working to prevent the barrel from breaking.

text: Natalana nga mag-istoryahanay ang involved nga mga opisyal kun yara na si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Tre as.
english: The involved officials are scheduled to meet when Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Tre as.

text: Nahibalu-an nga nagahimo sang walk-through inspection ang composite team sang City Engineers Office, Office of Building Officials (OBO) kag Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6 agud hibalu-on ang rason sang pagbaha sa syudad kag agud nga mahatagan ini sang solusyon.
english: The composite team of the City Engineers Office, Office of Building Officials (OBO) and Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6 is conducting a walk-through inspection to determine the cause of the flooding in the city and to provide a solution.

text: Naglapta na ang mga espiya sang China halin sa Batanes tubtub sa Sulu, kag lakip sa ginalantaw nga impluwensyahan sini amo ang resulta sang presidential elections sa 2028.
english: Chinese spies have spread from Batanes to Sulu, and are expected to influence the outcome of the 2028 presidential elections.

text: Suno sa security analyst nga si Chester Cabalza, nagapadayon ang Chinese espionage operations diri sa pungsod bangud sang mga isyu kaangay sang West Philippine Sea kag illegal gambling operators.
english: According to security analyst Chester Cabalza, Chinese espionage operations continue in the country due to issues such as the West Philippine Sea and illegal gambling operators.

text: Kun eleksyon ang pagahambalan, ginpahayag ni Cabalza nga magabubo sila sang pondo para nga makaapekto sila sa resulta sang piniliay: “Nagbe-bet din ‘yan kung sino ang magiging presidente natin.
english: When it comes to elections, Cabalza said they will pour funds so that they can affect the outcome of the election: “They are also betting on who will be our president.

text:
They will pour out campaign funds para maimpluwensiyahan ‘yung foreign and security policies natin.”

Pahayag pa sini, nagtuyo pa ang Chinese “sleeper agents” nga sudlon ang critical institutions kaangay sang Armed Forces kag Philippine Coast Guard.
english:
They will pour out campaign funds to influence our foreign and security policies.”

He said the Chinese “sleeper agents” even tried to infiltrate critical institutions such as the Armed Forces and the Philippine Coast Guard.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, may mga espiya nga makahihalo maghambal sang Filipino kag kun kaisa nagaupod pa sa Chinese Filipino communities.
english: In fact, he said, there are spies who speak Filipino and sometimes even join Chinese Filipino communities.

text: “Malawak ‘yung kanilang network because they are deep funded.
english: “Their network is wide because they are deeply funded.

text: Secondly, alam naman natin our relationship with China is very high ‘yung distrust and mistrust.
english: Secondly, we know our relationship with China is very high ‘yung distrust and mistrust.

text: Naturally, they would send spies.
english: Naturally, they would send spies.

text: The problem is – we have an archaic, very old, obsolete, espionage law way back World War 2,” pahayag pa sang analyst.
english: The problem is – we have an archaic, very old, obsolete, espionage law way back World War 2,” the analyst said.

text: Nagpanawagan ini nga usisaon gid sang maayo kag mag-conduct sang background check sa mga indibidwal nga gusto mag-upod sa mga institusyon kaangay sang Philippine Coast Guard Auxiliary.
english: He called for a thorough investigation and conduct of background checks on individuals who want to join institutions such as the Philippine Coast Guard Auxiliary.

text: Matandaan nga ginkumpirma anay sang PCG nga ginkakas sini sa listahan ang 36 ka mga tawo nga may “shaky” citizenship ukon natumod nga mga Chinese nationals.
english: It can be recalled that the PCG earlier confirmed that it removed from the list 36 people with “shaky” citizenship or identified Chinese nationals.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagpaandam si Sen.
english: It can be recalled that Sen.

text: Panfilo Lacson nga may Chinese “sleeper agents” kag mga operatiba nagikan sa People’s Liberation Army (PLA) sang China nga nagapang-espiya diri sa Pilipinas — kaangay sang nauna na-report nga suspected espionage activities sa Palawan, Makati, Dumaguete, malapit sa Camp Aguinaldo, sa Commission on Elections office sa Manila, kag mangin sa Malacanang.#
english: Panfilo Lacson said there are Chinese “sleeper agents” and operatives from China's People's Liberation Army (PLA) who are spying here in the Philippines — such as previously reported suspected espionage activities in Palawan, Makati, Dumaguete, near Camp Aguinaldo, the Commission on Elections office in Malaca, and Malaca.

text: Suportado sang mga retirado nga tennis players ang nangin pahayag sang four time Grand Slam winner nga si Naomi Osaka nga temporaryo anay ini nga maga-untat sa sports matapos madulaan sang interes sa kompetisyon.
english: Retired tennis players support four-time Grand Slam winner Naomi Osaka's announcement that she will temporarily retire from sports after losing interest in the competition.

text: Una diri, ginlutos sang Filipino-Canadian nga si Leylah Fernandez ang world’s No.
english: Earlier, Filipino-Canadian Leylah Fernandez defeated world's No.

text: 3 sa third round sang US Open.
english: 3 in the third round of the US Open.

text: Bangud sini, gilayon nga gin-anunsyo sang Japanese tennis star ang plano niya nga mag-indefinite break sa tennis.
english: As a result, the Japanese tennis star immediately announced his plans to take an indefinite break from tennis.

text: Sang tinalikdan nga bulan, gin-ako sang 23 anyos nga tennis player nga nagabatyag ini sang depresyon.
english: Earlier this month, the 23-year-old tennis player admitted to feeling depressed.

text: Samtang gindayaw naman nanday Retired American tennis pro James Blake ang desisyon ni Osaka.
english: Meanwhile, retired American tennis pro James Blake praised Osaka's decision.

text: Matandaan nga wala na nag-partisipar pa si Osaka sa French Open.
english: Osaka did not participate in the French Open.

text: Mangin ang four-time Olympic gold medal-winning sprinter nga si Michael Johnson ang nagdayaw sa nangin desisyon sang tennis star.
english: Even four-time Olympic gold medal-winning sprinter Michael Johnson praised the tennis star's decision.

text: Agaw-eksena ang tatlo ka mga myembro sang LGBTQ Community matapos nga nag-avail sang Libreng Tuli Program sa Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu.
english: Three members of the LGBTQ Community take the scene after availing of the Free Circumcision Program in Lapu-Lapu City, Cebu.

text: Ini amo sanday Layla, 22-anyos; Lesley, 26-anyos; kag Hanabi, 35-anyos.
english: They are Layla, 22; Lesley, 26; and Hanabi, 35-years-old.

text: Magluwas nga nakapapaltak, nakabaton pa sang kwarta ang tatlo.
english: Besides being released, the three also received money.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagatanyag ang syudad sang P10-K cash para sa mga lalaki nga nagaedad sang 20-anyos pasaka
english: The city is offering P10-K cash for men aged 20-years and above

text: Nagakasubo ang business sector sa pagpaidalom sa syudad sang Iloilo sa Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ).
english: The business sector is saddened by the placement of Iloilo City under Enhanced Community Quarantine (ECQ).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Terrence Uygongco, Chairman sang Iloilo Economic Development (ILED)Foundation Inc., iya ginpahayag nga kadungan sang pagpaidalom sa syudad sa ECQ status, mawad-an sang negosyo kag indi naman makahatag sang sweldo ang mga negosyante sa ila nga mga empleyado.
english: Terrence Uygongco, Chairman of the Iloilo Economic Development (ILED) Foundation Inc., said that along with the city being placed under ECQ status, businesses will lose their businesses and businessmen will not be able to pay their employees.

text: Suno kay Uygongco, indi na makasarang ang mga negosyante kun magapadayon pa ang pagpatuman sang lockdown.
english: According to Uygongco, businessmen will not be able to afford it if the lockdown continues.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Lea Lara, Executive Director sang Iloilo Business Club, gintinguhaan man sang business sector ang tanan nga masarangan agud indi lang kuntani madayon ang ECQ apang nagdesisyon na ang IATF kag sundon na lang nila ini.
english: Meanwhile, Lea Lara, Executive Director of the Iloilo Business Club, said the business sector has tried everything possible to prevent the ECQ from continuing but the IATF has decided to follow it.

text: Pahayag niya, indi na regular pa ang mga negosyo sang syudad humalin sang ginpaidalom ang Iloilo City sa Modified ECQ sa sulod sang kapin duha man ka bulan.
english: He said the city's businesses have not been regular since Iloilo City was placed under Modified ECQ for more than two months.

text: Kag mas nangin mabudlay pa gid subong dugang pa ni Lara bangud restricted ang hulag sang mga tawo.
english: And it's even more difficult now, Lara added, because people's movements are restricted.

text: Magkaupod ang apat ka kabataan ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga nagbisita sa iya sa International Criminal Court sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's four children visited him at the International Criminal Court in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Ginpakigbahin ni Davao Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte ang litrato sang iya mga utod upod kay Vice President Sara, Davao City Vice Mayor Baste kag Veronica ‘Kitty’ Duterte.
english: Davao Representative Paolo “Pulong” Duterte shared a photo of his siblings with Vice President Sara, Davao City Vice Mayor Baste and Veronica ‘Kitty’ Duterte.

text: Ang litrato may caption nga may dala sila nga daku nga paglaum sa ila tagipusuon kag isa ka adlaw maga-updanay sila.
english: The photo is captioned that they carry great hope in their hearts and one day they will be together.

text: Matandaan nga nadakpan ang anay Presidente sang Marso 11 gikan sa ICC arrest warrant for crimes against humanity may kaangtanan sa iya kampanya batok sa iligal nga druga sang siya pa ang alkalde sang Davao City tubtub nangin presidente sang pungsod.
english: The former President was arrested on March 11 from an ICC arrest warrant for crimes against humanity in connection with his campaign against illegal drugs when he was mayor of Davao City until he became president of the country.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nabaton na sang first Pinay boxer nga nag-qualify sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics nga si Irish Magno ang cash incentive nga ginhatag sang Iloilo Provincial Government.
english: ILOILO CITY- The first Filipino boxer to qualify for the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, Irish Magno, has received the cash incentive given by the Iloilo Provincial Government.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Magno nga tumandok sang Janiuay, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga dako nga butang ang nabaton niya nga P300K cash agud mapakay-o niya ang ila balay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Magno, a native of Janiuay, Iloilo, said the P300K cash he received was a big deal to repair his house.

text: Suno kay Magno, dako ang iya pagpasalamat bangud apisar wala ini sang nakuha nga medalya sa Olympiada, ginkilala kag ginakabig sa gihapon sang mga Ilonggo nga kadalag-an ang iya paghampang sa Olympics.
english: Magno said he is very grateful because although he did not win a medal in the Olympics, the Ilonggos still recognized and considered his performance in the Olympics as a victory.

text: Sa subong, plano ni Magno nga magbalik sa training para sa masunod pa nga mga kompetisyon.
english: For now, Magno plans to return to training for the next competitions.

text: Suno sa iya, indi siya mag-untat tubtob indi niya makuha ang gold medal sa Olympics.
english: He says he won’t stop until he wins the gold medal at the Olympics.

text: Nagpangabay man ini sang suporta para sa masunod pa niya nga mga away.
english: He also asked for support for his future fights.

text: Nagpaandam ang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) sa publiko batok sa pagbakal sang bantog nga “pasalubong” delicacy nga Bongbong’s Piaya.
english: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has warned the public against buying the famous “pasalubong” delicacy Bongbong’s Piaya.

text: Suno sa FDA, indi rehistrado kag napaslawan ang nasambit nga produkto nga magpaidalom sa evaluation process sang ahensya.
english: According to the FDA, the product was not registered and failed to undergo the agency's evaluation process.

text: Gina-abisuhan man sang nasambit nga ahensya ang publiko nga tsikyaron sa FDA verification portal sang supermarket ang produkto nga ginabakal agud masiguro ang kalidad, kag food safety.
english: The agency also advises the public to check the FDA verification portal of supermarkets for products purchased to ensure quality and food safety.

text: Makaupod sang Gilas Pilipinas ang New Zealand kag South Korea sa Group A sang 2023 FIBA World Cup Qualifiers.
english: Gilas Pilipinas will join New Zealand and South Korea in Group A of the 2023 FIBA ​​World Cup Qualifiers.

text: Bilang isa sa mga host sang FIBA World Cup 2023 kaupod ang Japan kag Indonesia, automatic nga qualified ang Pilipinas.
english: As one of the hosts of the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023 alongside Japan and Indonesia, the Philippines is automatically qualified.

text: Group B naman ang Australia, China, Japan kag Taiwan.
english: Group B is Australia, China, Japan and Taiwan.

text: Samtang Group C naman ang Jordan, Lebanon, Indonesia kag Saudi Arabia.
english: Group C is Jordan, Lebanon, Indonesia and Saudi Arabia.

text: Ginpangunahan naman sang Iran ang Group D kaupod ang Kazakhstan, Syria kag Bahrain.
english: Iran topped Group D alongside Kazakhstan, Syria and Bahrain.

text: Pagahiwaton ang first window sang home-and-away sa Nobyembre samtang ang masunod nga window para sa first round schedule ang patigayunon sa Pebrero, Hunyo kag Hulyo sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The first window of the home-and-away will be held in November while the next window for the first round schedule will be held in February, June and July next year.

text: Matandaan nga ang pinakaulihe nga pag-atubangay sang Pilipinas kag South Korea amo ang sang nagligad nga duha ka bulan sa Asia Cup qualifiers sa Clark, Pampanga kun sa diin nagdaog ang Gilas sa score nga 81-78.
english: The last meeting between the Philippines and South Korea was two months ago in the Asia Cup qualifiers in Clark, Pampanga where the Gilas won with a score of 81-78.

text: Ang pinakamaragtason nga pagdaog sang Pilipinas sa FIBA World Cup amo ang sang 1954 sa Rio de Janeiro kun sa diin na-secure sang pungsod ang bronze medal.
english: The Philippines' most historic FIBA ​​World Cup victory was in 1954 in Rio de Janeiro where the country secured the bronze medal.

text: Nalangkag na ang mga Pinoy sa Indonesia agud magtambong sa misa nga pangunahan ni Pope Francis.
english: Filipinos in Indonesia are eager to attend the mass to be led by Pope Francis.

text: Isa ini sa mga aktibidad sang santo papa sa iya pagbisita sa pila ka pungsod sa Asia kag Pacific region.
english: This is one of the activities of the pope during his visit to several countries in the Asia and Pacific region.

text: Suno kay Bombo Ginavella Limpin Cumla, international correspondent sa Jakarta, hiwaton ang balaan nga misa sa Gelora Bung Karno Stadium sa alas-singko sang hapon oras sa Indonesia.
english: According to Bombo Ginavella Limpin Cumla, international correspondent in Jakarta, the holy mass will be held at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium at 5 pm Indonesian time.

text: Ginkalipay ni Cumla nga mismo siya ang magatambong man sa amo nga misa.
english: Cumla was happy that he himself will attend the mass.

text: Pahayag niya nga ginalauman nga mapuno gid ang venue nga may 78,000 nga capacity.
english: He said the venue is expected to be full with a capacity of 78,000.

text: Magluwas sa misa, may yara man sang Interreligious meeting ang santo papa sa Istiqlal Mosque nga pinakadako sa Southeast Asia.
english: Besides the mass, the pope will also hold an interreligious meeting at the Istiqlal Mosque, the largest in Southeast Asia.

text: Pagasundan naman ini sang meeting sa mga benepisyaryo sang charitable organizations sa Indonesian Bishops’ Conference Headquarters.
english: This will be followed by a meeting with beneficiaries of charitable organizations at the Indonesian Bishops’ Conference Headquarters.

text: Ginsupendi sang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) ang anay hepe sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) kag subong direktor sang Police Regional Office 12 (PRO12) nga si Police Brigadier General Romeo Macapaz.
english: The National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) has suspended former Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) chief and Police Regional Office 12 (PRO12) director Police Brigadier General Romeo Macapaz.

text: Suno kay NAPOLCOM Vice Chairperson kag Executive Officer Commissioner Rafael Vicente Calinisan, igapapatuman ang 90-nga adlaw nga preventive suspension batok kay Macapaz bangud sa gina-alegar nga grave misconduct kag conduct unbecoming of a police officer.
english: NAPOLCOM Vice Chairperson and Executive Officer Commissioner Rafael Vicente Calinisan said a 90-day preventive suspension will be imposed against Macapaz for alleged grave misconduct and conduct unbecoming of a police officer.

text: Pahayag naman ni PRO12 spokesperson Police Major Rissa Hernaez, naka-leave si Macapaz kag wala sa ila area of responsibility, apang tinguhaan sini nga makig-angot sa iya.
english: PRO12 spokesperson Police Major Rissa Hernaez said Macapaz is on leave and not in their area of ​​responsibility, but she will try to contact him.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto 14, nagpadulong sa NAPOLCOM ang mag-utod nga Julie “Dondon” kag Elakim Patidongan agud mag-file sang reklamo batok kay Macapaz angot sa kaso nga missing sabungeros.
english: On August 14, Julie “Dondon” and Elakim Patidongan went to NAPOLCOM to file a complaint against Macapaz in connection with the missing sabungeros case.

text: Sa pahayag ni Elakim, ginsiling sini nga ginbalabagan ni Macapaz ang imbestigasyon sa kaso sang ginkuha sini ang ila mga cellphone samtang yara sila sa kustodiya sang Cambodia.
english: In a statement, Elakim said Macapaz obstructed the investigation into the case when he took their cellphones while they were in Cambodian custody.

text: Suno pa sa iya, gin-delete ni Macapaz ang pila ka messages sa ila mga telepono kag gintago ang mga SD card nga makabig kuntani nga ebidensya sa kaso.
english: He said Macapaz deleted some messages from their phones and hid SD cards that could have been considered evidence in the case.

text: Nahibaluan nga humalin 2021 tubtob 2022, gin-report sang pulisya nga may 34 ka mga manugbulang ang nadula.
english: It is known that from 2021 to 2022, the police reported that 34 healers went missing.

text: Suno sa report, possible biktima sila sang kidnapping angot sa isyu sa game fixing.
english: According to the report, they may be victims of kidnapping over the game fixing issue.

text: Sa separado nga pahayag, gintuad ni Dondon Patidongan nga gintagbong kag ginlubong ang mga biktima sa Taal Lake, sa diin gin-akusaran sini ang negosyante nga si Atong Ang bilang utok sang krimen.
english: In a separate statement, Dondon Patidongan confessed that the victims were thrown and buried in Taal Lake, where he accused businessman Atong Ang as the mastermind of the crime.

text: Gin-ulamid man sini ang actress nga si Gretchen Barretto sa kaso, bagay nga ginpanginwala sang duha.
english: He also implicated actress Gretchen Barretto in the case, which the two denied.

text: Sang Agusto 1, ginpasaka na ang mga kaso nga multiple murder, serious illegal detention, enforced disappearance, direct bribery, kag obstruction of justice batok kanday Ang kag sa iban pa nga may kahilabtanan.
english: On August 1, charges of multiple murder, serious illegal detention, enforced disappearance, direct bribery, and obstruction of justice were filed against Ang and others involved.

text: Nagpaathag ang Philippine Coast Guard nga naangot sa repair kag rehabilitation sang San Juanico Bridge sa Leyte ang pagdamo sang mga truck sa roll-on-roll-off (RoRo) port sa Dumangas Port sa Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard explained that the increase in trucks at the roll-on-roll-off (RoRo) port at Dumangas Port in Dumangas, Iloilo is linked to the repair and rehabilitation of the San Juanico Bridge in Leyte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lieutenant Junior Grade Danilo Nicdao, commander sang PCG Dumangas Substation, iya ginpahayag nga halos duha ka semana na nga amo sini ang pagpug-ok sang sitwasyon sang mga salakyan bangud sa paglain sang ruta sang trucking services.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lieutenant Junior Grade Danilo Nicdao, commander of the PCG Dumangas Substation, said that the situation of vehicles has been like this for almost two weeks due to the deterioration of the route of trucking services.

text: Suno kay Nicdao, ang iban sa sini nga mga truck ang nagikan pa sa Luzon pakadto sa Panay antes makaabot sa Leyte.
english: According to Nicdao, some of these trucks came from Luzon to Panay before reaching Leyte.

text: Indi sigurado suno sa opisyal kun tubtub san-o nga amo sini ang sitwasyon ilabi na bangud posible madugayan ang pagkaayo sa San Juanico Bridge.
english: The official said it is not sure how long the situation will last especially since the repair of the San Juanico Bridge may take a long time.

text: Apang pahayag sini, magapatigayon sila sang pagsinapol kaupod sa local government unit kag sa Philippine Ports Authority agud ma-address ang problema ilabi na bangud madamo sang pribado nga salakyan pakadto sa Negros Island ang apektado.
english: However, he said they will hold a meeting with the local government unit and the Philippine Ports Authority to address the problem especially since many private vehicles to Negros Island are affected.

text: Mas pabaskuron man ang maritime security suno kay Nicdao amo man ang pre-departure inspection bangud madamo sang posible iligalidad nga matabo kun kaangay sini nga madamo man ang nagaagi sa pantalan.
english: Nicdao said the maritime security will also be strengthened as well as the pre-departure inspection because there are many possible illegalities that can happen if there are many people passing through the port.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang Mayo 15, may yara sang three-ton load limit sa San Juanico Bridge matapos ang assessment nga may significant structural compromises sa taytay.
english: It is known that since May 15, there is a three-ton load limit on the San Juanico Bridge after an assessment that there are significant structural compromises on the bridge.

text: Bangud sa sini nga restriction, apektado ang heavy cargo vehicles nga rason sang disruption sang pagdul-ong sang suplay sang pagkaon, bulong, agricultural products, construction materials, kag iban pa nga essential commodities sa rehiyon.
english: Due to this restriction, heavy cargo vehicles are affected causing disruption in the delivery of food, medicine, agricultural products, construction materials, and other essential commodities in the region.

text: Nag-abot na sa Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Village ang duha ka Afghan athletes kasunod sang ila safe evacuation sa Afghanistan.
english: Two Afghan athletes have arrived at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Village following their safe evacuation from Afghanistan.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma sang International Paralympic Committee (IPC) kahapon, Agusto 28.
english: This was confirmed by the International Paralympic Committee (IPC) yesterday, August 28.

text: Ang duha ka para-athlete amo sanday Zakia Khudadadi kag Hossain Rasouli.
english: The two para-athletes are Zakia Khudadadi and Hossain Rasouli.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma, direkta sa Japan, una na nag-apelar si Khudadadi pinaagi sa video message nga buligan sila nga makahalin sa Kabul para malab-ot man ang ila handom nga ma-tiglawas ang ila pungsod sa Paralympics.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma, directly in Japan, Khudadadi had already appealed through a video message to help them leave Kabul to achieve their dream of representing their country in the Paralympics.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagbuligay ang paralympic groups agud ma-evacuate ang duha ka atleta sa Kabul, Afghanistan — nga subong ginasakop na sang Taliban militants sa diin may natabo pa nga duha ka bombing attacks sang damlag lang sa gwa sang Hamid Karzai International Airport kag sa gwa sang isa ka hotel.
english: Paralympic groups immediately worked together to evacuate the two athletes from Kabul, Afghanistan — now occupied by Taliban militants where two more bombing attacks occurred recently outside Hamid Karzai International Airport and outside a hotel.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala man naka-attend sanday Khudadadi kag Rasouli sa Tokyo Paralympics Opening Ceremony.
english: Khudadadi and Rasouli also missed the Tokyo Paralympics Opening Ceremony.

text: Si Khudadadi ang first female athlete sang Afghanistan nga maga-compete sa Paralympics humalin sang 2004.
english: Khudadadi is Afghanistan’s first female athlete to compete in the Paralympics since 2004.

text: Magahampang siya sa women’s K44 -49kg weight category sa taekwondo sa Huwebes, Septyembre 2.
english: She will compete in the women’s K44 -49kg weight category in taekwondo on Thursday, September 2.

text: Samtang si Rasouli naman ang magahampang sa men’s 400m T47 athletics event sa Byernes, Septyembre 3.
english: Meanwhile, Rasouli will compete in the men’s 400m T47 athletics event on Friday, September 3.

text: Tuman nga kasadya ang nabatyagan sang mga fans kag tumalan-aw sang concert sang singer kag anay member sang sikat nga banda nga The Beatles nga si Paul McCartney sang iya gin-imbitahan ang anay upod sini kag drummer sang banda nga si Ringo Starr.
english: Fans and concertgoers of singer and former member of The Beatles Paul McCartney were overjoyed when he invited his former colleague and drummer Ringo Starr.

text: Naghilinugyaw ang mga fans nga yara sa concert sang ginkanta ni McCartney kag Starr ang mga hitsongs sang Beatles.
english: The fans at the concert cheered when McCartney and Starr sang the Beatles' hitsongs.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini ang mangin ulihi nga concert ni McCartney kun sa diin ginkanta nya ang masobra sa 38 ka mga orihinal nga kanta sang the Beatles.
english: It is known that this will be McCartney's last concert where he will sing more than 38 original songs of the Beatles.

text: Nabayluhan sang kasubo ang kalipay sang driver sang Ceres Bus nga nagaselebrar sang iya kaadlawan subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 24, matapos masunog ang ginamaneho sini nga bus sa Barangay Tabucan, Cabatuan, Iloilo.
english: The joy of the Ceres Bus driver who was celebrating his birthday today, November 24, was replaced by sadness after his bus caught fire in Barangay Tabucan, Cabatuan, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver amo si Christopher Ison, 49, residente sang banwa sang Janiuay.
english: The driver was identified as Christopher Ison, 49, resident of Janiuay town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Fire Officer 3 Daryl Talamera, imbestigador sang Cabatuan Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga ‘las 7:22 sang gab-i sang nakabaton sila sang tawag nga may nasunog nga isa ka bus nga may byahe nga Pavia terminal padulong sa Calinog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Fire Officer 3 Daryl Talamera, investigator of the Cabatuan Fire Station, said they received a call at 7:22 pm that a bus heading from Pavia terminal to Calinog was on fire.

text: Gindeklara naman ini nga fire out ‘las 7:47 sang gab-i kun sa diin gintinguhaan pa kuntani ini nga palungon sang konduktor kag driver ang kalayo gamit ang fire extinguisher.
english: The fire was declared out at 7:47 pm when the conductor and driver tried to extinguish the fire with a fire extinguisher.

text: 22 ang sakay sang bus dala na ang driver kag konduktor.
english: 22 people were on board the bus including the driver and conductor.

text: Maswerte nga wala may nasamaran sa insidente bangud gilayon nga nakagwa ang mga ini.
english: Fortunately, no one was injured in the incident as they were immediately able to get out.

text:
Base naman sa inisyal nga imbestigasyon, naghalin sa nauna nga bahin sang bus ang kalayo apang padayon pa sa gihapon ang imbestigasyon sang Cabatuan Fire Station.#

(By: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english:
According to initial investigation, the fire broke out in the front of the bus but the Cabatuan Fire Station is still investigating.

(By: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: Ginlunsar ang panibag-o nga website nga amo ang makabulig sa publiko nga ma-monitor kag ma-evaluate ang mga existing flood control projects kag malagas ang ginatawag nga “ghost” projects.
english: A new website has been launched that will help the public monitor and evaluate existing flood control projects and eliminate so-called “ghost” projects.

text: Paagi ini sa gintingob nga pwersa sang Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), iban pa nga government agencies, kag ila mga partners.
english: This is through the combined forces of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT), other government agencies, and their partners.

text: Ginatawag ini nga Digital Information for Monitoring and Evaluation (DIME) nga separado pa gid sa “Sumbong sa Pangulo” website.
english: It is called the Digital Information for Monitoring and Evaluation (DIME) which is separate from the “Complaint to the President” website.

text: Suno kay DBM Sec.
english: According to DBM Sec.

text: Amenah Pangandaman, makit-an diri ang tanan nga yara sa General Appropriations Act pati na ang infrastructure projects sa Department of Education (DepEd) kaangay sang mga school buildings.
english: Amenah Pangandaman, it includes everything in the General Appropriations Act as well as infrastructure projects in the Department of Education (DepEd) such as school buildings.

text: “Today, everyone can look at our infrastructure projects,” kabahin sang speech ni Pangandaman.
english: “Today, everyone can look at our infrastructure projects,” Pangandaman said.

text:
“Everyone can log in their inputs, whether there are ghost projects or if there are ongoing projects, whether they are complete, finished or not.”

“That’s all we want to do here, to show that we, our government, are very transparent in implementing projects, and we also want to be accountable for what we do,” dugang sini.
english:
“Everyone can log in their inputs, whether there are ghost projects or if there are ongoing projects, whether they are complete, finished or not.”

“That’s all we want to do here, to show that we, our government, are very transparent in implementing projects, and we also want to be accountable for what we do,” it added.

text: Paagi sa dime.gov.ph, mahimo mapangita ang pangalan sang partikular nga proyekto kag lantawon kun may progreso man ang implementasyon.#
english: Through dime.gov.ph, you can search for the name of a particular project and see if there is any progress in implementation.#

text: Gin-revoke sang Land Transportation Office Region (LTO) ang lisensya sang apat ka public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers nga natukiban nga positibo sa iligal nga droga kadungan sang ginpatigayon nga surprise inspection sa mga terminal sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The Land Transportation Office Region (LTO) has revoked the licenses of four public utility vehicle (PUV) drivers who tested positive for illegal drugs during a surprise inspection at terminals in Iloilo City.

text: Ini ginalakipan sang isa ka taxi driver, isa ka tricycle driver, kag duha ka modernized jeepney drivers.
english: It consists of a taxi driver, a tricycle driver, and two modernized jeepney drivers.

text: Nagpositibo sila sa paggamit sang shabu kadungan sang Oplan Harabas nga ginhimo sang LTO Region 6 sa bus terminals sa Barangay Camalig, Jaro kag sa Mohon, Arevalo sang nagligad nga Abril 15.
english: They tested positive for shabu during Oplan Harabas conducted by LTO Region 6 at bus terminals in Barangay Camalig, Jaro and Mohon, Arevalo last April 15.

text: Base sa order sang opisina, ipatuman gilayon ang revocation; magluwas pa sang lifetime disqualification sa pag-angkon sang driver’s license.
english: Based on the office order, the revocation will be implemented immediately; in addition to lifetime disqualification from obtaining a driver’s license.

text: Apang sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jeck Conlu, assistant regional director sang LTO Western Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga may tyansa pa man nga mag-apelar ang mga involved nga driver, apang magadepende sa gihapon ini sa desisyon sang central office.
english: However, in an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jeck Conlu, assistant regional director of LTO Western Visayas, said the involved drivers still have a chance to appeal, but it will still depend on the decision of the central office.

text: Suno kay Conlu, ini nga tikang sang opisina ang nagapakita sang seryoso nga pagtuman sa transport safety standards ilabi na sa PUV drivers kun sa diin nakadepende ang kabuhi sang iban nga mga tawo nga nagabyahe.
english: According to Conlu, this step of the office shows serious compliance with transport safety standards especially for PUV drivers where the lives of other people traveling depend.

text: Matandaan nga sang Mayo 29, may yara man sang tricycle driver nga nagpositibo sa paggamit sang illegal drugs kadungan sang random drug test sa Ungka kag Tagbak terminals diri sa syudad.
english: On May 29, a tricycle driver also tested positive for illegal drugs during a random drug test at the Ungka and Tagbak terminals in the city.

text: Ginpahayag sang transportation official nga hulaton sang regional office ang confirmatory test results, magahimo sang rekomendasyon, kag ipadala man sa central office.
english: The transportation official said the regional office will wait for the confirmatory test results, make a recommendation, and send it to the central office.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ginapatigayon nga Oplan Harabas ang kabahin sang kampanya sang Department of Transportation kasunod sang mandu sang presidente para sa road safety sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: The ongoing Oplan Harabas is part of the Department of Transportation's campaign for road safety throughout the Philippines.

text: (Photo: LTO Region 6)
english: (Photo: LTO Region 6)

text: Nag-abot na si Pope Francis sa Indonesia agud umpisahan ang iya 11 ka adlaw nga Asia kag Pacific region tour.
english: Pope Francis has arrived in Indonesia to begin his 11-day Asia and Pacific region tour.

text: Sa iya pag-abot, ginbisita ni Pope Francis ang mga migrants kag refugees nga ginatatap sang Jesuit Refugee Service, amo man ang mga orphans nga ginaatender sang Dominican sisters kag ang mga tigulang kag masakiton nga ginabantayan sang Community of Sant’Egidio.
english: During his arrival, Pope Francis visited migrants and refugees cared for by the Jesuit Refugee Service, as well as orphans cared for by the Dominican sisters and the elderly and sick cared for by the Community of Sant’Egidio.

text: Ang pagbisita natabo sa apostolic nunciature kun sa diin ini magatinir samtang yara sa Indonesia.
english: The visit took place at the apostolic nunciature where he will stay while in Indonesia.

text: Ginalauman nga magasentro ang mensahe ni Pope Francis sa importansiya sang pagpreserba sang paghiliusa sa pihak sang nagkalain- lain nga pagpati ukon relihiyon.
english: Pope Francis' message is expected to focus on the importance of preserving unity despite differences of faith or religion.

text: Ang schedule sang santo papa nagalakip sang interreligious meeting sa pinakadako nga mosque sa Southeast Asia kag oportunidad nga makaatubang ang mga Katoliko sa amo nga nasyon kag mabisita ang pila ka social kag charitable works nga ginapatigayon sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The pope's schedule includes an interreligious meeting at the largest mosque in Southeast Asia and an opportunity to meet with Catholics in the country and visit some of the social and charitable works being carried out in the country.

text: Magluwas sa Indonesia, plano man niya nga magbisita sa Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste kag Singapore antes magbalik sa Roma sa Septyembre 13.
english: In addition to Indonesia, he also plans to visit Papua New Guinea, Timor-Leste and Singapore before returning to Rome on September 13.

text: Upod naman ni pope sa amo nga pagbisita si Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, nga amo ang Vatican’s pro-prefect sang Dicastery for Evangelization.
english: The pope was accompanied on the visit by Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle, who is the Vatican’s pro-prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization.

text: Napurnada ang hampang sang isa ka para-athlete sa Tokyo, Japan matapos nabungguan sang isa ka self-driving bus sa athlete’s village.
english: A para-athlete's game in Tokyo, Japan was interrupted after being hit by a self-driving bus in the athlete's village.

text: Ang biktima amo ang Japanese athlete nga si Aramitsu Kitazono, 30, isa ka bulag nga Paralympian, kag natalana kuntani nga maga-compete sa men’s 81-kilogram division subong nga Sabado.
english: The victim was Japanese athlete Aramitsu Kitazono, 30, a blind Paralympian, and was scheduled to compete in the men’s 81-kilogram division this Saturday.

text: Ginalantaw nga duha ka semana pa antes mag-ayo ang injury nga naangkon sang amo nga atleta pagkatapos sang insidente.
english: It is expected that it will take two weeks for the injury sustained by the athlete to heal after the incident.

text: Suno sa pulis, nagatabok si Kitazono sa pedestrian lane sang gulpi man nga nagliko pa-tuo ang amo nga bus sang nag-abot na sa intersection sang village.
english: According to police, Kitazono was crossing the pedestrian lane when the bus suddenly turned right when it reached the intersection of the village.

text: Ang e-Palette autonomous electric buses amo ang salakyan nga gin-develop sang Toyota Motor kag isa sa mga sponsors sa hinampang sa Tokyo subong nga tuig.
english: The e-Palette autonomous electric buses are the vehicle developed by Toyota Motor and one of the sponsors at the games in Tokyo this year.

text: Pahayag pa sang mga pulis, antes ang aksidente, nakapundo pa ang bus sang na-detect sang sensor sini ang security guard nga yara nagatindog sa intersection.Gilayon man nga nagpangayo sang pasaylo ang Toyota kag temporaryo nga ginsuspinde ang byahe sang amo nga e-Palette buses.
english: Police said that before the accident, the bus was stopped when its sensor detected the security guard standing at the intersection. Toyota immediately apologized and temporarily suspended the service of the e-Palette buses.

text: “We are very sorry that the accident has made many people worried.
english: “We are very sorry that the accident has made many people worried.

text: A vehicle is stronger than a person, so I was obviously worried about how they were.
english: A vehicle is stronger than a person, so I was obviously worried about how they were.

text: It shows that autonomous vehicles are not yet realistic for normal roads,” kabahin sang pahayag sang Toyota.
english: It shows that autonomous vehicles are not yet realistic for normal roads,” Toyota said in a statement.

text: Nagpasalig ang kumpaniya nga may imbestigasyon nga himuon.
english: The company promised that an investigation would be conducted.

text: Disappointed naman ang Japanese paralympian bangud indi na ini makahampang.
english: The Japanese paralympian is disappointed that he will not be able to play.

text: Suno sa coach nga si Yoshiyasu Endo: “He wanted to take good care of himself.
english: According to coach Yoshiyasu Endo: “He wanted to take good care of himself.

text: We feel regret, but I think he is the most disappointed.” ##
english: We feel regret, but I think he is the most disappointed.” ##

text: Ginklaro sang host nga si Luis Manzano ang iya nangin pahayag may kaangtanan sa engagement sang iya ex-girlfriend kag aktres nga si Angel Locsin kag film producer Neil Arce.
english: Host Luis Manzano clarified his statement regarding the engagement of his ex-girlfriend and actress Angel Locsin and film producer Neil Arce.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpahayag ang host sa isa ka interview kun sa diin ginpamangkot ang iya opinyon sa engagement sang ex-girlfriend iya ginhambal nga indi siya pag-i-ulamid sa nasambit nga isyu.
english: It is known that the host said in an interview where he was asked his opinion on the engagement of his ex-girlfriend he said that he will not be involved in the said issue.

text: Suno sa host, na misinterpret lang sang netizen ang iya nga pahayag kag indi si Angel ang ginatumod niya.
english: According to the host, the netizen misinterpreted his statement and he was not referring to Angel.

text: Madumduman nga nagbulagay si Luis kag Angel sang Enero 2016 kag gin anunsyo naman sang aktres ang iya engagement sang June 29, 2019.
english: Luis and Angel broke up in January 2016 and the actress announced her engagement on June 29, 2019.

text: Samtang  going strong naman ang relationship ni Luis sa iya current girlfriend nga si Jessie Mendiola.
english: Meanwhile, Luis' relationship with his current girlfriend, Jessie Mendiola, is going strong.

text: Gin-akusahan ni United States president Joe Biden ang iya kaalyado nga si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga wala sang bastante nga ginahimo para nga malab-ot na ang kasugtanan nga mahilway ang mga bihag sang Hamas sa Gaza.
english: United States President Joe Biden has accused his ally Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of not doing enough to reach an agreement to release Hamas prisoners in Gaza.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Biden sang nag-atubang sila ni Vice President Kamala Harris sa US negotiators para matigayon ang hostage-release deal matapos nakumpirma nga may anum ka dugang nga mga bihag sa Gaza lakip na ang isa ka American citizen.
english: Biden made the remarks when he and Vice President Kamala Harris met with US negotiators to secure a hostage-release deal after it was confirmed that there were six more hostages in Gaza, including an American citizen.

text: Suno sa presidente, “tuman na kalapit” ang negotiators sa pinal nga proposal nga amo ang ipresentar sa atubang sang Israel kag Hamas militants..
english: The president said negotiators are “very close” to the final proposal to be presented to Israel and Hamas militants.

text: Nahibaluan nga binulan na nga ginatulod sang US kag mediators halin sa Egypt kag Qatar ang pagbayluhanay sang preso kag mga bihag sa Gaza amo man ang pagpatigayon sang ceasefire sa gyera.
english: The US and mediators from Egypt and Qatar have been pushing for months to exchange prisoners and hostages in Gaza as well as a ceasefire in the war.

text: Matandaan nga 251 ka mga bihag ang gindala sang militante sa Gaza matapos nag-atake sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 2023 apang 97 pa diri ang nagapabilin sa Gaza Strip kun sa diin 33 sa ila ang bangkay na suno sa Israeli military.
english: It can be recalled that 251 hostages were taken by the militants to Gaza after attacking southern Israel in October 2023 but 97 of them remain in the Gaza Strip where 33 of them are dead, according to the Israeli military.

text: Sa pagtimalos sang Israel sa amo nga atake, masobra na sa 40,700 ang napatay sa Gaza Strip nga kadam-an mga sibilyan, kabataan, kag kababainhan suno sa UN human rights office.
english: In Israel's retaliation for the attack, more than 40,700 people have been killed in the Gaza Strip, mostly civilians, children, and women, according to the UN human rights office.

text: Wala sang pangduha-duha nga gin sabat sang aktres nga si Bella Padilla ang pamangkot sang isa ka fan sa iya social media may kaangtanan sa engagement sang iya ex nga si film producer Neil Arce kag aktres Angel Locsin.
english: Actress Bella Padilla did not hesitate to answer a fan's question on her social media regarding the engagement of her ex, film producer Neil Arce and actress Angel Locsin.

text: Suno kay Bella hindi sya affected sa engagement news kag sya ang happy para sa duha.
english: Bella said she is not affected by the engagement news and she is happy for both.

text: Madumduman nga ginkumpirma ni Bella ang breakup kay Neil sang January 2017 pagkatapos sang 4 ka tuig nga relasyon.
english: Bella confirmed her breakup with Neil in January 2017 after four years of relationship.

text: Sa pihak sini suno kay Bella nagapabilin man sa gihapon nga in good terms ang iya relationship sa iya nga ex kag sa current girlfriend nga si Angel Locsin.
english: Despite this, Bella said her relationship with her ex and current girlfriend Angel Locsin remains in good terms.

text: Nagpaandam sa publiko ang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) sa pagbakal kag paggamit sang Kirkland Signature Vitamin C tablet bangud indi ini rehistrado sa ahensya.
english: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has warned the public against buying and using Kirkland Signature Vitamin C tablets because they are not registered with the agency.

text: Naga-issue sang Certificate of Product Registration ang FDA agud pahanugutan ang manufacturers sang produkto nga magbaligya sang bulong agud nga masiguro nga safe ini kag epektibo.
english: The FDA issues a Certificate of Product Registration to allow product manufacturers to sell drugs to ensure that they are safe and effective.

text: Santu sa advisory nga ginpaguwa sang ahensya, indi nila masiguro ang kalidad kag safety sang nasambit nga bulong bangud wala ini nag-agi sa proseso.
english: According to the advisory issued by the agency, they cannot guarantee the quality and safety of the drug because it did not go through the process.

text: Naghingyo man ang FDA sa local government units kag kapulisan nga siguruhon nga wala sang may ginabaligya nga kaangay nga bulong sa lugar nga nasakupan.
english: The FDA also urged local government units and police to ensure that no such drugs are sold in the area.

text: Bukas ang Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 sa integration sang theoretical driving seminar para sa mga estudyante sa mga eskwelahan sa rehiyon.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 is open to the integration of theoretical driving seminar for students in schools in the region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Director sang Land Transportation Office Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga isa ang tikang ka oportunidad agud nga madasig nga ma-edukar ang mga estudyante nahanungod sa insakto nga pag-drive.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Director of the Land Transportation Office Region 6, said the move is an opportunity to quickly educate students about proper driving.

text: Suno kay Geduspan, ang Drivers Education Center sa Bacolod City, ang nagapakig-angot man sa tagsa ka eskwelahan agud nga mapatigayon ang amo nga tikang.
english: According to Geduspan, the Drivers Education Center in Bacolod City, is also in contact with each school to implement the move.

text: Dugang ni Geduspan nga ginalantaw sang talatapan ang resolusyon nga nagamando man sa ila agud magpartisipar sa isa ka theoretical driving seminar sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Geduspan added that the office is looking into the resolution that also orders them to participate in a theoretical driving seminar in Iloilo province.

text: Indi paman matumod sang natungdan ang proseso sa paghatag sang certificate kasunod sang seminar apang, bukas ang talatapan nga maghatag sang student permit.
english: He could not specify the process of issuing certificates following the seminar but the office is open to issue student permits.

text: Nagpanugyan man si Geduspan sa mga estudyante nga may luyag nga magpasakop nga sundon ang mga requirements agud nga matalunsay sila nga matudluan.
english: Geduspan also advised students who wish to participate to follow the requirements so that they can be taught smoothly.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang pinal nga pagsulundan ang LTO-6 sa pagpatuman sang amo nga tikang.
english: At present, the LTO-6 has no final rules on the implementation of the measure.

text: Naghingyo si Pope Francis sa mga tumuluo nga Katoliko nga ipangamuyo ang iya pagbyahe padulong sa Asya kag Oceania subong nga semana.
english: Pope Francis has asked the Catholic faithful to pray for his trip to Asia and Oceania this week.

text: Subong nga adlaw magabiya sa Vatican ang Santo Papa para sa 12 ka adlaw nga byahe sa apat ka lugar nga amo ang Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, East Timor ukon Timor Leste kag Singapore.
english: The Pope will leave the Vatican today for a 12-day trip to four places namely Indonesia, Papua New Guinea, East Timor or Timor Leste and Singapore.

text: Yara sa 33,000 km (20,500 miles) ang ma-cover sang sini nga byahe nga amo ang ginalantaw pinakamalawig nga apostolic trip sang subong 87-anyos na nga head sang Catholic Church.
english: The 87-year-old head of the Catholic Church will cover a distance of 33,000 km (20,500 miles).
