text: Magluwas sa byahe, ginapreparahan man sini ang 16 ka mga speech nga iya i-deliver sa mga misa bilang pagpakita sang nagatubo nga Catholic community sa sini nga mga pungsod.
english: Besides the trip, he is also preparing 16 speeches to deliver at masses as a showcase of the growing Catholic community in these countries.

text: Sa Indonesia, natalana ini nga magpakigkita kay outgoing President Joko Widodo kag sa mga tiglawas sang dalagku nga relihiyon sa Istiqlal Mosque (nga amo ang pinakadaku sa Southeast Asia) kag magapirma man sa joint declaration kaupod sa grand imam nga si Nasaruddin Umar.
english: In Indonesia, he is scheduled to meet with outgoing President Joko Widodo and representatives of major religions at the Istiqlal Mosque (which is the largest in Southeast Asia) and will also sign a joint declaration with grand imam Nasaruddin Umar.

text: Ang Indonesia amo ang pinakadaku nga Muslim nation sa kalibutan apang ginakilala sini ang Protestantism, Catholicism, Buddhism, Hinduism kag Confucianism.
english: Indonesia is the largest Muslim nation in the world but recognizes Protestantism, Catholicism, Buddhism, Hinduism and Confucianism.

text: Ini nga byahe sa rehiyon amo ang iya-45 nga pagbisita sa abroad.
english: This trip to the region will be his-45th visit abroad.

text: Una ini nga ginplano para sa 2020 apang wala nadayon bangud sa Covid-19 pandemic.
english: It was originally planned for 2020 but was canceled due to the Covid-19 pandemic.

text: Sa sulod sang sini nga apat ka tuig, daku ang ginhina sa ikaayong lawas ni Pope Francis rason nga nagasakay ini sa wheelchair, nagpaidalom sa hernia surgery sang nagligad nga tuig, kag may yara man sang ginasuprer nga respiratory issues.
english: During these four years, Pope Francis' health has deteriorated so much that he is confined to a wheelchair, underwent hernia surgery last year, and is also suffering from respiratory issues.

text: Ang katapusan sini nga byahe sa luwas sang pungsod ang natabo sa Marseille sa France sang September 2023.
english: The last of this international flight took place in Marseille in France in September 2023.

text: Indi pa tapos ang hampang para kay Pinoy Wheelchair racer Jerrold Mangliwan matapos na-disqualify sa men’s 400m T52 final round sa Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
english: The game is not over for Pinoy Wheelchair racer Jerrold Mangliwan after he was disqualified from the men’s 400m T52 final round at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay national para athletic coach Joel Deriada, iya ginpahayag nga apisar na-disqualify, wala nadula ang pagka-bilib niya kay Mangliwan bangud na-break sini ang iya nga rekord sa oras nga 1 minute and .80 seconds kag nangin fifth best sa hampang.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, national para athletic coach Joel Deriada said that despite being disqualified, he did not lose his admiration for Mangliwan because he broke his record in 1 minute and .80 seconds and became fifth best in the game.

text: Suno sa coach, sa 13 ka atleta, dako na nga bugal nga nangin ika-lima si Mangliwan apisar na-disqualify ini.
english: According to the coach, out of 13 athletes, Mangliwan was proud to finish fifth despite being disqualified.

text: Matandaan nga nalapas sang nasambit nga para-athlete ang Rule 18.5 sang World Para Athletics nga nakasaad nga indi pwede makaguwa sa ila nga respective lanes ang mga atleta kun mag-overtake sa ila nga kasumpong sa karera.
english: It can be recalled that the said para-athlete violated Rule 18.5 of World Para Athletics which states that athletes are not allowed to leave their respective lanes if they overtake their opponent in the race.

text: Sa pihak sini, buhi pa ang paglaom bangud magahampang pa si Mangliwan karon sa gab-i las 8:45 sa 1500m T52 kag kun mag-qualify, magahampang siya sa men’s 100m T52 sa Septyembre 2.
english: Meanwhile, hope is still alive as Mangliwan will play tonight at 8:45 in the 1500m T52 and if he qualifies, he will play in the men’s 100m T52 on September 2.

text: Patay ang 15 ka Islamic State militant group fighters sa military operation sang Estados Unidos sa Anbar sa western Iraq.
english: Fifteen Islamic State militant group fighters were killed in a US military operation in Anbar in western Iraq.

text: Sa amo nga operasyon, anum man ka mga soldado sang Estados Unidos ang nasamaran.
english: During the operation, six US soldiers were also wounded.

text: Ginsiling sang US defense officials nga pila sa napatay sa operasyon ang naga-uyat sang posisyon sa liderato sang amo nga militante nga grupo.
english: US defense officials said some of those killed in the operation held leadership positions in the militant group.

text: Antes ang operasyon, nag-partner ang U.S. Central Command sa Iraqi security forces ilabi na bangud armado ang ISIS operatives sang nagkalain-lain nga weapons, grenades, kag explosive ‘suicide’ belts.
english: Before the operation, the U.S. Central Command partnered with Iraqi security forces especially since the ISIS operatives were armed with various weapons, grenades, and explosive ‘suicide’ belts.

text: Pahayag pa sang central command, ginhimo ang operasyon para papason ang abilidad sang ISIS nga magplano, mag-organisar, kag magpatigayon sang atake sa mga sibilyan sa Iraq amo man sa mga pumuluyo sang Amerika kag ila mga kaalyado.
english: The central command said the operation was conducted to eliminate ISIS's ability to plan, organize, and carry out attacks on civilians in Iraq as well as on American citizens and their allies.

text: Wala sang indikasyon nga may nadalahig nga mga sibilyan sang tion nga ginhimo ang raid.
english: There was no indication that civilians were involved at the time the raid was conducted.

text: Yara sa 1.1 million learners ang magabalik-eskwela sa Hunyo 16, 2025 nga nagahalin sa isla sang Panay kag Guimaras ukon Western Visayas.
english: About 1.1 million learners will return to school on June 16, 2025 from the islands of Panay and Guimaras or Western Visayas.

text: Ini kasunod man sang opisyal nga pag-anunsyo sang Department of Education (DepEd) nga ang mga pampubliko nga eskwelahan sa bilog nga pungsod magabukas sang klase sa Hunyo 16, para sa School Year 2025–2026.
english: This also follows the official announcement by the Department of Education (DepEd) that public schools nationwide will resume classes on June 16, for School Year 2025–2026.

text: Ini nga pagbalik amo ang pagsunod sa pre-pandemic school calendar, base sa DepEd Order No.
english: This return is in compliance with the pre-pandemic school calendar, based on DepEd Order No.

text: 12, Series of 2025.
english: 12, Series of 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., Spokesperson sang Department of Education Region VI, iya ginpahayag nga ang school year magatapos sa Marso 31, 2026 kag magalawig sang 197 ka adlaw ang klase, lakip na ang End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., Spokesperson of the Department of Education Region VI, said the school year will end on March 31, 2026 and will last 197 days of classes, including End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites.

text: Suno kay Escullar, posible pa ini magbag-o depende sa mga indi mapunggan nga hitabo ukon dugang nga mga mando sa palaabuton.
english: Escullar said that could still change depending on unforeseen events or additional mandates in the future.

text: Dugang sini nga apisar nga opisyal nag nagseparar na ang Negros Occidental sa rehiyon, makabig sa gihapon nga madamo ang mga maga-eskwela nga estudyante.
english: He added that although Negros Occidental has officially separated from the region, there are still many students.

text: Ang enrollment kag Brigada Eskwela patigayunon halin Hunyo 9 tubtob 13, isa ka semana antes opisyal nga magsugod ang klase.
english: Enrollment and Brigada Eskwela will be held from June 9 to 13, a week before classes officially begin.

text: Pagpaathag ni Escullar, ini nga desisyon nagsunod sa pag-aprubar ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Escullar explained that this decision followed the approval of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: sang Mayo sang nagligad nga tuig nga ibalik sa tradisyonal nga Hunyo tubtob Marso ang school calendar — nga amo ang nakasanayan sang madamo nga manunudlo, ginikanan, kag mga estudyante antes pa nagbag-o bangod sang pandemya.
english: of May last year to return to the traditional June through March school calendar — which many teachers, parents, and students were used to before the pandemic changed.

text: Ginka kibot ni Broadway star kag singer Lea Salonga sang siya ang masal-an nga environmentalist sa isa ka TV show sa UK.
english: Broadway star and singer Lea Salonga was shocked when she was cast as an environmentalist on a TV show in the UK.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag guest si Lea Salonga sa Sky News morning show agud ipromote ang iya nga concert tour apang nakibot ang broadway superstar sang sala nga ngalan ang ginlawag sang news anchor nga si Stephen Dixon sang sya ang ginpakilala.
english: Lea Salonga guested on the Sky News morning show to promote her concert tour but the broadway superstar was surprised when news anchor Stephen Dixon looked for the wrong name when he was introduced.

text: Ang broadway superstar ang nasal-an nga si Anna Hughes nga isa ka environmental campaigner.
english: The broadway superstar happens to be Anna Hughes who is an environmental campaigner.

text: Depensa naman ni Dixon nakibot man sya samtang gina basa nya ang script bangud nahibaluan nya nga singer ang iya bisita.
english: Dixon said he was surprised while reading the script because he knew his guest was a singer.

text: Gindayaw naman si Lea bangud nga na-handle niya sang maayo  awkward nga sitwasyon nga iya nalang ginkadlawan.
english: Lea was praised for handling an awkward situation that she just laughed at.

text: Ang broadway star nga si Salonga ang tingog sa likod sang Disney Princess nga si Mulan kag Princess Jasmine.
english: Broadway star Salonga is the voice behind Disney Princess Mulan and Princess Jasmine.

text: Nagnubo sa 40 percent ang pork production sang Pilipinas bangud sa African swine fever (ASF).
english: The Philippines' pork production has dropped by 40 percent due to African swine fever (ASF).

text: Suno sa United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), ginalauman nga magnubo sa one million metric tons ang produksyon sang baboy sa sini nga tuig mas manubo sa 10 percent sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), pork production is expected to fall to one million metric tons this year, down 10 percent from last year.

text: Pahayag sang ahensya, sa imbukada sang 2021, nagapang-alang-alang na ang commercial operators sa pagpadamo sang baboy tuga sang kahangawa sa ASF outbreaks kag restrictions sa hog marketing.
english: The agency said that at the beginning of 2021, commercial operators are hesitant to raise pigs due to concerns about ASF outbreaks and restrictions on hog marketing.

text: Santo sa data sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), nagnubo sa 25.8 percent ang hog production sa 421,790 metric tons sa first three quarter.
english: According to data from the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), hog production decreased by 25.8 percent to 421,790 metric tons in the first three quarters.

text: Magapasundayag na sa Paralympic Games subong nga adlaw, Agusto 26, ang Team Pilipinas sa Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.
english: Team Philippines will perform at the Paralympic Games today, August 26, at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.

text: Magapanguna sa paghampang ang para-swimmer nga si Gary Adornado Bejino sa 200m individual medley T52 event (las 8:32 a.m. Manila time) kag (las 4:22 p.m.) para sa finals kun mag-qualify ang bugal sang Albay, Bicol.
english: Swimmer Gary Adornado Bejino will lead the 200m individual medley T52 event (8:32 a.m. Manila time) and (4:22 p.m.) for the finals if the pride of Albay, Bicol qualifies.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo sa 25 anyos nga si Bejino, iya ginpahayag nga handa na siya kag focused ilabi na nga siya ang pinakauna nga maga-compete para sa Pilipinas.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, 25-year-old Bejino said he is ready and focused especially as he is the first to compete for the Philippines.

text: Apisar wala sang tuo nga kamot kag wala nga tiil matapos na-aksidente sang pito siya ka-tuig, nagalaom si Bejino nga mangin madinalag-on sa iya debut competition.
english: Despite losing his right hand and left leg after an accident when he was seven, Bejino hopes to be successful in his debut competition.

text: Nahibaluan nga nangin back-to-back gold medalist si Bejino sa ASEAN Para Games sang 2015 sa punsod Singapore kag sa Malaysia sang 2017.
english: Bejino won back-to-back gold medals at the ASEAN Para Games in 2015 in Singapore and in Malaysia in 2017.

text: Ginsulod sang barko sang Chinese navy ang dagat nga sakop na sang Japan.
english: The Chinese navy ship entered the waters that were already part of Japan.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sang Japanese Defense Ministry halos isa ka semana lang matapos gin-report nga iligal man nga ginsulod sang military aircraft sang Beijing ang airspace sang Tokyo.
english: The Japanese Defense Ministry made the announcement almost a week after it was reported that Beijing's military aircraft had also illegally entered Tokyo's airspace.

text: Ini na ang ika-10 nga tion halin sang Nobyembre 2021 nga nag-trespass ang Chinese survey ship sa kadagatan sang Japan partikular sa Kagoshima Prefecture.
english: This is the 10th time since November 2021 that a Chinese survey ship has trespassed in Japanese waters specifically in Kagoshima Prefecture.

text: Nakit-an ang vessel nga nagsulod sa territorial waters sa nakatundan ang Kuchinoerabu Island sang alas sais sang aga kag nagbiya naman sa nabagatnan-nakatundan sang Yakushima Island sang 7:53 a.m..
english: The vessel was spotted entering territorial waters west of Kuchinoerabu Island at 6 a.m. and leaving southwest of Yakushima Island at 7:53 a.m..

text: Agud ma-monitor ang Chinese vessel, nagpadala man ang Japanese Maritime Self-Defense Force sang minesweeper kag patrol aircraft.
english: To monitor the Chinese vessel, the Japanese Maritime Self-Defense Force also sent a minesweeper and patrol aircraft.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang survey vessels amo ang masami nga ginagamit sa pag-conduct sang research sa underwater topography para sa submarine navigation.
english: It is known that survey vessels are most commonly used to conduct research on underwater topography for submarine navigation.

text: Kun lantawon ang tension sa tunga sang China kag Japan, sini lang nga mga tinuig sang nagsinulod ang Chinese ships sa territorial waters sang Japan sa East China Sea sa palibot sang Japanese-controlled nga Senkaku Islands nga gina-claim man sang Beijing kag ila ginatawag nga Diaoyu.
english: In recent years, Chinese ships have entered Japan's territorial waters in the East China Sea around the Japanese-controlled Senkaku Islands, which Beijing also claims and calls Diaoyu.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Congressman Leandro Leviste sang Batangas 1st District nga wala sang opisyal nga bidding sa mga proyekto sang Department of Public Works and Highways.
english: Congressman Leandro Leviste of Batangas 1st District revealed that there is no official bidding on projects of the Department of Public Works and Highways.

text: Suno sa iya, ginapili na lang ang mga contractor nga may kahilapit sa mga opisyal, kapin pa kun may kickbacks nga ginahatag.
english: He said contractors who are close to officials are preferred, especially when kickbacks are given.

text: Ginsugid man ni District Engineer Abelardo Calalo kay Leviste ang pila ka ngalan sang mga daku nga contractor kag ang papel sang mga ini sa idalum sang anay nga kongresista.
english: District Engineer Abelardo Calalo also told Leviste some of the names of the big contractors and their role under the former congressman.

text: Suno kay Leviste, sa sulod sang 3 ka tuig, posible nga sobra 1 bilyon pesos ang matago para sa isa ka kongresista.
english: According to Leviste, within 3 years, it is possible to save more than 1 billion pesos for a congressman.

text: Gindugang pa niya nga ginadul-ong siya sang mga contractor bangud ginainspeksyon niya ang mga flood-control projects sa distrito, kalakip na ang mga proyekto nga madali lang nga maguba.
english: He added that he is accompanied by contractors because he inspects flood-control projects in the district, including projects that are easily damaged.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga kun nakabaton na sang kickback ang isa ka kongresista, wala na niya ini ginabisita kag ginainbestigaran ang mga substandard nga proyekto.
english: He said that once a congressman receives a kickback, he does not visit him and investigate substandard projects.

text: Nanindugan si Leviste nga dapat matapos na ang korapsyon sa sulod sang Department of Public Works and Highways.
english: Leviste insisted that corruption within the Department of Public Works and Highways must end.

text: kag ginahingyo niya ang mga empleyado kag contractor nga magbulig bilang state witness agud mas mabal-an pa ang kadalumon sang korapsyon.
english: and he urged employees and contractors to help as state witnesses to learn more about the depth of corruption.

text: Ginpasidunggan man niya ang madinalag-on nga tikang ni Secretary Manuel Bonoan, kag ginpabutyag nga handa siya magpakig-angut kun may kinahanglan.
english: He also praised the successful initiative of Secretary Manuel Bonoan, and expressed his readiness to cooperate if necessary.

text: Wala napunggan ni Gian Frederick Arellano ang iya kalipay matapos nga nakuha sang ila team nga Western Visayas ang kampyonato sa Sepak Takraw Secondary Boys sa Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: Gian Frederick Arellano could not contain his joy after his team Western Visayas won the Sepak Takraw Secondary Boys championship in the Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Arellano, iya ginpahayag nga indi nangin mahapos ang ila naagyan sang iya nga team antes nakuha ang kadalag-an.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Arellano said it was not easy for his team to go through before winning.

text: Suno sa natungdan, antes pa man pormal nga nagsugod ang Palaro, nag-angkon ini sang duha ka injuries, apang, wala ini nangin upang sa iya agud nga malab-ot ang handom nga gold medal.
english: He said that before the Palaro formally started, he suffered two injuries, but this did not stop him from achieving his dream gold medal.

text: Apisar nga ini ang labing-una kag ulihi nga pagpasakop ni Arellano sa amo nga hampang, ginpasigurado sini nga indi siya mag-untat sa paghampang sang Sepak Takraw.
english: Although this is Arellano's first and last participation in the game, he assured that he will not stop playing Sepak Takraw.

text: Bangud sa abilidad ni Arellano, napilian ini sang Team sang Sepak Takraw sang Sta.
english: Because of Arellano's ability, he was selected by the Sepak Takraw Team of Sta.

text: Barbara.
english: Barbara.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Arellano ang tumandok sang Brgy.
english: Arellano is a native of Brgy.

text: Dalid, Alimodian, Iloilo, kon sa diin, lakip sa iya kaupdanan sa team nga sanday Clark Jerson Rabino, Kent Daryl Valentin, kag Redmark Alido ang lunsay tumandok man sang amo nga banwa.
english: Dalid, Alimodian, Iloilo, where, among his teammates, Clark Jerson Rabino, Kent Daryl Valentin, and Redmark Alido are all natives of the same town.

text: Nabuhinan ang mga Filipino para-athletes nga magahampang sa nagahilapit nga Tokyo Paralympics.
english: The number of Filipino para-athletes who will compete in the upcoming Tokyo Paralympics has decreased.

text: Ini matapos ginkumpirma ni Philippine Paralympic Committee president Mike Barredo nga isa sa anum ka atleta ang nagpositibo sa COVID-19.
english: This comes after Philippine Paralympic Committee president Mike Barredo confirmed that one of the six athletes tested positive for COVID-19.

text: Bangud sang 10-day quarantine ukon isolation nga protocol sang National Inter-Agency Task Force, indi na eligible ang amo nga para-athlete para sa Paralympics nga scheduled kuntani sa Agusto 24 tubtob sa Septyembre 5.
english: Due to the 10-day quarantine or isolation protocol of the National Inter-Agency Task Force, the athlete is no longer eligible for the Paralympics scheduled for August 24 to September 5.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Barredo nga may officials kag coaches man nga kabahin kuntani sang Philippine delegation nga nagpositibo man sa virus.
english: Barredo also said that there are officials and coaches who were supposed to be part of the Philippine delegation who also tested positive for the virus.

text: “It is unfortunate for us to inform the public that some officials, coaches, and a para-athlete of our Philippine delegation bound for Tokyo to participate in the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games have tested positive for COVID-19,” kabahin sang statement ni Barredo.
english: “It is unfortunate for us to inform the public that some officials, coaches, and a para-athlete of our Philippine delegation bound for Tokyo to participate in the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games have tested positive for COVID-19,” Barredo said in a statement.

text: Gin-athag sang natungdan nga ang mga nagpositibo sa virus ang indi kabahin sang Philippine Paralympic contingent nga nagbiya na sa pungsod kag nagpadulong sa Japan subong nga Domingo.
english: He explained that those who tested positive for the virus were not part of the Philippine Paralympic contingent that left the country and headed for Japan this Sunday.

text: ILOILO – Daku ang nangin bulig sang social media sa maduagon nga love story sang isa ka Ilongga kag Amerikano.
english: ILOILO – Social media has been a big help in the successful love story of an Ilongga and an American.

text: Ginpamatu-ad sang mag-asawa nga sanday Ann Salinas-Winston, 42, kag Paul Winston, 52, nga wala sang may ginapili ang paghigugma.
english: Ann Salinas-Winston, 42, and Paul Winston, 52, proved that love doesn't discriminate.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa ilongga nga si Ann Salinas-Winston sang Sta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ilongga Ann Salinas-Winston of Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nagkilalahay sila sang iya bana nga si Paul paagi sa social media sang 2013.
english: Barbara, Iloilo, she said she met her husband Paul through social media in 2013.

text: Suno kay Ann, wala niya ginhuna-huna nga iya gid mapamana ang lalaki nga iya lamang nakilala paagi sa chat kag video call.
english: According to Ann, she never thought she would marry the man she only met through chat and video calls.

text: Bilang isa ka single mom kag may isa kaanak, ginpahayag ni Ann nga wala niya ginhatag ang lubos nga pagsalig kay Paul agud nga makalikaw sa konsekwensya.
english: As a single mom with one child, Ann said she didn’t give full trust to Paul in order to escape the consequences.

text: Samtang nagadugay, iya nakilala si Paul nga isa ka maayo nga tawo tubtub nga sila ang nagkitaay kag nagpakasal sang 2016.
english: As time went on, she found Paul to be a nice guy until they met and got married in 2016.

text: Lakip sa nagpabilib kay Ann amo ang kaisog ni Paul nga magpadulong sa Iloilo agud nga makilala ang iya pamilya.
english: Among the things that impressed Ann was Paul's courage to go to Iloilo to meet his family.

text: Daku nga pagpanghangkat sa ila relasyon suno kay Ann amonga sa tagsa ka tatlo tubtub apat lang ka bulan lang nagapauli sa Iloilo si Paul bangud nga may yara siya sang negosyo kag trabaho Chicago, Illinois sa Estados Unidos.
english: Ann said Paul only returns to Iloilo every three to four months because he has a business and job in Chicago, Illinois in the United States.

text: Indi man malikawan suno sa natungdan nga may yara sang negatibo nga reaksyon ang iban nga tawo sa ila relasyon apang ginpahayag ni Ann nga ang importante amo nga nagapalangga-anay sila ni Paul.
english: It is inevitable that some people will have a negative reaction to their relationship but Ann said the important thing is that she and Paul love each other.

text: Nagalaum naman si Ann nga maka-apas sa Estados Unidos kaupod ang iya tatlo ka mga kabataan agud nga makilala sa personal ang pamilya sang iya bana.
english: Ann hopes to travel to the United States with her three children to meet her husband's family in person.

text: Wala gihapon matumod sang otoridad kun sa diin naghalin ang lapsag nga nasapwan wala na sang kabuhi nga nagalutaw sa punong sang Brgy.
english: Authorities are still unable to determine the origin of the baby who was found dead floating in a tree in Brgy.

text: South San Jose, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: South San Jose, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lenore Ravena Enriquez, City Social Welfare and Development – Molo District Focal Person, iya ginpahayag nga kumpirmado naman nga indi sa South San Jose naghalin ang bata bangud wala sang narekord nga residente nga nagabusong sa lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lenore Ravena Enriquez, City Social Welfare and Development – ​​Molo District Focal Person, said it was confirmed that the child did not come from South San Jose because there were no recorded pregnant residents in the area.

text: Suno kay Enriquez, ginausisa man sang kapulisan ang iban nga barangay agud mahibaluan kun may yara sila sang record sang mga pumuluyo nga nagabusong nga posible iloy sang lapsag.
english: Enriquez said police are also investigating other barangays to see if they have records of pregnant residents who may be the mother of the baby.

text: Matandaan nga nasapwan-patay sang isa ka manugpangisda ang lapsag nga fully developed na, kag isa ka baby girl.
english: It can be recalled that a fisherman found dead a fully developed baby, and a baby girl.

text: Gindala ini sa simbahan kag ginpamisahan bag-o ginhatagan sang disente nga pagpalubong.
english: He was taken to the church and offered mass before being given a decent burial.

text: MIAG-AO, ILOILO – Ang pagtuon sang maayo ang nangin sekreto sang labing una nga Magna Cum Laude sang Communication and Media Studies sang University of the Philippines – Visayas (UPV).
english: MIAG-AO, ILOILO – Studying well is the secret of the first Magna Cum Laude of Communication and Media Studies of the University of the Philippines – Visayas (UPV).

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga Graduation Ceremony sang UPV sa Miag-ao, Iloilo sang Hunyo 27, isa si Ge-Ann Marie Arenga sang Roxas City, Capiz ang nagpagkit sang sang kasaysayan sa nasambit nga unibersidad.
english: At the Graduation Ceremony of UPV in Miag-ao, Iloilo on June 27, Ge-Ann Marie Arenga of Roxas City, Capiz was one of the graduates who made history at the university.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Arenga, iya ginpahayag nga ang iya ginpili nga kurso ang may kaangtanan sa iya huyog sa patag sang news writing, script writing kag paghimu sang film projects.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Arenga said his choice of course is related to his interest in news writing, script writing and film projects.

text: Ini ang rason suno kay Arenga kun nga-a mas ginpili niya ang Communication and Media Studies ipaanggid sa iya napasaran nga kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Biology.
english: Arenga said this is the reason why he chose Communication and Media Studies compared to his Bachelor of Science in Biology.

text: Kun kaisa suno kay Arenga, indi madula ang stigma sa mga Communication course apang bilang isa ka estudyante, iya napamatud-an nga mabudlay ang nasambit nga kurso.
english: Sometimes, according to Arenga, the stigma of Communication courses does not disappear but as a student, he proved that the said course is difficult.

text: Magluwas nga madamu ang tulun-an, madamu man ang mga proyekto nga dapat ipasa santo sa deadline.
english: In addition to the many books, there are also many projects that must be submitted according to the deadline.

text: Sa pihak sang kabudlay, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga importante gid nga hatagan sang tion ang pagtuon ilabi na kun may yara sang exams kag kun may mga school project nga dapat tapuson.
english: Despite the difficulties, he said it is important to give time to study especially when there are exams and school projects to be completed.

text: Sa iya bahin suno kay Arenga, may yara siya sang kaugalingon nga pamaagi sa pagtuon nga makabig nga pinasahi ipaanggid sa iban nga estudyante.
english: For his part, Arenga said, he has his own way of learning that is considered unique compared to other students.

text: Lakip sa nangin inspirasyon sang UPV achiever amo nga mahatagan sang maayo nga pangabuhi ang iya pamilya.
english: Among the inspirations of the UPV achiever is to provide a better life for his family.

text: Sa pihak sang tanan nga kabudlay, ginpahayag ni Arenga nga ang pinakamasadya nga bahin sang iya kabuhi amo ang paghatag sang kahigayunan sa iya ginikanan nga makasaka sa entablado kadungan sang Graduation Ceremony bilang tanda sang iya pagtapos nga may yara sang Latin Honor.
english: Despite all the hardships, Arenga said the happiest part of his life was giving his parents the opportunity to take the stage in conjunction with the Graduation Ceremony to mark his graduation with Latin Honor.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang pinal nga desisyon si Arenga tuhoy sa iya pagasudlan nga trabaho.
english: At present, Arenga has not yet made a final decision on his job.

text: Magadayon sa pagbisita si Russian President Vladimir Putin sa Mongolia apisar nga ini nga pungsod ang miyembro sang International Criminal Court (ICC) nga amo anay ang nag-isyu sang warrant of arrest batok sa iya.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin will continue his visit to Mongolia despite the fact that the country is a member of the International Criminal Court (ICC) which previously issued a warrant of arrest against him.

text: Natalana ang byahe sang Russian leader sa Septyembre 3.
english: The Russian leader's flight is scheduled for September 3.

text: Ini ang iya una nga byahe sa isa ka member state sang ICC halin sang nagpaguwa ang amo nga korte sa The Hague sang arrest warrant sang Marso 2023 base sa akusasyon nga responsable si Putin sa illegal deportation sang Ukrainian children pakadto sa Russia kag sa Russian-controlled territory.
english: It will be his first trip to an ICC member state since that court in The Hague issued an arrest warrant in March 2023 based on the accusation that Putin was responsible for the illegal deportation of Ukrainian children to Russia and Russian-controlled territory.

text: Ini nga pagbisita sa Mongolia ang kasunod mismo sa imbitasyon ni Mongolian President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh.
english: This visit to Mongolia follows the invitation of Mongolian President Ukhnaa Khurelsukh.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang Rome Statute nga amo ang founding treaty sang ICC, ang mga pungsod nga miyembro sini ang mahimo maka-detain sa mga suspek nga nadagdagan sang korte sang arrest warrant kun magtapak ini sa ila teritoryo.
english: Under the Rome Statute, the founding treaty of the ICC, member countries can detain suspects whose arrest warrants have been extended by the court if they enter their territory.

text:
Kaangot diri, nagpanawagan naman ang Ukraine nga dakpon si Putin nga ila gintawag nga “war criminal.”

Matandaan nga ang arrest warrant nga gin-isyu sang ICC kay Putin amo ang una nga bes nga may ginpadakop ini nga lider halin sa isa ka lima ka permanent members sang United Nations Security Council.
english:
In this regard, Ukraine called for the arrest of Putin, whom they called a “war criminal.”

It can be recalled that the arrest warrant issued by the ICC against Putin is the first time it has arrested a leader from one of the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council.

text: NAGTAPOS na ang duha ka semana nga pagtililipon sa Egypt sang mga lideres kag mga tiglawas sang mga 200 ka mga pungsod sadtong Nobyembre 18 para sa ika-27 nga “Conference of the Parties” sang UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), ukon COP27.
english: THE two-week gathering of leaders and representatives of some 200 countries in Egypt on November 18 for the 27th “Conference of the Parties” of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), or COP27, ended.

text: Ginpanindugan nila diri ang pila ka pagbag-o (na naman!) sang mga hingyo batok sa Climate Change nga ginhisugtan sadto sa idalom sang COP26.
english: They insisted here on several revisions (again!) of demands against Climate Change previously agreed under COP26.

text: Ginhiwat ang COP26 sadtong Nobyembre 2020 sa Glascow, Scotland kon diin gin-“revisit and strengthen” ang “climate pledges” nga ginpasalig sang COP sa Paris Agreement of 2015.
english: COP26 was held in November 2020 in Glascow, Scotland where the climate pledges committed by the COP in the Paris Agreement of 2015 were revisited and strengthened.

text: Gintukod ang UNFCCC sadtong 1992 Earth Summit sa Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
english: The UNFCCC was established during the 1992 Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

text:
***

Sa COP26 ginhisugtan nga limitahan sa 2.0 degrees Celsius lang ang madugang nga init pangkalibutan (Global Warming), nga posible mapanubo pa gani sa 1.50 C, tubtub sa 2030.
english:
***

At COP26 it was agreed to limit global warming to 2.0 degrees Celsius, which could be reduced to 1.50 C, by 2030.

text: Target man ang paglab-ut sa “net zero”, ukon matupongan ang produksyon sang greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions sang ma-remove nga GHG sa atmospera sa pag-abot sang 2050.
english: The target is to reach “net zero”, or equal the production of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions to the removal of GHG from the atmosphere by 2050.

text: Sa subong, may 1.10 C tubtub 1.20 C nga Global Warming ang nagdugang na halin sang panahon sang Industrial Revolution sadtong 1800.
english: Currently, there is a 1.10 C to 1.20 C global warming increase since the Industrial Revolution in the 1800s.

text:
***

May 12 ka pahina ang COP27 Agreement nga ginpirmahan sang tanan nga mga lideres kag mga tiglawas sang mga 200 ka mga pungsod nga katapo sang COP.
english:
***

There are 12 pages of the COP27 Agreement signed by all the leaders and representatives of about 200 COP member countries.

text: Ginhisugtan diri sa COP27 ang masunod (sa ginpalip-ut naton nga sinulatan nanday Louise Boyle kag Saphora Smith sa Yahoo News/Nov.
english: The following was agreed at COP27 (in our abridged article by Louise Boyle and Saphora Smith in Yahoo News/Nov.

text:
22, 2022):

1.Ang pagpatuman, sa ngalan sang “climate justice”,  sang pondo para sa “loss and damages” sang mga “developing nations”, nga matudlo sa sobra-sobra nga pagbuga sang mga GHG, nga 75% sini ang carbon dioxide, sang mga industriya sang mga “developed nations” – nga nagpanghalit sang bug-os nga kalibutan lakip na ang mga pungsod nga may “small carbon footprints”.
english:
22, 2022):

The implementation, in the name of climate justice, of a fund for loss and damages of developing nations, which can be attributed to the excessive emissions of GHGs, of which 75% are carbon dioxide, by the industries of developed nations – which have damaged the entire world including countries with a small carbon footprint.

text: Gintudlo nila diri ang 30 anyos nga “loss and damages” nga naagom nila sugod sa pagtukod ang UNFCCC sadtong 1992.
english: They pointed to the 30 years of “loss and damages” they have suffered since the establishment of the UNFCCC in 1992.

text: Sadto, tubtub sa COP26, wala ini ginpasugtan sang mga “developed” kag manggaran nga mga pungsod.
english: Back then, until COP26, it was not allowed by the “developed” and rich countries.

text: Angot diri, ang COP27 Agreement nagtukod sang “transitional committee” halin sa 24 ka pungsod agud seguruhon kon paano ini matigayon kag kon diin magahalin ang pondo,  nga aksyunan pa ugaling sa COP28 sa United Arab Emirates (UAE) sa 2023.
english: In this regard, the COP27 Agreement established a “transitional committee” of 24 countries to ensure how this is achieved and where the funds will come from, which will be actioned at COP28 in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) in 2023.

text: Buhion (keep “alive”) ang 1.50 C bilang limite nga dugang nga init pangkalibutanon.
english: Keep alive 1.50 C as the limit for global warming.

text: Sa report sang COP27 gin-aku sini ang kapaslawan sang madamo nga mga pungsod sa pagpanubo  sang ila GHG emissions sa idalom sang COP26.
english: In the COP27 report it acknowledged the failure of many countries to reduce their GHG emissions under COP26.

text: Panugyan gid ini sang mga “developing” kag “vulnerable” nga mga pungsod.
english: Panugyan gid ini sang mga “developing” kag “vulnerable” nga mga pungsod.

text: Lakip diri ang Filipinas, ang “Most Vulnerable” nga pungsod sa Climate Change.
english: This includes the Philippines, the “Most Vulnerable” country to Climate Change.

text: Ginsiling pa gani nila nga ang kapaslawan sa pagpatuman sang limite sa 1.50 C nga Global Warming isa ka “death sentence” para sa ila.
english: Ginsiling pa gani nila nga ang kapaslawan sa pagpatuman sang limite sa 1.50 C nga Global Warming isa ka “death sentence” para sa ila.

text: Labi gid natublag diri ang mga pungsod nga ang kadutaan manubo sa dagat.
english: Countries with land below sea level are especially affected.

text: Sa karon, siling nila, sa pagsaka pa lang sa 1.20 C sang init pangkalibutanon naga-experyensya na gani sila sang “devastating impact” sang Climate Change.
english: Today, they say, with just a 1.20 C rise in global warming they are already experiencing the “devastating impact” of Climate Change.

text:
Sunu sa mga siyentipiko, kinahanglan sa subong nga ma-cut by 43% ang global temperature agud indi magtaas pa ang Global Warming sing 1.50 C.

Napaslawan diri ang panawagan sang pila ka pungsod kag mga climate activists agud pauntaton sing lubos ang paggamit sang fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) – ang mayor gid nga kabangdanan sang “global climate crisis”.
english:
According to scientists, the global temperature needs to be cut by 43% to prevent global warming from rising by 1.50 C.

The call of some countries and climate activists to completely stop the use of fossil fuels (oil, natural gas, coal) – the main cause of the global climate crisis – has failed.

text: Ginpasalig lang diri sa COP27 ang pagpadasig sang pag-phasedown sang paggamit sang coal kag sang “inefficient fossil fuel subsidies”.
english: The acceleration of the phasedown of coal use and inefficient fossil fuel subsidies was just promised here at COP27.

text: Apang ginpasalig man sini ang targeted support para sa  “…the poorest and most vulnerable” nga mga pungsod.
english: But it also assured targeted support for  “…the poorest and most vulnerable” countries.

text: 3.Nagpanawagan man diri ang COP27 sa mabulig sang mga bangko agud mapahapos ang “access” sa bangko kag ang pagdihon sini sang “new vision” nga bagay sa pagsabat sa “global climate emergency”.
english: COP27 also called for the help of banks to facilitate access to banking and its development of a new vision to respond to the global climate emergency.

text: 4.Wala diri magpasugot ang mga “developed nations” agud doblehon pa ang “financing” para sa “vulnerable nations” nga na-doble na sadto sang Glascow Agreement tubtub sa 2025.
english: The developed nations did not agree to double the financing for vulnerable nations that was already doubled by the Glascow Agreement until 2025.

text: Apang ginpasalig nila diri sa COP27 Agreement ang pila ka bulig nga ginapangayo sang “vulnerable” nga mga pungsod.
english: But they promised here in the COP27 Agreement some of the help that “vulnerable” countries are asking for.

text: Lakip diri  ang pagpataas sang mga dalan agud malikawan ang “sea level rise”, pagpabalik sang mga wetlands kag coral reefs agud makasagang sa bagyo, kag ang pagtukod sang mabakod nga mga infra projects batok sa “extreme weather”.
english: Lakip diri  ang pagpataas sang mga dalan agud malikawan ang “sea level rise”, pagpabalik sang mga wetlands kag coral reefs agud makasagang sa bagyo, kag ang pagtukod sang mabakod nga mga infra projects batok sa “extreme weather”.

text: Matuman ayhan ining mga pasalig sang COP27 sa pag-abot sang COP28 sa 2023?
english: Will these COP27 commitments be fulfilled in the run-up to COP28 in 2023?

text: “Patup-a anay!” ang masiling lang seguro ni  Greta Thunberg nga “butigon” ang tawag sa sining Conference of Parties./PN
english: “Turn it off!” Greta Thunberg can only say that the Conference of Parties is called “liar”./PN

text: Isa sa pinakamabudlay nga matun-an amo ang paglangoy.
english: One of the hardest things to learn is swimming.

text: Pero mas mabudlay pa gid siguro tun-an ang paglakat…sa idalom sang tubig.
english: But it's probably even harder to learn to walk...underwater.

text: Apang may isa ka babaye sa Australia nga naglakat sa idalom sang tubig sa kalayuon nga 370 ka tapak.
english: But there was a woman in Australia who walked underwater for a distance of 370 feet.

text: Ini amo si Amber Bourke, 35, nga naga-freedive sa sulod sang kapin 10 ka tuig.
english: This is Amber Bourke, 35, who has been freediving for more than 10 years.

text: Ang ginhimo niya, naghaklo siya anay sang madamo nga oxygen, nagsalom sa pool kag naglakat sa salog.
english: What he did was he first took in a lot of oxygen, dived into the pool and walked on the floor.

text: Tuyo niya nga mag-break sang Guinness World Record para sa longest underwater walk with one breath (female).
english: She aims to break the Guinness World Record for the longest underwater walk with one breath (female).

text: Ang una nga record nga siya man ang naghimo amo ang 357 feet, 7 inches.
english: The previous record he also set was 357 feet, 7 inches.

text: Sang damlag lang, na-break niya ini paagi sa paglakat sa distansya nga 370 feet, 2 inches.
english: Recently, he broke it by walking a distance of 370 feet, 2 inches.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Bourke ang nagauyat na sang 17 ka Australian freediving records kag isa ka International Association for the Development of Apnea world record para sa swimming sa idalom sang dagat.
english: Bourke already holds 17 Australian freediving records and an International Association for the Development of Apnea world record for underwater swimming.

text: Ginbaligya na sang Villar Group ang PrimeWater Infrastructure Corp.
english: Villar Group has sold PrimeWater Infrastructure Corp.

text: sa Crystal Bridges Holding Corp.
english: to Crystal Bridges Holding Corp.

text: Ang Villar Group ginapamunuan sang bilyonaryo nga si anay senador Manny Villar.
english: The Villar Group is led by billionaire former senator Manny Villar.

text: Ang Crystal Bridges naman ang ginapanag-iyahan sang tycoon nga si Lucio Co.
english: Crystal Bridges is owned by tycoon Lucio Co.

text: Wala naman ginsapubliko ang balor sang transaksyon sang pag-acquire sang Crystal Bridges sang 100 percent sang PrimeWater.
english: The transaction value of Crystal Bridges' acquisition of 100 percent of PrimeWater was not disclosed.

text: Ang PrimeWater amo ang naga-operate sang water kag wastewater infrastructure projects sa bilog nga pungsod, kalakip na ang water district joint ventures, bulk water supply, kag septage and wastewater management services.
english: PrimeWater operates water and wastewater infrastructure projects nationwide, including water district joint ventures, bulk water supply, and septage and wastewater management services.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto, ginpahayag ni anay Senator Cynthia Villar nga luyag nila ibaligya ang Prime Water bangud wala man sila nagaginasya diri kag ginagamit lang ini sang iban agud gub-an sila sa politika.
english: In August, former Senator Cynthia Villar said they wanted to sell Prime Water because they are not making a profit from it and others are using it to destroy them politically.

text: Ginakalangkagan sang Filipino tennis fans ang bag-o nga anunsyo nga posible mag-host ang Pilipinas sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) 125 tournament sa masunod nga tuig.
english: Filipino tennis fans are looking forward to the new announcement that the Philippines is likely to host the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) 125 tournament next year.

text: Kaangay ini sa Guadalajara 125, Jingshan Tennis Open, kag sa Suzhou WTA 125.
english: This is similar to the Guadalajara 125, Jingshan Tennis Open, and the Suzhou WTA 125.

text: Isa ini ka tournament nga ginapasakupan sang mga dalagku na nga WTA players kag mga bag-uhan apang abilidaran sa tennis nga nagaplano nga mapapag-on pa ang ila karera kag makasaka sa mas mataas nga lebel sang WTA Tour.
english: It is a tournament for both veteran WTA players and new but talented tennis players who plan to further strengthen their careers and climb to the higher levels of the WTA Tour.

text: Sa matandaan, nagdaog ang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sang iya una nga WTA 125 title sa Guadalajara sa Mexico sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala won her first WTA 125 title in Guadalajara, Mexico last year.

text: Sandig sa Philippine Sports Commission (PSC), target nila nga patigayunon ang aktibidad sa Enero 26 tubtub Pebrero 1, 2026.
english: According to the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC), they target to hold the activity from January 26 to February 1, 2026.

text: Natabo ini nga development sang nagkit-anay sanday PSC chair Patrick Gregorio kag Navotas Mayor kag Philippine Tennis Association secretary-general John Rey Tiangco sang Septyemnre 29.
english: This development happened when PSC chair Patrick Gregorio and Navotas Mayor and Philippine Tennis Association secretary-general John Rey Tiangco met on September 29.

text: Magluwas sa sini nga potensyal nga tournament, maga-host man ang Pilipinas sang International Tennis Federation (ITF) J30 tournament sini nga tuig.
english: In addition to this potential tournament, the Philippines will also host the International Tennis Federation (ITF) J30 tournament this year.

text: Ginaplanuhan man nga buksan liwat ang Rizal Memorial Tennis Courts kag tukuron ang Philippine Tennis Center.
english: There are also plans to reopen the Rizal Memorial Tennis Courts and build the Philippine Tennis Center.

text: Sa bahin ni Eala, balantayan 10:00 subong nga aga ang hampang sini batok kay Viktorija Golubic sang Switzerland sa quarterfinals sang Suzhou Open WTA 125.
english: For her part, Eala will face Viktorija Golubic of Switzerland in the quarterfinals of the Suzhou Open WTA 125 at 10:00 this morning.

text: Ini na ang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod sini nga quarterfinal appearance kasunod sang Guadalajara 125, SP Open, kag Jingshan Tennis Open.
english: This is his fourth consecutive quarterfinal appearance following the Guadalajara 125, SP Open, and Jingshan Tennis Open.

text: Sa bilog nga tuig, ikaanum na niya ini nga quarterfinal match kag lakip sa pinakadaku sini nga nalab-ot amo ang sa Miami Open sang Marso kag ang Eastbourne Open sang Hunyo.
english: This was his sixth quarterfinal match all year and among his biggest achievements were at the Miami Open in March and the Eastbourne Open in June.

text: Gin-ako ni Coach Freddie Roach nga indi niya luyag nga masaksihan ang adlaw nga maga-retiro na si Pinoy Ring Icon Manny Pacquiao apang ‘posible’ suno sa iya nga ang Pacquiao versus Ugas nga hampang kahapon, Agusto 22, amo na ang katapusan nga sambuwa sang Pambansang Kamao sang Pilipinas.
english: Coach Freddie Roach admitted that he does not want to witness the day that Pinoy Ring Icon Manny Pacquiao retires but he said it is 'possible' that the Pacquiao versus Ugas match yesterday, August 22, will be the last fight of the Philippine National Kamao.

text: Suno kay Roach, nakit-an niya nga indi na maayo ang performance sang 42 anyos nga boksidor — kaangay man mismo sang pag-ako ni Pacquiao nga naga-cramp ang iya nga tiil rason nga indi siya makahulag sang husto sa sulod sang boxing ring.
english: According to Roach, he noticed that the 42-year-old boxer's performance was not good — just like Pacquiao's admission that his leg was cramping and he could not move properly inside the boxing ring.

text: “I hate to see the day he retires but this could be it.
english: “I hate to see the day he retires but this could be it.

text: He didn’t have a great performance tonight.
english: He didn’t have a great performance tonight.

text: We’ll see what Manny decides,” pahayag ni Roach.
english: We’ll see what Manny decides,” Roach said.

text: Masobra 20 ka tuig man ang pag-updanay nanday Roach kag Pacquiao.
english: Roach and Pacquiao have also been together for more than 20 years.

text: Indi lang trainer kag boxer ang paglantaw sa ila kundi amay kag anak.
english: They are not just trainers and boxers but father and son.

text: May standing agreement sa tunga nanday Roach kag Pacquiao nga kun makit-an sang trainer nga indi na ‘at the heighest level’ ang paghampang sang eight-division world champion, siya mismo ang una nga magahambal sini sa iya.
english: There is a standing agreement between Roach and Pacquiao that if the trainer sees that the eight-division world champion is no longer playing at the highest level, he will be the first to tell him.

text: Kahapon, kasunod sang kapaslawan ni Pacquiao nga mabawi ang World Boxing Association super welterweight belt kay Cuban boxer Yordenis Ugas, nagpahayag si Roach nga nagapakita na gid man ang edad ni Pacquiao.
english: Yesterday, following Pacquiao's failure to regain the World Boxing Association super welterweight belt from Cuban boxer Yordenis Ugas, Roach said Pacquiao's age is showing.

text: Suno kay Roach, indi na malab-ot sang Pinoy ring icon si Ugas kag wala man nahatagan sang solusyon ang height and reach advantage sang amo nga defending champion.
english: According to Roach, the Filipino ring icon can no longer reach Ugas and the defending champion's height and reach advantage has not been addressed.

text: Sa pihak sini ginpahayag sa gihapon sang trainer nga hulaton lang kun ano ang desisyon ni Pacquiao, ang nagaisahanon nga eight-division world champion sa kalibutan.
english: Meanwhile, the trainer said he will wait for the decision of Pacquiao, the only eight-division world champion in the world.

text: Mas ginpalapad kag gin-upgrade sang Department of Transportation (DOTr) ang seaport kag airport sa Ilocos Region kadungan sang preparasyon sang rehiyon sa trade kag tourism.
english: The Department of Transportation (DOTr) has expanded and upgraded the seaport and airport in the Ilocos Region in line with the region's preparation for trade and tourism.

text: Suno kay Transportation Secretary Arthur Tugade, ginpalapad kag ginpanami pa nila ang Port sang Salomague sa Cabugao, Ilocos Sur kag Laoag International Airport sa Laoag City, Ilocos Norte bilang pagpanghanda sa pagbukas sang turismo.
english: According to Transportation Secretary Arthur Tugade, they have expanded and improved the Port of Salomague in Cabugao, Ilocos Sur and the Laoag International Airport in Laoag City, Ilocos Norte in preparation for the opening of tourism.

text: Pahayag ni Tugade, ginahanda na ang Solamague Port bilang key cruise gateway sang ports sang Hong Kong, Taiwan kag South China.
english: Tugade said the Solamague Port is being prepared as a key cruise gateway for the ports of Hong Kong, Taiwan and South China.

text: Pahayag ni Tugade ginalauman nga magdamo ang cruise calls samtang naga-amat-amat na ang post-pandemic economic recovery sang pungsod.
english: Tugade said cruise calls are expected to increase as the country's post-pandemic economic recovery slows.

text: Pormal na nag-assume bilang OIC PNP Chief si PLTGen.
english: PLTGen formally assumed as OIC PNP Chief.

text: Melencio Nartatez.
english: Melencio Nartatez.

text: Wala naman nagtambong sa turnover ceremony kaina sang aga si anay PNP Chief General Nicolas Torre III nga ginpangunahan ni Sec.
english: Former PNP Chief General Nicolas Torre III, led by Sec.

text: Jonvic Remulla.
english: Jonvic Remulla.

text: Ginklaro ni Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga wala ini ginrekomenda kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla clarified that it was not recommended to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga i-relieve sa pwesto si Torre.
english: to relieve Torre from office.

text: Wala man sang may ginlapas nga layi, suno sa pahayag ni Senator Ping Lacson nga anay lider man sang pambansang pulisya.
english: There was no violation of the law, according to Senator Ping Lacson, a former national police chief.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Remulla nga ginkosiderar ni Pres.
english: Remulla also revealed that Pres.

text: Marcos nga hatagan sang pwesto sa gobyerno sang anay PNP chief.
english: Marcos to be given a government position by the former PNP chief.

text: Gin-athan man niya nga wala sang pamulitika ang pagkakas sa pwesto kay Torre.
english: He also assured that Torre's removal was not political.

text: Ginsiling sang opisyal, “Difficult and necessary” ang nangin desisyon sang Presidente nga kakson si Torre sa pwesto.
english: The official said the President's decision to remove Torre from office was “difficult and necessary”.

text: Aminado si Remulla nga isa sa nangin konsiderasyon ni Marcos nga kakson si Torre amo ang indi pagsuno sa ginpagguwa nga resolution sang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) nga i-recall ang ginpatuman sini nga pagbalasa.
english: Remulla admitted that one of the considerations of Marcos to remove Torre was not to comply with the resolution issued by the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) to recall the reading it implemented.

text: Sa subong, may duha ka option ang anay PNP Chief, ini amo ang early retirement ukon mag-stay sa pwesto.
english: Currently, the former PNP Chief has two options, early retirement or stay in office.

text:
Samtang ang apat ka star rank ni Torre ang estoryahan sang NAPOLCOM

Base sa layi isa lang sa PNP ang may 4 star rank kag ini ang lider sang pambansang pulisya.
english:
Meanwhile, Torre's four star rank will be discussed by NAPOLCOM

According to the law, only one of the PNP has a 4 star rank and he is the leader of the national police.

text: Ginpahayag ni Remulla nga lima ka beses niya gintawgan si Torre kagab-i apang wala niya ini ginasabat.
english: Remulla said he called Torre five times last night but he did not answer.

text: Ginahandaan na ni Pope Francis ang iya malapit duha ka semana nga pagbyahe kag pagtinir sa Southeast Asia sa masunod nga semana.
english: Pope Francis is preparing for his nearly two-week trip and stay in Southeast Asia next week.

text: Sa Martes, Septyembre 3, magaabot ang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa sa Jakarta nga kapital sang Indonesia antes ini magkadto sa Papua New Guinea, East Timor ukon Timor Leste, kag Singapore.
english: On Tuesday, September 3, the 87-year-old Pope will arrive in Jakarta, the Indonesian capital, before traveling to Papua New Guinea, East Timor or Timor Leste, and Singapore.

text: Magluwas sa byahe, ginapreparahan man sini ang 16 ka mga speech nga iya i-deliver sa mga misa bilang pagpakita sang nagatubo nga Catholic community sa sini nga mga pungsod.
english: Besides the trip, he is also preparing 16 speeches to deliver at masses as a showcase of the growing Catholic community in these countries.

text: Sa Indonesia, natalana ini nga magpakigkita kay outgoing President Joko Widodo kag sa mga tiglawas sang dalagku nga relihiyon sa Istiqlal Mosque nga amo ang pinakadaku sa Southeast Asia kag magapirma man sa joint declaration sa grand imam nga si Nasaruddin Umar.
english: In Indonesia, he is scheduled to meet with outgoing President Joko Widodo and representatives of major religions at the Istiqlal Mosque which is the largest in Southeast Asia and will also sign a joint declaration with grand imam Nasaruddin Umar.

text: Ang Indonesia amo ang pinakadaku nga Muslim nation sa kalibutan apang ginakilala sini ang Protestantism, Catholicism, Buddhism, Hinduism kag Confucianism.
english: Indonesia is the largest Muslim nation in the world but recognizes Protestantism, Catholicism, Buddhism, Hinduism and Confucianism.

text: Ini nga byahe sa rehiyon amo ang iya-45 nga pagbisita sa abroad.
english: This trip to the region will be his-45th visit abroad.

text: Una ini nga ginplano para sa 2020 apang wala nadayon bangud sa Covid-19 pandemic.
english: It was originally planned for 2020 but was canceled due to the Covid-19 pandemic.

text: Sa sulod sang sini nga apat ka tuig, daku ang ginhina sa ikaayong lawas ni Pope Francis rason nga nagasakay ini sa wheelchair, nagpaidalom sa hernia surgery sang nagligad nga tuig, kag may yara man sang ginasuprer nga respiratory issues.
english: During these four years, Pope Francis' health has deteriorated so much that he is confined to a wheelchair, underwent hernia surgery last year, and is also suffering from respiratory issues.

text:
Ang katapusan sini nga byahe sa luwas sang pungsod ang natabo sa Marseille sa France sang September 2023.#

(Photo: REUTERS/Yara Nardi)
english:
The last of this international flight took place in Marseille in France in September 2023.#

(Photo: REUTERS/Yara Nardi)

text: GUIMARAS – Indi malipatan sang isa ka iloy ang masakit nga inagihan sang bug-os niya nga pamilya sa paglugdang sang pumpboat nga MV Tawash sang 2015.
english: GUIMARAS – A mother will never forget the painful experience of her entire family in the sinking of the pumpboat MV Tawash in 2015.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Riza Sadaba sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Riza Sadaba of Brgy.

text: Alaguisoc, Jordan, Guimaras, iya ginpahayag nga tubtub subong, nagapabilin pa sa gihapon sa iya paminsaron ang natabo nga trahedya.
english: Alaguisoc, Jordan, Guimaras, he said that until now, the tragedy that happened still remains in his mind.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sadaba nga halin sila sa syudad sang Iloilo kag nagapapa-uli sang natabo ang insidente sa diin kaupod niya ang iya bana kag duha ka kabataan.
english: Sadaba said they were returning home from Iloilo City with her husband and two children.

text: Santo sa panaysayon ni Sadaba, maayo pa ang tiyempo sang naghalin sila sa syudad sang Iloilo apang pag-abot sa tunga sang kalalawran, hinali lang nga nagdulom ang kalangitan kag nagtuhaw ang pugada.
english: According to Sadaba, the weather was still good when they left Iloilo City but when they reached the middle of the sea, the sky suddenly darkened and the pugada appeared.

text: Sang amo nga tion suno kay Sadaba, ang tanan nga nga pasahero sang pumpboat ang mansig suksuk sang life jacket tubtub nagkulob ang pumpboat bangud sa dalagku nga balod.
english: At that time, Sadaba said, all the passengers of the pumpboat were wearing life jackets until the pumpboat capsized due to the big waves.

text: Sang amo nga tion, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga siya lamang sa ila pamilya ang indi makahibalo maglangoy.
english: At the time, he said he was the only one in his family who did not know how to swim.

text: Gintuad ni Sadaba nga iya na lang nga gintugyan sa Ginuo ang tanan tubtub nga naluwas siya paagi man sa iya pagpanikasog kag sa bulig sang iya bana.
english: Sadaba confessed that she left everything to the Lord until she was saved through her own efforts and the help of her husband.

text: Naglab-ot pa sa masobra sa 20 ka minutos bag-o sila naluwas samtang nagasakay sa nagkulob nga pumpboat.
english: It took more than 20 minutes before they were rescued while boarding the capsized pumpboat.

text: Matapos ang natabo nga trahedya, ginpahayag ni Sadaba nga iya nabinag-binag nga tuman ka lip-ot sang kabuhi kag dapat nga magpasalamat sa Ginuo sa tagsa ka adlaw.
english: After the tragedy, Sadaba said he realized that life is too short and he should thank the Lord every day.

text: Matandaan nga indi magnubo sa pito ang patay matapos nga nagkapan ang nasambit nga pumpboat.
english: At least seven people were killed after the pumpboat capsized.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Dismayado ang pamunuan sang Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) sa natabo nga paglapta sang bomb threat.
english: Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) is disappointed with the spread of bomb threats.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Gabriel M. Salistre, Jr., president sang ISAT-U, iya ginpahayag nga dako nga huol ang natuga sang nasambit nga pamahog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Gabriel M. Salistre, Jr., president of ISAT-U, said the threat has caused great concern.

text: Suno kay Salistre, wala sang anuman nga bomba nga narekober sa unibersidad.
english: Salistre said no bombs were recovered from the university.

text: Kuntani suno sa natungdan, likawan ang paglapata sang mga patalang nga impormasyon.
english: He said he hopes to avoid spreading false information.

text: Nagbulig man sa pagpatigayon sang inspeksyon sa lugar ang Philippine National Police kag Philippine Army.
english: The Philippine National Police and Philippine Army also assisted in the inspection.

text: Bangud sa natabo, ginpakamaayo na lang nga ikansela ang klase subong nga adlaw.
english: Due to the incident, it was decided to cancel classes today.

text: ILOILO – Daku nga kadulaan sa showbiz industry ang kamatayon sang beterano nga aktor nga si Eddie Garcia.
english: ILOILO CITY – The death of veteran actor Eddie Garcia is a great loss to the showbiz industry.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elvert Bañares, ilonggo nga director kag cinematographer, iya ginpahayag nga makalima niya ka beses nga nakita kag nakaupod ang aktor kag direktor nga si Garcia.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elvert Bañares, Ilonggo director and cinematographer, said he saw and accompanied actor and director Garcia five times.

text: Ginpahayag ni Bañares nga sa patag sang showbiz, si Garcia ang makabig nga maayo nga ehemplo sa mga ulihing-tubo.
english: Bañares said that in the field of showbiz, Garcia is considered a good example for the younger generation.

text: Ini bangud nga suno kay Bañares, si Garcia ang sahi sang tawo nga talentado, maambong, mapainubuson, disiplinado kag may maayo nga paminatasan.
english: This is because, according to Bañares, Garcia is the kind of person who is talented, graceful, humble, disciplined and has good manners.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa ilonggo nga direktor, gawi na sang 90 anyos nga aktor nga temprano pa nga naga-abot sa set ukon sa venue sa tion nga may yara sang ‘taping’.
english: In fact, according to the Ilonggo director, it is the habit of the 90-year-old actor to arrive early on set or at the venue when there is a taping.

text: Bilang isa naman ka direktor, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ginatapos gid gilayon ni Garcia ang ‘taping’ santo sa gintalana nga deadline.
english: As a director, Garcia said he finishes the taping immediately according to the deadline.

text: Kun tani suno kay Bañares, ang natabo kay Garcia ang mangin pamukaw sa showbiz industry ilabi na sa patag sang film making nga mas mangin maid-id ilabi na sa tion sang ‘taping’.
english: Bañares said Garcia's incident should be a wake-up call to the showbiz industry especially in the field of film making to be more careful especially during taping.

text: Nagapati ang Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG) nga wala nakabenepisyo ang gobyerno kag manugbakal sa pagnubo sang taripa para sa mga ginpang-import nga baboy bangud nagapabilin sa gihapon nga mataas ang presyo sini.
english: The Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG) believes that the government and consumers have not benefited from the reduction in tariffs for imported pork because the price remains high.

text: Ini ang kasunod sa nangin report sang Department of Finance nga ang gobyerno ang nadulaan sang P1.3 billion nga kita bangud sa manubo nga taripa sang imported nga baboy humalin sang Abril tubtob Hunyo.
english: This follows a report by the Department of Finance that the government lost P1.3 billion in revenue due to low tariffs on imported pork from April to June.

text: Sa sini nga period, 76 million ka kilo sang baboy ang gin-import santu sa rekord sang Bureau of Customs.
english: During this period, 76 million kilos of pork were imported according to the records of the Bureau of Customs.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Abril, nag-isyu sang Executive Order No.
english: In April, the government issued Executive Order No.

text: 128 si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa diin nagnubo ang taripa sang pork imports sa idalom sang minimum access volume (MAV) sa 5% gikan sa 30% kag oout-quota pork import tarrifs sa 20% gikan sa 40% sa pihak sang negatibo nga epekto sang African Swine Fever sa suplay sang baboy.
english: 128 where President Rodrigo Duterte reduced tariffs on pork imports below minimum access volume (MAV) to 5% from 30% and oout-quota pork import tarrifs to 20% from 40% despite the negative impact of African Swine Fever on pig supply.

text: Ginpatumba ni Filipino boxer Mark “Magnifico” Magsayo ang iya kasumpong nga si Julio Ceja sa Pacquiao Versus Ugas undercard fight sa T-Mobile Arena sa Las Vegas Nevada.
english: Filipino boxer Mark “Magnifico” Magsayo knocked out his opponent Julio Ceja in the Pacquiao Versus Ugas undercard fight at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas Nevada.

text: Halin sa umpisa sang sambuwa, nangin mainit na ang pagbayluhanay sang sumbag sang duha ka boxer.
english: From the beginning of the fight, the exchange of blows between the two boxers became heated.

text: Pag-abot sa ika-10 nga round, ginbubo ni Magsayo ang iya mabug-at nga sumbag kag gin-knockout si Ceja.
english: Coming into the 10th round, Magsayo poured his heavy punches and knocked out Ceja.

text: Naghinugyaw naman ang fans matapos nag back-flip pa sa kalipay si Magsayo.
english: The fans cheered after Magsayo did a back-flip for joy.

text: Nahibaluan nga ika-23 na ini nga daog sang Filipino boxer sa diin wala pa siya sang pyerde.
english: It is known that this is the 23rd win of the Filipino boxer where he has not lost.

text: Sa subong, si Magsayo ang number 1 contender ni WBC featherweight champion Gary Russell, Jr.
english: Magsayo is currently the number 1 contender for WBC featherweight champion Gary Russell, Jr.

text: Yari naman ang resulta sang sambuwa sang tatlo pa ka set of players sa Pacman undercard fight:
english: Here are the results of the three other sets of players in the Pacman undercard fight:

text: Gin-relieve sa iya posisyon si Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Nicolas Torre III.
english: Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Nicolas Torre III has been relieved of his post.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin.
english: This was confirmed by Executive Secretary Lucas Bersamin.

text: Wala pa sang dugang nga detalye nga gin-isyu angot diri.
english: No further details have been released.

text: Wala na sang dapat pamatud-an sa kalibutan si 8th Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao apisar napyerde sa ila hampang ni Cuban boxer Yordenis Ugas via unanimous decision sa T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, Nevada.
english: 8th Division World Champion Manny Pacquiao has nothing to prove to the world despite losing his fight to Cuban boxer Yordenis Ugas via unanimous decision at the T-Mobile Arena, Las Vegas, Nevada.

text: Ini ang kasunod man sang pagdayaw kag pagpanginbulahan nga ginbubo sang fans sa Pinoy Boxing Legend pagkatapos sang amo nga sambuwa.
english: This follows the praise and congratulations that fans poured on the Pinoy Boxing Legend after the fight.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay boxing analyst Edwin Espejo, iya ginpahayag nga posible nangin bitin ang stamina kag strength ni Pacquiao bangud masobra duha ka-tuig ini nga nagpahuway sa iya karera sa boxing.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, boxing analyst Edwin Espejo said Pacquiao's stamina and strength may have become a snake because he took a break from his boxing career for more than two years.

text: Dako man ang posibilidad nga wala ni Pacquiao na-antisipar ang nangin fighting style ni Ugas sa diin bentaha ang malaba nga mga kamot sang Cuban fighter kag madasig ang pagbuya sini sang sumbag kag footwork.
english: It is also likely that Pacquiao did not anticipate Ugas' fighting style where the Cuban fighter's long hands are advantageous and he is quick to throw punches and footwork.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagbubo ang suporta sang Filipino fans sa Pambansang Kamao — nga wala pa man nakapagwa sang iya official statement kun bala ini na ang katapusan niya nga sambuwa sa iya boxing career.
english: Meanwhile, Filipino fans have poured their support into the Pambansang Kamao — who has yet to issue an official statement on whether this will be his last fight in his boxing career.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagaisahanon si Pacquiao nga eight-division world champion, may karera nga nagalawig na sang 26 ka tuig, nakaagi sa 71 ka professional matches, may 62 ka daug, kag nag-knockout sa 39 niya ka mga kasumpong.
english: Pacquiao is the only eight-division world champion, with a career spanning 26 years, 71 professional matches, 62 wins, and knockouts of 39 of his opponents.

text: Nagapapabilin nga yara sa kustodiya sang kapulisan ang menor-de-edad nga suspek sa pagbuno-patay sa barangay tanod sa Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: The minor suspect in the stabbing death of a barangay tanod in Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City remains in police custody.

text: Ang biktima amo si Michael Barredo, 38-anyos, residente sang Zone 2 sa amo nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Michael Barredo, 38, resident of Zone 2 in the said barangay.

text: Ang ginaalegar nga mga suspek amo sanday alias Carlo, 17-anyos, kag residente sang South Baluarte, Molo kag si alias Jet-jet sang Zone 1B, San Juan, Molo.
english: The alleged suspects were identified as alias Carlo, 17, resident of South Baluarte, Molo and alias Jet-jet of Zone 1B, San Juan, Molo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, Chief sang Iloilo City Police Station 4, iya ginpahayag nga santo sa kaupod sang biktima nga barangay tanod man, ginkumpirma sini nga si Alias Jet-jet gid ang nagpangamot sa pagpamuno.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 4, said that based on the victim's companion, who is also a barangay tanod, he confirmed that Alias ​​Jet-jet was involved in the killing.

text: Suno kay Inot, kinahanglan pa sang dugang nga kumpirmasyon halin mismo sa saksi nga tanod agud matumod kon si alias Carlo gidman ang menor-de-edad nga involve sa krimen.
english: According to Inot, further confirmation is needed from the witness tanod to identify if alias Carlo is indeed the minor involved in the crime.

text: Ginalantaw man kon ang natungdan ang naghatag sang kutsilyo kag nagbulig lampos sa biktima.
english: It is also being investigated whether the suspect gave the knife and helped stab the victim.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Inot nga ang pagpanghangkat sa ila bahin, amo ang may isa pa gid sang certain alias Carlo sang nagluntad ang insidente.
english: Inot also said that the challenge on their part, is that there was another certain alias Carlo when the incident occurred.

text: Ginahulat naman sang talatapan ang statement sang sang tanod nga nagresponde sa lugar agud makumpirma ang kahilabtanan sang menor-de-edad nga si alias Carlo sa insidente.
english: The office is waiting for the statement of the tanod who responded to the scene to confirm the involvement of the minor alias Carlo in the incident.

text: Ginlaragway sang punong barangay sang San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City nga aktibo klase tanod sa ila lugar si Michael Barredo, ang ginbuno-patay sang menor-de-edad kahapon nga adlaw.
english: The barangay captain of San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City described Michael Barredo, who was stabbed to death by a minor yesterday, as an active class tanod in their area.

text: Ini kasunod man sang iya pagresponde sa kinagamo sang mga pamatan-on sa nasambit man nga lugar.
english: This follows his response to the youth riots in the same area.

text: Suno kay Punong Barangay Jose Martin Maloto, iya ginpahayag nga si Barredo ang nagaserbi nga taga-luto sa ila nga tanod outpost.
english: According to Punong Barangay Jose Martin Maloto, he said Barredo is the cook at their tanod outpost.

text: Dugang sang opisyal nga masami gidman nga nagapangsaway ang biktima sa mga kabataan nga pasaway sa ila komunidad.
english: The official added that the victim often scolded the children who were disobedient in their community.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga duha lamang sila nga tanod ang nagpadulong sa lugar agud sawayon ang mga kabataan.
english: He also explained that only two tanods went to the scene to reprimand the children.

text: Minutos lamang ang nagligad, didto na kag may nag-report sa iya nga nabun-an na si Barredo.
english: Just minutes later, he was there and someone reported to him that Barredo had been stabbed.

text: Nag-apelar ang Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV) nga ini ang mangin katapusan nga kahigayunan agud ipaisol ang Barangay kag Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE), matapos ini ginsaylo sa Disyembre 2025 pakadto sa Nobyembre 2026.
english: The Parish Pastoral Council for Responsible Voting (PPCRV) has appealed that this will be the last chance to postpone the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE), after it was postponed from December 2025 to November 2026.

text: Suno kay PPCRV chairperson Evelyn Singson, importante ang regular nga pagpatigayon sang eleksyon agud mapabilin ang accountability sang mga opisyales kag ang pagsalig sang mga pumuluyo.
english: According to PPCRV chairperson Evelyn Singson, it is important to conduct regular elections to maintain the accountability of officials and the trust of the people.

text: Ginhatagan niya sing importansya nga ang sulit-sulit nga pag-isol makahalit sa demokrasya.
english: He stressed that repeated defections are detrimental to democracy.

text: Madumduman nga sang damlag lang ginpirmahan ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr ang Republic Act No.12232 nga nagtalana sang bag-o nga petsa para sa BSKE.
english: It can be recalled that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. recently signed Republic Act No.12232 which set a new date for the BSKE.

text: Sa amo man nga tion, ang BSKE ginapatigayon kada apat ka tuig.
english: At the same time, BSKE is conducted every four years.

text: Magluwas diri, ginbaton man sang PPCRV ang rason sang pag-isol agud mahatagan sang lugar ang preparasyon para sa first-ever Parliamentary Elections sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) sa Oktubre 2025, apang ginpanindugan ni Singson nga indi ini dapat mangin rason agud pirme ipaisol ang barangay elections.
english: In addition, the PPCRV also accepted the reason for the postponement to give way to preparations for the first-ever Parliamentary Elections in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) in October 2025, but Singson insisted that this should not be a reason to always postpone the barangay elections.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Napaidalom sa Revised Penal Code (RPC) ang kaso nga mahimo atubangon sang driver sang pick-up truck nga nakabunggo-patay sa mag-asawa kag sa ila anak sa Barangay Canas, San Dionisio, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The driver of a pick-up truck that killed a couple and their child in Barangay Canas, San Dionisio, Iloilo is under the Revised Penal Code (RPC).

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Artemio Arabe, 64, Rosemarie Asupra, 58 kag ila anak nga si Angelie, 15, lunsay residente sang Barangay Cubay, San Dionisio, Iloilo.
english: The victims were identified as Artemio Arabe, 64, Rosemarie Asupra, 58 and their daughter Angelie, 15, both residents of Barangay Cubay, San Dionisio, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver naman sang pick-up truck amo si Tomy Clarito, 26-anyos nga negosyante kag residente sang Calinog, Iloilo.
english: The driver of the pick-up truck was identified as Tomy Clarito, a 26-year-old businessman and resident of Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Noel Palomado,  iya ginpahayag nga kaso nga reckless driving resulting in property damage and multiple homicide ang mahimo atubangon sang suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Noel Palomado, he said the suspect could face charges of reckless driving resulting in property damage and multiple homicide.

text: Suno kay Palomado, sa idalom sang Article 365 sang Revised Penal Code, ang reckless imprudence ang nagakahulugan sang “voluntarily, apang wala sang malisya  nga paghimo sang akto nga naguba sa propedad.
english: According to Palomado, under Article 365 of the Revised Penal Code, reckless imprudence means “voluntarily, but without malice committing an act that damages property.

text: Kun ang reckless imprudence naman ang nagresulta sa kamatayon, mahimo ang suspek nga magpangatubang sang kaso nga reckless driving resulting in property damage and multiple homicide.
english: If reckless imprudence resulted in death, the suspect could face charges of reckless driving resulting in property damage and multiple homicide.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ang isa ka indibidwal nga ginpasakaan sang nasambit nga kaso ang nagakadapat nga magpaidalom sa legal proceedings agud matumod ang ila salabton.
english: He said that an individual charged with the said case should undergo legal proceedings to determine their responsibility.

text: Magadepende naman sa korte kun ano kalawig ang mangin penalidad kag kadugayon sang itinir sa presuhan sang suspek.
english: The length of the penalty and the length of the suspect's stay in jail will depend on the court.

text: Magluwas diri, mahimo pa gid ini nga magbayad sang multa sa diin ginabase man ini sa halit nga natuga sa propedad kag sa mga biktima.
english: In addition, it can also pay a fine based on the damage caused to property and victims.

text: Magluwas sa criminal penalties, mahimo man nga mangin civilly liable ang suspek sa diin nagakadapat nga bayaran sini ang gasto sa medical treatment, funeral costs, ukon pagkaayo kag pag-ilis sang damaged property.
english: In addition to criminal penalties, the suspect may also be civilly liable where he or she must pay the cost of medical treatment, funeral costs, or repair and replacement of damaged property.

text: Matandaan nga nakagwa ang driver sang pick-up truck bangud nag-lapse na ang reglementary period sini kag wala maka-file sang kaso ang himata sang mga biktima.
english: It can be recalled that the driver of the pick-up truck was released because his reglementary period had lapsed and the relatives of the victims could not file a case.

text: ILOILO CITY – Tama gid ka importante para sa isa ka anak ang maka-angkon sang bug-os nga pamilya.
english: ILOILO CITY – It is very important for a child to have a whole family.

text: Ini ang natun-an sang isa ka anak nga nagdaku sa broken family sa diin ang iya amay kag iloy ang lunsay nag-angkon sang iban nga pamilya.
english: This is the lesson of a child who grew up in a broken family where his father and mother both had other families.
