text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Angela Cain-Espora sang Lapaz, Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga nagdaku siya sa luyo sang iya amay matapos siya nga ginbilin sang iya iloy sang naga-edad pa lang siya sadto sang 2 tubtub 3 ka bulan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Angela Cain-Espora of Lapaz, Iloilo City said she grew up with her father after she was abandoned by her mother when she was 2 to 3 months old.

text: Sang una suno kay Espora, ang iya amay ang may nagkalain-lain nga bisyo kasubong na lang sang sugal, inom kag pagpakig-relasyon sa iban nga babayisa diin ang iya biological mother ang nangin kerida sang iya amay.
english: In the past, according to Espora, her father had various addictions such as gambling, drinking and having relationships with other women where her biological mother became her father's mistress.

text: Sa pihak sini, hugot sila nga ginbaton sang legal wife sang iya amay.
english: Despite this, they were firmly accepted by his father's legal wife.

text: Bangud nga nagpalagyo ang iya iloy, nagdaku siya suno kay Espora sa pag-atipan sang iya amay apang kun kaisa, ang ila nalang nga mga kasilingan ang nagabantay sa iya.
english: Because her mother ran away, Espora said she grew up in the care of her father but sometimes, only their neighbors looked after her.

text: Kun wala naman sang may magabantay sa iya, ginpahayag ni Espora nga ginadala siya sang iya amay sa pagbyahe sang tricycle sa diin ang tricycle na mismo ang nagaserbe nila nga balay kun kaisa.
english: When there is no one to look after her, Espora said her father takes her on tricycle trips where the tricycle itself serves as their home sometimes.

text: Nagbag-o man suno kay Espora ang pagginawi sang iya amay tubtub nga nakapangasawa liwat matapos napatay ang legal wife.
english: Espora said her father also changed his behavior until he remarried after his legal wife died.

text: Ang masakit lang suno kay Espora amo nga indi siya mabaton sang iban niya nga mga utod.
english: The only pain, Espora said, is that she is not accepted by her other siblings.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa natungdan, ang iya man lang mga utod kag manding ang nagapakala-in sa iya.
english: In fact, according to the concerned, it is only his brothers and sisters who criticize him.

text: Isa sa iya ginhinulsulan suno kay Espora amo nga wala siya nahatagan sang malawig nga tion agud nga mapabutyag ang pagpalangga sa iya amay bangud nga sa lamharon nga edad, naka-angkon naman siya sang kaugalingon nga pamilya kag wala na naka-eskwela sa kolehiyo.
english: One of her regrets, according to Espora, is that she was not given a long time to express her love for her father because at a young age, she had her own family and did not go to college.

text: Wala na nagalaum pa si Espora nga batunon siya sang iya mga utod apang ang importante lang suno sa iya amo nga mapabatyag ang iya pagpalangga sa iya amay nga amo ang nagsagod sa iya.
english: Espora no longer expects her brothers to accept her but the important thing is to feel her love for her father who raised her.

text: Wala nagpasugot si Cuban Boxer Yordenis Ugas nga mabawi sang Pinoy Boxing Legend nga si Senator Manny Pacquiao ang World Boxing Association (WBA) super welterweight crown.
english: Cuban boxer Yordenis Ugas has refused to allow Pinoy Boxing Legend Senator Manny Pacquiao to regain the World Boxing Association (WBA) super welterweight crown.

text: Ini matapos ginlutos sang 35 anyos si People’s Champ sa 12-round championship boxing match sa T-Mobile Arena sa Las Vegas Nevada.
english: The 35-year-old defeated the People's Champ in a 12-round championship boxing match at the T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada.

text: Ginpaboran sang tatlo ka judges ang Cuban boxer via unanimous decision sa score nga 115-113, 116-112, 116-112.
english: The three judges favored the Cuban boxer via unanimous decision with a score of 115-113, 116-112, 116-112.

text: Ini na ang ika-27 nga daog ni Ugas samtang ika-walo pa lang ini nga pyerde sang Pambansang Kamao.
english: This is Ugas' 27th win while Pambansang Kamao's eighth loss.

text: Makabig man nga dako nga maragtas sa boxing career ni Ugas ang paglutos niya sa nagaisahanon nga eight-division world champion nga si Pacquiao.
english: Ugas' defeat of the only eight-division world champion, Pacquiao, is also a great milestone in his boxing career.

text: Duha gid ka bulawan nga medalya ang nakuha sang tumandok sang Passi City nga si Kate P. Pardilla sa nagapadayon nga Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: Passi City native Kate P. Pardilla won two gold medals in the ongoing Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Kampyon siya sa Standard Individual Chess amo man sa Standard Team Chess kun sa diin kaupod sini ang taga-Iloilo City nga si Thea Grace Clar.
english: He is a champion in Standard Individual Chess as well as Standard Team Chess with Iloilo City's Thea Grace Clar.

text: Si Pardilla ang naga-eskwela sa Passi I Central School kag nagatiglawas sang Western Visayas sa sini nga sports event.
english: Pardilla is a student at Passi I Central School and is representing Western Visayas in this sports event.

text: Nagpalab-ot man sang pagpanginbulahan ang local government unit sang Passi kasunod sang kadalag-an sini.
english: The local government unit of Passi also extended its congratulations following its victory.

text: “Representing Western Visayas, Kate demonstrated brilliance, strategy, and determination as she outplayed the best young chess players from all over the Philippines,” kabahin sang social media post sang LGU.
english: “Representing Western Visayas, Kate demonstrated brilliance, strategy, and determination as she outplayed the best young chess players from all over the Philippines,” the LGU said in a social media post.

text:
Suno pa sa local government, sang 2024, naka-upod ni Pardilla sa paghampang sang chess ang billiards legend nga si Efren “Bata” Reyes kadungan sang 1st Mayor Stephen A. Palmares 9-Ball National Open Championship sa City of Passi Arena — bagay nga suno sa LGU, “a quiet yet powerful sign of the champion she would become.”

As of press time, nagapang-apat ang Western Visayas sa medal tally sa sini nga multi-sport event sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte nga may 29 ka gold medals.#

(Photo: Palarong Pambansa -Chess/FB)
english:
According to the local government, in 2024, Pardilla will play chess with billiards legend Efren “Bata” Reyes during the 1st Mayor Stephen A. Palmares 9-Ball National Open Championship at the City of Passi Arena — something that according to the LGU, “a quiet yet powerful sign would become the champion.”

As of press time, Western Visayas is fourth in the medal tally in this multi-sport event in Laoag, Ilocos Norte with 29 gold medals.#

text: Magaroll-out sang mas malapad nga coverage para sa COVID-19 ang Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) tuga sang mapin-ot nga hospitalization costs sa tunga sang pandemya.
english: The Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) will roll out wider coverage for COVID-19 due to low hospitalization costs amid the pandemic.

text: Suno kay PhilHealth Spokesperson Dr. Shirley Domingo, ginatun-an na sang ahensya ang nagataas nga kaso sa COVID-19 sa diin may yara na sang rekomendasyon agud ipatuman ang masangkad nga inpatient hospital care para sa COVID-19 cases.
english: According to PhilHealth Spokesperson Dr. Shirley Domingo, the agency is already studying the increasing number of COVID-19 cases and has already recommended the implementation of intensive inpatient hospital care for COVID-19 cases.

text: Sa idalom sang PhilHealth Circular No.
english: Under PhilHealth Circular No.

text: 2020-0009, ginacover sang PhilHealth ang P43,997 para sa mga tigulang nga may comorbidities kag may balatian nga mild pneumonia, P143,267 sa mga may moderate pneumonia, P333,519 sa mga may severe pneumonia, kag P786,384 sa may critical pneumonia.
english: 2020-0009, PhilHealth covers P43,997 for the elderly with comorbidities and mild pneumonia, P143,267 for those with moderate pneumonia, P333,519 for those with severe pneumonia, and P786,384 for those with critical pneumonia.

text: Nagpaandam si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. warns

text: batok sa mga korap nga opisyal kag indibidwal nga padayon nga nagaabuso sang ila poder, sa iya mensahe kahapon sa selebrasyon sang National Heroes Day sa Libingan ng mga Bayani.
english: against corrupt officials and individuals who continue to abuse their power, in his message yesterday at the celebration of National Heroes Day at Libingan ng mga Bayani.

text: Suno sa Presidente, ang korapsyon indi lamang pagpangawat sang kwarta sang pungsod kundi isa man ka porma sang pagkuha sang kabuhi kag handum sang mga kabataan kag sang bug-os nga pumuluyo.
english: According to the President, corruption is not only stealing the country’s money but also a form of taking the lives and dreams of children and the entire people.

text: Ang kampanya batok sa korapsyon indi lamang responsabilidad sang gobyerno kundi obligasyon sang tagsa ka indibidwal.
english: The campaign against corruption is not only the responsibility of the government but the obligation of every individual.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini nga dapat magbinuligay ang tanan sa pagpakig-away sa abuso kag paglapas sa katungdanan sang tawo.
english: He also called for everyone to work together to fight abuse and human rights violations.

text: Gin-emphasize man ni Marcos ang importansya sang paggiya sa kabataan, agud mangin masanag ang ila panan-aw sa mga isyu sa palibot kag mangin aktibo sa pagpangabuhi nga may integridad.
english: Marcos also emphasized the importance of guiding children, so that they can have a bright view of environmental issues and be active in living with integrity.

text: Ginsiguro man sang Presidente nga padayon ang kampanya sang gobyerno batok sa korapsyon, tubtob nga may yara pa sang mga elemento nga nagapatiko sang hustisya kag nagaabuso sang poder.
english: The President also assured that the government's campaign against corruption will continue, as long as there are still elements who pervert justice and abuse power.

text: GUIMARAS -Ginakabig sang isa ka amay nga ‘blessing in disguise’ ang iya pagkapreso agud nga mahatagan sang maayo nga pangabuhi ang iya pamilya.
english: GUIMARAS - A father considers his imprisonment as a blessing in disguise in order to provide a better life for his family.

text: Nangin emosyonal si Giovanie Geromiano, tumandok sang Tapaz, Capiz kag inmate sa Bureau of Jail Mananagement and Penology (BJMP) facility sa Guimaras, samtang ginsaysay ang iya kabuhi bilang preso kag bilang amay sa iya lima ka kabataan.
english: Giovanie Geromiano, a native of Tapaz, Capiz and an inmate at the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) facility in Guimaras, became emotional as he narrated his life as a prisoner and as a father to his five children.

text: Bag-o pa man napreso, ginpahayag ni Geromiano nga nagatrabaho siya sadto bilang isa ka driver agud nga masaguran ang mga kabataan kag ang iya tiayon.
english: Before being arrested, Geromiano said he used to work as a driver to support his children and wife.

text: Sa wala ginalauman, naulamid siya sa isa ka kaso kag tubtub subong, iya pa nga ginaserbisyuhan ang ginpamatbat nga silot batok sa iya.
english: Unexpectedly, he was involved in a case and is still serving the sentence imposed against him.

text: Sang una suno kay Geromiano, mabudlay para sa iya nga mapahilayo sa iya mga kabataan nga lunsay pa naga-eskwela.
english: In the past, Geromiano said, it was difficult for her to be away from her children who were all in school.

text: Sa sulod sang presuhan suno kay Geromiano, nahatagan siya sang kahigayunan nga maka-angkon sang palangabuhi-an kag ini amo ang furniture making kag naka-eskwela sang furniture making agud mapaayo pa gid ang iya paghimu sang kagamitan kasubong sang cabinet, katre kag locker.
english: Inside the jail, Geromiano said, he was given the opportunity to earn a living and that is furniture making and studied furniture making to improve his making of equipment such as cabinets, beds and lockers.

text: Bangud nga madamu ang iya cutomer, ginpahayag sang natungdan nga siya na mismo ang nagdesisyon nga saguron ang iya lima ka kabataan ilabi pa nga may yara naman sang iban nga pamilya ang iya tiayon.
english: Because she has many customers, she said she decided to take care of her five children especially since her husband has other families.

text: Sa sulod sang presuhan, madamu siya sang nabinag-binag sa kabuhi kag mas napalapit sa Ginuo.
english: In prison, he thought about many things in life and drew closer to the Lord.

text: Sa pihak sang natabo, ginpahayag ni Geromiano nga indi upang ang pagkapareso kag wala sang imposible kun nagahimakas sa pagpangabuhi.
english: Despite the incident, Geromiano said that parity is not an obstacle and nothing is impossible when struggling to make ends meet.

text: Nagnubo ang inflation ukon ang pagtaas sang presyo sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon sang nagligad nga bulan sang Hunyo sa 4.1 percent.
english: Inflation or the increase in the prices of basic goods last month in June decreased to 4.1 percent.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang pagnubo sang annual increase sa transport index.
english: This follows a decrease in the annual increase in the transport index.

text: Suno kay Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, ini man ang pinakanubo nga rekord humalin sang 3.5 percent nga rekord sang pagnubo sang inflation sang Disyembre 2020.
english: According to Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, this is also the lowest record since the 3.5 percent record of decline in inflation in December 2020.

text: Magluwas sa pili nga mga pagkaon kag energy items, nagnubo ang core inflation sa 3.0 percent mas manubo sa 3.3 percent sang Mayo.
english: With the exception of select food and energy items, core inflation fell to 3.0 percent below 3.3 percent in May.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Nagasinggitan sang hustisya ang pamilya sang mag-asawa kag sa ila anak nga ginbungguan-patay sang pick-up truck sa Barangay Canas, San Dionisio, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The family of a couple and their son who were hit and killed by a pick-up truck in Barangay Canas, San Dionisio, Iloilo is crying for justice.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Artemio Arabe, 64, Rosemarie Asupra, 58 kag ila anak nga si Angelie, 15, lunsay residente sang Barangay Cubay, San Dionisio, Iloilo.
english: The victims were identified as Artemio Arabe, 64, Rosemarie Asupra, 58 and their daughter Angelie, 15, both residents of Barangay Cubay, San Dionisio, Iloilo.

text: Ang driver naman sang pick-up truck amo si alias Tomy Clarito, 26-anyos nga negosyante kag residente sang Calinog, Iloilo.
english: The driver of the pick-up truck was identified as Tomy Clarito, a 26-year-old businessman and resident of Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Melinda Dejoro, utod ni Rosemarie Asupra, iya ginpahayag nga masakit para sa ila ang natabo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Melinda Dejoro, sister of Rosemarie Asupra, said the incident was painful for them.

text: Apang ang mas masakit pa suno sa natungdan amo nga nakagwa ang suspek apisar nga wala pa naathagan ang kaso.
english: But what is more painful, he said, is that the suspect was released despite the fact that the case has not been clarified.

text: Ginpanawagan man sini sa publiko nga likawan ang paghusgar sa ila pamilya kag pagtawag sa mga ini nga bayaran.
english: He also called on the public to refrain from judging their families and calling them to pay.

text: Ginbuno-patay sang pamatan-on ang isa ka barangay tanod sa Zone 1-B, Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: A youth stabbed to death a barangay tanod in Zone 1-B, Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Michael Barredo, 38-anyos, residente sang Zone 2 sang amo nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Michael Barredo, 38, resident of Zone 2 of the said barangay.

text: Ang mga suspek amo sanday Carlo Lacquin, sang South Baluarte, Molo kag Philip John Sanico sang Zone 1B, San Juan, Molo.
english: The suspects were identified as Carlo Lacquin, of South Baluarte, Molo and Philip John Sanico of Zone 1B, San Juan, Molo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jon Enojado, Barangay Kagawad sang nasambit nga Barangay, iya ginpahayag nga nagresponde ang tanod sa baybay kun sa diin may gin-report nga may nagarambol kag nagahabuyanay sang bato nga mga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jon Enojado, Barangay Kagawad of the said barangay, said the tanod responded to the beach where there was a report that some children were fighting and throwing stones at each other.

text: Suno man sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang natungdan, ginsaway sang tanod ang kabataan kag ginaalegar nga nakapatupa ang tanod sa isa kag didto na nga ginbalusan, ginlagas kag ginbuno sang suspek.
english: According to information obtained by the concerned, the tanod reprimanded the children and allegedly the tanod knocked down one of them and the suspect retaliated, chased and stabbed them.

text: Nag-agum naman sang pilas sa abaga kag likod ang biktima.
english: The victim sustained injuries to his shoulder and back.

text: Gilayon naman nga nadakpan ang mga suspek kasunod sang ginpatigayon nga hot pursuit operation sang kapulisan.
english: The suspects were immediately arrested following a hot pursuit operation conducted by the police.

text: Ano man oras ang pag-retiro ni Pinoy ring icon Senator Manny Pacquiao sa iya karera sa boksing, pat-od nga wala na sang makapanas sang legasiya nga iya i-bilin sa patag sang sini nga hampang.
english: Whatever time Pinoy ring icon Senator Manny Pacquiao retires from his boxing career, surely nothing will erase the legacy he will leave in the field of this sport.

text: Apang subong nga adlaw, Agusto 22, sa ginasiling sang iban nga posible katapusan nga hampang sang People’s Champ, isa ang iya tuyo: bawion ang World Boxing Association (WBA) “super” welterweight crown nga ginkuha sa iya kag ginpasa sa Cuban boxer nga si Yordenis Ugas.
english: But today, August 22, in what some say may be the People’s Champ’s final match, he has one goal: to reclaim the World Boxing Association (WBA) “super” welterweight crown that was taken from him and passed to Cuban boxer Yordenis Ugas.

text: Ginpasa sang WBA ang amo nga titulo kay Ugas apisar wala man lang ini nakapatupa sang bisan isa ka hapaw nga sumbag batok sa Pambansang Kamao sang Pilipinas.
english: The WBA passed the title to Ugas even though he did not land a single punch against the Philippine National Fighter.

text: Pamatud-an ni Ugas sa sulod sang boxing ring subong nga adlaw nga deserving siya sa amo nga 147-pound title.
english: Ugas will prove inside the boxing ring today that he deserves the 147-pound title.

text: Apang antes niya ina mahimo, atubangon niya ang PacMan sang Pilipinas: nagaisahanon nga eight-division world champion, may karera nga nagalawig na sang 26 ka tuig, nakaagi sa 71 ka professional matches, may 62 ka daug, kag nag-knockout sa 39 niya ka mga kasumpong.
english: But before he can do that, he will face the PacMan of the Philippines: the only eight-division world champion, with a career that now spans 26 years, has been through 71 professional matches, has 62 wins, and has knocked out 39 of his opponents.

text: Ano ang tyansa ni Ugas, 35 anyos nga anay Olympic Bronze Medalist, nga mapamatud-an sa atubang sang 42 anyos nga si Pacquiao nga nagakabagay sa iya ang korona nga iya subong gina-uyatan?
english: What chance does Ugas, a 35-year-old former Olympic Bronze Medalist, have of proving to the 42-year-old Pacquiao that he deserves the crown he now holds?

text:
*EKSPERYENSYA

2019, napierde si Ugas sa hampang batok kay Shawn Porter.
english:
*EXPERIENCE

2019, Ugas lost a match to Shawn Porter.

text: Si Porter ang isa anay sa mga sparring partner ni Pacquiao.
english: Porter was one of Pacquiao's sparring partners.

text: Pagkatapos sang amo nga hampang, tatlo ka consecutive fights ang nadaug ni Ugas.
english: After that match, Ugas won three consecutive fights.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa boxing analyst nga si Edwin Espejo, iya ginpahayag nga kun basehan ang previous fights ni Ugas, masami ini nga naga-adapt sa estilo sang iya nga kasumpong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, boxing analyst Edwin Espejo said that based on Ugas' previous fights, he often adapts to the style of his opponent.

text: Apang pahayag ni Espejo, wala sang impressive ukon dalagku nga pangalan nga nakontra si Ugas indi kaangay sa mga hall of famer kag future hall of famer nga nakasambuwa ni Pacquiao.
english: However, Espejo said Ugas did not face any impressive or big names unlike the hall of famer and future hall of famer who faced Pacquiao.

text:
*FIGHTING STYLE

Orthodox ukon right-handed si Ugas.
english:
*FIGHTING STYLE

Ugas is orthodox or right-handed.

text: Lain ini sa Southpaw nga si Errol Spence Jr., ang orihinal nga kaaway nga amo gid kuntani ang nahandaan ni Pacquiao apang wala nadayon bangud sang eye injury ni Spence.
english: This is different from Southpaw Errol Spence Jr., the original opponent that Pacquiao was supposed to prepare for but was canceled due to Spence's eye injury.

text: Kun basehan ang Porter vs.
english: Based on Porter vs.

text: Ugas fight suno kay Espejo, nagaduko si Ugas sa iya away.
english: Ugas fight according to Espejo, Ugas is bowing in his fight.

text: “Kun amo na ang iya nga posisyon, dasig siya nga lab-uton ni Manny.
english: “If he's in that position, Manny will catch him quickly.

text:
While laba ang iya nga kamot, mas madasig maglupad ang kamot ni Manny.”

Ginpaathag ni Espejo nga kun magduko si Ugas, wala siya sang upper body strength agud nga mapalagyuhan ang sumbag ni Pacquiao.”Dapat he should fight tall in order to neutralize Manny’s speed.” Apang kun speed naman ang istoryahan, “pierdehon gid siya ni Manny sa speed lang.”

Suno kay Espejo, kalabanan sang nakasambuwa ni Pacquiao, lunsay mas mataas sa iya.
english:
While his hand is long, Manny's hand flies faster.”

Espejo explained that if Ugas bends down, he doesn't have the upper body strength to escape Pacquiao's punch. But when it comes to speed, “Manny will beat him on speed alone.”

According to Espejo, most of Pacquiao's opponents were taller than him.

text: Katapusan nga nakasambuwa ni Pacquiao nga mas manubo sa iya amo ang 5’4″ Mexican boxer nga si Emmanuel Lucero nga ginpierde man ni Pacquiao via 3rd Round Technical Knockout.
english: Pacquiao's last opponent was 5'4″ Mexican boxer Emmanuel Lucero whom Pacquiao also defeated via 3rd Round Technical Knockout.

text:
*SAOT NI PACQUIAO

Suno kay Espejo, indi kilala si Ugas nga ‘body-puncher from the distance’.
english:
*SAOT NI PACQUIAO

According to Espejo, Ugas is not known as a ‘body-puncher from the distance’.

text: Bangud sini, kinahanglan niya nga magdikit kay Pacquiao.
english: Because of this, he had to stick with Pacquiao.

text: “Kapag dumikit naman siya kay Manny, ayawan naman siya sang speed ni Manny,” suno kay Espejo bangud sang bantog nga combinations ni Pacquiao.
english: “When he sticks to Manny, he will lose Manny's speed,” Espejo said because of Pacquiao's famous combinations.

text: “Ugas will have to neutralize Manny’s lateral movement,” pahayag ni Espejo nga nagapatuhoy naman sa infamous ‘saot ni Manny sa sulod sang ring’.
english: “Ugas will have to neutralize Manny’s lateral movement,” Espejo said, referring to Manny’s infamous ‘dance inside the ring’.

text: Tentative suno sa natungdan ang jab deliveries ni Ugas, ‘perfect target’ sa counter right hooks sang Pinoy ring icon.
english: He said Ugas' jab deliveries were tentative, a 'perfect target' for the Pinoy ring icon's counter right hooks.

text:
*ANTI-CLIMACTIC FIGHT

Subong mahibaluan ang sabat kun deserving si Ugas nga sa iya ginpasa ang korona nga ginkakas sang WBA kay Pacquiao bangud sang inactivity sang People’s Champ sa boksing.
english:
*ANTI-CLIMACTIC FIGHT

Now the answer will be known if Ugas deserves the crown that the WBA took away from Pacquiao because of the inactivity of the People's Champ in boxing.

text: Subong man mahibaluan kun worth it bala si Ugas nga mangin last fight sang people’s champ.
english: Also know if Ugas is worth it to be the last fight of the people's champ.

text: “It’s not good for someone to take that belt without fighting me,” una nga pahayag ni Pacquiao sa iya grand arrival sa Las Vegas, Nevada.
english: “It’s not good for someone to take that belt without fighting me,” Pacquiao said at his grand arrival in Las Vegas, Nevada.

text: 100% naman nga sigurado si Ugas nga indi siya ma-knockout ni Pacquiao.
english: Ugas is 100% sure that Pacquiao will not knock him out.

text: Mapierde ayhan liwat ni Pacquiao ang Father Time kag mapadayon ang pagtukod sang iya legasiya, ukon mahatagan tyansa si Ugas nga mangin madinalag-on batok sa isa sa best fighters sang kalibutan?
english: Will Pacquiao beat Father Time again and continue to build his legacy, or will Ugas be given a chance to be successful against one of the best fighters in the world?

text: Bantayi ang update sa Bombo Radyo.
english: Stay tuned for updates on Bombo Radyo.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Former President Donald Trump nga may nahimo na sila nga kasugtanan agud mag-partisipar ini sa isa ka debate kay Vice President Kamala Harris nga natalana sa September 10 sa Philadelphia sa ABC News.
english: Former President Donald Trump announced that they had reached an agreement for him to participate in a debate with Vice President Kamala Harris scheduled for September 10 in Philadelphia on ABC News.

text: Kasunod ini sang una naggwa nga impormasyon nga posible nga mag-atras si Trump sa amo nga debate matapos ginpasibangdan sini ang host nga ABC News nga indi patas sa Republican Party partikular ang pagtrato sa Republican Senator nga si Tom Cotton sang Arkansas sang gin-interview ini sang network sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: This follows earlier reports that Trump might withdraw from the debate after he accused the ABC News host of being unfair to the Republican Party, particularly the treatment of Republican Senator Tom Cotton of Arkansas when he was interviewed by the network the other day.

text: Ang pinakaulihi nga anunsyo ni Trump ang kasunod man sang malawig nga negosasyon sa tunga sang Trump kag Harris campaigns, kun sa diin nangin isyu ang pila ka debate protocols, partikular ang pag- mute sang microphones kun wala na nagahambal ang kandidato.
english: Trump's latest announcement also follows lengthy negotiations between the Trump and Harris campaigns, where some debate protocols, particularly the muting of microphones when the candidate is no longer speaking, have become an issue.

text: Suno kay Trump,ang ipatuman nga rules ang pareho man sa nagligad nga CNN debate, nga epektibo kag paborable para sa ila.
english: According to Trump, the rules will be the same as in the previous CNN debate, which is effective and favorable for them.

text: ILOILO CITY- Liwat na naman nga gin-indict si former President Donald Trump may kaangtanan sa iya nangin pagtinguha nga baliskadon ang iya kalutusan sa 2020 presidential election, nga amo ang nagresulta sa natabo nga Jan.
english: ILOILO CITY – Former President Donald Trump has been indicted again in connection with his attempt to overturn his defeat in the 2020 presidential election, which resulted in the Jan.

text: 6 attack sa U.S. Capitol.
english: 6 attack on the U.S. Capitol.

text: Si Special counsel Jack Smith ang nag-charge kay Trump sa superseding indictment sa iya federal election interference case.
english: Special counsel Jack Smith charged Trump with the superseding indictment in his federal election interference case.

text: Ini naga-charge sa anay president sang apat sa gihapon nga counts sang felony charges nga iya gin-atubang sa original indictment: conspiracy to defraud the United States; conspiracy to obstruct an official proceeding; obstruction of and attempt to obstruct an official proceeding; kag conspiracy against rights.
english: It charges the former president with the same four counts of felony charges he faced in the original indictment: conspiracy to defraud the United States; conspiracy to obstruct an official proceeding; obstruction of and attempt to obstruct an official proceeding; and conspiracy against rights.

text: Ini nga superseding indictment ang ginbalik kasunod sang desisyon sang Supreme Court tuhoy sa presidential immunity sang nagligad nga bulan, nga nagpugong sa gobyerno nga maggamit sang pila ka “official acts” nga ginhimo ni Trump bilang parte sang iya papel bilang president sa prosecution.
english: This superseding indictment was reinstated following the Supreme Court’s ruling on presidential immunity last month, which prevented the government from using certain “official acts” Trump performed as part of his role as president in the prosecution.

text: Matandaan nga sini lang nga Agusto sang nag-plead nga not guilty si Trump sa federal charges angot sa iya plano nga baliskadon ang resulta sang 2020 election agud magpabilin sa poder.
english: Trump pleaded not guilty to federal charges in connection with his plan to overturn the results of the 2020 election to stay in power.

text: Duha na lang kaadlaw kag liwat na naman nga makit-an si eight division world champion Manny Pacquiao sa ibabaw sang boxing ring.
english: Two days later, eight division world champion Manny Pacquiao will be seen once again on the boxing ring.

text: Bilog nga bulan man kuntani ang nangin preparasyon ni Pacquiao batuk sa American boxer nga si Errol Spence Jr.
english: Pacquiao would have spent a month preparing for his fight against American boxer Errol Spence Jr.

text: apang nag-withdraw ini bangud sa injury.
english: but he withdrew due to injury.

text: Napilitan ang boxing champ nga liwat nga tun-an ang hulag sang iya mangin kasumpong sa Agusto 22 nga si Cuban champion Yordenis Ugas.
english: The boxing champ was forced to relearn the moves of his August 22 opponent, Cuban champion Yordenis Ugas.

text: Apang gin-ako ni Pacquiao nga may yara sang gamay nga kabudlay sa iya nga bahin samtang nagapreparar para kay Ugas — ang reigning “super” WBA welterweight king.
english: But Pacquiao admitted there was a bit of hardship on his side while preparing for Ugas — the reigning “super” WBA welterweight king.

text: Antes ang adlaw sang hampang, masako ang boxing champ sa paglantaw sang mga away man sadto ni Ugas agud nga makuha ni Pacquiao ang estilo sang Cuban champion sa ibabaw sang boxing ring.
english: Before the day of the match, the boxing champ was busy watching former Ugas fights so Pacquiao could get the Cuban champion's style on top of the boxing ring.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kun bala masarangan ni Pacquiao nga i-knockout si Ugas, sabat sang fighting senator, tinguhaan niya ini apang ang iya ginasiguro amo nga mangin malipayon ang boxing fans.
english: When asked if Pacquiao can knockout Ugas, the fighting senator said he will try but he is sure that the boxing fans will be happy.

text: Hiwaton ang World Welterweight Championship sa Las Vegas, Nevada sa Estados Unidos.
english: The World Welterweight Championship will be held in Las Vegas, Nevada in the United States.

text: Gina-abi-abi sang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) ang pagpili ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) welcomes the election of President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kay Police Major General Nicolas Torre III bilang chief sang Philippine National Police.
english: to Police Major General Nicolas Torre III as chief of the Philippine National Police.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, Spokesperson sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga committed nga magpakita sang suporta ang PRO-6 sa bag-o nga chief sang PNP.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonel Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office 6, said PRO-6 is committed to showing its support to the new PNP chief.

text: Ini agud mapasangkad ang pagpatuman sang peace and order sa Western Visayas.
english: This is to expand the implementation of peace and order in Western Visayas.

text: Dugang ni Solis, pananglitan nga may changes nga ipatuman ang bag-o nga PNP chief, bukas ang tatalapan nga sundon ang amo nga tikang.
english: Solis added that if there are changes to be implemented by the new PNP chief, the office is open to follow the move.

text: Nagpabutyag naman sang pagpasalamat ang PRO-6 kay outgoing PNP Chief General Rommel Marbil sa nahatag sini nga bulig sa patag sang welfare sang mga kapulisan.
english: PRO-6 expressed its gratitude to outgoing PNP Chief General Rommel Marbil for his assistance in the field of police welfare.

text: Si Torre ang nangin lider sang pila ka high-profile nga mga kaso, lakip na ang pagpangita kag pagkadakop kay televangelist Apollo Quiboloy sa Davao City, antes siya na-promote bilang hepe sang Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG).
english: Torre was the leader of several high-profile cases, including the search and arrest of televangelist Apollo Quiboloy in Davao City, before he was promoted as chief of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG).

text: Bilang hepe sang CIDG, siya man ang nagserbi sang warrant of arrest batok kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kasunod sang kaso sini sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: As chief of the CIDG, he also served a warrant of arrest against former President Rodrigo Duterte following his case in the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Dapat nga magpatigayon ang Ombudsman sang kaugalingon nga imbestigasyon sa mga flood control projects, ginaalegar nga budget insertions, kag iban pa nga mga ginapahayag kurapsyon nga nagakatabo sa pondo sang gobyerno.
english: The Ombudsman should conduct its own investigation into flood control projects, alleged budget insertions, and other alleged corruption occurring with government funds.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco, isa ka constitutional law expert, iya ginpahayag nga mahimo makapatigayon ang Ombudsman sang motu proprio investigation ukon, buot silingon, wala na nagahulat ukon nagakinahanglan nga may mag-file pa sang kaso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco, a constitutional law expert, said the Ombudsman can conduct a motu proprio investigation or, that is, without waiting or requiring someone to file a case.

text: “Hindi kailangan na may magsampa ng kaso sa kanila,” pahayag sini.
english: “There is no need for anyone to file a case against them,” he said.

text:
“Under the Constitution and under the Ombudsman Act, they can initiate —on their very own— an investigation against criminal activities involving corruption.”

Paagi sa sini nga imbestigasyon suno kay Yusingco, mabusisi ang kriminal nga mga aktibidad lakip na ang posibilidad sang plunder.
english:
“Under the Constitution and under the Ombudsman Act, they can initiate —on their very own— an investigation against criminal activities involving corruption.”

Through this investigation, Yusingco said, criminal activities including the possibility of plunder will be investigated.

text: Dapat suno sa iya nga na-umpisahan na ang preliminary investigation, natumod na kun sin-o ang mga tawo nga istoryahon, amo man kun sin-o ang mga posible nga persons of interest.
english: He said the preliminary investigation should have been started, the people to be interviewed should have been identified, as well as the possible persons of interest.

text: Ginpaathag sini nga indi maasahan nga mangin impartial ukon patas ang imbestigasyon sang Kongreso sa flood control projects, ilabi na bangud klaro nga may mga legislators nga involved sa sini nga mga eskandalo kag kurapsyon pati na sa pagduso sang insertions sa national budget.
english: He explained that Congress cannot be expected to be impartial or fair in its investigation of flood control projects, especially since it is clear that there are legislators involved in these scandals and corruption as well as in proposing insertions in the national budget.

text: “Gusto natin na may patunguhan [ang imbestigasyon ng Kongreso].
english: “We want [the Congressional investigation] to go somewhere.

text: Mayroon tayong responsibilidad bilang civil society na tutukan itong imbestigasyon na gagawin ng Kongreso para siguraduhin na kahit paano ay lumabas lahat ng impormasyon na importante,” dugang niya.
english: We have a responsibility as civil society to focus on this investigation that Congress will conduct to ensure that somehow all the important information comes out,” he added.

text: Sa privilege speech ni Senator Panfilo Lacson sang nagligad nga semana, nabuyagyag nga 40% lamang sa flood control funds ang nagakadto sa actual implementation samtang ang nabilin naman ang nagakadto sa kickbacks kag sa corruption.#
english: In Senator Panfilo Lacson's privilege speech last week, it was revealed that only 40% of the flood control funds go to actual implementation while the rest goes to kickbacks and corruption.

text: Isa ka giyera batok sa political dynasties ang gina-atubang sang subong nga henerasyon sang mga Pilipino.
english: A war against political dynasties is facing the current generation of Filipinos.

text: Ini ang ginpahangop sang isa ka constitutional law expert kag political analyst nga si Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco kadungan sang selebrasyon subong nga adlaw, Agusto 25, sang National Heroes Day kun sa diin ginakilala ang mga sakripisyo sang mga baganihan para sa kahilwayan kag dignidad sang Pilipinas.
english: This was explained by a constitutional law expert and political analyst, Atty. Michael Henry Yusingco in conjunction with the celebration today, August 25, of National Heroes Day which recognizes the sacrifices of heroes for the freedom and dignity of the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Yusingco, ginpahayag sini nga ang mga dynastic politicians ukon ang magpamilya nga naga-uyat sang gahum sa pulitika amo ang yara sa likod sang pork barrel campaign ukon pork barrel cartel sa Kongreso.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Yusingco said that dynastic politicians or families who hold political power are behind the pork barrel campaign or pork barrel cartel in Congress.

text: “Itong mga dynastic politicians na ‘to —that is our war now, our revolution now.
english: “Those dynastic politicians —that is our war now, our revolution now.

text: Tayong mga regular lang na mga Indio, ang kalaban natin itong mga political dynasties kasi sila talaga ang nasa likod ng pork barrel cartel.
english: We are just regular Indians, our enemy is these political dynasties because they are really behind the pork barrel cartel.

text: Sila ang pork barrel cartel sa totoo lang,” pahayag sini.
english: They are the pork barrel cartel in fact,” he said.

text: Sang 2013 pa sang gindeklarar sang Supreme Court en banc nga unconstitutional ang Priority Development Assistance Funds (PDAF) ukon ang congressional pork barrel.
english: It was in 2013 that the Supreme Court en banc declared the Priority Development Assistance Funds (PDAF) or the congressional pork barrel unconstitutional.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagguwa ang mga pagpakamalaot sa sini nga pondo kasunod sang special report sang Commission on Audit (COA) nga nagbulgar sang gross misuse sa funds sang mga mamalidha.
english: At the time, condemnations of this fund came out following a special report by the Commission on Audit (COA) that exposed gross misuse of funds by lawmakers.

text: Apang suno kay Yusingco, may pork barrel man gihapon subong ang mga legislators sa porma na sang budget insertions.
english: But according to Yusingco, legislators still have a pork barrel in the form of budget insertions.

text: Pahayag pa sang abogado, kun yara na ang dynastic politicians sa Kamara kag Senado, pat-od nga ang direksyon nila amo ang pagpangawat sang pondo sang gobyerno agud nga magdako pa ang ila manggad.
english: The lawyer said that when dynastic politicians are in the House and Senate, their direction is to steal government funds in order to increase their wealth.

text: “Alam na nating kung ano ang gagawin nila, nanakawin nila yung pera ng bayan, para mapayaman sila, para makabili sila ng 40 kotse, [at] magbabayad pa sila ng mga media para interviewhin sila.
english: “We know what they are going to do, they are stealing the people's money, to make themselves rich, to buy 40 cars, [and] they will pay the media to interview them.

text: Alam na natin na nanakawin nila ang pera ng kaban ng bayan,” dugang sini.
english: We know that they stole the money of the people's treasury,” he added.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa report sang Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism, dominado gihapon sang political dynasties ang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Philippine Center for Investigative Journalism, the Philippines is still dominated by political dynasties.

text: Pahayag sa report, 80% sang 254 district representatives sa 20th Congress ang halin sa political families.
english: According to the report, 80% of the 254 district representatives in the 20th Congress are from political families.

text: Ginakibang ang pila sa mga residente sa Barangay Lantangan (Gigantes Sur), Carles, Iloilo pila ka semana matapos natabo ang pagpatay sa mag-asawa nga senior citizen sa amo nga island barangay.
english: Some residents in Barangay Lantangan (Gigantes Sur), Carles, Iloilo are in shock weeks after the murder of a senior citizen couple in the island barangay.

text: Kun balikan, ang mga biktima amo sanday Violeta Bolohabo, 71, kag Jesus Bolohabo, 75, nga gintiro sang nagapauli na ang mga ini halin sa gintambungan nga kahiwatan sa plaza.
english: The victims were identified as Violeta Bolohabo, 71, and Jesus Bolohabo, 75, who were shot while returning home from an event in the plaza.

text: Ang suspek naman amo si Wenrey Belasa, 31, residente sang Brgy.
english: The suspect was identified as Wenrey Belasa, 31, resident of Brgy.

text: Bayuyan, Estancia, Iloilo, nga nadakpan naman sang mga pulis sa hot pursuit operation.
english: Bayuyan, Estancia, Iloilo, who was arrested by the police in a hot pursuit operation.

text: Una na nagguwa ang impormasyon nga posible naangot sa kaakig kag pagtimalos ang insidente bangud sa pagpangduha-duha nga mga manughiwit ang mga biktima.
english: Earlier, information emerged that the incident may have been linked to anger and revenge as the victims were suspected to be witches.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alias Jen nga nagpakilala nga hinablos sang mga biktima, ginpahayag sini nga indi gihapon mapahamtang ang ila pamilya sa ila nga safety apisar nga napreso na ang suspek.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, alias Jen, who identified herself as the victims' nephew, said her family is still unable to feel safe despite the suspect's imprisonment.

text: Suno sa tag-reklamo, may mga nakit-an sila nga indi kilala nga mga tawo sa ila palibot kag nagakahangawa nga basi kun mabutang sa alang-alang ang ila nga seguridad sa island barangay.
english: According to the complainant, they saw unknown people around them and were worried that their security in the island barangay might be compromised.

text: Ginahingyo sang pamilya nga kuntani hugot ang inspection sa ila lugar ilabi na bangud may mga turista man nga nagasulod sa ila apang indi man ma-identify tanan.
english: The family requests that there should be strict inspection in their area especially since there are tourists who enter them but not all can be identified.

text: Lakip man sa gindangop sini sa Bombo Radyo amo ang reklamo batok sa ila punong barangay.
english: He also turned to Bombo Radyo for a complaint against their barangay captain.

text: Suno kay alias Jen, indi ma-cater ang ila nga concern bangud wala ang opisyal sa barangay hall kag yara ini nagatinir sa ila balay sa Estancia kag mga barangay kagawad lang ang naga-atubang sa ila pamilya.
english: According to alias Jen, their concern cannot be catered because the official is not in the barangay hall and he is staying at his house in Estancia and only barangay kagawads are dealing with their families.

text: Ginpalab-ot ini sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Siegfredo Betita sang Carles.
english: Bombo Radyo reached out to Mayor Siegfredo Betita of Carles.

text: Pahayag sang alkalde, posible nga may iban man nga concerns nga ginahikot ang punong barangay bilang ABC president rason nga wala dayon naatubang ang reklamo sang pamilya.
english: The mayor said it is possible that the barangay captain has other concerns as ABC president that is why the family's complaint was not immediately addressed.

text: Kaangot sa seguridad, ginpaathag man sang alkalde nga sa port of origin pa lamang ukon Bancal port, nagalista na sang pangalan ang mga turista.
english: Regarding security, the mayor also explained that even at the port of origin or Bancal port, tourists are already registering their names.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga maga-istorya sila dugang sang barangay official kaangot diri.#
english: He also said that they will talk to the barangay official regarding this.

text: Naglab-ot sa 1 million ang ginpromisa nga trabaho sang pribado nga sektor subong nga tuig.
english: The private sector has promised 1 million jobs this year.

text: Apang mahimo lamang ini kun mabuligan sang gobyerno ang ila nga “wish list” kaangay sang bakuna kag maayo nga transportasyon sa mga mamumugon.
english: But this can only be done if the government helps their “wish list” such as vaccines and good transportation for workers.

text: Suno kay Sergio Ortiz-Luis, Presidente sang Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP), ang mga pribado nga sektor mismo ang boluntaryo nga nagpahayag nga masarangan nila nga maghimo sang isa ka milyon nga mga trabaho para sa mga Pilipino.
english: According to Sergio Ortiz-Luis, President of the Employers Confederation of the Philippines (ECOP), the private sector itself has voluntarily declared that it can create one million jobs for Filipinos.

text: Sa idalom sang “Reform.
english: Under the “Reform.

text: Rebound.
english: Rebound.

text: Recover: One million jobs for 2021”, solusyonan sang nagkalain-lain nga ahensya sang gobyerno ang problema sa transportasyon sang mga mamumugon, buligan ang pribado nga sektor sa pagpangita sang kwalipikado nga aplikante kag hatagan sang access sa bakuna kontra COVID-19 ang mga empleyado nga mangin kabahin sang proyekto.
english: Recover: One million jobs for 2021”, various government agencies will solve the problem of transportation of workers, assist the private sector in finding qualified applicants and provide access to the COVID-19 vaccine to employees who will be part of the project.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa labor force survey sang Mayo, naglab-ot sa masobra 3.7 million ka mga Pilipino ang wala sang trabaho gani subong, target sang gobyerno nga mahatagan sang obra ang 2.4 million tubtob 2.8 million ka mga indibidwal subong nga tuig.
english: It is known that based on the labor force survey in May, more than 3.7 million Filipinos are unemployed so now, the government targets to provide jobs to 2.4 million to 2.8 million individuals this year.

text: Nagpositibo ang isa ka tricycle driver sa iligal nga druga kasunod sang ginpatigayon nga random drug testing sang Land Transportation Office Region 6 (LTO-6) kag Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 6 sa duha ka transport terminal sa Iloilo City.
english: A tricycle driver tested positive for illegal drugs following the random drug testing conducted by the Land Transportation Office Region 6 (LTO-6) and Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 6 at two transport terminals in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Director sang Land Transportation Office Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang simultaneous drug testing ginpatigayon sa Tagbak Terminal kon sa diin, may yara sang 112 ka mga driver ang ginpaidalom sa drug test.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Gaudioso Geduspan II, Director of the Land Transportation Office Region 6, said the simultaneous drug testing was conducted at the Tagbak Terminal where 112 drivers were subjected to drug tests.

text: Sa amo nga terminal man nagabyahe ang amo nga tricycle driver.
english: The tricycle driver also travels to the same terminal.

text: Samtang, 102 drivers naman ang ginpaidalom sa amo nga tikang sa bahin sang Ungka Terminal.
english: Meanwhile, 102 drivers were subjected to the same measure at Ungka Terminal.

text: Suno kay Geduspan, kasunod sang pagpositibo sang tricycle driver, ipaidalom pa ini sa gihapon sa confirmatory test apang, hawidan sa gihapon sang LTO ang iya nga lisensya.
english: According to Geduspan, following the positivity of the tricycle driver, he will still undergo a confirmatory test but the LTO will still withhold his license.

text: Pananglitan nga makumpirma sa confirmatory test nga involve sa illegal drugs ang driver, i-revoke sang talatapan ang drivers’ license sini.
english: If the confirmatory test confirms that the driver is involved in illegal drugs, the office will revoke his drivers' license.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga ang drug test ang nagatuyo nga ipabilin nga safe kag malayo sa mga kompromisa ang mga pasahero.
english: He also explained that the drug test aims to keep passengers safe and away from compromises.

text: Posible nga mag-atras si former United States President Donald Trump sa naka-schedule nga presidential debate batok kay Vice President Kamala Harris sa Septyembre 10.
english: Former United States President Donald Trump is likely to withdraw from the scheduled presidential debate against Vice President Kamala Harris on September 10.

text: Ini matapos ginpasibangdan sini ang host nga ABC News nga indi patas sa Republican Party partikular ang pagtrato sa Republican Senator nga si Tom Cotton sang Arkansas sang gin-interview ini sang network sang nagligad nga adlaw.
english: This comes after he accused the ABC News host of being unfair to the Republican Party particularly the treatment of Republican Senator Tom Cotton of Arkansas when he was interviewed by the network yesterday.

text: Gintawag sini nga “ABC FAKE NEWS” ang network kag ginlaragway man nga biased ang interview sa iya kaalyado rason nga wala siya sang nakit-an nga rason suno kay Trump nga dayunon ang debate batok kay Harris nga amo ang official candidate sang Democrats para sa November presidential elections.
english: He called the network “ABC FAKE NEWS” and described the interview with his ally as biased, saying he saw no reason to continue the debate against Harris, the Democrats' official candidate for the November presidential elections.

text: “I watched ABC FAKE NEWS this morning, both lightweight reporter Jonathan Carl’s(K?) ridiculous and biased interview of Tom Cotton (who was fantastic!), and their so-called Panel of Trump Haters, and I ask, why would I do the Debate against Kamala Harris on that network?” kabahin sang post ni Trump.
english: “I watched ABC FAKE NEWS this morning, both lightweight reporter Jonathan Carl’s(K?) ridiculous and biased interview of Tom Cotton (who was fantastic!), and their so-called Panel of Trump Haters, and I ask, why would I do the Debate against Kamala Harris on that network?” was part of Trump's post.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Republican candidate nga nagsugot siya sa Septyembre 4 nga dabate sa Fox News nga network apang nagpangindi diri ang Harris campaign.
english: The Republican candidate earlier said he agreed to a September 4 debate on the Fox News network but the Harris campaign refused.

text: Antes ang komento ni Trump sa iya posible pag-atras, nag-guwa na ang reports kaangot sa ginabaisan nga regulasyon sa debate partikular ang paggamit sang microphone.
english: Before Trump's comments on his possible withdrawal, reports had surfaced regarding the controversial rules of the debate particularly the use of microphones.

text: Gina-alegar sang reports nga gina-demand sang kampo ni Harris nga ipabilin nga naka-on ang mikropono bangud sa pagpati nga ang linya sang pagkwestyon sang bise-presidente ang magapainit sang ulo sang former president, bagay nga ginkontra naman sang Trump campaign kag gin-insister nga patyon ang microphone kun makatapos na ang turno sang kandidato.
english: Reports allege that Harris' camp is demanding that the microphone be kept on because it believes that the vice president's line of questioning will heat up the former president, something the Trump campaign has opposed and insisted that the microphone be turned off when the candidate's turn is over.

text: Nagnubo ang business confidence sa Pilipinas sa ikaduha nga quarter sang tuig 2021.
english: Business confidence in the Philippines declined in the second quarter of 2021.

text: Suno kay Redentor Paolo Alegre Jr., senior director sang Department of Economic Statistics sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), humalin sang Abril tubtob Hunyo, nanaog sa 1.4 percent halin sa 17.4 percent ang calculated percentage sang mga kompaniya nga nagsabat sang ‘yes’ sa Business Expectations Survey (BES) sa pinakauna nga quarter sang tuig.
english: According to Redentor Paolo Alegre Jr., senior director of the Department of Economic Statistics of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), from April to June, the calculated percentage of companies that answered 'yes' to the Business Expectation Survey (BES) in the first quarter of the year fell to 1.4 percent from 17.4 percent.

text: Pahayag ni Alegre, mas nagnubo ang kumpyansa sang mga negosyo bangud sa asud-asud nga pagtimbuok sang kaso sang COVID-19 partikular na sa National Capital Region (NCR) Plus nga nagresulta sa inflation ukon pagsaka sang presyo kasunod sang supply constraints.
english: Alegre said the confidence of businesses has declined due to the rapid increase in COVID-19 cases particularly in the National Capital Region (NCR) Plus which has resulted in inflation or price increases following supply constraints.

text: Ang confidence index para sa ikatatlo nga quarter sang tuig ang nagnubo man sa 31.4 percent halin sa 42.8 percent sang nagligad nga poll.
english: The confidence index for the third quarter of the year also fell to 31.4 percent from 42.8 percent in the previous poll.

text: Gin-aresto sa Taal, Batangas ang isa ka district engineer sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) bangud sa ginaalegar nga pag-bribe sang pila ka beses kay Batangas 1st District Rep.
english: A district engineer of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) was arrested in Taal, Batangas for allegedly bribing Batangas 1st District Rep.

text: Leandro Leviste.
english: Leandro Leviste.

text: Ginpahayag nga gintuyo nga bayaran sang amo nga district engineer si Leviste sang kapin P3.1 million agud pauntaton ang imbestigasyon sang mamalidha sa ginaalegar nga iregularidad sa infrastructure projects sang probinsya.
english: The district engineer allegedly tried to pay Leviste more than P3.1 million to stop the lawmaker's investigation into alleged irregularities in infrastructure projects in the province.

text: Ang arestado amo ang 51-anyos nga si alyas “Abe”.
english: The arrested was identified as 51-year-old alias “Abe”.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, P3,126,900 ang gintanyag ni “Abe” kay Leviste sang adlaw nga gin-aresto ini agud pauntaton ang mamalidha sa imbestigasyon sa anomaliya sa proyekto sang DPWH sa first district sang Batangas.
english: According to the investigation, “Abe” offered P3,126,900 to Leviste on the day of his arrest to stop the lawmaker from investigating the anomaly in the DPWH project in the first district of Batangas.

text: Nagpatigayon sang entrapment operation ang kapulisan nga nagresulta sa pagkaaresto sa engineer.
english: Police conducted an entrapment operation that resulted in the arrest of the engineer.

text: Narekober naman sa iya ang bribe money.
english: The bribe money was recovered from him.

text: Mangatubang si alyas “Abe” sang kaso nga paglapas sa Article 212 sang Revised Penal Code (corruption of public officials) kag Republic Act No.
english: Alias ​​“Abe” will face charges of violation of Article 212 of the Revised Penal Code (corruption of public officials) and Republic Act No.

text: 3019 ukon ang Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act.
english: 3019 or the Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act.

text: Yara na sa bastante nga lebel ang na-impound nga tubig sang Jalaur River Multipurpose Project II sa Calinog, Iloilo.
english: The impounded water of the Jalaur River Multipurpose Project II in Calinog, Iloilo is now at a sufficient level.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Steve Cordero, spokesperson sang National Irrigation Administration, iya ginpahayag nga gikan sa 189 nga full height sang high dam, yara na ang lebel sang tubig sa 171 meters.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Steve Cordero, spokesperson of the National Irrigation Administration, said that from the 189 full height of the high dam, the water level is now at 171 meters.

text: Suno kay Cordero, katumbas ini sang 125.
english: According to Cordero, this is equivalent to 125.

text: 52 million cubic meters nga volume gikan sa 150 million cubic meters nga full capacity.
english: 52 million cubic meters volume out of 150 million cubic meters full capacity.

text: Pahayag ni Cordero, mahimo pa nga madugangan ang volume sini sa pagsulod sang tig-ululan.
english: Cordero said the volume could be increased with the onset of the rainy season.

text: Pahayag ni Cordero, sa tion nga mangin operational na ang dam, powede nag magamit ang tubig sa irigasyon sa mga lugar nga sakop sang service area sang dam.
english: Cordero said that once the dam becomes operational, the water can be used for irrigation in the areas within the service area of ​​the dam.

text: Ang Jalaur River Multi-Purpose Project Stage II (JRMP II) amo ang una nga large-scale water reservoir nga gintukod sa Visayas kag Mindanao regions.
english: The Jalaur River Multi-Purpose Project Stage II (JRMP II) is the first large-scale water reservoir constructed in the Visayas and Mindanao regions.

text: Ini ang flagship project sang National Irrigation Administration sa Western Visayas.
english: This is the flagship project of the National Irrigation Administration in Western Visayas.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 –  Dakop ang manug-ihaw sang baboy sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation sa Brgy.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – A pig slaughterer was arrested in a drug buy bust operation in Brgy.

text: Kasing Kasing , Molo Iloilo City.
english: Kasing Kasing , Molo Iloilo City.

text: Ang arestado amo si Joselito Exito, 42, residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The arrested was identified as Joselito Exito, 42, resident of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 4, iya ginpahayag nga tatlo ka semana nila nga ginbantayan ang arestado antes nadakpan.
english: Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 4, said they monitored the suspect for three weeks before arresting him.

text: Nakuha sa posisyon sini ang 50 grams sang suspected shabu balor P340,000.
english: Recovered from his possession were 50 grams of suspected shabu worth P340,000.

text: Sa subong, preso na ini kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: He is currently in custody and facing charges of violating Republic Act No.

text: 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Lain nga lebel sang panibag-o nga bayolasyon ang ginhimo sang People’s Republic of China sang ginsulod sang military aircraft sini ang airspace sang Japan sa labing-una nga tion.
english: The People's Republic of China committed another level of violation when its military aircraft entered Japanese airspace for the first time.

text: Ginkumpirma mismo sang Japanese Defense Ministry nga isa ka Chinese military aircraft ang iligal nga nagsulod sa territorial airspace nga sakop na sang Danjo Islands sa Nagasaki Prefecture sa Japan.
english: The Japanese Defense Ministry itself confirmed that a Chinese military aircraft illegally entered the territorial airspace of the Danjo Islands in Nagasaki Prefecture in Japan.

text: Base sa ministry, ang nag-trespass amo ang “Y-9 intelligence-gathering” aircraft kag natabo ini 11:29 am (local time sa Tokyo) kag naglawig sang halos duha ka minutos.
english: According to the ministry, the trespasser was the “Y-9 intelligence-gathering” aircraft and it happened at 11:29 am (local time in Tokyo) and lasted for almost two minutes.

text: Wala pa sang ginpaguwa nga official statement ang Chinese authorities kaangot diri.
english: The Chinese authorities have not yet issued an official statement on the matter.

text: Madasig man nga gingamit sang Japan ang ila fighter jets nga ginapreparar sa tion sang emerhensya.
english: Japan also quickly used its fighter jets that were on standby in case of emergency.

text: Ini ang first incursion sang Chinese military aircraft sa airspace sang Japan nga ginbalusan sang mga Japanese sang warnings.
english: This was the first incursion of Chinese military aircraft into Japanese airspace which the Japanese responded with warnings.

text: Gin-athag man sang ministry nga wala sila naggamit sang weapons kaangay sang flare guns sang nag-isyu sila sang alert sa aircraft sang Beijing.
english: The ministry also clarified that it did not use weapons such as flare guns when it issued the alert to Beijing's aircraft.

text: Antes sini, matandaan nga na-involve man ang Japanese kag Chinese vessels sa tensyonado nga mga insidente sa disputed areas ilabi na sa Senkaku islands sa East China Sea nga ginatawag sang Beijing nga Diaoyus.
english: Earlier, Japanese and Chinese vessels were also involved in tense incidents in disputed areas especially in the Senkaku islands in the East China Sea which Beijing calls Diaoyus.

text: Nangin agresibo pa gid ang Beijing sa ila pag-claim sa amo nga isla sini lang nga mga tinuig rason kun ngaa gin-report sang Tokyo nga may ginpadala na ang China nga coast guard vessels, naval ship kag mangin nuclear-powered submarine.
english: Beijing has become more aggressive in its claim to the island in recent years, prompting Tokyo to report that China has sent coast guard vessels, a naval ship and a nuclear-powered submarine.

text: ILOILO CITY – Bugal para sa isa ka anay manunudlo nga pasidunggan bilang champion alumni sa 1st Pinwheel Awards: Champions of Children sang CHILD Initiative.
english: ILOILO CITY – A former teacher is proud to be honored as a champion alumni in the 1st Pinwheel Awards: Champions of Children of the CHILD Initiative.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Maria Corazon Buala, anay manunudlo kag subong operations manager sang Ace2Ace Training and Education, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga pasidungog nga iya nabaton ang ginhatag sang CHILD Initiative, isa ka Non Government Organization (NGO), sa mga tawo nga nagatib-ong sang kaayuhan sang kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Maria Corazon Buala, former teacher and operations manager of Ace2Ace Training and Education, said the award she received was given by the CHILD Initiative, a Non Government Organization (NGO), to people who promote the welfare of children.

text: Ginpahayag ni Buala nga bag-o pa man siya nangin isa ka manunudlo, nagtrabaho siya sa isa ka NGO kag ini ang rason kun nga-a, iya nga ginbayaan ang teaching profession.
english: Buala said that before he became a teacher, he worked for an NGO and this is the reason why he left the teaching profession.

text: Ang pagbulig sa mga nagakinahanglan ilabi na sa kabataan ang malapit sa iya tagipusu-on bangud nga mismo siya ang sadto anay isa ka sponsored child sang nasambit nga NGO nga kilala sadto nga Christian Children’s Fund.
english: Helping those in need especially children is close to his heart because he himself was a sponsored child of the said NGO known as the Christian Children's Fund.

text: Mismo ang iya iloy suno kay Buala ang nangin inspirasyon niya sa pagpili sang career.
english: Buala said his mother was his inspiration in choosing a career.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga labaw sa pasidungog, bugal para sa iya nga mahatagan sang kahigayunan nga makapadulong sa luwas sang pungsod para sa pagtib-ong sang child protection kag itiglawas sang 12 million ka mga kabataan nga pinoy.
english: He also said that more than an honor, it is a pride for him to be given the opportunity to go abroad to promote child protection and represent 12 million Filipino children.

text: Importante suno sa iya ang paghatag sang proteksyon sa mga kabataan nga ginakabig nga paglaum sang sosyodad.
english: He said it is important to provide protection to children who are considered the hope of society.

text: Nagalaum naman si Buala nga malab-ot man niya ang handum nga makapatindog sang kaugalingon nga NGO agud nga makahatag sang bulig sa mas madamu nga kabataan.
english: Buala hopes to achieve her dream of establishing her own NGO to help more children.

text: Gina-welcome sang Department of Education ang proposal sang Iloilo Provincial Government nga i-integrate sa curriculum ang driving course kag road safety education para itudlo sa mga estudyante.
english: The Department of Education welcomes the proposal of the Iloilo Provincial Government to integrate driving course and road safety education into the curriculum to teach students.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson sang Department of Education- Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga kun matigayon ini, dako ini nga bulig para mas magsangkad ang ihibalo sang mga kabataan sa amo nga patag.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Leonil Salvilla, spokesperson of the Department of Education-Iloilo, said that if this is achieved, it will be a big help to expand the knowledge of children in the field.

text: Suno kay Salvilla, sa subong ginahulat nila ang koordinasyon sang provincial government sa Department of Education- Iloilo kun ano ang masunod nga mga tikang angot diri.
english: Salvilla said they are currently waiting for the coordination of the provincial government with the Department of Education-Iloilo on the next steps in this regard.

text: Pahayag ni Salvilla, pwede ini ma-integrate sa subject nga Araling Panlipunan ukon sa Health.
english: Salvilla said it can be integrated into the subject of Social Studies or Health.

text: Dugang niya, kun matigayon ini, kinahanglan nga hanason man ang mga manunudlo nga in-charge, sa bulig sang mga ahensya sang gobyerno agud nga mas mangin epektibo ang pagtudlo sini.
english: He added that if this is achieved, it is necessary to train the teachers in-charge, with the help of government agencies to make teaching more effective.

text: Naghatag sang impormasyon ang anak sang principal suspect sa kaso sang pagkidnap sa American national nga si Elliot Onil Eastman sa Sibuco, Zamboanga del Norte.
english: The son of the principal suspect in the kidnapping case of American national Elliot Onil Eastman in Sibuco, Zamboanga del Norte has given information.

text: Suno kay Brig.
english: According to Brig.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jean Fajardo, spokesperson sang Philippine National Police (PNP), ini nga mga impormasyon ang nagalakip sang detalye halin sang tion nga ginkuha gid mismo si Eastman sa balay sang iya mga ugangan sa Barangay Población tubtub nga ginsakay ini sa motorized boat.
english: Jean Fajardo, spokesperson of the Philippine National Police (PNP), said the information includes details from the time Eastman was taken from his in-laws' house in Barangay Poblacion until he was boarded a motorized boat.

text: Ini nga mga detalye ang subject pa para sa verification sang PNP kag Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
english: These details are still subject to verification by the PNP and Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).

text: Lakip sa ginbuyagyag sang anak sang principal suspect amo nga ang sakayan nga gingamit sa pagdala kay Eastman ang ginpintahan liwat para malikawan nga ma-detect.
english: Among the revelations made by the son of the principal suspect was that the boat used to transport Eastman was repainted to avoid detection.

text: Indi klaro subong kun buhi ukon patay na si Eastman halin sang ginkidnap ini sang Oktubre 17.
english: It is currently unclear whether Eastman has been alive or dead since her Oct. 17 kidnapping.

text: Lakip sa ginalantaw nga motibo sa kidnapping amo ang ransom apang may iban pa gid nga ginatun-an nga mga posibilidad.
english: Among the suspected motives for the kidnapping is ransom but other possibilities are being studied.

text: Nahibaluan nga may kidnapping and serious illegal detention complaints na nga na-file batok sa anum ka mga suspek.
english: It was learned that kidnapping and serious illegal detention complaints have already been filed against the six suspects.

text: Tatlo sa ila ang yara sa kustodiya sang pulis samtang at large naman ang principal suspect.
english: Three of them are in police custody while the principal suspect is at large.

text: Si Eastman nga isa man ka vlogger ang kasado sa isa ka Pinay kag lima ka bulan na nga yara sa Sibuco antes natabo ang insidente.
english: Eastman, who is also a vlogger, is married to a Filipina and had been in Sibuco for five months before the incident.

text: Padayon man ang pag-trabaho sang US Embassy kaupod sa local authorities sa pagpangita kay Eastman ilabi na bangud una na nagguwa ang impormasyon nga natiruhan ini antes dalayon nadala sang mga armado nga kalalakinhan.
english: The US Embassy is also working with local authorities to find Eastman especially since there were reports that he was stabbed before being taken away by armed men.

text: Nagpakitaay sang mabaskog nga pwersa ang Israel kag Lebanese militant group nga Hezbollah paagi sa pagpalupad sang drones, rockets kag jets apang gin-untat man gilayon kag wala gindayon ang ginakahangaw-an nga all-out war nga amo pa ang magapasingki sang tensyon sa Middle East.
english: Israel and the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah showed their strong force by flying drones, rockets and jets but immediately stopped and did not continue the feared all-out war that would further escalate tensions in the Middle East.

text: Ginhimo ini nga cross-border attacks kadungan man sang pag-istoryahanay sang mediators, Israelis, kag Hamas representatives sa Egypt agud kuntani mapatigayon ang ceasefire sa Gaza kag mapahagan-hagan ang gamo sa rehiyon.
english: The cross-border attacks were carried out in conjunction with talks between mediators, Israelis, and Hamas representatives in Egypt to hopefully achieve a ceasefire in Gaza and ease unrest in the region.

text: Suno sa Hezbollah, naggamit sila sang drones kag masobra 320 ka rockets batok sa 11 ka Israeli military sites bilang una nga hugnat sang ila pagtimalos kasunod sang Israeli airstrike nga nag-resulta sa kamatayon sang ila commander nga si Fuad Shukr sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: Hezbollah said it used drones and more than 320 rockets against 11 Israeli military sites as the first phase of its retaliation following an Israeli airstrike that killed its commander Fuad Shukr last month.

text: Nagpaandam ini nga may ikaduha pa nga hugnat sang atake.
english: It warned that there would be a second round of attacks.

text: Sa una nga atake, isa ka Israeli navy officer ang napatay kag duha ka iban nga service members ang nasamaran, kag naigu man ang military intelligence site sang Israel malapit sa Tel Aviv.
english: In the first attack, an Israeli navy officer was killed and two other service members wounded, and an Israeli military intelligence site near Tel Aviv was also hit.

text: Sa airstrikes naman sang Israel, duha ka Hezbollah fighters kag isa ka militante halin sa ila kaalyado nga grupo ang napatay.
english: In the Israeli airstrikes, two Hezbollah fighters and a militant from their allied group were killed.

text: Sunod nga ginklaro ni Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga wala sila sang tuyo nga magpatigayon sang full-scale war apang determinado sila nga magdepensa pananglitan may maghalit sa ila.
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later clarified that they have no intention of waging a full-scale war but are determined to defend themselves in case of harm.

text: Ginkumpirma man ni Netanyahu ang impormasyon nga mas nauna ang air strikes sang Israel ipaanggid sa barrage sang Hezbollah.
english: Netanyahu also confirmed reports that Israel's air strikes were earlier than Hezbollah's barrage.

text: Isa ini ka “preemptive” strike suno sa prime minister kag amo ang nakapugong sa mas daku kuntani nga pwersa nga ipadala sang militante nga grupo.
english: The prime minister said it was a “preemptive” strike and prevented a larger force from being sent by the militant group.

text: Kadungan sini nga tensyon, ginsuspinde sang masobra isa ka oras ang operasyon sa airport sa Tel Aviv amo man ang byahe halin kag pakadto sa Beirut sa Labanon.
english: In parallel with this tension, operations at the airport in Tel Aviv were suspended for more than an hour as well as flights to and from Beirut in Labanon.

text: Gin-athag man sang Estados Unidos nga indi sila involved sa airstrikes sang Israel, apang nag-ako nga nakahatag sila sang intelligence kaangot sa himuon nga atake sang Hezbollah.
english: The United States also clarified that it was not involved in the Israeli airstrikes, but acknowledged that it had provided intelligence regarding the attack by Hezbollah.

text: Nagbaha ang pagdayaw matapos ginlutos ni Filipino WBO bantamweight champion John Riel Casimero ang Cuban veteran two-time division champion nga si Guillermo Rigondeaux sa 12 round boxing match nga ginpatigayon sa Dignity Health Sports Park, Carson, California sa Estados Unidos.
english: Filipino WBO bantamweight champion John Riel Casimero defeated Cuban veteran two-time division champion Guillermo Rigondeaux in a 12 round boxing match held at Dignity Health Sports Park, Carson, California in the United States.

text: Daog sa sambuwa via split decision ang Pinoy Pride nga tumandok sang Ormoc City, Leyte.
english: Pinoy Pride, a native of Ormoc City, Leyte, won the fight via split decision.

text: Ginpaboran sang mga judges ang pagka-agresibo kag impresibo nga performance ni Casimero.
english: The judges favored Casimero's aggressiveness and impressive performance.

text: 115-113 ang score para kay Rigondeaux, samtang 116-112 kag 117-111 naman para kay Casimero.
english: The score was 115-113 for Rigondeaux, while it was 116-112 and 117-111 for Casimero.

text: Sa 12 rounds, mas madamo pa ang dalagan kag paglikaw sang 40-anyos nga Cuban boxer batok sa 32-anyos nga Pinoy Champion.
english: In 12 rounds, the 40-year-old Cuban boxer had more running and avoiding than the 32-year-old Pinoy Champion.

text: Bangud diri, nangin tuman ka obvious naman ang ‘frustrations’ ni Casimero lakip na sang mga tumalan-aw sa sulod sang arena.
english: Because of this, Casimero's frustrations became very obvious as well as those of the spectators inside the arena.

text: Mabatian man ang ”booo” nga ginahaboy batok kay Rigondeaux.
english: A ”booo” can also be heard being thrown against Rigondeaux.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang three division world champion nga si Casimero ang yara sa idalom sang MP Promotions ni Senador Manny Pacquiao.
english: It is known that three division world champion Casimero is under the MP Promotions of Senator Manny Pacquiao.

text: Ini na ang ika-duha nga paglutos sang Pinoy Champion kay Rigondeaux nga naka-secure sadto sang duha ka gold medal sa Olympiada.
english: This is the second time the Pinoy Champion has defeated Rigondeaux, who previously secured two gold medals at the Olympics.

text: Ginsekyar sang Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang 417 boxes sang official ballots para sa 417 ka mga clustered precincts sa Iloilo City.
english: The Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) checked 417 boxes of official ballots for 417 clustered precincts in Iloilo City.

text: Ini bilang preparasyon man sa palaabuton nga May 12, 2025 midterm elections.
english: This is also in preparation for the upcoming May 12, 2025 midterm elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Pinky Jevini Tentativa, Election Officer sang Iloilo City Commission on Elections, iya ginpahayag nga ‘las-8:36 kaina sang aga, nagpatuman na ang talatapan sang deployment sang mga automated counting machines (ACM) sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Pinky Jevini Tentativa, Election Officer of the Iloilo City Commission on Elections, said that at 8:36 am yesterday, the office implemented the deployment of automated counting machines (ACM) in the city.

text: Suno kay Tentiva, gin-deliver ang machines sa 66 ka voting centers sa Iloilo City para sa 330,621 ka mga registered voters.
english: According to Tentiva, the machines were delivered to 66 voting centers in Iloilo City for 330,621 registered voters.

text: Gintuad man sini nga nauna dulong ang ACM sa Distrito sang Arevalo, ginsundan sang Molo, Lapuz, La Paz, Mandurriao, kag Jaro.
english: He also admitted that the ACM went first to Arevalo District, followed by Molo, Lapuz, La Paz, Mandurriao, and Jaro.

text: Ipatuman naman buwas nga adlaw ang synchronize final testing and sealing sang machines.
english: The synchronize final testing and sealing of the machines will be implemented tomorrow.

text: Matapos ang amo nga tikang, i-seal na ang mga ACM kag indi na ini mahimo mabuksan tubtob sa adlaw sang eleksyon.
english: After the move, the ACMs will be sealed and cannot be opened until election day.

text: Ipahamtang naman ini sa mga storage facilities sang voting centers lakip na sa mga mall.
english: They will be placed in the storage facilities of voting centers including malls.

text: Pagabantayan naman automated counting machines sang katapo sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: Automated counting machines will be guarded by members of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: May isa ka tawo sa state sang Telangana sa India nga nakapukaw sang interes sang publiko bangud sa pinasahi sini nga ginhimo nga ginkilala sang Guinness World Record.
english: There is a man in the state of Telangana in India who has aroused the interest of the public because of his unique feat that was recognized by the Guinness World Record.

text: Ini amo si Kranthi Kumar Panikera nga napa-untat ang pagtiyog sang 57 ka electric fans sa sulod sang isa ka minuto gamit lamang ang iya nga dila!
english: This is Kranthi Kumar Panikera who stopped the vibration of 57 electric fans in one minute with just his tongue!

text: Halos indi makapati ang tanan kun paano ini ginhimo ni Kranthi, apang matuod ini nga natabo bangud may video mismo ang Guinness nga naga-dokumento sang iya kadasigon kag daw kaangay nga wala ini sang sakit nga nabatyagan.
english: Almost everyone couldn't believe how Kranthi did it, but it really happened because Guinness itself has a video documenting his speed and it looks like he didn't feel any pain.
