text: Antes ini nga record, kilala naman si Kranthi bilang si “Drill Man” bangud daring gid man ang iya stunts nga ginapakita sa publiko.
english: Before this record, Kranthi was known as the “Drill Man” because of his daring stunts.

text: Mas nasemento pa gid ang iya reputasyon sa indi mapatihan nga performances bangud nakuha sini ang world record nga pinakadamo nga electric fan blades nga napauntat gamit ang dila sa sulod sang isa ka minuto.
english: Its reputation for incredible performances was further cemented as it achieved the world record for the most electric fan blades stopped with the tongue in one minute.

text: May mga na-impress kay may ara man nga nakibot kag gintawag ini nga iron tongue.
english: Some were impressed while others were shocked and called it iron tongue.

text: Interesado naman ang iban sa training ni Kranthi kag may mga curious naman kun paano sini ayhan bulngon ang iya dila.
english: Others are interested in Kranthi's training and some are curious about how it will cure his tongue.

text: May mga naga-kwestyon naman sini nga abilidad kag ginpamangkot ang Guinness kun ngaa ginakilala nila ang kaangay sini nga mga buluhaton.
english: Some have questioned this ability and asked Guinness why they recognize such activities.

text: Sa bahin ni Kranthi, ginsiling sini nga tuman ang iya kalipay sa iya record bangud nagdaku siya sa isa ka nabaw-ing nga lugar sa India kun sa diin feeling niya sang una, tuman gid ka daku kag kalayo ang paghandom para sa ila tanan.
english: For his part, Kranthi said he is very happy with his record because he grew up in a recovered area in India where he felt that in the past, the longing for them all was very big and far away.

text: Sa subong, uyat na sini ang world record nga siya pa lamang ang nakahimo.#
english: He currently holds the world record.

text: Posible nga palawigon pa sang Department of Agriculture (DA) kag Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) ang moratorium sa sugar importation nga ginalauman nga matapos sa 2026 ukon pagtapos sang milling season.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) and Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) are likely to extend the moratorium on sugar importation which is expected to end in 2026 or the end of the milling season.

text: Ang amo nga tikang, nagatuyo nga maprayoridad ang lokal nga produksyon sang kalamay, ilabi na sa tunga sang mabaskog nga suplay sang kalamay sa pungsod.
english: The move aims to prioritize local sugarcane production, especially amid the country's strong sugarcane supply.

text: Sa isa ka pahayag, ginsiling ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: In a statement, Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: nga ang polisa gin-anunsyo una sang Oktubre 15, kun sa diin ginpahayag ang posible nga pag-extend sang moratorium matapos ang milling season, depende sa aktwal nga lebel sang sugar stocks.
english: that the policy was first announced on October 15, stating the possible extension of the moratorium after the milling season, depending on the actual level of sugar stocks.

text: Ini kasunod sang mas mataas nga raw sugar output sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This follows higher raw sugar output last year.

text: Magluwas sini, ginpahayag man nga nagapreparar ang DA kag SRA sang isa ka regulatory framework para sa molasses importation, nga nagatuyo nga maprotektahan ang mga lokal nga producer sang kalamay kag masiguro ang balanse sa industriya sang amo nga produkto.
english: Besides, the DA and SRA are also said to be preparing a regulatory framework for molasses importation, which aims to protect local sugarcane producers and ensure balance in the industry of the product.

text: NAKAGWA na sa pungsod si Bagyo Paeng sadtong Oktubre 31, pero duha ka semana na ang nagligad sadtong Nobyembre 12 kag mga 36 pa ka lugar gali ang wala komunikasyon kag 24 pa ang wala kuryente sa ina nga tion.
english: TYPHOON Paeng left the country on October 31, but two weeks later on November 12, about 36 areas were still without communication and 24 were still without electricity.

text: Ginsugid ini sa aton sang abyan ko nga si Pedro halin sa report sang The Daily Inquirer sadtong Nobyembre 12.
english: My friend Pedro told us this from a report in The Daily Inquirer back on November 12th.

text: “Nagaantos na sa halit sang bagyo, ginapaaantos pa ninyo!” pusnga gani niya.
english: “Already suffering from the damage of the typhoon, you are still suffering!” he even gasped.

text: Sa report sang NDRRMC sa amo man nga petsa, naglab-ut na gali sa 160 ang napatay.
english: According to the NDRRMC report on the same date, 160 people have died.

text: Ang apektado nga mga pumuluyo naglab-ut sa 5,410,106, nga ang 25,672 yara gihapon sa mga evacuation centers.
english: The affected population reached 5,410,106, with 25,672 still in evacuation centers.

text: Ang kabug-usan naman sang mga damages sa agrikultura kag infrastructure naglapaw na sa PHP11 ka Bilyon.
english: The total damage to agriculture and infrastructure has exceeded PHP11 billion.

text: Natam-an gid sing namatyan amo ang Bangsamoro Autonomous Region nga nag-rehistro sing 64 nga napatay, nga pinakadamo sa mga rehiyon.
english: The Bangsamoro Autonomous Region was hit hardest with 64 deaths, the highest number among the regions.

text: Ang Western Visayas namatyan sing 37, samtang may 33 nga namatyan sa Calabarzon.
english: Western Visayas reported 37 deaths, while Calabarzon reported 33 deaths.

text:
***

Ginkabalaka gid ni President BBM ang daku nga kahalitan sang Bagyo Paeng, labi na gid sa nakita niya sa southern Maguindanao province, kon diin ang mamonog nga ulan nagtuga sang daludu (cascade) sang lunang (mudslide) paubos halin sa ibabaw sang Mount Minandar nga nagdulot sing kalamidad sa mga pumuluyo sa ubos sini.
english:
***

President BBM was deeply concerned about the extensive damage caused by Typhoon Paeng, especially what he saw in southern Maguindanao province, where heavy rains caused a cascade of mudslide down from the top of Mount Minandar that caused disaster to the people below.

text: Nakita niya kon paano ang mudslide madasig kag hilway nga nagdaludu sa ubos sa bahin sang Mount Mindanar nga kalbo na, nga napunggan tani kon may nagatubo pa nga kakahuyan dira.
english: He saw how the mudslide quickly and freely rolled down the bald side of Mount Mindanar, which could have been prevented if there were still trees growing there.

text: Tungod sini, ginpanugyan niya nga matamnan, ukon maulian tanom, ini sing kahoy kag ang iban pa nga kalbo nga kabukiran sa pungsod agud malikawan ang katulad nga trahedya.
english: For this reason, he suggested that these and other bald mountains in the country be planted with trees to avoid a similar tragedy.

text: Isa ka rason, no doubt, sa pagkakalbo sang mga kabukiran amo ang illegal logging.
english: One reason, no doubt, for the baldness of the mountains is illegal logging.

text: Sadtong Nobyembre 18 gani ginbalita ang pagdakop sa isa ka talaguan sang illegally-cut logs sa Lipa, Batangas.
english: On November 18, it was reported that a cache of illegally-cut logs was arrested in Lipa, Batangas.

text: Minilyon ka pesos ang balor sini nga ginbakal halin sa mga illegal loggers.
english: Millions of pesos worth of these were purchased from illegal loggers.

text: Mga nalagare na ini nga mga kahoy, nga galakip pa sang endangered nga kahoy nga narra.
english: These are already logged trees, including the endangered narra tree.

text:
***

Sa problema nga ini sang kalbo nga mga kabukiran, gin-report sang Forest Mangement Bureau sadtong 2017 nga ang forest cover sang pungsod nakalab-ut na lang sa 7.014 milyon ka ektariya, ukon 23.38% na lang, sang kabug-usan nga 30 ka milyon ka ektariya sang land area sang pungsod.
english:
***

With this problem of bald mountains, the Forest Management Bureau reported in 2017 that the country's forest cover has reached only 7.014 million hectares, or 23.38%, of the country's total 30 million hectares of land area.

text: Sadtong mga 1900s sa paghingapos na sang Spanish Occupation naglab-ut pa ang aton forest cover sa 70%.
english: In the 1900s, at the end of the Spanish Occupation, our forest cover reached 70%.

text: Kon napabilin naton ini sa karon, daku tani ini nga “carbon sink” agud masuyop ang sobra nga carbon dioxide nga ginabuga sang mga industriya.
english: If we had kept it today, it would have been a large carbon sink to absorb the excess carbon dioxide emitted by industries.

text: Mga 75% sang mahaliton nga greenhouse gases (GHG) ang carbon dioxide.
english: About 75% of harmful greenhouse gases (GHG) are carbon dioxide.

text: Upod sini, sunu sa Wikipedia, ang methane, nitrous oxide, ozone, lakip na ang tun-og (water vapor).
english: These include, according to Wikipedia, methane, nitrous oxide, ozone, including dew (water vapor).

text: Madugang pa dira ang hydroflourocarbons (HFCs).
english: Add to that hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).

text: Ang GHG ginabangdan sang mahaliton nga dugang nga pag-init sang kalibutan (Global Warming) tungod ginapunggan sini ang pag-eskapo sang init palayo sa nawong (surface) sang kalibutan.
english: GHGs cause harmful additional global warming because they prevent heat from escaping the earth's surface.

text:
***

Pero, paano natabo ining  madasig nga pagnubo sang aton forest cover?
english:
***

But, how did this  rapid decline in our forest cover happen?

text: Kuhaon naton ang pagsaysay diri sang Wikipedia.
english: Let's take Wikipedia's explanation here.

text:
Colonial era deforestation

Sadtong 1900, sadtong paghingapos na sang mga 380 ka tuig nga Spanish Occupation, ang forest cover naton galab-ut pa sing mga 70%.
english:
Colonial era deforestation

In 1900, at the end of about 380 years of Spanish Occupation, our forest cover was still about 70%.

text: Mga 20% sini ugaling ang nadula sa pagbulos sang 46 ka tuig nga American Occupation kag mga 3 ka tuig nga Japanese Occupation tungod sa pagtapas sang kakahuyan para sa agrikultura, mga dalanon kag iban pa nga mga proyekto.
english: About 20% of this however was lost in the succession of 46 years of American Occupation and about 3 years of Japanese Occupation due to deforestation for agriculture, roads and other projects.

text:
Deforestation sa martial law era

Sadtong 1960 tubtub 1970 nag-boom ang logging industry, nga nag-peak sa panahon sang presidency ni Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english:
Deforestation in the martial law era

In the 1960s and 1970s, the logging industry boomed, peaking during the presidency of Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: Sang ideklarar sini ang 1972 martial law nanagtag ini sing concession sing dalagku nga kadutaan para sa mga “senior military officials, cronies and relatives”.
english: When it declared martial law in 1972 it distributed concessions of large tracts of land to “senior military officials, cronies and relatives”.

text: Gin-encourage man sini ang log exportation sa Japan.
english: It also encouraged log export to Japan.

text: Ginpadayon pa ini agud makabayad kita sang aton foreign debt paagi sa log exportation, samtang halos napabay-an na ang reforestation, ukon pag-uli tanom sang napatas nga mga kakahuyan, sang mga “set-up companies”.
english: This has been continued so that we can pay off our foreign debt through log exports, while reforestation, or replanting of cleared forests, by set-up companies has been almost neglected.

text:
Deforestation pagkatapos sang 1986 EDSA

Ang deforestation nagpabilin nga masaEnyog sa panahon nanday President Corazon Aquino kag Fidel Ramos bisan sige man ang replanting sang mga kakahuyan tungod sa corruption kag inefficiency sang mga government agencies.
english:
Deforestation after 1986 EDSA

Deforestation remained rampant during the years of President Corazon Aquino and Fidel Ramos despite the continuous replanting of trees due to corruption and inefficiency of government agencies.

text: Ano abe kon magpasar kita sing polisa (policy) nga ma-maintain sa at least 50% ang aton forest cover, labi na gid sa karon nga nagaaway kita sa Climate Change batok sa GHG?/PN
english: What if we pass a policy that will maintain at least 50% of our forest cover, especially now that we are fighting Climate Change against GHG?/PN

text: Mangin dako nga accomplishment sa career ni Filipino WBO welterweight champion John Riel Casimero kun maparetiro niya ang Cuban veteran two-time division champion nga si Guillermo Rigondeaux sa hiwaton nga boxing match subong nga adlaw sa Carson, California sa Estados Unidos .
english: It will be a big accomplishment in the career of Filipino WBO welterweight champion John Riel Casimero if he retires Cuban veteran two-time division champion Guillermo Rigondeaux in today's boxing match in Carson, California in the United States.

text: Nagapati si MP Promotions president Sean Gibbons nga labi pa nga magasangkad ang karera ni Casimero kun mapiyerde sini ang veteran Cuban boxer.
english: MP Promotions president Sean Gibbons believes that Casimero's career will expand even more if he defeats the veteran Cuban boxer.

text: Apang pahayag sang mga US Analysts, paborito sa gihapon sang kadam-an nga magdaog si Rigondeaux.
english: But according to US analysts, Rigondeaux is still the favorite to win.

text: Yara na sa state of decomposition ang bangkay sang lalaki sang masapwan sang iya pamilya sa Brgy.
english: The man's body was in a state of decomposition when it was found by his family in Brgy.

text: Bayan, Passi City.
english: Bayan, Passi City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Alyas Banong, 39-anyos, laborer, kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Banong, 39, laborer, and resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Maria Rosario Miranda, Public Information Officer sang Passi City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakita sang iya iloy ang biktima malapit sa iya puluy-an nga nagakulob nga may pilas sa likod, ulo, kag may nakahigot nga shoe lace sa iya liog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Maria Rosario Miranda, Public Information Officer of the Passi City Police Station, said the victim was found lying near her house with injuries to her back, head, and a shoe lace tied around her neck.

text: Pahayag sang iloy sang biktima, ulihi sini nga nakita ang iya anak sang Domingo nga adlaw sang nagtulog sa ila balay kag naglisensya ini nga mapauli kag mabalik lang ugaling para magkuha sang bugas.
english: According to the victim's mother, she last saw her son on Sunday when he slept in their house and he asked permission to go home and only returned to get rice.

text: Wala na ini makabalik rason nga ginkadtuan ini sang iya iloy.
english: He did not return so his mother went to him.

text: Wala nakasugid ang pamilya kun may kontra ang biktima apang ginpahayag nga masabad ini kun makainom.
english: The family did not say if the victim had an opponent but said he would get angry if he drank.

text: May ginasundan na subong nga person of interest ang kapulisan bangud may nakakita sa amo nga indibidwal sa lugar antes pa masapwan ang biktima.
english: Police are now pursuing a person of interest because someone saw the individual in the area before the victim was found.

text: Nagpabutyag naman ang pamilya nga ipa-autopsy ang bangkay sang ila himata.
english: The family said they will have their relative's body autopsied.

text: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: Arestado ang district engineer sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) sa Taal, Batangas.
english: The district engineer of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) was arrested in Taal, Batangas.

text: Ini bangud sa tuyo nga suholan sang P3,126,900 si Batangas 1st District Representative Leandro Leviste agud nga indi ini malakip sa imbestigasyon sang mga proyekto sang DPWH sa iya distrito.
english: This is because of the intention to bribe Batangas 1st District Representative Leandro Leviste with P3,126,900 so that he will not be included in the investigation of DPWH projects in his district.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Poblacion, Taal, Batangas sang Biyernes.
english: The incident occurred in Poblacion, Taal, Batangas on Friday.

text: Gindayaw naman ni Senador Panfilo Lacson ang pamatan-on nga kongresista sa pagdakop sini batok sa opisyal sang DPWH.
english: Senator Panfilo Lacson praised the young congressman for his arrest against the DPWH official.

text: Masobra isa ka milyon nga myembro sang Social Security System (SSS) ang wala nakabayad sang kontribusyon bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: More than one million members of the Social Security System (SSS) have not paid their contributions due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Halin sa 17.6 million nga mga myembro nga nakabayad sang 2019, nagnubo ini sa 16.1 million.
english: From 17.6 million members who paid in 2019, it dropped to 16.1 million.

text: Buot silingon, ginabanta 1.5 million nga mga myembro ang wala nakabayad ukon P19 billion ang nabuhin nga kita sang SSS.
english: This means that an estimated 1.5 million members have not paid or P19 billion in SSS revenue.

text: Samtang nangin P34 billion na lang halin sa P38 billion ng narekord nga mandatory savings sang Pag-IBIG bangud sa epekto sang pandemya.
english: Meanwhile, Pag-IBIG recorded mandatory savings of P34 billion due to the impact of the pandemic.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, nagtaas naman ang pondo sa voluntary Modifies Pag-IBIG ukon MP2 savings.
english: However, despite this, the fund in voluntary Modifies Pag-IBIG or MP2 savings increased.

text: Sa una nga bahin sang 2021, amat-amat nga nakabawi ang Pag-IBIG bangud employed na ang mga nadulaan sang trabaho sa tunga sang pandemya.
english: In the first half of 2021, Pag-IBIG slowly recovered as those who lost their jobs amid the pandemic were employed.

text: ILOILO CITY – Todo ang kampanya sang mga environmental group sa pagtipig sang palibot ilabi na nga ginasaulog subong nga bulan sang Hunyo ang Philippine Environment Month.
english: ILOILO CITY – Environmental groups are campaigning to protect the environment especially as the Philippine Environment Month is celebrated this June.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Daniel Agan, chairman sang Youth Proyekto Philippines, iya ginpahayag nga indi lamang kun tani sa bulan sang Hunyo ginadumdum ang Philippine Environment Month kundi dapat nga ini ang ginadumdum sa tanan nga tion.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Daniel Agan, chairman of the Youth Project Philippines, said that the Philippine Environment Month should not only be celebrated in June but should be celebrated at all times.

text: Ang pagtipig sang palibot kag dunang manggad ang dapat nga mangin kabahin na sang pagpangabuhi sang tawo sa baylo nga ini ang pabay-an.
english: Conservation of the environment and natural resources should become part of human life instead of being neglected.

text: Sa subong suno kay Agan, indi man mahinago nga isa sa mga dapat mahatagan sang solusyon amo ang environmental problems rason nga igalunsyar sang ila grupo amo ang ‘MaharliKalikasan’ nga kombinasyon sang tinaga nga maharlika kag kalikasan nga nagakahulugan sang pagtipig sa palibot.
english: Agan said it is no secret that one of the issues that needs to be addressed is environmental problems, which is why their group will launch 'MaharliKalikasan', a combination of the words maharlika and nature which means environmental protection.

text: Magluwas sa pag-engganyo, ginpahayag ni Agan nga importante nga may yara sang aktu ukon ginahimo ang tagsa ka tawo agud nga masolbar ang mga nanari-sari nga environmental problems.
english: Besides encouraging, Agan said it is important that everyone has an action to solve the various environmental problems.

text: Lakip sa mga proyekto sang nasambit nga grupo amo ang pagpahagan-hagan ang plastic nga basura rason nga ila gid nga ginaduso ang eco-bricks ukon ang mga water bottle nga ginsudlan sang plastic wrapper.
english: Among the projects of the said group is to reduce plastic waste which is why they are pushing for eco-bricks or water bottles filled with plastic wrapper.

text: Ang eco-bricks ang ginagamit bilang alternatibo nga hollow blocks.
english: Eco-bricks are used as alternative hollow blocks.

text: May kaangtanan diri, igalunsyar sang ila grupo kaupod ang partner agencies ang ‘MaharliKalikasan’ sa Hunyo 27 tubtub 28 sa Bucari, Leon, Iloilo.
english: In this regard, their group together with partner agencies will launch 'MaharliKalikasan' on June 27 to 28 in Bucari, Leon, Iloilo.

text: May yara man sang patigayunon nga mga nagkalain-lain nga aktibidad nga nagapakita sang pagtib-ong sa pagtipig sang palibot.
english: There will also be various activities that show the importance of environmental protection.

text: Napaslawan si Filipino mixed martial artist Eduard “Landslide” Folayang sa kamot sang Chinese fighter nga si Zhang “The Warrior” Lipeng pinaagi sa unanimous decision sa ONE: BattleGround II nga ginhiwat sa Singapore.
english: Filipino mixed martial artist Eduard “Landslide” Folayang lost to Chinese fighter Zhang “The Warrior” Lipeng by unanimous decision at ONE: BattleGround II held in Singapore.

text: Sa una nga round pa lang, nagpakita na sang manami nga performance ang Chinese fighter sa diin na-trap pa niya si Folayang pinaagi sa leg scissor magluwas pa sa pagpa-ulan sang mga asud-asud nga sumbag.
english: In the first round, the Chinese fighter showed a good performance where he trapped Folayang with a leg scissor in addition to raining down blows.

text: Nakabawi man si Folayang sa mga sunod nga rounds apang naigo-an ini sang solid left kick ni Zhang sa iya mismo nawong.
english: Folayang also recovered in the following rounds but was hit by a solid left kick from Zhang in his own face.

text: Ini na ang ika-apat nga sunod-sunod nga pagkapyerde sang 37 anyos nga Team Lakay fighter.
english: This is the 37-year-old Team Lakay fighter's fourth consecutive defeat.

text: Bangud sini, may yara na siya sang record nga 22 wins kag 12 loses samtang ang Chinese fighter naman ang may yara sang 31 wins, 11 loses kag 2 draws.
english: As a result, he has a record of 22 wins and 12 losses while the Chinese fighter has 31 wins, 11 losses and 2 draws.

text: Handa na ang legal defense ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte para sa confirmation of charges hearing sa International Criminal Court (ICC) nga natalana nga magasugod sa Setyembre 23, 2025.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's legal defense is ready for the confirmation of charges hearing at the International Criminal Court (ICC) scheduled to begin on September 23, 2025.

text: Base sa dokumento nga ginsumiter sa Pre-Trial Chamber I sang Agosto 22, gin-anunsyo ni Nicholas Kaufman nga maga-alokar sila sang 30 minutos kada isa para sa opening kag closing statements, samtang tatlo tubtob apat ka oras ang iga-alokar para sa oral presentation sang depensa.
english: Based on the document submitted to Pre-Trial Chamber I on August 22, Nicholas Kaufman announced that they would allocate 30 minutes each for opening and closing statements, while three to four hours would be allocated for the defense’s oral presentation.

text: Ang nasambit nga hearing ang kabahin sang proseso agud madeterminar kun may yara sang bastante nga ebidensiya agud mapadayon ang full trial batok kay Duterte bangud sa mga alegasyon sang krimen batok sa katawhan may kaangtanan sa iya kontrobersyal nga kampanya kontra droga.
english: The hearing is part of the process to determine if there is sufficient evidence to proceed with a full trial against Duterte for allegations of crimes against humanity in connection with his controversial anti-drug campaign.

text: Suno sa mga report, masobra 7,000 ka tawo ang napatay sa mga operasyon halin 2016 tubtob 2019, bisan pa nga ginabulubanta sang mga grupo sang tawhanon nga kinamatarung nga ang aktwal nga numero mahimo nga maglab-ot sa 30,000.
english: According to reports, more than 7,000 people were killed in operations from 2016 to 2019, although human rights groups estimate the actual figure could be as high as 30,000.

text: Sa iya pahayag, ginpanindugan ni Kaufman nga wala sang krimen nga nahimo si Duterte kag matutom kag may bugal nga nagserbisyo sa pungsod sa sulod sang madamo nga tinuig.
english: In his statement, Kaufman insisted that Duterte has not committed any crime and has faithfully and proudly served the country for many years.

text: Ginalauman sang iya kampo nga magatutok ang depensa sa mga legal nga argumento angot sa hurisdiksyon sang ICC, ang ginapahayag “politically motivated” nga kinaiya sang kaso, kag ang kakulang sang direkta nga kahilabtanan ni Duterte sa mga pagpamatay.
english: His camp expects the defense to focus on legal arguments over the jurisdiction of the ICC, the alleged “politically motivated” nature of the case, and Duterte’s lack of direct involvement in the killings.

text: Matandaan ng gin-aresto si Duterte sang mga otoridad sa Pilipinas sang Marso 11, 2025, base sa arrest warrant nga ginpaguwa sang ICC kag priso ini sa gihapon sa Scheveningen Prison sa The Hague.Kapin sa 300 ka mga biktima sang kampanya kontra droga ang nagsumiter sang aplikasyon agud magpasakop sa pre-trial proceedings.
english: Duterte was arrested by Philippine authorities on March 11, 2025, based on an arrest warrant issued by the ICC and is still detained at Scheveningen Prison in The Hague. More than 300 victims of the anti-drug campaign have submitted applications to participate in pre-trial proceedings.

text: Indi na kinahanglan nga magbiyahe pakadto sa The Hague ang mga biktima bangud pagarepresentar sila sang mga legal representatives, lakip na si Atty. Kristina Conti sang National Union of Peoples’ Lawyers (NUPL) kag Atty. Gilbert Andres kag iban pa.
english: The victims will not have to travel to The Hague as they will be represented by legal representatives, including Atty. Kristina Conti of the National Union of Peoples’ Lawyers (NUPL) and Atty. Gilbert Andres et al.

text: Kon kumpirmahon sang Pre-Trial Chamber ang mga alegasyon, ang kaso magapadayon sa isa ka full trial nga mahimo maglawig sang pila ka tuig.
english: If the Pre-Trial Chamber confirms the allegations, the case will proceed to a full trial that could take several years.

text: Apang, kon indi, mahimo nga ibasura ang kaso, isa ka butang nga ginapamatukan gid sang mga biktima kag sang ila mga abogado.
english: Otherwise, however, the case could be dismissed, something both the victims and their lawyers vehemently oppose.

text: Ginalauman nga magalawig sang pila ka adlaw ang hearing, kag mangin sentro sang internasyunal nga atensyon bilang isa sa pinakadako nga human rights accountability cases sa maragtas sang Pilipinas.
english: The hearing is expected to last several days, and will be the center of international attention as one of the biggest human rights accountability cases in Philippine history.

text: Ako si Remy Tayona y Galvan, 50 anyos, may asawa, tanod kag naga istar sa Brgy.
english: I am Remy Tayona y Galvan, 50 years old, married, tanod and living in Brgy.

text: San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo, matapos makapanumpa suno sa layi nagapanalaysay sang mga masunod (I am Remy Tayona y Galvan, 50 years old, married, tanod and resident of Brgy.
english: San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo, after taking the oath according to the law, explains the following (I am Remy Tayona y Galvan, 50 years old, married, tanod and resident of Brgy.

text:
San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo, after having been duly sworn in accordance with the law hereby depose and say):

Ang nagapamangkot sang judicial affidavit ko nga ini amo si PSSg Glenn Mark Abayon nga isa ka pulis nga nadistino sa Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english:
San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo, after having been duly sworn in accordance with the law hereby depose and say):

The questioner of my judicial affidavit is PSSg Glenn Mark Abayon who is a policeman assigned to the Tigbauan Municipal Police Station, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Naluntad ang pagpamangkot na kanakon sa sulod sang Investigation Room sang Tigbauan Police Station.
english: My interrogation took place inside the Investigation Room of the Tigbauan Police Station.

text: (The person who is questioning my judicial affidavit is PSSg Glenn Mark Abayon, a police officer assigned at Tigbauan Municipal Police Station.
english: (The person who is questioning my judicial affidavit is PSSg Glenn Mark Abayon, a police officer assigned at Tigbauan Municipal Police Station.

text: The questioning was held inside the Investigation Room of said station.)Ginasabat ko ang mga pamangkot kanakon sa idalom sang pagpanumpa na magasugid lang ako kang tuod kag naman-an ko na pwede ako maakusar kung magbinutig ako.
english: The questioning was held inside the Investigation Room of said station.) I answer the questions to me under oath that I will tell the truth and I know that I can be prosecuted if I lie.

text: (I am answering the questions under oath that I will just tell the truth and I know that I can be held criminally liable if I will give false testimony).
english: (I am answering the questions under oath that I will just tell the truth and I know that I can be held criminally liable if I will give false testimony).

text: Nagapati ang Department of Trade and Industry nga mabatak sang Creative Industries ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sa tion nga matapos na ang pandemya.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry believes that Creative Industries will boost the Philippine economy once the pandemic is over.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, kabug-usan nga 305,070 ukon 30.5 percent sang mga establisemento sa pungsod ang nalakip sa creative sector humalin sang nagligad nga tuig, apang kadam-an diri ang ginlockdown sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya.
english: According to Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, a total of 305,070 or 30.5 percent of establishments in the country have been included in the creative sector since last year, but most of them were locked down when the pandemic began.

text: Pahayag ni Lopez, nakarekord ang nasambit nga sektor sang 4.8 million ukon 11.3 percent nga total employment sang 2019.
english: Lopez said the sector recorded 4.8 million or 11.3 percent of total employment in 2019.

text: Ang total creative exports sang amo man nga tuig ang nagsaka sa $6.8 billion ukon 6 percent sang total outbound shipments, samtang ang industry investments ang nagabalor P281 million.
english: Total creative exports in the same year rose to $6.8 billion or 6 percent of total outbound shipments, while industry investments amounted to P281 million.

text: Dugang pa ni Lopez, sang 2018 nagpanguna ang pungsod sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) para sa creative services exports kag ika-lima naman sa total creative exports.
english: Lopez added that in 2018, the country led the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) for creative services exports and ranked fifth in total creative exports.

text: Wala naluyagan sang engaged couple nga sanday Rodjun Cruz kag Dianne Medina ang mga komento sang pila ka mga netizens may kaangtanan sa biyahe nila sa Japan kaupod ang delegasyon ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Engaged couple Rodjun Cruz and Dianne Medina did not like the comments of some netizens regarding their trip to Japan with the delegation of President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Sa subong yara sa Japan si Duterte kaupod ang mga cabinet members kag pila pa ka mga opiyales sang gobyerno para sa apat ka adlaw nga working visit kadungan sang 25th Nikkei International Conference.
english: Duterte is currently in Japan with cabinet members and other government officials for a four-day working visit in conjunction with the 25th Nikkei International Conference.

text: Ang conference ang nag-umpisa sang Martes, Mayo 28 kag magatapos subong nga Mayo 31.
english: The conference began on Tuesday, May 28 and will end on May 31.

text: Magluwas sa delegasyon sang Presidente, yara man sa Japan ang pila ka mga celebrity supporters nga sanday Robin Padilla, Philip Salvador, Bayani Agbayani, Michael Pangilinan, Martin Escudero, kag ang engaged couple nga sanday Rodjun kag Dianne.
english: Besides the President's delegation, also in Japan are several celebrity supporters Robin Padilla, Philip Salvador, Bayani Agbayani, Michael Pangilinan, Martin Escudero, and the engaged couple Rodjun and Dianne.

text: Suno kay Philippine Ambassador to Japan Jose Laurel V, ang Nikkei ang naggasto sa biyahe sang Presidente.
english: According to Philippine Ambassador to Japan Jose Laurel V, the Nikkei paid for the President's trip.

text: Samtang gindepensahan naman sang engaged couple ang mga pagpakamalaot sa ila sang netizens.
english: Meanwhile, the engaged couple defended the criticisms of netizens.

text: Suno kay Rodjun, may yara siya sang kinamatarong nga mag post sang picture sa social media bangud sila ang nagbayad sang ila nga trip padulong sa Japan para sa Filipino Community meet and greet nga gintambongan sang Presidente.
english: Rodjun said he has the right to post the picture on social media because they paid for their trip to Japan for the Filipino Community meet and greet attended by the President.

text: Ginpanginwala naman sang Malacañang ang naguwa nga impormasyon nga regalo sang Presidente sa cabinet members kag iban nga mga delegasyon ang pagpadulong sa Japan bangud nangin madinalag-on ang iya gin-endorso nga mga kandidato sang eleksyon.
english: Malacañang denied reports that the President's trip to Japan was a gift to cabinet members and other delegations because his endorsed candidates were successful in the election.

text: Gin-aresto ang anay child-actor nga si John Wayne Sace bangud sa pagpatay sa iya abyan nga lalaki sa Barangay Sagad, Pasig City.
english: Former child-actor John Wayne Sace was arrested for killing his boyfriend in Barangay Sagad, Pasig City.

text: Natabo ang insidente sang Lunes sang gab-i, Oktubre 28.
english: The incident happened on Monday night, October 28th.

text: Suno sa Eastern Police District, nadakpan sang Pasig City Police ang aktor sa isa ka hotel.
english: According to the Eastern Police District, the Pasig City Police arrested the actor at a hotel.

text: Natalana naman ini nga ipaidalom sa paraffin test.
english: It is scheduled to undergo a paraffin test.

text: Nalakip man ini sadto sa mga ginpang Tokhang sang mga pulis bangud sa kaangtanan sini sa iligal nga droga.
english: He was also among those arrested by the police for his links to illegal drugs.

text: Sang 2016, naulamid man ini sa engkwentro sa isa ka pulis sa diin natiruhan ini.
english: In 2016, he was also involved in an encounter with a police officer where he was stabbed.

text: Binawi ng kampo ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte ang kanilang kahilingan sa Appeals Chamber ng International Criminal Court (ICC) na alisin si Prosecutor Karim Khan sa paghawak ng kaso laban sa dating pinuno ng Pilipinas.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's camp has withdrawn its request to the Appeals Chamber of the International Criminal Court (ICC) to remove Prosecutor Karim Khan from handling the case against the former Philippine leader.

text: Batay sa dokumentong may petsang Agosto 15, 2025, sinabi ni Nicholas Kaufman, lead counsel ni Duterte, na wala umanong malinaw na dahilan upang pagdudahan ang pagiging patas ni Khan, o ang kanyang pahayag na hindi siya conflicted sa nasabing usapin, sa kabila ng nauna niyang pagrepresenta sa ilang dating kliyente na may kaugnayan sa kasong isinampa laban kay Duterte.
english: Based on a document dated August 15, 2025, Nicholas Kaufman, Duterte's lead counsel, said there was no clear reason to doubt Khan's fairness, or his statement that he was not conflicted on the matter, despite his previous representation of their client in a dispute involving their former client. to Duterte.

text: Dagdag pa sa dokumento, sinabi ni Kaufman na hindi na hahadlangan ng depensa ang maayos na daloy ng mga proseso sa korte sa pamamagitan ng muling paggiit sa diskwalipikasyon ng Prosecutor.
english: In addition to the document, Kaufman said that the defense will not obstruct the smooth flow of court proceedings by re-insisting on the disqualification of the Prosecutor.

text: Una nang iginiit ng kampo ni Duterte na posibleng may conflict of interest si Khan dahil sa kanyang naging papel bilang abogado ng ilang umano’y biktima ng war on drugs noong administrasyon ni Duterte.
english: Earlier, Duterte's camp insisted that Khan may have a conflict of interest because of his role as a lawyer for some alleged victims of the war on drugs during the Duterte administration.

text: Sa kanyang tugon, sinabi ni Khan na wala siyang nakikitang anumang batayan upang tanggalin siya sa kaso, at nilinaw niyang agad niyang inabisuhan ang abogado ng depensa ukol sa kanyang dating papel, bilang bahagi ng kanyang tungkulin na maging bukas sa Pre-Trial Chamber kung sakaling magkaroon ng pagbabago sa sitwasyon.
english: In his response, Khan said he did not see any basis to remove him from the case, and clarified that he immediately advised the defense lawyer of his former role, as part of his duty to be open in the Pre-Trial Chamber in case of a change in the situation.

text: Noong Marso 11, inaresto si Duterte sa Pilipinas dahil sa kasong crimes against humanity na may kaugnayan sa madugong kampanya kontra droga noong siya ay alkalde ng Davao City at kalauna’y naging Pangulo ng bansa.
english: On March 11, Duterte was arrested in the Philippines on charges of crimes against humanity in connection with the bloody anti-drug campaign when he was mayor of Davao City and then President of the country.

text: Si Duterte, na ngayon ay 80 taong gulang, ay kasalukuyang nakakulong sa Scheveningen Prison sa The Hague, The Netherlands.
english: Duterte, now 80 years old, is currently detained at Scheveningen Prison in The Hague, The Netherlands.

text: Ayon sa opisyal na tala ng gobyerno, mahigit 6,000 ang napatay sa mga police operations sa ilalim ng war on drugs.
english: According to official government records, more than 6,000 people have been killed in police operations under the war on drugs.

text: Ngunit batay sa pagtataya ng mga human rights organizations, maaaring umabot sa 30,000 ang aktwal na bilang ng mga napatay, kabilang ang mga hindi naiulat na insidente.
english: However, according to estimates by human rights organizations, the actual number of deaths could reach 30,000, including unreported incidents.

text: Dakop ang mag-amay lakip ang live-in partner sang bata sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation sa Barangay Rizal, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: The father and the child's live-in partner were arrested in a drug buy-bust operation in Barangay Rizal, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ginkilala ang mag-amay kanday alyas Panong, 48, alyas Koykoy, 23, kag alyas Faith, 24, live-in partner kag lunsay residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The father and daughter were identified as Panong, 48, Koykoy, 23, and Faith, 24, live-in partners and both residents of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, officer-in-charge sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), iya ginpahayag nga main subject sang operasyon amo ang bata lang kuntani nga si alyas Koykoy nga ginakabig sang mga otoridad nga high value individual.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, officer-in-charge of the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU), said the main subject of the operation was a child alias Koykoy who is considered by the authorities to be a high value individual.

text: Suno kay Inot, na-monitor ang illegal nga aktibidad sang mga subject bangud sa nabaton nga impormasyon gikan sa mga pumuluyo sang nasambit nga Barangay.
english: According to Inot, the illegal activities of the subjects were monitored due to information received from the residents of the said Barangay.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga nagaserbe nga runner ni alyas Koykoy sa illegal drug trade ang live-in partner nga si alyas Faith, samtang look-out naman ang amay sini.
english: He also explained that Koykoy's live-in partner, Faith, is serving as a runner in the illegal drug trade, while his father is a look-out.

text: Base sa mga Barangay officials, under monitoring si alyas Koykoy kag makapila na ini ka beses nga ginasaway nga indi mag-engage sa iligal nga droga.
english: According to Barangay officials, alias Koykoy is under monitoring and has been repeatedly reprimanded not to engage in illegal drugs.

text: Natigayon nga nakuhaan sang 50 grams nga suspected shabu ang mga subjects nga may standard drug price nga P340,000.
english: Seized from the suspects were 50 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P340,000.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang kapulisan ang tatlo ka mga nagkaladakpan kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: The three suspects are now in police custody and are facing charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nag-deploy ang Thailand sang 300 ka military personnel agud magpangita sa siyam ka mga tawo nga missing matapos nagtibusok ang isa ka eroplano sa Bangkok, Thailand.
english: Thailand has deployed 300 military personnel to search for nine people missing after a plane crashed in Bangkok, Thailand.

text: Duha ka Thai pilots, lima ka Chinese kag duha ka Thai nga pasahero ang sakay sa Cessna Caravan C208B turboprop plane kag ginapatihan nga lunsay nagkalamatay matapos ang insidente.
english: Two Thai pilots, five Chinese and two Thai passengers were on board the Cessna Caravan C208B turboprop plane and are believed to have died after the incident.

text: Halin ang aircraft sa main international airport sang Thailand 2:46 p.m. local time kag pakadto kuntani sa airport sa eastern Trat province suno sa Chachoengsao provincial office of the government’s public relations department.
english: The aircraft left Thailand's main international airport at 2:46 p.m. local time and was bound for an airport in eastern Trat province, the Chachoengsao provincial office of the government's public relations department said.

text: Nadulaan ini sang kontak ginabanta 10 minutos matapos nga yara na ini sa kahawaan.
english: It lost contact approximately 10 minutes after it was already in the air.

text: Nakit-an na sang otoridad nga naglalapta ang mga parte sang aircraft amo man ang halos 70 ka lapta-lapta nga parte sang lawas sang tawo nga gilayon man gindala sa ospital para ma-identify.
english: Authorities found scattered parts of the aircraft as well as nearly 70 scattered parts of the human body that were immediately taken to the hospital for identification.

text: Nangin mabudlay man para sa rescuers ang search operations bangud magluwas nga naga-ulan, nagtibusok ang aircraft sa isa ka mangrove forest rason nga indi makahulag sang maayo ang mga personnel.
english: The search operations were also difficult for the rescuers because besides raining, the aircraft got stuck in a mangrove forest causing the personnel to not move properly.

text:
Natalana nga iga-analisa sang otoridad ang aircraft debris para mahibaluan ang rason sang plane crash.#

(Chachoengsao’s Public Relations Department/AP)
english:
Authorities are scheduled to analyze the aircraft debris to determine the cause of the plane crash.

(Chachoengsao’s Public Relations Department/AP)

text: Magabaton sang dugang nga travel allowance ang Paralympic athletes sang Pilipinas para sa Tokyo Para Games.
english: Philippine Paralympic athletes will receive additional travel allowance for the Tokyo Para Games.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) chairman William “Butch” Ramirez nga hatagan sang dugang nga $2,000 ukon P100,770 ang delegasyon sang pungsod sa Tokyo.
english: Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) chairman William “Butch” Ramirez announced that an additional $2,000 or P100,770 will be given to the country's delegation in Tokyo.

text: Ang para athletes ang makabaton lang kuntani sang $1,000 ukon masobra P50,300 bilang allowance nila.
english: Para athletes would only receive $1,000 or more than P50,300 as their allowance.

text: Maga-umpisa ang Paralympics sa Agusto 24 tubtob Septyembre 5.
english: The Paralympics will run from August 24 to September 5.

text: Samtang ang mangin flag bearer sang Pilipinas sa opening ceremony amo ang wheelchair racer nga si Jerold Mangliwan.
english: Meanwhile, the flag bearer of the Philippines in the opening ceremony will be wheelchair racer Jerold Mangliwan.

text: Posible nga may himuon nga cleansing sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) agud nga makakas ang mga opisyal kag mga personnel nga involved sa mga anomaliya.
english: It is possible that there will be a cleansing in the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to remove officials and personnel involved in anomalies.

text: Kabahin ini sang ginpahayag ni Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan sa tunga sang mga pagpakamalaot nga naangkon sang ahensya bangud sang kurapsyon sa flood control projects.
english: This is part of what Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan said amid criticism that the agency has received for corruption in flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Bonoan, gina-imbestigaran na subong ang mga department officials kag district engineers nga may kahilabtanan sa “ghost” flood control projects.
english: Bonoan said department officials and district engineers involved in ghost flood control projects are now being investigated.

text: Ipasaka ang nagakaigo nga kaso suno sa iya kag idagdag man ang sanctions nga magaserbe man nga leksyon sa iban nga indi na pag-ilugon ini nga buluhaton.
english: Appropriate cases will be filed, he said, and sanctions will be added which will also serve as a lesson to others not to imitate this practice.

text: “Titingnan namin kung sino ‘yung mga kasangkot dito sa paggawa ng mga inferior at saka ghost projects,” suno sa DPWH chief.
english: “We are looking into who is involved in doing inferior and ghost projects,” the DPWH chief said.

text:
“I think we’ll have to file all the necessary cases, sanctions din and let it be a lesson to everybody that we will not allow this kind of thing to happen.”

Dugang sini, “I think we have to cleanse up actually the organization kung kailangan.”

Nahibaluan nga personal gid mismo nga nagapatigayon sang inspeksyon si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english:
“I think we’ll have to file all the necessary cases, sanctions din and let it be a lesson to everyone that we will not allow this kind of thing to happen.”

He added, “I think we have to cleanse up actually the organization if necessary.”

President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. is personally conducting the inspection.

text: sa flood control projects matapos ginmensyonar sa iya State of the Nation Address ang mga government personnel nga nagapangawat sang pondo nga para kuntani sa sini nga mga proyekto.
english: on flood control projects after mentioning in his State of the Nation Address government personnel who are stealing funds that should be for these projects.

text: Balantayan ang bag-o nga kasumpong ni Pinoy boxing legend Manny Pacquiao matapos nag-back-out si Errol Spence Jr.
english: Watch out for Pinoy boxing legend Manny Pacquiao's new opponent after Errol Spence Jr. backed out.

text: bangud sa naangkon sini nga eye injury kadungan sang iya training.
english: due to an eye injury he sustained during his training.

text: Siya amo si WBA (Super) welterweight titlist Yordenis Ugas, “right-hander” nga boxidor kag may professional record nga 26-4 kag 12 knockouts (KOs).
english: He is WBA (Super) welterweight titlist Yordenis Ugas, “right-hander” boxer and has a professional record of 26-4 and 12 knockouts (KOs).

text: Bag-o siya gin-promote bilang Super champion, nakuha ni Ugas ang WBA (regular) title sang 2020 matapos ginlutos si Abel Ramos para sa vacant title.
english: Before he was promoted as Super champion, Ugas won the WBA (regular) title in 2020 after defeating Abel Ramos for the vacant title.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Boxing Analyst Edwin Espejo, iya ginpahayag nga kilala bilang bronze medalist sa 2008 Beijing Olympic Games si Ugas kag naka-secure man sang pila ka gold medal sa 2006 Mianyang World Championships, 2006 Cartagena Central American and Caribbean Games, kag 2007 Rio Pan American Games.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Boxing Analyst Edwin Espejo said Ugas is known as a bronze medalist in the 2008 Beijing Olympic Games and also secured several gold medals in the 2006 Mianyang World Championships, 2006 Cartagena Central American and Caribbean Games, and Rio 2007 Pan American Games.

text: Sang Enero, ginlista sang WBA si Pacquiao bilang “champion in recess” matapos napaslawan nga ma-depensahan ang titulo nga nadag-an batok kay Keith Thurman sang 2019 bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: In January, the WBA listed Pacquiao as “champion in recess” after failing to defend the title won against Keith Thurman in 2019 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Si Ugas ang ginpangalanan nga new champion.
english: Ugas was named the new champion.

text: Sa natalana nga sambuwa sa tunga nanday Pacquiao versus Ugas sa Agusto 21 sa Las Vegas, Nevada, ini na ang tyansa sang Pinoy boxing legend nga mabawi ang titulo.
english: In the scheduled fight between Pacquiao versus Ugas on August 21 in Las Vegas, Nevada, this is the chance for the Pinoy boxing legend to regain the title.

text: Liwat na naman nga masaka ang presyo sang produkto petrolyo bwas nga adlaw.
english: The price of petroleum products will rise again tomorrow.

text: Ini ang ika-anom nga semana sa pagsaka sang presyo sa gasolina, ika-onse sa diesel kag ika-lima naman sa kerosene.
english: This is the sixth week of price increases for gasoline, the eleventh for diesel and the fifth for kerosene.

text: Sa gasolina, piso ang dugang sa presyo sini sa kada litro; 65 centavos naman ang dugang sa diesel kag 70 centavos sa kerosene.
english: For gasoline, the price will be increased by a peso per liter; 65 centavos more for diesel and 70 centavos for kerosene.

text: Ang price adjustment ang nangin epektibo las 6 bwas nga aga.
english: The price adjustment took effect at 6 am tomorrow.

text: Base sa latest data halin sa Department of Energy, nagapakita nga ang year-to-date adjustments ang may net increase nga P10.75 sa kada litro sang gasolina, P9.25 sa kada litro sang diesel kag P7.70 sa kada litro sang kerosene as of June 22, 2021.
english: Based on the latest data from the Department of Energy, the year-to-date adjustments show a net increase of P10.75 per liter of gasoline, P9.25 per liter of diesel and P7.70 per liter of kerosene as of June 22, 2021.

text: Ginaselebrar subong nga adlaw ang ika -160 nga anibersaryo sang Jaro bilang isa ka Diocese.
english: Today is the 160th anniversary of Jaro as a Diocese.

text: Santo sa maragtas sang Jaro, opisyal nga ginkilala ini bilang diocese paagi sa Papal Bull “Qui Ab Initio”, nga gin-isyu ni Pope Pius IX” sang Mayo 27, 1865, kun sa diin si St.
english: According to the history of Jaro, it was officially recognized as a diocese through the Papal Bull “Qui Ab Initio”, issued by Pope Pius IX” on May 27, 1865, in which St.

text: Elizabeth of Hungary amo ang patron saint.
english: Elizabeth of Hungary is the patron saint.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rev.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rev.

text: Fr.
english: Fr.

text: Angelo Colada, director sang Commission on Social Communications sang Archdiocese of Jaro, iya ginpahayag nga sa sini man nga adlaw ginlunsar ang ika-75 nga anibersaryo sang Jaro bilang isa ka Archdiocese humalin sang gin-elevate ini bilang Metropolitan Archdiocese sang Hunyo 29, 1951.
english: Angelo Colada, director of the Commission on Social Communications of the Archdiocese of Jaro, said that on the same day, the 75th anniversary of Jaro as an Archdiocese was launched since it was elevated to Metropolitan Archdiocese on June 29, 1951.

text: Suno kay Fr.
english: According to Fr.

text: Colada, isa ka tuig ini nga selebrasyon sang Archdiocese kag may yara sang mga aktibidad kaangot sa selebrasyon.
english: Colada, this is a one-year celebration of the Archdiocese and there will be activities related to the celebration.

text: Pahayag ni Colada, nagapanguna nga aktibidad diri amo ang paglibot sang pilgrim image ni Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria sa mga simbahan nga sakop sang archdiocese of Jaro.
english: Colada said the main activity here is the tour of the pilgrim image of Our Lady of the Candlemas in the churches of the archdiocese of Jaro.

text: Dal-on man ini sa iban nga Archdiocese sa Western Visayas.
english: It will also be brought to other Archdioceses in Western Visayas.

text: Dugang ni Colada, ginaplanuhan pa subong ang iban nga mga aktibidad may kaangtanan sa isa ka tuig nga selebrasyon.
english: Colada added that other activities related to the one-year celebration are still being planned.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Nagapabilin sa isa ka safehouse ang suspek nga nagluthang-patay sa barangay kagawad sang San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The suspect who shot dead the barangay kagawad of San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo remains in a safehouse.

text: Ang suspek amo si John Castro Jr., samtang ang biktima naman amo si former Punong Barangay kag subong Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste, lunsay residente sang Barangay San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: The suspect was identified as John Castro Jr., while the victim was identified as former Punong Barangay and current Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste, both residents of Barangay San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Shiela Olid nga amo ang ginapangayuan sang legal advice ni Castro, iya ginpahayag nga personal siya nga gintawgan ni Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structure Unit (ASIS-U) head Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla agud magbulig sa pagpasungka kay Castro.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Shiela Olid, who is being sought by Castro for legal advice, said she was personally called by Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structure Unit (ASIS-U) head Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla to help surrender Castro.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Hosenilla ang anay head ni Castro sang nagatrabaho pa ini sa ASIS-U rason nga diri ini nagpabulig nga magsungka.
english: It was learned that Hosenilla was Castro's former head when he was working at ASIS-U and that is why he asked for help to surrender.

text: Suno kay Olid, gindala nila si Castro kay Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director Police Col.
english: Olid said they took Castro to Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director Police Col.

text: Kim Legada sa diin ginpasulat ini sang iya affidavit.
english: Kim Legada where he was asked to write his affidavit.

text: Diri kag ginpaathag sini nga self-defense lang ang natabo bangud man sa gina pagpanggarit-garit sa iya sang biktima.
english: He explained that the incident was self-defense because of the victim's harassment.

text: Apang suno kay Olid, indi na mahimo makustodiya si Castro bangud napasaka na ang kaso nga murder batok sa iya kag wala pa ini sang warrant of arrest.
english: However, Olid said Castro can no longer be detained because a murder case has been filed against him and he does not have a warrant of arrest.

text: Magluwas diri, wala man sang natabo nga warrantless arrest rason nga indi ini mapreso.
english: Besides, there was no warrantless arrest so he could not be imprisoned.

text: Bangud man sa kahangawa sa seguridad ni Castro, ginpahamtang lang ini sa lugar sa diin ini ini masakit sang bisan sin-o nga indibidwal kasunod sang nahimo sini nga krimen.
english: Due to concerns for Castro's security, he was placed in a place where he could be hurt by any individual following his crime.

text: Gin-athag man ni Olid nga indi siya ang legal counsel ni Castro sa baylo, nagbulig lang ini agud mapasungka ini sa pulis.
english: Olid also clarified that he was not Castro's legal counsel but instead, he helped him surrender to the police.

text: 𝗚𝗔𝗭𝗔 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗣 —Nagnubo ang mga paglaum para sa isa ka ceasefire sa Gaza Strip, sa diin ang inaway nagapadayon apisar sang pagduso sang Estados Unidos sa Israel kag sa mga militante nga Palestinian nga Hamas nga makalab-ot sa isa ka kasugtanan.
english: 𝗚𝗔𝗭𝗔 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗣 —Hopes have dimmed for a ceasefire in the Gaza Strip, where fighting continues despite U.S. pressure on Israel and the Palestinian militant Hamas to reach a deal.

text: Pagkatapos sang masobra 10 ka bulan nga inaway, ang mga opisyales gikan sa Estados Unidos kag mga Arab mediator nga Egypt kag Qatar natalana nga magkitaay sa Cairo para sa isa ka bag-o nga hugna sang paghambalanay sini nga semana, apang ang kumpirmasyon wala pa matapos.
english: After more than 10 months of fighting, officials from the United States and Arab mediators Egypt and Qatar are set to meet in Cairo for a new round of talks this week, but confirmation is pending.

text: Ang inaway nga gintunaan sang pag-atake sang Hamas sa Israel sang Oktubre 7 nagguba sang Gaza, nagsaylo sang halos tanan nga populasyon sini sa dimagkubos makaisa kag nagtuga sang isa ka humanitarian crisis.
english: The war sparked by Hamas’s Oct. 7 attack on Israel has devastated Gaza, displaced nearly all of its population at least once and created a humanitarian crisis.

text: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken ang nagtapos sang iya pinakaulihi nga paglibot sa Middle East, nga nagatuyo nga ma-finalize ang ceasefire.
english: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken concluded his latest tour of the Middle East, aiming to finalize a ceasefire.

text: Sa isa ka tawag sa telepono, ginduso ni Presidente Joe Biden ang Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga batunon ang isa ka kasugtanan, sa tunga sang pag-ipit sang mga pro-Palestinian nga mga nagaprotesta sa kombensihon sang US Democratic party antes sang Nobyembre nga eleksyon sa pagkapresidente.
english: In a phone call, President Joe Biden pushed Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to accept a deal, amid pressure from pro-Palestinian protesters at the US Democratic party convention ahead of the November presidential election.

text: Ginpasalig man siya ni Biden sa mga panikasog sang Estados Unidos — ang panguna nga kaalyado kag supplier sang armas sang Israel — nga suportahan ini batok sa mga pamahog gikan sa Iran kag mga proxy sini.
english: Biden also reassured him of efforts by the United States — Israel’s main ally and arms supplier — to support it against threats from Iran and its proxies.

text: Nagpakigbahin man sa panawagan si Vice President Kamala Harris, ang kandidato sang Democratic party sa US presidential election.
english: Vice President Kamala Harris, the Democratic party's candidate in the US presidential election, also joined the call.

text: Nagagamit na sang Quick Response (QR) codes para sa person-to-person (P2P) payments ang kadam-an sang mga Filipino.
english: Most Filipinos are already using Quick Response (QR) codes for person-to-person (P2P) payments.

text: Suno kay Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, naghatag sang mas madali, madasig kag barato nga payment option sa consumers ang QR Ph, ukon ang National QR Code Standard sa tion sang health crisis.
english: According to Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, QR Ph, or the National QR Code Standard, has provided an easier, faster and cheaper payment option to consumers during the health crisis.

text: Sang bulan sang Mayo, naglapit sa P1 billion ang transactions gamit ang QR Ph.
english: In May, transactions using QR Ph. approached P1 billion.

text: Pahayag ni Diokno, bangud sa paglunsyar sang QR person-to-person (P2P) payments, madamo pa nga stakeholders ang malab-ot sang benepisyo sini lakip na ang magagmay nga negosyo kaangay sang sari-sari store, kag tricycle drivers.
english: Diokno said that with the launch of QR person-to-person (P2P) payments, more stakeholders will benefit from it including small businesses such as sari-sari stores, and tricycle drivers.

text: Gintuad sang Police Regional Office VI (PRO-6) nga wala pa nakabaton ang talatapan sang sulat nga nagatumod sang mga pangalan sang police personnel nga iga-dismiss sa pwesto.
english: The Police Regional Office VI (PRO-6) admitted that the office has not yet received a letter specifying the names of the police personnel who will be dismissed from their posts.

text: Ini matapos mapamatud-an nga guilty sa seryoso nga administrative offenses base sa ginpatigayon nga imbestigasyon sang National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM).
english: This was after being found guilty of serious administrative offenses based on the investigation conducted by the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonle Arnel Solis, Spokesperson sang Police Regional Office VI, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka maayo nga tikang ang ginpatuman sang NAPOLCOM kon sa diin, mahatagan na sang hustisya ang mga complainants nga nagpasaka sang panumbungon batok sa pila ka pulis.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Colonle Arnel Solis, spokesperson of the Police Regional Office VI, said that a good step has been implemented by NAPOLCOM where justice will be given to the complainants who filed charges against some policemen.

text: Suno kay Solis, isa ka palaagyan ang tikang agud maresolba ang kaso nga madugay na nga ginahulat sang complainant.
english: According to Solis, the move is a way to resolve the case that the complainant has been waiting for for a long time.

text: Dugang niya nga nagapakita lamang ini nga ang Philippine National Police (PNP) kag NAPOLCOM ang nagahulag kag nagasunod sa rekisitos kon sa diin, wala ginatolerar ang mga indi maayo nga hinimuan sang isa ka pulis.
english: He added that this only shows that the Philippine National Police (PNP) and NAPOLCOM are acting and following the requirements where, the wrongdoings of a policeman are not tolerated.

text: Matandaan nga pila sa mga kaso ang gin-file sang tuig 2010 pa, samtang ang pinakaulihi nga reklamo nasumiter sang tuig 2022.
english: It can be noted that some of the cases were filed as far back as the year 2010, while the latest complaint was submitted in the year 2022.

text: Lakip sa mga reklamo ang naga-angot sa grave misconduct, conduct unbecoming of a police officer, nga may mga kaso nga homicide, physical injury, may utang, kag iban pa.
english: Among the complaints are those related to grave misconduct, conduct unbecoming of a police officer, with charges of homicide, physical injury, indebtedness, and others.

text: Sa nangin desisyon sang NAPOLCOM En Banc, ginbasura ang kaso batuk sa 10 ka mga pulis bangud sa kakulang sang ebidensya, anum ang gin-dismiss sa serbisyo, apat ang gin-demote sang isa ka rank, tatlo ang gin-suspend sang 20 ka adlaw kag isa ang gin-suspend sang anum ka bulan.
english: In the decision of the NAPOLCOM En Banc, the case against 10 policemen was dismissed for lack of evidence, six were dismissed from service, four were demoted by one rank, three were suspended for 20 days and one was suspended for six months.

text: Nagsungka ang suspek nga nagluthang-patay sa barangay kagawad sang San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: The suspect who shot dead the barangay kagawad of San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo surrendered.

text: Ang suspek amo si John Castro Jr., samtang ang biktima naman amo si former Punong Barangay kag subong Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste, lunsay residente sang Barangay San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: The suspect was identified as John Castro Jr., while the victim was identified as former Punong Barangay and current Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste, both residents of Barangay San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Natabo ang krimen sang Oktubre 24 sa diin si Triste ang nagaserbe bilang Officer in Charge sa ila barangay.
english: The crime occurred on October 24 when Triste was serving as Officer in Charge in their barangay.

text: Si Castro ang nagsungka kay Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structure Unit (ASIS-U) head Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla.
english: Castro surrendered to Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structure Unit (ASIS-U) head Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hosenilla, iya ginpahayag nga si Castro ang nagatrabaho sadto sa iya opisina rason nga sa iya ini nagpabulig nga magsungka.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hosenilla said Castro was working in his office and asked him to help him surrender.

text: Suno kay Hosenilla, personal nga nagtawag sa iya si Castro kag nagpabutyag nga magsungka sa diin gindepensa sini nga self-defense lang ang natabo kasunod sang pag-away nila ni Triste.
english: According to Hosenilla, Castro personally called him and expressed his surrender, which he defended as self-defense following the fight between him and Triste.

text: Ginpahayag ni Hosenilla nga ginsugata niya si Castro sa Iloilo Terminal Market kag gindala sa Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) apang wala na ini gin-detain matapos napasakaan na ini sang kaso nga murder kag wala pa sang warrant of arrest.
english: Hosenilla said he met Castro at the Iloilo Terminal Market and took him to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) but he was not detained after he was charged with murder and there was no warrant of arrest.

text: Diri kag ginkuhaan man sang affidavit si Castro ni Atty. Shiela Olid sa diin gin-ako sini ang krimen.
english: Castro was also taken an affidavit by Atty. Shiela Olid where he confessed to the crime.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin si Castro sa isa ka safe house.
english: For now, Castro remains in a safe house.

text: Nagapanindugan sa gihapon si Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga nga indi dapat pag-ibasol sa Summer Games ang nakit-an nga spike sa coronavirus cases sa Tokyo, Japan.
english: Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga still insists that the Summer Games should not be blamed for the spike in coronavirus cases in Tokyo, Japan.

text: Duha ka semana antes ang closing ceremony sang hinampang, ang positive cases sa Japan ang yara sa kapin 5,000.
english: Two weeks before the closing ceremony of the games, the positive cases in Japan are at more than 5,000.

text: Sang nagtipon ang mga atleta kag nag-inabot sa amo nga pungsod ang delegasyon sang iban nga mga nasyon, ginapahayag nga nag-amat amat man saka ang numero sang kaso.
english: When the athletes gathered and the delegation of other countries arrived in the country, the number of cases reportedly increased.

text: Isa ka adlaw antes ang pagtakop sang Olimpyada, nagsaka sa 15,743 ang positive cases.
english: A day before the end of the Olympics, the number of positive cases rose to 15,743.

text: Matandaan nga antes ang pormal nga pag-umpisa sang Tokyo Olympics sang Hulyo 23, nagtipon ang mga protesters malapit sa venue agud pamatukan ang hinampang.
english: Before the formal start of the Tokyo Olympics on July 23, protesters gathered near the venue to oppose the games.

text: Sa pinal nga adlaw sang Olimpyada, may nabilin gihapon sa sini nga protesters nga nagpakita sa atubang sang Sendagaya station malapit sa Olympic stadium.
english: On the final day of the Olympics, there was still a remnant of these protesters who showed up in front of the Sendagaya station near the Olympic stadium.

text: Nakasulat sa placard ang mga tinaga nga “Cancel Olympics”.
english: The words “Cancel Olympics” were written on the placard.

text:
May yara man sang drums kag chants nga nabatian: “Abolish Olympics!”

Isa sa mga nagpabilin nga protester amo ang isa ka female doctor.
english:
There were also drums and chants heard: “Abolish Olympics!”

One of the remaining protesters was a female doctor.

text: Suno sa doktor, kun ginaabisuhan sang gobyerno ang mga tawo nga magpabilin sa balay bangud wala na sang bastante nga espasyo sa mga ospital, ngaa Tokyo man sa gihapon ang ma-host sang 2020 Paralympic Games?
english: According to the doctor, if the government is advising people to stay at home because there is not enough space in hospitals, why will Tokyo still host the 2020 Paralympic Games?

text: Ang Paralympic Games amo ang pinakadaku nga Para sports event sa kalibutan.
english: The Paralympic Games are the biggest Para sports event in the world.

text: 1964 sang katapusan nga nag-host ang Japan sang sini nga games.
english: 1964 when Japan last hosted these games.

text: Patigayunon ini sa Agusto 24 tubtub Septyembre 5.
english: It will be held from August 24 to September 5.

text: Ang Tokyo ang napaidalom sa fourth state of emergency nga magatakop tubtub sa katapusan sang bulan sang Agusto — tion man kun sa diin full swing ini nga Paralympics.
english: Tokyo is under a fourth state of emergency that will last until the end of August — the same time when the Paralympics are in full swing.

text: Ginapahayag sang mga eksperto nga nga posible maglab-ot sa 10,900 a day ang COVID-19 cases sa Agusto 18 kun magpadayon pa ang ini nga current transmission.##
english: Experts predict that the number of COVID-19 cases could reach 10,900 a day on August 18 if the current transmission continues.##

text: 𝗥𝗘𝗗 𝗦𝗘𝗔 — Naluwas ang 23 ka mga Filipino seafarers nga sakay sa MT Sounion sang European Union naval mission kasunod sang pag-atake sang missile sa ila tanker sa Red Sea.
english: 𝗥𝗘𝗗 𝗦𝗘𝗔 — Twenty-three Filipino seafarers aboard the MT Sounion of the European Union naval mission were rescued following a missile attack on their tanker in the Red Sea.

text: Ginabug-usan sang mayorya sang 25 ka tripulante ang 23 ka mga Pilipino nga sakay sang MT Sounion nga ginsalakay sang hapon sang Miyerkules, Agosto 21 (oras sa Manila).
english: The majority of the 25 crew members were the 23 Filipinos aboard the MT Sounion that was attacked in the afternoon of Wednesday, August 21 (Manila time).

text: Ang duha pa ka crew, nga naglakip sa kapitan, ang mga Russian.
english: The other two crew, which included the captain, were Russian.

text: Ang mga rebelde nga Houthi sang Yemen, nga nagsalakay sa international shipping sa Red Sea kag Gulf of Aden may kaangtanan sa inaway sang Israel batok sa militante nga grupo sang Palestinian nga Hamas, wala pa nag-ako sang responsibilidad sa pag-atake.
english: Yemen’s Houthi rebels, who have attacked international shipping in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden in connection with Israel’s war against the militant Palestinian group Hamas, have not claimed responsibility for the attack.

text: Apang, si Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Cacdac nagsiling nga ini “daw” isa ka pag-atake sang Houthi.
english: However, Migrant Workers Secretary Hans Cacdac said it “appeared” to be a Houthi attack.

text: Suno sa Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), wala sang may napilasan sa mga Filipino seafarers.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), none of the Filipino seafarers were injured.

text: Duha ka magagmay nga sakayan ang sulitsulit nga nagsalakay sa tanker nga may bandera sang Greek, nga nag-igo sini sang madamo nga mga projectile sa palibot sang 77 nautical miles sa nakatundan sang pantalan sang Yemen nga Hodeidah.
english: Two small boats repeatedly attacked the Greek-flagged tanker, hitting it with multiple projectiles around 77 nautical miles west of the Yemeni port of Hodeidah.

text: Suno sa United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), may yara sang malip-ot nga pagbayluhanay sang small arms fire sa tion sang insidente.
english: According to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), there was a brief exchange of small arms fire during the incident.

text: Sa ulihi nga update, ang UKMTO nagsiling nga ang barko nagreport sang isa pa ka pag-atake nga nagtuga sang sunog, rason nga madulaan sang engine power kag sang iya ikasarang sa pagmaniobra.
english: In a later update, the UKMTO said the ship reported another strike that caused a fire, causing it to lose engine power and its ability to maneuver.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga pag-atake nagtuga sang pagsulod sang tubig sa barko, apang indi bastante agud malugdang ini, apang nagtuga sa barko nga madulaan sang kontrol.
english: It turns out that the attacks caused water to enter the ship, but not enough to sink it, but caused the ship to lose control.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Cacdac nga indi na makapadayon ang pagbiyahe sang tanker bangud sa kahalitan sa iya makina, apang may bastante ini nga pagkaon kag mga kinahanglanon sa sakayan para mabuhi ang mga crews antes sila ginluwas.
english: Cacdac said the tanker could not continue its voyage due to damage to its engine, but it had enough food and supplies on board to keep the crews alive before they were rescued.

text: Magafile sang petition ang Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG) sa Philippine Tariff Commission agud pasakaan ang rate sang taripa sang imported rice nagikan sa iban nga pungsod nga wala nalakip sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).
english: The Samahang Industriya ng Agrikultura (SINAG) will file a petition with the Philippine Tariff Commission to raise the tariff rate of imported rice from other countries that are not included in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).

text: Suno kay Rosendo So, chairman sang SINAG, manubo ang taripa sang mga pungsod nga indi regular ang pag-export sang bugas sa pungsod kaangay sang India, Pakistan kag China ukon ang Most Favored Nations (MFN).
english: According to Rosendo So, chairman of SINAG, tariffs are low for countries that do not regularly export rice to the country such as India, Pakistan and China or the Most Favored Nations (MFN).

text: Pahayag ni So, ang pagpanubo sang taripa para sa MFN ang lain man ipaanggid sa manubo nga taripa para sa iban nga ASEAN nations.
english: So said the reduction in tariffs for MFN is also different compared to the low tariffs for other ASEAN nations.

text: Nahibaluan nga may trade agreement ang Pilipinas sa mga pungsod nga nalakip sa ASEAN.
english: The Philippines has trade agreements with ASEAN countries.

text: Ginpasa na sang Japan ang Olympic flag sa pungsod France, ang masunod nga host sang Olympiada.
english: Japan has already passed the Olympic flag to France, the next host of the Olympiad.

text: Ang naghatag sang flag amo si Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike, ginbaton sang Olympic representative, kag ginpasa naman kay Anne Hidalgo, ang mayor sang Paris nga amo ang host city sang Summer Olympics sa 2024.
english: The flag was presented by Tokyo Governor Yuriko Koike, accepted by the Olympic representative, and passed to Anne Hidalgo, the mayor of Paris which is the host city of the Summer Olympics in 2024.

text: Sa pagtakop sang Tokyo 2020 Olympics subong nga tuig, ang Team USA ang nagpanguna sa may pinakamataas nga numero sang medalya.
english: At the conclusion of this year's Tokyo 2020 Olympics, Team USA topped the list with the highest number of medals.

text: 113 ka medals ang nakuha sang USA sa 28 ka lain-lain nga sports.
english: The USA won 113 medals in 28 different sports.

text: Lakip diri ang 39 gold, 41 silver kag 33 bronze medals.
english: This includes 39 gold, 41 silver and 33 bronze medals.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga Summer Olympic Games nga nagpanguna ang Estados Unidos.
english: This is the third consecutive Summer Olympic Games that the United States has led.

text: Ika-50 naman ang Pilipinas sa Olympic medal standings matapos nakakuha sang 1 ka gold, duha ka silver, kag 1 ka bronze medal.
english: The Philippines is 50th in the Olympic medal standings after winning 1 gold, 2 silver, and 1 bronze medal.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 –  Nagsungka na ang suspek nga nagluthang-patay sa barangay kagawad sang San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – The suspect who shot dead the barangay kagawad of San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo has surrendered.

text: Ang suspek amo si John Castro Jr., samtang ang biktima naman amo si former Punong Barangay kag subong Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste, lunsay residente sang Barangay San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: The suspect was identified as John Castro Jr., while the victim was identified as former Punong Barangay and current Barangay Kagawad Jobanie Triste, both residents of Barangay San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.

text: Natabo ang krimen sang Oktubre 24 sa diin si  Triste ang nagaserbe bilang OIC Punong Barangay sa ila lugar.
english: The crime occurred on October 24 when Triste was serving as OIC Punong Barangay in their area.

text:
Si Castro ang nagsungka kay Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structure Unit (ASIS-U) head Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hosenilla, iya ginpahayag nga si Castro ang nagatrabaho sadto sa iya opisina rason nga sa iya ini nagpabulig nga magsungka.
english:
Castro surrendered to Anti-Squatting and Illegal Structure Unit (ASIS-U) head Mr. Love Joy Hosenilla

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hosenilla said Castro was working in his office and asked him to help him surrender.

text: Suno kay Hosenilla, personal nga nagtawag sa iya si Castro kag nagpabutyag nga magsungka sa diin gindepensa sini nga self defense lang ang natabo kasunod sang pag-away nila ni Triste.
english: According to Hosenilla, Castro personally called him and asked him to surrender. He defended that it was self defense following the fight with Triste.

text: Ginpahayag ni Hosenilla nga ginsugata niya si Castro sa Iloilo Terminal Market kag gindala sa Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) apang wala na ini gin-detain matapos napasakaan na ini sang kaso nga murder kag wala pa sang warrant of arrest.
english: Hosenilla said he met Castro at the Iloilo Terminal Market and took him to the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) but he was not detained after he was charged with murder and there was no warrant of arrest.

text: Diri kag ginkuhaan man sang affidavit si Castro ni Atty. Shiela Olid sa diin gin-ako sini ang krimen.
english: Castro was also taken an affidavit by Atty. Shiela Olid where he confessed to the crime.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin si Castro sa isa ka safe house.
english: For now, Castro remains in a safe house.

text: Nagapanguna nga complaint batok sa pila ka mga myembro sang kapulisan amo ang paglapas sa RA 9262 ukon ang Anti-Violence Against Women and their Children.
english: The main complaint against some members of the police is the violation of RA 9262 or the Anti-Violence Against Women and their Children.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Michelle Yotoko, spokesperson sang National Police Commission Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga kalabanan nga ginareklamo ang mga pulis nga wala nagasuporta sa ila mga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Michelle Yotoko, spokesperson of the National Police Commission Region 6, said most of the complaints are that police officers do not support their children.

text: Suno kay Atty. Yotoko, ginasiguro nila nga ginahatagan gid sang NAPOLCOM sang atensyon ini nga mga reklamo.
english: According to Atty. Yotoko, they are ensuring that NAPOLCOM takes these complaints seriously.

text: Dugang niya, nagapatigayon man sila sang motu-proprio investigation may kaangtanan sa nanuhay-tuhay man nga mga complaints nga indi direkta nga ginadangop sa ila kundi ginapaagi sa media.
english: He added that they are also conducting motu-proprio investigations regarding various complaints that are not directly addressed to them but through the media.
