text: Matandaan nga anom ka mga pulis nga na-assign sa Western Visayas ang ginpangkakas sa serbisyo matapos nga mapamatud-an nga guilty sa mga seryoso nga administrative offenses.
english: Six policemen assigned to Western Visayas were dismissed from service after being found guilty of serious administrative offenses.

text: May yara man sang tatlo nga gin-demote, apat ang ginsuspinde sang 20 ka adlaw, kag isa naman ang ginsuspinde sang anom ka bulan.
english: There were also three demoted, four suspended for 20 days, and one suspended for six months.

text: Nakabulig ang maabtik nga koordinasyon kag pagbinuligay sang mga otoridad sa Indonesia kag Pilipinas kun ngaa natigayon nga madakpan ang duha sa mga kaupdanan ni anay Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo kag nadala-pabalik diri sa pungsod.
english: The quick coordination and cooperation of the authorities in Indonesia and the Philippines helped to arrest two of the companions of former Bamban, Tarlac Mayor Alice Guo and brought them back to the country.

text: Sandig sa impormasyon nga ginpaguwa sang Indonesian Ministry of Law and Human Rights, nakasaad nga nakit-an sang immigration officers ang makaduluda nga “foreigners” sa isla sang Batam rason nga nagpakig-angot gilayon sa isa pa ka ahensya para nga matumod ang ila nga mga identity.
english: According to information released by the Indonesian Ministry of Law and Human Rights, immigration officers found the suspicious foreigners on the island of Batam and immediately contacted another agency to verify their identities.

text: Sa dalayon nga review, na-identify sila nga amo sanday “Sheila Guo” kag “Cassandra Li Ong” nga yara sa sulat sang Pilipinas sang ginpahibalo sini sa Jakarta ang kaso ni Alice Leal Guo ukon Guo Hua Ping nga nagpalagyo kag na-report nga yara sa Indonesia kag may mga kaupdanan.
english: In the ongoing review, they were identified as “Sheila Guo” and “Cassandra Li Ong” who were in the Philippines' letter when it informed Jakarta of the case of Alice Leal Guo or Guo Hua Ping who fled and was reported to be in Indonesia and with companions.

text: Martes, Agusto 20, sang gindakop ang duha sa Mega Mall Batam Center apang wala na-aresto ang dismissed mayor kag ang isa pa ka utod sini nga si Wesley.
english: Tuesday, August 20, when the two were arrested at the Mega Mall Batam Center but the dismissed mayor and his other brother, Wesley, were not arrested.

text: Suno kay Bombo Ginavella Limpin Cumla, international correspondent sa Indonesia, halin sa Singapore sanday Sheila kag Ong kag nagtabok sa isla sang Batam paagi sa cruise ship.
english: According to Bombo Ginavella Limpin Cumla, international correspondent in Indonesia, Sheila and Ong were from Singapore and crossed the island of Batam by cruise ship.

text: Madamo ang mga tawo sa Batam bangud isa ini ka ka urban kag industrial zone kag amo man ang pinakamalapit nga Indonesian Island sa Singapore kag sarang mabyahe sa sulod lamang sang 45 tubtub 70 minutos.
english: Batam is crowded because it is an urban and industrial zone and is also the closest Indonesian Island to Singapore and can be traveled in just 45 to 70 minutes.

text:
Nagaguwa man nga may nagbulig pa sa ila samtang yara didto bangud isa ka tawo ang nag-book sang apat ka mga kuwarto sa Harris Hotel Batam Center sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw

Nakasaad sa report ni Indonesian Director of Immigration Supervision and Enforcement Safar Godam nga nakit-an sa surveillance cameras nga ang Singaporean national nga si ZJ ang naghikot sang hotel reservations.
english:
It also appears that someone else helped them while there as one person booked four rooms at the Harris Hotel Batam Center in three days

According to a report by Indonesian Director of Immigration Supervision and Enforcement Safar Godam, surveillance cameras showed that Singaporean national ZJ made the hotel reservations.

text: Padayon ang pagbulig sang Indonesian authorities agud nga matultulan man sanday Alice Guo kag si Wesley nga ila gintawag nga mga pugante.
english: Indonesian authorities continue to help track down Alice Guo and Wesley, whom they called fugitives.

text: DIIN SANDAY ALICE KAG WESLEY?
english: WHERE ARE ALICE AND WESLEY?

text: Kun ang Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) ang pahambalon, ginapatihan nga yara pa ang anay alkalde kag ang iya utod sa Batam.
english: As for the Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC), it is believed that the former mayor and his brother are still in Batam.

text: Suno kay Cumla, posible nga mas mahapos sa otoridad nga madakpan ang duha kun yara pa matuod sila sa isla, apang daku naman nga pagpanghangkat pananglitan makasaylo sila sang lokasyon kag pilion nila ang lugar nga mas magamay ang tawo bangud mainit na sila sa mata sang otoridad.
english: According to Cumla, it may be easier for the authorities to arrest the two if they are still on the island, but it is a big challenge if they move location and choose a place with fewer people because they are hot in the eyes of the authorities.

text: Nagguwa naman sa report sang PAOCC nga ang Singaporean national nga nagbulig kanday Ong kag Sheila sa Batam ang wala man sang liwan kundi amo ang anay presidente sang Lucky South 99 nga isa ka illegal nga POGO hub sa Porac, Pampanga kun sa diin si Ong amo ang authorized representative.
english: The PAOCC report revealed that the Singaporean national who helped Ong and Sheila in Batam is none other than the former president of Lucky South 99, an illegal POGO hub in Porac, Pampanga where Ong is the authorized representative.

text: Pasado alas singko kaina sang hapon sang nadala-pabalik sa Pilipinas sanday Sheila kag Ong kag subong napaidalom sa kustodiya sang Bureau of Immigration.
english: Sheila and Ong were brought back to the Philippines around 5 pm yesterday and are now under the custody of the Bureau of Immigration.

text: ALIMODIAN, ILOILO – Ginapabugal ni Alimodian, Iloilo Mayor Gefree “Calay” Alonsabe ang ginhimo sang Alimodian Central Elementary School nga respetuhon ang Lesbian Gay Bisexual Transgender (LGBT) community.
english: ALIMODIAN, ILOILO – Alimodian, Iloilo Mayor Gefree “Calay” Alonsabe is proud of the Alimodian Central Elementary School's efforts to respect the Lesbian Gay Bisexual Transgender (LGBT) community.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Alonsabe, iya ginpahayag nga dalayawon ang pagpatukod sang nasambit nga eskwelahan sang Comfort Room (CR) para sa mga myembro sang LGBT.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Alonsabe said the school's construction of a Comfort Room (CR) for LGBT members is commendable.

text: Suno kay Mayor Alonsabe, paagi sa nasambit nga lihok sang eskwelahan, malikawan ang ‘bullying’ sa kabataan kag mahatagan sang igtalupangod ang kinahanglan sang tagsa ka estudyante.
english: According to Mayor Alonsabe, through the school's initiative, bullying of children will be avoided and the needs of each student will be given attention.

text: Magluwas sa LGBT CR, may yara man sang CR nga ginpatukod para sa mga Persons With Disability  (PWD).
english: Apart from the LGBT CR, a CR has also been set up for Persons With Disability (PWD).

text: Nahibalu-an nga sa saguwa sang CR, nakasulat ang tinaga nga LGBT kag ang pangalan sang alkalde nga isa man miyembro sang LGBT.
english: It was learned that on the outside of the CR, the word LGBT and the name of the mayor who is also a member of LGBT are written.

text: Mapauli na sa Pilipinas subong nga adlaw, Agusto 9, ang nabilin nga delegasyon sang pungsod nga nagpasakop sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
english: The remaining delegation of the country that participated in the Tokyo 2020 Olympics will return to the Philippines today, August 9.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mariano ‘Nonong’ Araneta, Jr., chef de mission sang Philippine delegation sa Olympics, iya ginpahayag nga halos isa ka bulan man sila nga nagtinir sa Japan bangud sa ginpasakupan nga mga hampang.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mariano 'Nonong' Araneta, Jr., chef de mission of the Philippine delegation to the Olympics, said they also stayed in Japan for almost a month due to the participation in the Games.

text: Restricted ang hulag sang mga atleta pati sang mga officials sa Olympic village, apang nabayluhan naman ini sang isa ka historic gold, duha ka silver, kag isa ka bronze nga medalya.
english: The movement of athletes and officials in the Olympic village was restricted, but it was exchanged for one historic gold, two silver, and one bronze medals.

text: Ang Pilipinas ang nagpanguna sa mga pungsod sa Southeast Asia nga may best performance sa Olimpyada subong nga tuig.
english: The Philippines topped Southeast Asian countries with the best performance at this year's Olympics.

text: Ang 19 ka mga atleta sang Pilipinas ang ginalakipan nanday boxers Irish Magno, Nesthy Petecio, Eumir Marcial, Carlo Paalam, weightlifters Elreen Ando kag Hidilyn Diaz, pole vaulter EJ Obiena, rower Cris Nievarez, gymnast Carlos Yulo, taekwondo jin Kurt Barbosa, skateboarder Margielyn Didal, rifle shooter Jayson Valdez, sprinter Kristina Knott, judoka Kiyomi Watanabe, golfers nga sanday Juvic Pagunsan, Bianca Pagdanganan, Yuka Saso, kag swimmers nga sanday Remedy Rule kag Luke Gebbie.
english: The 19 Philippine athletes include boxers Irish Magno, Nesthy Petecio, Eumir Marcial, Carlo Paalam, weightlifters Elreen Ando and Hidilyn Diaz, pole vaulter EJ Obiena, rower Cris Nievarez, gymnast Carlos Yulo, taekwondo board Barbosa, rifle skater Difleynte Margiel. shooter Jayson Valdez, sprinter Kristina Knott, judoka Kiyomi Watanabe, golfers Juvic Pagunsan, Bianca Pagdanganan, Yuka Saso, and swimmers Remedy Rule and Luke Gebbie.

text: Iban sa sini nga mga atleta ang nakauna na pauli sa Pilipinas.
english: Some of these athletes have already returned to the Philippines.

text: Sa 19 sa ila, si Diaz lang ang four-time Olympian; ang 18 sa ila ang lunsay first-timer sa Olympics.
english: Of the 19 of them, only Diaz is a four-time Olympian; all 18 of them are first-timers at the Olympics.

text: Nagdangat sa 50 ka mga Palestinian ang nagkalamatay sa bag-o nga pagpang-atake sang Israel kasunod sang pagbiya ni US Secretary of State Antony Blinken sa Middle East agud kuntani iplastar ang ginaduso sang Estados Unidos nga ceasefire sa Gaza war.
english: At least 50 Palestinians have been killed in fresh Israeli attacks following US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's departure from the Middle East to implement a US-proposed ceasefire in the Gaza war.

text: Suno sa Israeli military, gin-igu sang ila jets ang 30 ka mga target sa Gaza Strip lakip na ang tunnels, launch sites, kag isa ka observation post.
english: According to the Israeli military, its jets struck 30 targets in the Gaza Strip including tunnels, launch sites, and an observation post.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga napatay nila ang dinosena ka armado nga mga hangaway kag nakumpiskar ang mga hinganiban kaangay sang bomba, granada, kag automatic rifles.
english: Ginpahayag sini nga napatay nila ang dinosena ka armado nga mga hangaway kag nakumpiskar ang mga hinganiban kaangay sang bomba, granada, kag automatic rifles.

text: Kasunod sina, gin-igu man sang militar ang isa ka eskwelahan kag isa ka balay sa Gaza City kun sa diin tatlo ang napatay kag 15 ang nasamadan suno sa Civil Emergency Service.
english: Subsequently, the military also hit a school and a house in Gaza City, killing three and wounding 15, according to the Civil Emergency Service.

text: Ginrason sang Israel nga naga-operate ang Hamas militants sa command center nga yara sa compound.
english: Israel argued that Hamas militants were operating in a command center located in the compound.

text: Padayon sini nga ginaakusaran ang militante nga grupo nga naga-operate sa mga pasilidad sang mga sibilyan apang ginapanginwala naman ini sang dominant Islamist militant group sa Gaza.
english: It continues to accuse the militant group of operating in civilian facilities but the dominant Islamist militant group in Gaza denies this.

text: Wala gihapon sang kasiguruhan subong ang estado sang ceasefire apisar nga ini na ang ika-siyam ka bes nga ginpabalik si Blinken sa Middle East sa tuyo nga indi na magsaka pa ang tension sa amo nga rehiyon nga subong 40,000 na ang nagkalamatay bangud sa gyera nga nagsugod ang Oktubre 2023.
english: The state of the ceasefire remains uncertain despite the fact that this is the ninth time Blinken has been sent back to the Middle East in an effort to prevent further escalation of tensions in the region, which has now seen 40,000 deaths due to the war that began in October 2023.

text: Hugot nga ginahingyo sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang sektor sang construction agud sudlon ang mga oportunidad sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) strongly urges the construction sector to explore opportunities abroad.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, nagakadapat nga ikonsidera sang construction sector ang mga oportunidad sa global market agud nga mabuhi sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez, the construction sector should consider the opportunities in the global market to survive in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Pahayag ni Lopez, ang partisipasyon sang pungsod sa free trade agreements ang makahatag sang avenue para sa economic activity kag job creation para sa construction industry.
english: Lopez said the country's participation in free trade agreements will provide an avenue for economic activity and job creation for the construction industry.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, ang gasto sang construction ang nagnubo sa P2.2 trillion ukon 13 percent sang gross domestic product (GDP) halin sa P3.2 trillion ukon 17 percent sang GDP sang 2019.
english: Last year, construction spending fell to P2.2 trillion or 13 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) from P3.2 trillion or 17 percent of GDP in 2019.

text: Nag-reklamo ang isa ka massage therapist sa Iloilo City matapos gintanyagan ini sang customer sang kuwarta kag ginpilit nga maghatag sang ‘extra service’ samtang yara sa sulod sang isa ka kuwarto.
english: A massage therapist in Iloilo City complained after a customer offered her money and forced her to give extra service while inside a room.

text: Natabo ini sa ka hotel sa Benigno Aquino Jr.
english: This happened at a hotel in Benigno Aquino Jr.

text:
Avenue, Mandurriao, Iloilo City subong gid lamang nga gab-i.

Sa video nga ginpadala sa Bombo Radyo, makit-an ang isa ka lalaki nga ginabanta naga-edad sang 50-anyos tubtub 60-anyos, nagauyat sang kuwarta, kag Tagalog ang panghambal samtang ginapilit ang babaye nga batunon ang bayad basta iduot lang sini ang iya kinatawo.
english:
Avenue, Mandurriao, Iloilo City just tonight.

In the video sent to Bombo Radyo, a man, believed to be in his 50s to 60s, can be seen holding money and speaking Tagalog while forcing the woman to accept the payment as long as she touches his genitals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa 29-anyos nga masahista, iya ginpahayag nga sang nag-abot na siya sa hotel pasado alas singko sang hapon, naga-istorya sa iya kliyente apang sang ulihi ginkumbinse na sini ang babaye nga hikapon ang iya kinatawo bangud mahatag man siya sang singko mil pesos.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the 29-year-old masseuse said that when he arrived at the hotel around 5 pm, he was talking to his client but later convinced the woman to touch his genitals because he would give her five thousand pesos.

text: Pahayag sang tag-reklamo, nagsige sa pagpamilit ang lalaki kag nagsaka na sa siyete mil pesos ang offer sini, tubtub nga sang ulihi, natulugan ini sa dalayon nga masahe.
english: According to the complainant, the man kept insisting and increased the offer to seven thousand pesos, until finally, he fell asleep during the constant massage.

text: Sang ginpa-atubang naman ini sang massage therapist, nagliwat naman ini sa pagpamilit sa babaye nga iduot lang sini ang iya kinatawo agud mapaumpawan siya bangud mapauli na siya sa ila lugar pagkaaga.
english: When the massage therapist confronted him, he again insisted that the woman just touch his genitals to comfort him because he was going home in the morning.

text: Dugang sang masahista, tuman pa gid ang iya kakulba bangud sang gina-masahe na niya ang lalaki sa ulo sini, nagakamang naman ang kamot sang customer sa iya nga butkon pakadto sa abaga rason nga ginwaslik niya ini.
english: The masseuse added that she was even more nervous because when she was massaging the man's head, the customer's hand was crawling on her arm to her shoulder and she threw it away.

text: Didto na kag nagtindog ang lalaki kag nagsaka sa otso mil pesos ang iya nga offer.
english: The man stood up and raised his offer to eight thousand pesos.

text: Tuman man ang kakulba sang massage therapist bangud nga gin-lock sang lalaki ang puertahan kag ginadudahan na nga nagakuha siya sang video kag naghana pa nga kuhaon ang cellphone sang masahista.
english: The massage therapist was also very nervous because the man locked the door and suspected that he was taking a video and even tried to take the cellphone of the masseur.

text: Ginkontak naman sang babaye ang ila spa agud nga matawagan ang staff sang hotel kag ma-check sila sa kuwarto.
english: Ginkontak naman sang babaye ang ila spa agud nga matawagan ang staff sang hotel kag ma-check sila sa kuwarto.

text: Sang nakaabot na ang hotel staff, naabtan nga hublas na ang customer kag may ginauyatan nga kuwarta samtang didto na kag nakaguwa ang babaye sa hulot kag tuman ang pasalamat nga safe ang iya sitwasyon.
english: When the hotel staff arrived, they found the customer naked and holding money while the woman was able to leave the room and was very grateful that her situation was safe.

text: Nag-responde ang mga pulis sa hotel.
english: Police responded to the hotel.

text:
Nag-file naman sang blotter report ang babaye kag subong nagaplano nga mag-file sang complaint para nga mahatagan leksyon ang lalaki kag para man sa safety sang kaangay sini nga mga masahista.#

(*This is not the actual photo)
english:
The woman filed a blotter report and is now planning to file a complaint so that the man can be taught a lesson and also for the safety of such masseuses.

(*This is not the actual photo)

text: ILOILO – Handa na ang Pilipinas sa Same-Sex union.
english: ILOILO – The Philippines is ready for same-sex union.

text: Ini ang personal nga panan-awan ni Father Marco Sulayao sang Iglesia Filipina Independiente kag chairperson sang Promotion of Church People’s Response (PCPR).
english: This is the personal view of Father Marco Sulayao of the Iglesia Filipina Independiente and chairperson of the Promotion of Church People's Response (PCPR).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay  Father Sulayao, iya ginpahayag nga wala siya sang may nakita nga problema diri bangud kinahanglan nga magpangibabaw ang pagrespeto kag pag-alalangay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Father Sulayao said he does not see any problem here because respect and mutual respect should prevail.

text: Dugang pa ni Sulayao, kinahanglan nga batunon ang Same-Sex Union bangud indi malipod nga naga-eksister ini sa subong nga panahon kag madamo na nga pungsod ang nagpahanugot nga himuon ini nga legal.
english: Sulayao added that the Same-Sex Union must be accepted because it is undeniable that it exists today and many countries have allowed it to be legalized.

text: Sa pihak sini, gin-athag ni Father Sulayao nga ang iya panan-awan personal ang wala nagapatimaan nga ini man ang panindugan sang Iglesia Filipina Independiente.
english: Meanwhile, Father Sulayao explained that his personal view does not indicate that this is the position of the Independent Filipino Church.

text: Nagdangat sa 15 ka mga tawo ang napatay kag 40 ang napilasan kasunod sang pagsigabong sang pharmaceuticals manufacturing plant sa Andhra Pradesh state sa southern India.
english: At least 15 people have been killed and 40 injured in a fire at a pharmaceuticals manufacturing plant in Andhra Pradesh state in southern India.

text: Suno sa district officials, posible pa nga magsaka ang numero sang patay bangud nagapadayon pa ang rescue operations.
english: According to district officials, the death toll is likely to rise as rescue operations are still ongoing.

text: Antes ang explosion, una nga nagluntad ang sunog sa 40-acre manufacturing unit sang tigpalanyaga na.
english: Before the explosion, the fire first broke out in the 40-acre manufacturing unit during the summer.

text: Wala pa sang dugang nga detalye apang may ginmandu na sang otoridad ang imbestigasyon.
english: No further details were available but authorities have ordered an investigation.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, duha man ang patay kag lima ang pilason sa kaangay nga insidente sa solvent reactor sa unit sang Sahithi Pharma sa Anakapalli district sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Last year, two people were killed and five others injured in a similar incident at a solvent reactor at Sahithi Pharma's unit in Anakapalli district in the country.

text: Naglab-ot sa hawak ang kataason sang baha sa Sta.
english: The flood in Sta.

text:
Rosa, Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City matapos nga nagbubo ang mamunog nga ulan kagab-i.

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Janet Ramos, residente sang nasambit nga lugar, iya ginpahayag nga madugay na nga problema ang madasig nga pagtaas sang tubig-baha sa amo nga lugar.
english:
Rosa, Tagbak, Jaro, Iloilo City after heavy rains last night.

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Janet Ramos, a resident of the said area, said that the rapid rise of flood waters in the area has been a problem for a long time.

text: Suno kay Ramos, bisan sila ang nakulbaan bangud tuman man ka tunog ang pagpangilat nga may dala nga mabaskog nga ulan.
english: According to Ramos, even they were nervous because the lightning was so loud that it brought heavy rain.

text: Dugang sini nga kon tayuyon ang ulan, nagalab-ot gid ang kataason sini nga makatupong sa ila tay-tay.
english: He added that when it rains continuously, it reaches a height that is equal to their bridge.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga lakip sa mga ginalantaw nga rason amo ang pagsupon sang mga basura ilabi na sang mga non-biodegradable ukon plastic sa kanal.
english: He also admitted that among the reasons is the dumping of garbage especially non-biodegradable or plastic in the canal.

text: Gin-ako man ni Ramos nga ‘first time’ ini nga natabo sa ila kag subong lang gid nga nangin tuman ka taas ang baha.
english: Ramos also acknowledged that this is the first time this has happened to them and it is only recently that the floods have become so high.

text: Ginsaysay man sini nga bisan ang salakyan ang indi maka-agi sa lugar bangud malab-ot sang baha ang makina sini.
english: He also explained that even a vehicle cannot pass through the area because the flood will reach its engine.

text: Ginakahangaw-an man sang amo nga residente nga liwat masulit ang gulpiyada nga pagtaas sang baha.
english: The resident is also concerned that the sudden increase in floods will happen again.

text: Sa subong, amat-amat na nga naganubo ang baha sa ila nga lugar.
english: Now, the flood in their area is slowly subsiding.

text: Ginluthang ang anay Punong Barangay sang San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo.
english: The former Punong Barangay of San Rafael, Tigbauan, Iloilo was shot dead.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jobanie Triste.
english: The victim was identified as Jobanie Triste.

text: Ang ginpahayag nga suspek amo si JR.
english: The suspect was identified as JR.

text: Castro.
english: Castro.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa amo man nga barangay.
english: The incident happened in the same barangay.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa nga ginaimbestigaran sang otoridad ang natabo nga krimen.
english: Authorities are still investigating the crime.

text: Ginpahayag nga nalagyo ang suspek matapos ang insidente.
english: The suspect reportedly fled the scene after the incident.

text: Nahimo na nga isa ka tropical storm ang anay Tropical Depression Isang.
english: Former Tropical Depression Isang has become a tropical storm.

text: Sa latest bulletin sang weather bureau, nakit-an ang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 290 km nakatundan sang Bacnotan, La Union.
english: In the latest bulletin of the weather bureau, the typhoon was located at a distance of 290 km west of Bacnotan, La Union.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 65 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 80 km/h.

Nagahulag ini pa nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 25 km/h.

Napaidalom naman sa Signal number 1 ang masunod nga mga lugar:

Ginapabaskog man sini nga bagyo ang Southwest Monsoon ukon Habagat nga nagaapekto pati na sa Western Visayas kag Negros Island Region.
english:
It brought winds of 65 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 80 km/h.

It is moving westward at 25 km/h.

The following areas are under Signal number 1:

The typhoon is also strengthening the Southwest Monsoon or Habagat which is also affecting Western Visayas and Negros Island Region.

text: Padayon nga magahulag ang bagyo pa nakatundan kag ginalantaw nga magaguwa man sa Philippine Area of Responsibility subong nga aga.
english: The typhoon will continue to move westward and is expected to leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility this morning.

text: Ginalantaw nga magabaskog ini kag magalab-ot sa typhoon category samtang nagahinampot sa Hainan, China.
english: It is expected to intensify and reach the typhoon category as it approaches Hainan, China.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang isa ka pa Low Pressure Area sa guwa sang PAR ang padayon man nga gina-monitor sang weather bureau kag may manubo nga tyansa nga mangin bagyo sa masunod nga 24 oras.
english: Meanwhile, another Low Pressure Area outside the PAR is also being monitored by the weather bureau and has a low chance of becoming a typhoon in the next 24 hours.

text: Nakitaan sang potensyal ang Pilipinas bilang hub para sa audio production.
english: The Philippines sees potential as a hub for audio production.

text: Suno sa Hit Productions Incorporated, pabor ini nga mga tion sang pandemya para sa pungsod nga magstep-up kag mangin global pag-abot sa audio production para sa global film, television, music, gaming, advertising, kag iban pa nga key creative industries.
english: According to Hit Productions Incorporated, these pandemic times are favorable for the country to step-up and go global when it comes to audio production for global film, television, music, gaming, advertising, and other key creative industries.

text: Nagtuga suno sa Hit Productions Incorporated sang silver lining ang COVID-19 pandemic para magsangkad ang audio production industry sang pungsod kag mahatagan sang oportunidad ang mga Filipino nga madiscover sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Hit Productions Incorporated said the COVID-19 pandemic has created a silver lining to expand the country's audio production industry and give Filipinos the opportunity to be discovered abroad.

text: Nagapati ang amo nga firm nga dako ang kapabilidad sang mga Filipino sa lenggwahe nga english kag musical talent lakip na ang paggamit sang digital tools.
english: The firm believes that Filipinos have great potential in English language and musical talent including the use of digital tools.

text: Nag-apelar ang Jalasig Sugarcane Planters Association Incorporated kay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga pauntaton ang pag-export sang kalamay sa Estados Unidos.
english: The Jalasig Sugarcane Planters Association Incorporated has appealed to President Rodrigo Duterte to stop the export of sugarcane to the United States.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang quota sang pungsod sa pag-export sang kalamay ang yara sa 7% sang kabilugan nga produksyon ukon 140,000 metric tons sa diin mas barato ang presyo sang isa ka bag sang kalamay nga gina-export kun ipaanggid sa domestic price.
english: The country's sugarcane export quota is 7% of the total production or 140,000 metric tons where the price of a bag of exported sugarcane is cheaper compared to the domestic price.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd District Board Member Matt Palabrica kag myembro sang Jalasig Sugarcane Planters Association Incorporated, iya ginpahayag nga una na ginforecast sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) ang kakulang sang suplay sang kalamay nga nagadangat sa 300, 000 metric tons sa pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 3rd District Board Member Matt Palabrica and member of the Jalasig Sugarcane Planters Association Incorporated, said the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) had already forecast a shortage of sugarcane supply of 300,000 metric tons in the country.

text: Apang suno sa iya, ginpahanugutan pa sang SRA ang exportation sang 69,000 metrict tons sang kalamay sa Estados Unidos.
english: However, he said, the SRA still allowed the export of 69,000 metric tons of sugarcane to the United States.

text: Nagapati si Palabrica nga indi obligado ang pungsod sa pag-export sang kalamay bangud wala man sang trade agreement.
english: Palabrica believes that the country is not obliged to export sugarcane because there is no trade agreement.

text: Suno kay Palabrica, sa kada bag sang ‘A’ sugar nga gina-export, P350 diri ang pyerde sang mga mangunguma.
english: According to Palabrica, for every bag of 'A' sugar exported, farmers lose P350.

text: Pahayag ni Palabrica, bangud sini, tuman ka apektado sila nga local sugarcane farmers.
english: Palabrica said that because of this, they are severely affected as local sugarcane farmers.

text: Dugang pa niya, kun i-export pa sang pungsod ang nabilin nga 34,000 metric tons sang kalamay, magasaka na sa P721 million ang total nga pyerde sang sugarcane farmers bangud sa manubo nga purchase price sang ‘A’ sugar.
english: He added that if the country exports the remaining 34,000 metric tons of sugarcane, the total loss of sugarcane farmers will rise to P721 million due to the low purchase price of 'A' sugar.

text: Nangin ehemplo sang Pinoy pole vaulter nga si Ernest John ‘EJ’ Uy Obiena ang iya mga ginikanan sa pagsulod sini sa patag sang hinampang.
english: Pinoy pole vaulter Ernest John 'EJ' Uy Obiena set an example for his parents in his entry into the sport.

text: Kilala si EJ Obiena nga tumandok sang Tondo, Manila bilang tiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics sa diin siya lamang ang naga-isahanon nga asyano nga na-qualify sa finals sang men’s pole vault.
english: EJ Obiena, a native of Tondo, Manila, is known as the Philippines' representative in the Tokyo 2020 Olympics where he was the only Asian to qualify for the finals of the men's pole vault.

text: Apisar napaslawan nga makakuha sang medalya, nagbubo ang pagdayaw kay Obiena bangud sa iya dako nga effort sa diin naatubang niya ang Olympic gold medalist nga si Mondo Duplantis sang Sweden.
english: Despite failing to win a medal, Obiena was praised for his great effort against Olympic gold medalist Mondo Duplantis of Sweden.

text: Magluwas sini, naatubang man ni Obiena ang iya man mismo training partner nga si Thiago Braz sang Brazil nga sadto anay nangin gold medalist man sa Rio 2016 Olympics apang, nangin bronze medalist na lang subong nga Olimpyada.
english: Obiena also faced his own training partner, Thiago Braz of Brazil, who was a gold medalist at the Rio 2016 Olympics but became a bronze medalist at the Olympics.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ma.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Ma.

text: Jeanette Obiena, iloy sang pole vaulter, iya ginpahayag nga nagdako si EJ sa pamilya nga lunsay athletics, kag ang nag-inspire sa iya amo ang iya amay – isa ka former national record holder nga si Emerson Obiena.
english: Jeanette Obiena, mother of the pole vaulter, said EJ grew up in a family that was all about athletics, and he was inspired by his father – a former national record holder Emerson Obiena.

text: Isa ka sports coach ang iloy ni EJ, record holder man sa pole vaulting ang iya naga-isahanon nga utod kag ang iya amay, isa man ka pole vaulter, silver medalist sa 1995 Southeast Asian Games kag bronze medalist sa 2005 Manila Games.
english: EJ's mother is a sports coach, his only brother is also a record holder in pole vaulting and his father, also a pole vaulter, silver medalist in the 1995 Southeast Asian Games and bronze medalist in the 2005 Manila Games.

text: Suno kay Mrs. Obiena, ang iya amay ang rason kun ngaa na-inlove ang atleta sa pole vaulting sa diin ginlab-ot gid niya ang handom sang iya amay nga makahampang sa Olimpyada.
english: According to Mrs. Obiena, his father is the reason why the athlete fell in love with pole vaulting where he achieved his father's dream of playing in the Olympics.

text: Sa tion sang mga pagpanghangkat sa iya mga hampang, ilabi na sa iya pinakaulihi nga challenge sa finals sang men’s pole vault sa diin napaslawan ang atleta nga malapawan ang iya world record, bug-os nga suporta kag encouragement sa gihapon ang ginbubo sang iloy para sa iya anak.
english: During the challenges in his games, especially in his latest challenge in the finals of the men's pole vault where the athlete failed to break his world record, the mother still poured full support and encouragement for her son.

text: Pahayag niya, tuman siya ka proud para sa anak kag ginahatagan man niya ini sang espasyo agud ma-rebuild ang kaugalingon kun yara sa lowest point kag ginapuno man sang positibo nga mga paglaygay.
english: She said she is very proud of her daughter and gives her space to rebuild herself when she is at her lowest point and is also filled with positive advice.

text: Sang ginpamangkot naman ang iloy kaangot sa nangin agaw atensyon nga mga medyas ni EJ sa diin naka-imprint ang spongebob squarepants nga cartoon characters nga ginsuksok niya sa finals sang men’s pole vault, ginpahayag sang iloy nga pahanumdom ini ni EJ sa iya kaugalingon nga mag-enjoy lang sa hampang sa tunga sang pressure.
english: When asked about EJ's attention-grabbing socks printed with spongebob squarepants cartoon characters that he wore in the finals of the men's pole vault, the mother said it was EJ's reminder to himself to enjoy the game in the midst of pressure.

text: Sa subong, yara pa sa Italya si EJ agud padayunon ang iya nga training para sa mga masunod nga kompetisyon ilabi na para sa Paris 2024 Olympics.
english: EJ is currently in Italy to continue his training for the upcoming competitions especially for the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text: Indi sa gihapon makasaho ang aktor nga si Daniel Padilla nga indi makaupod sa trabaho ang iya nobya nga si Katryn Bernardo.
english: Actor Daniel Padilla still can't accept that his girlfriend Katryn Bernardo can't work with him.

text: Suno kay Daniel, indi siya makasaho sa nangin sitwasyon nila sa subong sang aktres.
english: According to Daniel, he can't cope with the current situation with the actress.

text: Dugang pa niya, malayo sa iya si Kathryn sa diin yara ini subong sa Hong Kong agud nga magtrabaho.
english: He added that Kathryn is far from him where she is currently in Hong Kong to work.

text: Bangud sa kahidlaw, gin-surprise ni Daniel si Kathryn sang damlag lang sa pagpadulong sa Hong Kong.
english: Due to nostalgia, Daniel surprised Kathryn recently with a trip to Hong Kong.

text: Gin-ako man sang aktor nga indi na masarangan sang iya tagipusuon nga indi makit-an ang iya nga nobya.
english: The actor also admitted that his heart can't handle not seeing his girlfriend.

text: Ma-imagine mo ayhan kun ano ka gahmanan ang isa ka gunting?
english: Can you imagine how powerful a pair of scissors is?

text: Daw ka budlay gid panumdumon no bangud ang gunting ginagamit lang naton sa pag-gunting sang papel, buhok kag tanan nga bagay nga pwede gamitan sang gunting.
english: It's hard to remember because we only use scissors to cut paper, hair and everything that can be used with scissors.

text: Pera nagsulod bala sa pinsar mo nga gunting mahimo mag-apekto sa operasyon sang isa sa busiest airport sa kalibutan?
english: Did it ever occur to you that scissors could affect the operation of one of the busiest airports in the world?

text: Sang damlag lang, malapit 40 ka mga flights ang gincancel kag 201 ka mga flights ang na- delay sa isa ka Japanese airport.
english: Recently, nearly 40 flights were canceled and 201 flights were delayed at a Japanese airport.

text: Ini matapos nga nadula ang isa ka gunting sa isa ka store malapit sa boarding gates.
english: This was after a pair of scissors went missing from a store near the boarding gates.

text: Kasunod sini, gin-suspend ang Security checks sa New Chitose Airport domestic terminal sa Hokkaido sa sulod sang duha ka oras nga nagresulta sa pagka-stranded sang ginatos ka travellers.
english: Subsequently, Security checks at the New Chitose Airport domestic terminal in Hokkaido were suspended for two hours, leaving hundreds of travelers stranded.

text: Naggilinutok ang mga pasahero sa departure lounge kag napilitan nga magpaidalom liwat sa security checks.
english: Passengers crowded into the departure lounge and were forced to undergo security checks again.

text: Gintinguhaan sang otoridad nga pangitaon ang nadula nga gunting nga sang ulihi, nakit-an man lang sa sulod sang amo nga store.
english: Authorities tried to find the missing scissors which were later found inside the store.

text: Apisar nga madamo ang nahul-an, madamo naman ang nagdayaw sa response sang airport sa insidente kag labi pa nga nagdako ang ila pagsalig sa Japanese air safety.
english: Although many were injured, many praised the airport's response to the incident and increased their confidence in Japanese air safety.

text: Ang New Chitose isa sa pinakamasako nga airports sa Japan kag nagaserbisyo sa second-most travelled domestic air route – sa tunga sang Tokyo kag Sapporo.
english: New Chitose is one of the busiest airports in Japan and serves the second-most traveled domestic air route – between Tokyo and Sapporo.

text: Sang 2022, masobra sa 15 million travellers ang naggamit sang amo nga paluparan.
english: In 2022, more than 15 million travelers used the airport.

text: Nagpakig-upod ang Pilipinas kag South Korea sa pag-implementar sang $16 million nga grant para sa duha ka proyekto nga nagatuyo sa pagpasanyog sang aquaculture development kag community-based agribusiness.
english: The Philippines and South Korea have partnered to implement a $16 million grant for two projects aimed at promoting aquaculture development and community-based agribusiness.

text: Ginpahayag sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga ang grant nga ginpirmahan upod sa Korea International Cooperation Agency (Koica) ang magapadali sang implementasyon sang multiyear projects para sa mga mangunguma kag mangingisda.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) said the grant signed with the Korea International Cooperation Agency (Koica) will facilitate the implementation of multiyear projects for farmers and fishermen.

text: Ang una nga undertaking ang ginatawag Capacity Building on Aquaculture Development for Income Increase of Fisherfolk sa Probinsya sang Guimaras.
english: The first undertaking is called Capacity Building on Aquaculture Development for Income Increase of Fisherfolk in Guimaras Province.

text: Ini nagatuyo sa pagbulig sa mga mangingisda nga madugangan ang ila kita paagi sa pagpabakod sang produksyon sang aquaculture kag value chain.
english: It aims to help fishers increase their income by strengthening aquaculture production and value chain.

text: Ini ipatuman sa sulod sang pito ka tuig.
english: It will be implemented over a period of seven years.

text: Ini nga inisyatibo, nga nakabaton sang grant nga $10 million, nagalakip sang pagpauswag sang imprastraktura sa aquaculture pareho sang sistema sang hatchery kag pilot pond para sa mga high-value species.
english: This initiative, which received a grant of $10 million, includes the development of aquaculture infrastructure such as a hatchery system and pilot pond for high-value species.

text: Nagalakip man ini sang pagbalhin sang mga advanced aquaculture technologies paagi sa capacity-building programs kag ang pagpauswag sang mga istruktura sang operasyon sang negosyo para sa mga kooperatiba.
english: It also includes the transfer of advanced aquaculture technologies through capacity-building programs and the improvement of business operating structures for cooperatives.

text: Patay sa nasunog nga balay ang mag-utod nga tatlo kag apat ka tuig kag ang ila 63-anyos nga yaya sa Iriga City, Camarines Sur.
english: Three- and four-year-old brothers and their 63-year-old nanny were killed in a fire in Iriga City, Camarines Sur.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, na-trap ang mga biktima sa kuwarto sa 2nd floor bangud nga may “iron grills” ang bintana.
english: According to the investigation, the victims were trapped in a room on the 2nd floor because there were iron grills on the window.

text: Nakaluwas naman ang lolo kag lola sang mga bata matapos makagwa.
english: The children's grandparents were able to escape.

text: Nalapnos man ang panit sang isa pa nila ka kaupod sa balay.
english: Another housemate was also injured.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga ang kabangdanan sang sunog amo ang “electrical short circuit” sa sala sang balay.
english: Investigation revealed that the cause of the fire was an electrical short circuit in the living room.

text: ONGOING sa karon ang pagsinugilanon (Nov.
english: ONGOING is currently underway (Nov.

text: 6-18) sang mga “parties” sa 27th Conference of the Parties (COP27) sang UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UN FCCC) sa Red Sea Resort sa Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt.
english: 6-18) of the “parties” at the 27th Conference of the Parties (COP27) of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UN FCCC) at the Red Sea Resort in Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt.

text: Ginpaabot diri ang pagtambong sang mga 200 ka “world leaders” upod ang ila “team of negotiators” agud athagon pa gid ang “commitment” kag ang nahimo na sang ila mga pungsod nga nagpirma sang ila pagpasakop sa UN FCCC sadtong 1992 Earth Summit sa Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.
english: About 200 world leaders and their team of negotiators are expected to attend to further clarify the commitment and achievements of their countries that signed their accession to the UN FCCC during the 1992 Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

text: Pwede man makatambong diri ang mga observer organizations katulad sang environmental NGOs, think-tanks kag faith-based groups, pati na ang media kag ang general public.
english: Observer organizations such as environmental NGOs, think-tanks and faith-based groups, as well as the media and the general public, can also attend.

text: Gintukod ining UN FCCC agud punggan ang “dangerous human interference” sa “climate system” nga nagdangat sang ulihi sa Kyoto Protocol (1997) kag sa Paris Agreement of 2015 agud hisugtan na ang “emission-cutting deals”, ukon ang pag-limite na sang ginabuga nga mga “disastrous” nga greenhouse gases (GHG) sa atmospera.
english: The UN FCCC was established to prevent dangerous human interference in the climate system that eventually led to the Kyoto Protocol (1997) and the Paris Agreement of 2015 to agree on emission-cutting deals, or limiting the emission of disastrous greenhouse gases (GHG) into the atmosphere.

text: Sa napamatud-an na sang mga siyentipiko, ang ining GHG emissions ang mayor gid nga kabangdanan sang sige pagtaas sang init sang kalibutan (Global Warming) nga nagadulot sang “abnormal” kag “disastrous” nga mga hitabo sa palibut.
english: As scientists have proven, these GHG emissions are the main cause of global warming that causes “abnormal” and “disastrous” environmental events.

text:
Ginatudlo diri ang wala pahuway nga paggamit sang fossil fuel

(oil, natural gas, coal) sang mga industriya nga nagabuga sang GHG sa atmospera.
english:
It points out the relentless use of fossil fuels

(oil, natural gas, coal) of industries that emit GHG into the atmosphere.

text: Ginapatihan gani nila nga indi  na masarangan atubangon kag ma-proteksyunan pa ang kalibutan kon madugangan pa ang init sang kalibutan sing 1.5o Celsius (para sa mga “more vulnerable” countries, lakip ang Filipinas) tubtub 2.00 Celsius (para sa “less vulnerable” nga mga pungsod).
english: They even believe that the world can no longer be coped with and protected if global warming increases by 1.5o Celsius (for more vulnerable countries, including the Philippines) to 2.00 Celsius (for less vulnerable countries).

text: Tubtub sa karon, ugaling, nagapati ang madamo nga ang mga myembro sang UN FCCC, labi na gid ang mga dalagku nga mga pungsod, nagpabaya sa ila “commitment” sa pagpanubo sang ila GHG emissions pabor sa ila padayon nga interes sa negosyo.
english: To date, however, many believe that UN FCCC members, especially the major countries, have neglected their “commitment” to reduce their GHG emissions in favor of their continued business interests.

text: Lakip na dira ang grupo sang popular youth activist nga si Greta Thunberg kag ang The Economist, nga nakilala sa iya authoritative insight kag opinyon sa international news, politics, finance, science, kag technology.
english: These include the group of popular youth activist Greta Thunberg and The Economist, known for its authoritative insight and opinion on international news, politics, finance, science, and technology.

text: Nagpahibalo pa gani sila nga indi magtambong sa sining COP27.
english: They even announced not to attend this COP27.

text: “Not by words but by action!”siling gani nila sa mga lideres sang kalibutan sa sining pagkinit-anay nila sa COP27.
english: “Not by words but by action!” they even told world leaders during their meeting at COP27.

text: In fact, recent evidence ang padayon nga paglala sang Climate Change ang “worst flooding” sa Pakistan (Agosto 2022) kag ang “super typhoon” nga panghalit sang Severe Tropical Storm Paeng sang Oktubre 2022 despite sang kuno mga aksyon nga ginahimo nila batok sa Climate Change.
english: In fact, recent evidence of the continued worsening of Climate Change is the “worst flooding” in Pakistan (August 2022) and the “super typhoon” damage caused by Severe Tropical Storm Paeng in October 2022 despite the supposed actions they are taking against Climate Change.

text:
***

Lakip sa global concern batok sa Climate Change ang pagpanubo sang greenhouse gas (GHG) emission; ang madinalag-on nga pagbangon (resilience) batok sa problema nga dala sang Climate Change; ang pagpakigbagay (adapt) sa mga hitabo sa palibut agud indi matam-an sing halit; kag ang pagpatuman sang “commitments” agud ma-finance ang Climate Action sang mga developing kag “more vulnerable” countries.
english:
***

Global concern against Climate Change includes reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions; resilience against the challenges posed by Climate Change; adapting to environmental events to avoid excessive damage; and the implementation of “commitments” to finance Climate Action by developing and “more vulnerable” countries.

text: Ginapaabot ining mga bulig sang “more vulnerable” countries labi na gid halin sa nagapanguna nga mga global GHG emitters katulad sang China (20.9% GHG emission), Estados Unidos (17.89%), Russia (7.53%), kag sang India (4.10%).
english: These assistance is expected from “more vulnerable” countries especially from the leading global GHG emitters such as China (20.9% GHG emission), the United States (17.89%), Russia (7.53%), and India (4.10%).

text: Naglain pa kay ang problema sa Climate Change ginpalala pa sang gyera sa tunga sang Rusya kag Ukraine nga nag-resulta man sa pagbinahin-bahin sang mga pungsod.
english: To make matters worse, the problem of Climate Change has been exacerbated by the war between Russia and Ukraine which has also resulted in the division of countries.

text: Nagbutang man ini sa wala-kaseguruhan ang supply sang petrolyo (fossil fuel), nga nagapanguna sa karon nga source sang energy sang mga pungsod.
english: It has also threatened the supply of petroleum (fossil fuel), which is the main source of energy for countries.

text: Nagpataas man gani ini sang bili sang petrolyo nga nagpasaka pa gid sang presyo sang mga balaklon.
english: It even increased the price of petroleum which pushed up the price of goods even more.

text: Tani mag-askyon na ang COP27 kag indi kay sige lang tikal!
english: I hope COP27 will take action and not just keep talking!

text:
***

By the way, kadungganan naton nga makabaton sing email message halin kay Tuvalu Prime Minister Kausea Natano  nga kon mahimo updan naton ang kawsa sang Tuvalu kag iban pa nga mga magagmay kag “more vulnerable” nga mga pungsod sa sining COP27 sa Egypt.
english:
***

By the way, we are honored to receive an email message from Tuvalu Prime Minister Kausea Natano that if possible we will join the cause of Tuvalu and other small and “more vulnerable” countries in this COP27 in Egypt.

text: Isa ka gamay kag “vulnerable” sa “tide rise” nga teritoryo sa Pacific Ocean ang Tuvalu.
english: Tuvalu is a small and “vulnerable” to “tide rise” territory in the Pacific Ocean.

text: Gin-relay niya ang iya email message sa aton paagi sa AVAAZ nga “friend” naton sa internet, sa diin ginasulong ta man gani sa aton kolum ang kawsa batok sa Climate Change sa madamo na naton nga mga artikulo diri.
english: He relayed his email message to us through AVAAZ, our “friend” on the internet, where we even advance the cause against Climate Change in our column in many of our articles here.

text: Thank you, Mr. Prime Minister of Tuvalu!
english: Thank you, Mr. Prime Minister of Tuvalu!

text: Ang AVAAZ isa ka US-based non-profit organization nga nagasulong sang global activism sa mga isyu sa climate change, human rights, animal rights, corruption, poverty kag gyera (conflict).
english: AVAAZ is a US-based non-profit organization that advances global activism on issues of climate change, human rights, animal rights, corruption, poverty and gwera (conflict).

text: Ginkilala ini sang The Guardian nga “the globe’s largest and most powerful online activist network”./PN
english: It has been identified by The Guardian as “the globe’s largest and most powerful online activist network”./PN

text:
Ginatun-an subong sang Department of Agriculture kag Sugar Regulatory Administration nga palawigon pa ang moratorium sang pag-angkat sang kalamay tubtob sa Disyembre 2026

Ini agud matagaan sang prayoridad ang lokal nga produksyon bangud sa kadamuon sang supply sang kalamay sa pungsod.
english:
The Department of Agriculture and Sugar Regulatory Administration are currently studying whether to extend the moratorium on sugarcane imports until December 2026

This is to give priority to local production due to the abundance of sugarcane supply in the country.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., ang pag-ban mahimo pa palawigon depende sa aktwal nga stock levels.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the ban could be extended depending on actual stock levels.

text: Ginapangabay man sini ang Sugar Regulatory Administration SRA nga bantayan sing hugot ang produksyon sang mga refinery.
english: It also asks the Sugar Regulatory Administration SRA to strictly monitor the production of the refineries.

text: Magapatuman man ang DA kag SRA sang government buying program para buligan ang mga mangunguma, samtang magahanda sang regulasyon sa pag-angkat sang molasses.
english: The DA and SRA will also implement a government buying program to assist farmers, while preparing regulations on the importation of molasses.

text: Nagbalik na naman sa pagpang-atake ang Russia sa kritikal nga mga energy infrastructure sa Ukraine.
english: Russia has resumed its attacks on critical energy infrastructure in Ukraine.

text: Sandig sa Ukraine Air Force, nagpalupad ang Russia sang 71 missiles kag 450 ka mga drone kahapon.
english: According to the Ukrainian Air Force, Russia flew 71 missiles and 450 drones yesterday.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 38 ka mga missile kag 412 ka mga drone ang napunggan nga makasulod, samtang 27 naman ka missiles kag 31 ka drones ang nakaigo kag nakatupa gid sa 27 ka mga lugar.
english: Of this number, 38 missiles and 412 drones were prevented from entering, while 27 missiles and 31 drones hit and landed in 27 areas.

text: Ini ang pinakadaku nga pagpang-atake nga ginhimo sang Moscow sa Ukraine subong nga tuig.
english: It is the biggest strike Moscow has carried out in Ukraine this year.

text: Ini man ang pinakadamo nga munitions nga ila ginpaulan sa isa lang ka gab-i kun basehan ang record halin sang Disyembre 27.
english: This is also the highest number of munitions they have dropped in a single night based on records since December 27.

text: Sa post naman sang Russian Defense Ministry, ginkumpirma nila ang daku nga strike sa military-industrial complex kag energy facilities sang Ukraine.
english: In a post, the Russian Defense Ministry confirmed the massive strike on Ukraine's military-industrial complex and energy facilities.

text: Ini nga mga pasilidad suno sa Russia amo ang ginataguan sang mga long-range unmanned aerial vehicles.
english: These facilities according to Russia are where long-range unmanned aerial vehicles are stored.

text: Sa kumpirmasyon naman ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, naigo ang mga rehiyon sang Sumy, Kharkiv, Kyiv, Dnipro, Odesa kag Vinnytsia kag nahalitan gid ang mga energy infrastructure kag pati ang residential buildings.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy confirmed that the regions of Sumy, Kharkiv, Kyiv, Dnipro, Odesa and Vinnytsia were hit and energy infrastructure and residential buildings were severely damaged.

text: Siyam ang kumpirmado nga pilason sa amo nga insidente.#
english: Nine people were confirmed injured in the incident.

text: Ginaduso sang Iloilo City Government nga magapatigayon sang Market Day sa kada merkado sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The Iloilo City Government is proposing to hold a Market Day in every market in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, Spokesperson ni Mayor Raisa Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ini agud mahatagan sang oportunidad ang mga vendors kag mga bolantero halin sa Probinsya sang Iloilo nga makabagsak kag makabaligya sang ila mga produkto sa mga nagkalain-lain nga merkado sa Syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Fantilaga Gorzal, Spokesperson of Mayor Raisa Treñas, said this is to give vendors and volunteers from Iloilo Province the opportunity to sell their products in various markets in the city.

text: Ginaproponer sang alkalde kag Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) nga himuon ang adlaw sang Martes nga Market day para sa terminal Market.
english: The mayor and the Local Economic Enterprise Office (LEEO) are proposing to make Tuesday a market day for the terminal market.

text: Ang adlaw sang Miyerkules naman para sa La Paz Market.
english: Wednesday is for La Paz Market.

text: Samtang, ang adlaw sang Huwebes ang Market Day sa Jaro Big Market kun sa diin naandan na nga schedule para sa pagpaninda sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Meanwhile, Thursday is the Market Day at the Jaro Big Market where it is the usual schedule for residents to shop.

text: Pagahatagan naman sang kahigayunan ang mga bulantero nagikan sa Probinsya sang Iloilo nga makabagsak kag makabaligya indi lang sa Iloilo Terminal Public Market kundi sa tanan nga merkado sa syudad.
english: Volunteers from Iloilo Province will be given the opportunity to drop and sell not only in the Iloilo Terminal Public Market but in all markets in the city.

text: Nagapadayon naman ang koordinasyon sa mga vendors kag nagkalain-lain nga mga market associations agud ma-finalize na ang nasambit nga inisyatibo.
english: Coordination with vendors and various market associations is ongoing to finalize the initiative.

text: Ano ang imo batyagon kun nagalakat ikaw sa dalan tapos may tawo nga gulpi lang nagabugno sa imo kag nagadayaw sa imo itsura, sa imo buhok, ukon sa imo panapton?
english: How would you feel if you were walking down the street and someone suddenly stopped you and complimented your appearance, your hair, or your clothes?

text: Mahimo nga maham-ot ang iban, may ara man nga mahuya, may ara man nga mangakig ukon mainsulto — depende kun kilala nila ang tawo nga nagabugno kag kun paano sini ihambal ang iya dayaw.
english: Some may be embarrassed, others may be embarrassed, others may be angry or insulted — depending on whether they know the person who is beating and how he says his praise.

text: Apang may isa ka tawo sa Japan nga halos wala na nahadlok kun paano mag-react ang tawo nga iya dayawon, bangud sa pagkamatuod, ginhimo na niya ini nga propesyon.
english: But there is a man in Japan who is almost not afraid of how the person he praises will react, because in fact, he has made it a profession.

text: Gintawag na gani siya nga si Uncle Praise bangud bantog siya nga nagadayaw sa kada tawo nga nagalabay.
english: He was even called Uncle Praise because he famously praised every person who passed by.

text: Ini nga 43-anyos nga lalaki ang naga-ubra anay sa isa ka kumpaniya sa Tochigi sa Japan, apang na-adik siya sa pagsugal rason nga nadulaan sang trabaho kag sang ulihi, ginbayaan pa siya sang iya pamilya.
english: The 43-year-old man used to work for a company in Tochigi, Japan, but he became addicted to gambling and lost his job and was later abandoned by his family.

text: Nagbalatian pa ang iya amay gani nga wala na siya sang palangitan-an kag napilitan nga sa higad-dalan na lang mag-istar.
english: His father became ill and was forced to live on the streets.

text: Daw namarasmasan siya bangud sa iya naabtan, kag bangud kinahanglan niya maka-survive, ginpinsar sini nga mangin street performer ugaling kay wala man siya sang talent kaangay sang pagkanta kag pagsaot ukon bisan magic tricks.
english: He seemed to be overwhelmed by what he found, and because he had to survive, he thought of becoming a street performer but he didn't have any talents like singing and dancing or even magic tricks.

text: Sang ulihi, nadumduman niya nga dayawon ang iban nga mga tawo, apang may mga nagapangakig… gani nagdala na lang siya sang cardboard kag nga may nakasulat sang iya pagdayaw sa iban.
english: Eventually, he remembered to compliment other people, but some were angry… so he just brought a cardboard and that someone wrote his compliment to others.

text: Nakatuon man si Uncle Praise nga indi ini pagpasobrahan — halimbawa, kun una nga bes niya nakit-an ang tawo, itsura anay ang iya dayawon, kag kun nasadyahan man ang tawo, makig-istorya na siya kag hibaluon ang iban nga bagay nga sarang niya mahatagan sang compliment.
english: Uncle Praise also learned not to overdo it — for example, when he first saw a person, he would praise his appearance first, and if the person was happy, he would talk to him and find out other things he could compliment him on.

text: Tatlo ka tuig na niya ini nga ginahimo kag may pila man nga nanamian gid bangud wala gid sang naga-apresyar sa ila.
english: He has been doing this for three years and there are some who really enjoy it because no one really appreciates them.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, may mga regular clients pa si Uncle Praise nga nagatawag sa iya kun kinahanglan nila ang morale boost.
english: In fact, Uncle Praise still has regular clients who call him when they need a morale boost.

text: Nakalibot naman siya sa 31 sa 47 prefectures sang Japan para sa sini nga unique nga trabaho kag nakadayaw sang masobra 30 ka tawo kada adlaw kag may income nga 10,000 yen.
english: He has traveled to 31 of Japan's 47 prefectures for this unique job and has impressed more than 30 people a day with an income of 10,000 yen.

text: Imbitaron si Vice President Sara Duterte nga magtambong sa ikaapat nga State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte will be invited to attend the fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA) of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: sa Hulyo 28 subong nga tuig.
english: on July 28 this year.

text: Suno kay House Secretary General Reginald Velasco, ipadala nila ang invitation letter sa opisina sang bise-presidente apisar nga naglain na ang relasyon nanday Sara kag Marcos nga runningmates anay sang 2022 elections.
english: House Secretary General Reginald Velasco said they will send the invitation letter to the vice-president's office despite the deteriorating relationship between Sara and Marcos, who were runningmates in the 2022 elections.

text: Suno kay Velasco, ginapreparahan nila ang tanan nga posibilidad lakip na pananglitan magtambong si Duterte.
english: Velasco said they are preparing for all possibilities including if Duterte attends.

text: May yara sang protocol para sa seating arrangement suno sa opisyal gani lauman nga yara ang bise sa VIP section sa tunga sang hall.
english: There is a protocol for the seating arrangement, the official said, so the vice is expected to be in the VIP section in the middle of the hall.

text: “So she will be seated in the VIP section, doon sa may gitna.
english: “So she will be seated in the VIP section, there in the middle.

text: So if she attends, she will be seated there.
english: So if she attends, she will be seated there.

text: And then ‘yung mga officials na kasama niya, they’ll be given the usual seats given to their senior staff,” suno sa House Secretary General.
english: And then the officials who are with him, they’ll be given the usual seats given to their senior staff,” the House Secretary General said.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga tuig, wala nagtambong si Sara.
english: Last year, Sara did not attend.

text: Sang Pebrero, gin-impeach siya sang Kamara kun sa diin nalakip sa ginbasehan amo ang iya pamahog nga kun may magpatay sa iya, may ginsugo naman siya agud patyon ang presidente, ang first lady, kag ang House Speaker.
english: In February, the House impeached him on the grounds that he threatened to kill the president, the first lady, and the House Speaker.

text: Umpisahan sang Senado ang impeachment trial kay Sara kun matapos na ang SONA sang presidente.
english: The Senate will begin the impeachment trial against Sara after the president's SONA.

text: Mangatubang sang reklamo nga frustrated homicide ang isa ka 19-anyos nga lalaki nga nagbuno sa duha ka mga pamatan-on sa Barangay Guinticgan, Carles, Iloilo.
english: A 19-year-old man who stabbed two youths in Barangay Guinticgan, Carles, Iloilo will face charges of frustrated homicide.

text: Ang suspek amo si alias Edward, construction worker kag residente man sang amo nga barangay.
english: The suspect was identified as Edward, a construction worker and resident of the same barangay.

text: Ang mga biktima naman amo sanday alias Jessy, 18, residente man sang Barangay Guinticgan kag si alias Rex, 15, residente sang Barangay Tarong sa amo nga banwa.
english: The victims were identified as Jessy, 18, resident of Barangay Guinticgan and alias Rex, 15, resident of Barangay Tarong in the same town.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Sonny Boy Garnace, hepe sang Carles Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagsugod ang gamo sa baylehan sa People’s Village sa amo nga lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Sonny Boy Garnace, chief of the Carles Municipal Police Station, said the riot started at a dance floor in the People's Village in the area.

text: Ginaalegar nga may indi-paghangpanay nga natabo bangud sa grupo-grupo, kag sang nagguwa ang mga biktima agud magpauli, ginbanggaan ini sang suspek.
english: It is alleged that there was a misunderstanding over the groups, and when the victims went out to go home, the suspect hit them.

text: Isa sa mga biktima ang napilasan sa wala nga bahin sang dughan, samtang ang isa naman ang gin-operahan sa ospital sa Pototan bangud sa samad malapit sa iya kinatawo.
english: One of the victims sustained injuries to the left side of his chest, while the other was operated on at a hospital in Pototan for a wound near his genitals.

text: Ginapahayag nga yara sa impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon si alias Edward sang nahimo sini ang krimen sang ala una sang kaagahon sang Oktubre 20.
english: Alias ​​Edward was reportedly under the influence of alcohol when he committed the crime at 1:00 am on October 20.

text: Nagapabilin ini subong sa kustodiya sang mga pulis sa Carles Municipal Police Station.
english: He remains in police custody at the Carles Municipal Police Station.

text: Nagsaka sa $808 million ukon ukon P38.5 billion ang foreign direct investment sang Marso.
english: Foreign direct investment rose to $808 million or P38.5 billion in March.

text: Suno sa Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP), ini ang mas mataas sang 139.5 percent kun ipaanggid sa $337 million ukon P16.1 million nga narekord sa kaangay man nga bulan sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP), this is 139.5 percent higher compared to $337 million or P16.1 million recorded in the same month last year.

text: Isa sa mga ginalantaw nga rason sang BSP sa pagsaka sang foreign direct investment amo ang pagbalik liwat sang ekonomiya.
english: One of the reasons the BSP sees for the rise in foreign direct investment is the revival of the economy.

text: Ang total nga cumulative foreign direct investment net flow sa first quarter subong nga tuig ang nagdangat sa $2.4 billion P114.6 billion.
english: The total cumulative foreign direct investment net flow in the first quarter of this year amounted to $2.4 billion P114.6 billion.

text: Ini ang mas mataas sang 45.1 percent kun ipaanggid sa $1.6 billion P76.4 bilion sa kaangay man nga period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: This is 45.1 percent higher compared to $1.6 billion P76.4 billion in the same period last year.

text: “March 2021 FDI increased on account of improved investor sentiment amid the gradual resumption of domestic activities, while adhering to the minimum health standards, and government efforts to accelerate the vaccination program,” pahayag sang BSP.
english: “March 2021 FDI increased on account of improved investor sentiment amid the gradual resumption of domestic activities, while adhering to the minimum health standards, and government efforts to accelerate the vaccination program,” the BSP said.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni BSP Governor Benjamin Diokno nga pat-od nga makarekober na ang foreign direct investments subong nga tuig.
english: Earlier, BSP Governor Benjamin Diokno said foreign direct investments are sure to recover this year.

text: Antes pa man ang pagtakop sang Tokyo 2020 Olympics subong nga adlaw, ginsipa kag ginpapauli na sang organisasyon ang German modern pentathlon coach matapos ginsumbag ang kabayo sa women’s event.
english: Even before the closing ceremony of the Tokyo 2020 Olympics today, the organization has already kicked and sent home the German modern pentathlon coach after he kicked a horse in the women’s event.

text: Suno sa International Modern Pentathlon Union, ang ginhimo ni coach Kim Raisner ang paglapas sa pagsulundan sang hampang.
english: According to the International Modern Pentathlon Union, coach Kim Raisner’s actions violated the rules of the game.

text: Nag-ugat ang insidente bangud nagapanguna na kuntani sa kompetisyon ang tiglawas sang Germany nga si Annika Schleu apang nabudlayan siya nga ma-kontrol ang kabayo bangud indi ini maglumpat sa “showjumping segment” rason nga nalutos ini batuk sa Briton nga si Kate French.
english: The incident stemmed from the fact that German representative Annika Schleu was about to lead the competition but she had difficulty controlling the horse because it did not jump in the showjumping segment and lost to British Kate French.

text: Si Raisner ang ika-duha nga German official nga ginpapauli matapos ang sporting director sang cycling team sang Germany ang nagpahayag sang racist comment tuhoy sa mga riders nagikan sa Africa kadungan sang men’s time trial.
english: Raisner is the second German official to be sent home after the sporting director of Germany's cycling team made a racist comment about riders from Africa during the men's time trial.

text: ILOILO  CITY – Tinguhaan sang Ilongga Beauty Queen nga si Ruffa Nava nga itiglawas ang Pilipinas sa Ambassador and Ambassadress of the World-Philippines 2019.
english: ILOILO CITY – Ilongga Beauty Queen Ruffa Nava will try to represent the Philippines at the Ambassador and Ambassadress of the World-Philippines 2019.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ruffa Nava, 26, sang Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga 20 ka mga lalaki kag 20 ka babayi ang magapakigbahin sa nasambit nga pageant.
english: Ruffa Nava, 26, of Iloilo City, said 20 men and 20 women will participate in the pageant.

text: Ginpahayag ni Nava nga ang coronation night ang patigayunon sa Hunyo 22 sa Metro Manila.
english: Nava said the coronation night will be held on June 22 in Metro Manila.

text: Tatlo ka babayi kag tatlo man ka lalaki suno kay Nava ang magadaug sang titulo nga mahimo nga magtiglawas sa Pilipinas sa International pageants.
english: Three women and three men, Nava said, will win the title that could represent the Philippines in international pageants.

text: Ang Ambassador and Ambassadress of the World-Philippines 2019 suno kay Nava ang kombinasyon sang pageant kag modelling.
english: The Ambassador and Ambassadress of the World-Philippines 2019, Nava said, is a combination of pageant and modeling.

text: Kadungan sini, ginbalikan man sang natungdan ang iya gin-agyan sa iya modelling career bag-o nakasulod sa pageantry.
english: Meanwhile, she also looked back on her modeling career before entering the pageantry.

text: Sa pihak sang kabudlay nga iya naagyan, ginpahayag sang 26 anyos nga Beauty Queen nga tinguhaan niya nga makahatag sang dungog sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Despite the hardships she went through, the 26-year-old Beauty Queen said she will try to bring honor to Iloilo City.

text: Sa subong suno sa natungdan, masako na siya pagpanghanda kag ginatutukan ang Question and Answer Portion.
english: Currently, he said, he is busy preparing and focusing on the Question and Answer Portion.

text: Nahibalu-an nga si Nava ang masami na nagapakigbahin sa mga beauty pagent kasubong na lang sang Miss Iloilo Dinagyang, Binibining Pilipinas kag Supermodel International.
english: Nava has often participated in beauty pageants such as Miss Iloilo Dinagyang, Miss Pilipinas and Supermodel International.

text: Gin-ako sang kampo sang naka-detained nga si Pastor Apollo C. Quiboloy nga posible ipatuman ang extradition bisan pa nga may gina-atubang ini nga pending nga mga kaso.
english: The camp of detained Pastor Apollo C. Quiboloy acknowledged that extradition is possible even though he is facing pending cases.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay legal counsel ni Pastor Quiboloy nga si Atty. Israelito Torreon, nag-ako nga indi ini imposible nga matabo.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo, Pastor Quiboloy's legal counsel, Atty. Israelito Torreon, admitted that it is not impossible to happen.

text: Suno sa iya, may gahum ang estado sang pungsod nga ihatag ang extradition request sang America para sa pastor.
english: He said the country’s state has the power to grant America’s extradition request for the pastor.

text: Nagapangatubang ang kontrobersyal nga televangelistini sang pila ka mga kaso kaangay sang child sex trafficking, fraud, kag iban pa nga karon ginapangita man sa pungsod.
english: The controversial televangelistini is facing several charges such as child sex trafficking, fraud, and others that are now also wanted in the country.

text: Samtang ginhatagan pagtamod ni Atty. Torreon nga apisar posible nga mapadala sa Estados Unidos ang mga akusado, option sa gihapon suno sa iya nga tapuson anay sang pungsod ang mga pending nga kaso sini antes istoryahan ang extradition issue.
english: Meanwhile, Atty. Torreon said that although it is possible to send the accused to the United States, it is still an option for the country to complete its pending cases before discussing the extradition issue.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag sini nga wala pa sila sang may nabaton nga dokumento ukon pormal nga kopya sang ‘Extradition Request’ sang Estados Unidos.
english: Meanwhile, he said they have not yet received any document or formal copy of the US Extradition Request.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga ginahulat pa nila ini kadungan sang panawagan sa gobyerno nga respetuhon anay ang progreso sang kaso sa pungsod antes magdesisyon sa hingyo gikan sa dumuluong nga pungsod.
english: He said they are still waiting for this while calling on the government to respect the progress of the case in the country before deciding on the request from a foreign country.

text: Samtang, naghingyo naman ang kampo ni Pastor Quiboloy sa Estados Unidos nga respetuhon ang soberanya sang pungsod may kaangtanan sa ila extradition request.
english: Meanwhile, Pastor Quiboloy's camp urged the United States to respect the country's sovereignty in connection with their extradition request.

text: Nagpanindugan man ang iya abogado nga si Atty. Israelito Torreon, nga yara na sa korte sang Pilipinas ang mga kaso sang iya kliyente, gani suno sa iya dapat pabay-an lang sila.
english: His lawyer, Atty. Israelito Torreon, that his client's cases are already in Philippine courts, so he said they should be left alone.

text: Sa karon priso na ang akusado nga si Pastor Apollo Quiboloy bangud sa mga reklamo sang pagpang-abuso kag human trafficking sa pungsod.
english: The accused, Pastor Apollo Quiboloy, is currently in jail on charges of abuse and human trafficking in the country.

text: Ginkumpirma ni anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Rogelio Singson nga gintanyagan siya sang Malacañang sang trabaho nga magbalik bilang tiglikom sag ahensya.
english: Former DPWH secretary Rogelio Singson confirmed that Malacañang offered him a job to return as secretary of the agency.

text: Suno kay Singson, nakabaton siya sang offer, apang ginbalibaran niya ini para man sa iya nga pamilya, mga personal nga rason amo man para sa seguridad.
english: Singson said he received an offer, but he turned it down for his family, personal reasons and security.

text: Pahayag sini, madugay na sila nga naga-istoryahanay sang chief executive kaangot sa Integrated Water Resources Management Program sang administrasyon.
english: He said they have been in talks with the chief executive for a long time regarding the administration's Integrated Water Resources Management Program.

text: Sa pihak sini, nangindi ang former DPWH nga magbalik bilang head sang government agency bangud indi ini gusto sang iya asawa.
english: Meanwhile, the former DPWH refused to return as head of the government agency because his wife did not want him.

text: “Definitely, may feelers.
english: “Definitely, there are feelers.

text: The President and I go a long way when he was still a governor and then he became a senator,” suno kay Singson.
english: The President and I went a long way when he was still a governor and then he became a senator,” Singson said.

text: “We’ve known each other in quite a lot of projects so hindi naman stranger.
english: “We’ve known each other in quite a lot of projects so no stranger.

text: I’m not stranger to the President… I think that’s far-fetched because my wife will leave me already if I go back to government.
english: I’m not stranger to the President… I think that’s far-fetched because my wife will leave me already if I go back to government.

text: Nagserbe si Singson nga DPWH Secretary sang Hulyo 2010-Hunyo 2016 sa idalom sang administrasyon ni anay President Benigno Simeon “Noynoy” Aquino III.
english: Singson served as DPWH Secretary from July 2010-June 2016 under the administration of former President Benigno Simeon “Noynoy” Aquino III.

text: Nauna naman nga ginpahayag ni incumbent DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan nga ginatugyan niya ang desisyon kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, incumbent DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan said he leaves the decision to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr.

text: kun kinahanglan niya nga mag-leave sa tunga sang mga imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar kurapsyon sa mga flood control projects.
english: if he needs to take leave amid investigations into alleged corruption in flood control projects.

text: Sa iya nga State of the Nation Address (SONA), matandaan nga nagpaandam si Marcos nga pangkasuhan ang mga madakpan nga involved sa ma-anomaliya nga flood-control projects nga amo subong ang ginakasakuan niya kag personal nga gina-inspeksyon.
english: In his State of the Nation Address (SONA), Marcos warned that those caught involved in anomalous flood-control projects will be prosecuted.

text: Tuman ang nabatyagan nga kalipay sang pamilya Bataican sa Iloilo City sa kadalag-an ni Melchor III Bataican matapos nakakuha sang gold medal sa Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: The Bataican family in Iloilo City was overjoyed by the victory of Melchor III Bataican after winning the gold medal in the Palarong Pambansa 2025.

text: Si Melchor III ukon mas kilala sa hayo nga “Thirdy” ang gold medalist sa doble baston individual sa elementary level.
english: Melchor III or better known as “Thirdy” is the gold medalist in the double pole individual at the elementary level.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Melchor Bataican Jr., amay ni Thirdy, iya ginpahayag nga Grade 4 pa lang ang iya anak sang nadiscover sang iya coach nga may abilidad ini sa arnis.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Melchor Bataican Jr., Thirdy's father, said his son was only in Grade 4 when his coach discovered that he had the ability to play arnis.

text: Suno sa amay nga Bataican, nagalaum sila nga mapadayon sang iya anak ang hilig sa sini nga sport tubtob sa pag-abot sini sa sekondarya.
english: Father Bataican said they hope his son will continue his passion for the sport well into secondary school.

text: Si Thirdy ang yara na subong sa Grade 6 sa Graciano Lopez Jaena Elementary School sa La Paz.
english: Thirdy is now in Grade 6 at Graciano Lopez Jaena Elementary School in La Paz.

text: Gintuad naman sang amay sang gold medalist nga ginalantaw man nila nga mangin isa man ka arnis player ang utod ni Thirdy nga si Naruto nga subong nagaedad palang sang duha ka tuig.
english: The gold medalist's father admitted that they are also looking forward to Thirdy's brother Naruto, who is now only two years old, becoming an arnis player.

text: Suno naman kay Ofelia Bataican,lola ni Thirdy, nakit-an niya kun paano magdedikar ang iya apo sa training bangud wala ini nagatambong sa mga birthday parties kag wala man nagalagaw para maka-focus sa iya training.
english: Ofelia Bataican, Thirdy's grandmother, said she saw how her grandson dedicated himself to training because he did not attend birthday parties and did not go out to focus on his training.

text: Ang pamilya Bataican ang pumuluyo sang Jereos, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: The Bataican family is a resident of Jereos, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Missing ang isa sa pinakabantog nga tech entrepreneur sa Britanya nga si Mike Lynch matapos naabtan sang bagyo kag naglugdang ang ginasakyan nga yate sa Sicily.
