english: One of Britain's most famous tech entrepreneurs, Mike Lynch, is missing after his yacht was hit by a typhoon and sank in Sicily.

text: 22 ka mga tawo ang sakay sa British-flagged “Bayesian” nga sailboat kag naka-angkla malapit sa port sang Porticello sang naglain ang tyempo suno sa Italian coast guard.
english: 22 people were on board the British-flagged “Bayesian” sailboat and anchored near the port of Porticello when the weather turned bad, the Italian coast guard said.

text: Madasig nga nadula ang yate apang antes ini dalayon nga naglugdang sang kaagahon, nakaluwas pa ang 15 ka mga tawo lakip na ang asawa ni Lynch nga amo ang tag-iya sang yate kag isa ka isa-ka-tuig nga bata.
english: The yacht quickly disappeared but before it sank in the early hours of the morning, 15 people were rescued including Lynch's wife who was the owner of the yacht and a one-year-old child.

text: Kumpirmado nga isa ang napatay nga amo ang onboard chef samtang anum ang missing nga nagalakip pa gid sa 18-anyos nga anak nga babaye ni Lynch kag ang British, American kag Canadian nationalities nga wala pa ginhingadlan.
english: One of the onboard chefs was confirmed dead while six are missing, including Lynch's 18-year-old daughter and British, American and Canadian nationals who have not been named.

text: Sa 15 nga nakaluwas, tatlo ang ang nakaangkon sang seryoso nga mga samad sa lawas.
english: Of the 15 survivors, three sustained serious injuries.

text: Ang 59-anyos nga si Lynch ang popular sa Britanya bangud sa pagtukod sini sang largest software firm sa pungsod nga amo ang Autonomy halin sa iya ground-breaking research sa Cambridge University.
english: The 59-year-old Lynch is popular in Britain for having founded the country’s largest software firm Autonomy from his ground-breaking research at Cambridge University.

text: Ginabansagan siya nga Bill Gates sang Britanya nga ginatangla sang academicians, scientists kag politicians.
english: He is known as the Bill Gates of Britain and is looked up to by academicians, scientists and politicians.

text: Nagbalik si US Secretary of State Antony Blinken sa Israel agud nga maplastar pa gid ang ginaduso nga ceasefire kag hostage-release deal sa Gaza.
english: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken returned to Israel to further lay out the proposed ceasefire and hostage-release deal in Gaza.

text: Ini na ang iya ika-siyam nga byahe sa Middle East halin sang nagsugod ang giyera sa Gaza sang Oktubre 2023 kun sa diin lapaw na sa 40,000 ka Palestinians ang nagkalamatay.
english: This will be his ninth trip to the Middle East since the war in Gaza began in October 2023 in which more than 40,000 Palestinians have been killed.

text: Ini nga pagbisita ang kasunod man sa ginpresentar sang Estados Unidos nga modified proposal para nga mataytayan na ang indi paghangpanay sang militar sang Israel kag militante nga grupo nga Hamas.
english: The visit also follows a modified proposal presented by the United States to end the conflict between the Israeli military and the militant group Hamas.

text: Natabo ini sa Qatar kun sa diin yara man ang Egyptian, US, kag Qatari mediators.
english: This took place in Qatar where Egyptian, US, and Qatari mediators were also present.

text: Kun sila ang pahambalon, may improvement na sa ginaduso nga ceasefire, apang suno kay Hamas political bureau member Sami Abu Zuhri, ilusyon lamang ang pahayag nga may progress na sa negosasyon.
english: If they are asked to speak, there is an improvement in the proposed ceasefire, but according to Hamas political bureau member Sami Abu Zuhri, the statement that there is progress in the negotiations is an illusion.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga indi deal ukon matuod nga negosasyon ang ginaplastar kundi mga pagpangdikta sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: He said that it is not a deal or genuine negotiations that are being put forward but dictates of the United States of America.

text: May statement man ang Hamas nga naga-akusar kay Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga naga-set ini sang bag-o nga mga kondisyon kag nagapamalibad sa pag-withdraw sang pwersa-militar sa Gaza.
english: Hamas also issued a statement accusing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of setting new conditions and refusing to withdraw military forces from Gaza.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa amo nga proposal, may panawagan sa Hamas nga buy-an na ang ila mga ginbihag sang nag-atake sila sang Oktubre 7, 2023 sa southern Israel; samtang kabaylo sina, ang Israel ang maga-isol naman sang ila pwersa sa Gaza kag ila man hilwayon ang Palestinian prisoners.
english: It is known that in the proposal, there is a call to Hamas to release those they took hostage when they attacked on October 7, 2023 in southern Israel; in return, Israel will withdraw its forces from Gaza and release Palestinian prisoners.

text: Nanindugan si anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga wala siya sang ginhinulsulan sa tanan nga ginhimo niya bilang presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte insists that he has no regrets about everything he did as president of the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Veronica ”Kitty” Duterte, ini ang isa sa ila naistoryahan sang iya amay sang ulhi nga pagbisita niya sa International Criminal Court (ICC) Detention Center.
english: According to Veronica ”Kitty” Duterte, this is one of the things her father talked about during his last visit to the International Criminal Court (ICC) Detention Center.

text: Suno sa presidente, bisan ginpasakaan siya sang kaso sa ICC, indi gid siya magpangayo sang pasaylo sa ginhimo niya.
english: The president said that even if he is charged with the ICC, he will never apologize for what he did.

text: Samtang, yara na sa maayo nga kondisyon ang anay presidente.
english: Meanwhile, the former president is in good condition.

text: Suno kay Kitty, malipayon ang iya amay basta makita niya nga maayo ang kahimtangan sang iya bilog nga pamilya.
english: According to Kitty, her father is happy as long as he sees that his whole family is doing well.

text: Indi mahangpan sang TV host/reporter nga si Gretchen Ho kun ngaa nalakip ang iya pangalan sa mga media personalities nga ginapahayag may plano nga gub-on ang gobyerno ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: TV host/reporter Gretchen Ho cannot understand why her name is included among the media personalities who allegedly have plans to overthrow the government of President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Samtang nalakip man si Gretchen sa madamo nga mga artista nga gin-imbitahan sa private dinner sa Malacanang Palace.
english: Meanwhile, Gretchen was among the many artists invited to the private dinner at Malacanang Palace.

text: Pila sa mga artista nga nagtambong sa appreciation dinner amo sanday Richard Gomez, Robin Padilla, Ai-Ai delas Alas, Ruffa Gutierrez, Aiko Melendez, Toni Gonzaga, Mariel Rodriguez, Joseph Marco, kag John Lloyd Cruz.
english: Some of the artists who attended the appreciation dinner were Richard Gomez, Robin Padilla, Ai-Ai delas Alas, Ruffa Gutierrez, Aiko Melendez, Toni Gonzaga, Mariel Rodriguez, Joseph Marco, and John Lloyd Cruz.

text: Apang antes pa man imbitahan si Gretchen sa panyapon kaupod ang Presidente, una na nga naghiwat sang press briefing si Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Salvador Panelo nga naga-eksplikar sang destabilization matrix kag makit-an nga nalakip sa matrix ang pangalan ni Gretchen sa diin madamo nga mga netizens ang nakibot.
english: But before Gretchen was invited to dinner with the President, Presidential Spokesperson Atty. Salvador Panelo explaining the destabilization matrix and found that Gretchen's name was included in the matrix which surprised many netizens.

text: Magluwas kay Gretchen, nalakip man sa matrix ang Olympic weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz.
english: In addition to Gretchen, the matrix also included Olympic weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz.

text: Gin athag man ni Diaz nga sini niya kilala si  alyas “Bikoy” kag si Rodel Jayme, nga ginapahayag nag-share sang mga videos nga naga angot sa pamilya Duterte sa isyu sang iligal nga droga.
english: Diaz also explained that he knows alias “Bikoy” and Rodel Jayme, who allegedly shared videos related to the Duterte family on the issue of illegal drugs.

text: Nagdangat sa P510,000 ang balor sang iligal nga droga nga nakumpiskar sa isa ka subject sa drug buy bust operation sa Brgy.
english: P510,000 worth of illegal drugs were seized from a subject in a drug buy bust operation in Brgy.

text: San Antonio, Oton, Iloilo.
english: San Antonio, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Ang arestado tumandok man sang amo nga lugar kag ginakabig sang awtoridad nga high value individual (HVI).
english: The arrested is also a native of the same area and is considered by the authorities to be a high value individual (HVI).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Colonel Abner Jordan, officer-in-charge sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga 75 grams sang ginapasuni nga shabu ang nakuha sa subject sa operasyon nga ginpatigayon matapos ang apat tubtob anum ka bulan ang monitoring.
english: Police Lieutenant Colonel Abner Jordan, officer-in-charge of the Oton Municipal Police Station, said 75 grams of suspected shabu were recovered from the suspect in an operation conducted after four to six months of monitoring.

text: Suno kay Jordan, nagasaylo-saylo sang lugar ang subject sa kaiping nga kabarangayan ukon sa iya mga barkada sa banwa kun mamutikan sini nga gina-monitor siya sang mga operatiba.
english: According to Jordan, the subject moved from place to place in neighboring barangays or to his friends in the town when he noticed that he was being monitored by the operatives.

text: Wala pa ini sang gintuad sa kapulisan kun sa diin siya nagakuha sang suplay.
english: He has not yet confessed to the police where he gets the supplies.

text: Wala man ini sang previous record sa illegal drugs suno pa sa Oton MPS.
english: He also has no previous record for illegal drugs, according to the Oton MPS.

text: Natalana ini nga mag-atubang sa panumbungon nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon sa Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.#
english: He is scheduled to face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.#

text: Mangin flag bearer sang Pilipinas ang boxing silver medalist nga si Nesthy Petecio sa closing ceremonies sa Tokyo Olympics bwas, Agusto 8.
english: Boxing silver medalist Nesthy Petecio will be the flag bearer of the Philippines at the closing ceremonies of the Tokyo Olympics tomorrow, August 8.

text: Suno kay Chef de mission Mariano “Nonong” Araneta, mas madamo na nga atleta ang pahanugutan nga maka-upod sa parada.
english: According to Chef de mission Mariano “Nonong” Araneta, more athletes will be allowed to join the parade.

text: Sa opening ceremonies sang Hulyo 23, anum lang ka mga opisyal ang nakasunod sa parade upod sa flag bearers nga sanday Eumir Marcial kag Kiyomi Watanabe.
english: At the opening ceremonies on July 23, only six officers were able to follow the parade with flag bearers Eumir Marcial and Kiyomi Watanabe.

text: Subong nga closing ceremony, may dugang nga 10 passes para sa Pilipinas.
english: This closing ceremony, there will be an additional 10 passes for the Philippines.

text: Maupod man sa parade sanday Eumir Marcial, bronze medalist, kag Carlo Paalam, silver medalist.
english: Also joining the parade will be Eumir Marcial, bronze medalist, and Carlo Paalam, silver medalist.

text: Ang Tokyo 2020 ang ginakabig best Summer Games para sa Pilipinas bangud apat ka mga medalya ang nadaug sang mga Olympians, lakip na ang historic gold nga nakuha ni weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz sa women’s 55-kilogram division.
english: Tokyo 2020 is considered the best Summer Games for the Philippines as the Olympians won four medals, including the historic gold won by weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz in the women’s 55-kilogram division.

text: Nagtaas sang 8.7 percent ang unemployment sa bulan sang Abril kun ipaanggid sa una nga quarter subong nga tuig.
english: Unemployment rose by 8.7 percent in April compared to the first quarter of this year.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), nagdangat sa 4.14 million ang mga jobless nga Filipinos sang Abril.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), there were 4.14 million unemployed Filipinos in April.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang Enero, 8.7 percent man ang unemployment rate sa pungsod nga may katumbas nga 3.95 million jobless Filipinos.
english: In January, the unemployment rate in the country was 8.7 percent with 3.95 million jobless Filipinos.

text: Sa month-on-month basis, ang figure sa bulan sang Abril ang mas mataas kun ipaanggid sa unemployment sang Marso nga nagdangat sa 7.1 percent ukon may katumbas nga 3.44 million jobless Filipinos.
english: On a month-on-month basis, the figure in April is higher compared to unemployment in March which reached 7.1 percent or the equivalent of 3.44 million jobless Filipinos.

text: Ang Labor Force Participation naman sang Abril ang mas mataas sang 63.24 percent kun ipaanggid sa 60.5 percent sang Enero 2021.
english: Labor Force Participation in April was higher at 63.24 percent compared to 60.5 percent in January 2021.

text: Ang underemployment naman sang Abril ang nagdangat sa 17.2 percent sa diin mas mataas ini sa 16 percent nga narekord sang Enero subong nga tuig.
english: Underemployment in April reached 17.2 percent, higher than the 16 percent recorded in January this year.

text: Ini ang mas manubo naman kun ipaanggid sa 18.9 percent nga underemployment rate nga narekord sang Abril 2020.
english: This is lower than the 18.9 percent underemployment rate recorded in April 2020.

text: Narekord naman ang “worst” unemployment rate sang 2020 nga may 10.4 percent bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic,.
english: The worst unemployment rate in 2020 was recorded at 10.4 percent due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Una na ng ginpahayag ni Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua nga ang employment nga nadula bangud sa pandemya ang nabalik na.
english: Earlier, Socioeconomic Planning Secretary Karl Kendrick Chua said that the employment lost due to the pandemic has been restored.

text: Sulod na sa Finals ang men’s basketball team sang France matapos ginpyerde ang Slovenia sa score nga 90-89 sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics .
english: France's men's basketball team is now in the Finals after beating Slovenia 90-89 at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

text: Bangud sini, maatubang sang France ang USA sa Finals men’s basketball.
english: As a result, France will face the USA in the Finals men’s basketball.

text: Nagapanguna sa kadalag-an sang France amo si Nando De Colo nga naghatag sang 25 points samtang may yara naman nga 23 points si New York Knicks free agent Evan Fournier.
english: France was led by Nando De Colo with 25 points while New York Knicks free agent Evan Fournier had 23 points.

text: May tyansa pa kuntani nga mangibabaw ang Slovenia kun wala gin-block ni LA Clippers forward Nicolas Batum ang drive ni Dallas Mavericks superstar Luca Doncic sa katapusan nga duha ka segundo sang hampang.
english: Slovenia would have had a chance to take the lead if LA Clippers forward Nicolas Batum hadn't blocked Dallas Mavericks superstar Luca Doncic's drive in the last two seconds of the game.

text: Wala napuslan ang nahimo nga 16 points, 10 rebounds kag 18 assists ni Doncic.
english: Doncic's 16 points, 10 rebounds and 18 assists were in vain.

text: Matandaan nga ginpyerde sang France ang USA sa una nga round sang hampang sang nagligad nga semana.
english: France defeated the USA in the first round of the match last week.

text: Makatulublag ang natabo sa isa ka hotpot restaurant sa Makati City sang gintiro-patay sang isa ka Chinese national ang kaangay man sini nga Chinese samtang sila ang nagaatubangay kag naga-istorya.
english: A Chinese national shot dead a fellow Chinese man at a hotpot restaurant in Makati City while they were facing each other and talking.

text: Yara sila sa isa ka private room lakip na ang 29-anyos nga biktima.
english: They were in a private room with the 29-year-old victim.

text: Nakita gid sa closed circuit television nga nagtindog ang lalaki nga naka-itom kag daw sa wala lang nga gintiro ang iya kaupod sang apat ka beses nga nag-igu sa iya kamot, butkon, kag dughan.
english: Closed circuit television showed the man in black standing and shooting his companion four times, hitting his hand, arm, and chest.

text: Sang nagtindog na ang isa ka babaye kag naghibi, didto na kag may ginhambal ang suspek sa isa pa nila ka kaupod nga lalaki nga wala man lang naghulag-hulag sa iya pwesto.
english: When one of the women stood up and cried, the suspect said something to another man who did not move from his seat.

text: Nakit-an sang mga pulis sa lugar ang walo ka bullet casings, duha ka metal jackets, kag lima ka bala.
english: Police at the scene found eight bullet casings, two metal jackets, and five rounds of ammunition.

text: Suno sa Makati City law enforcement, ginalantaw nga problema sa negosyo ang ginabaisan sang duha antes natabo ang insidente.
english: According to Makati City law enforcement, the two were believed to have been arguing over business problems before the incident.

text: Ginalagas na subong ang suspek nga nalagyo matapos ang insidente.
english: The suspect, who fled the scene after the incident, is being pursued.

text: Nagapakig-angot man ang pulis sa Land Transportation Office agud ma-trace ang tag-iya sang salakyan nga ginsakyan sang suspek.
english: Police are also liaising with the Land Transportation Office to trace the owner of the vehicle in which the suspect was riding.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, matandaan nga pilason man ang isa ka Chinese national matapos nga gintiro sang kapareho man niya nga mga Chinese nga nagpakuno-kuno pa nga magabakal sang iya malahalon nga salakyan sa Cabuyao, Laguna.
english: Last day, a Chinese national was also injured after being shot by fellow Chinese who pretended to buy his expensive car in Cabuyao, Laguna.

text: Nagaduda ang Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) sa intensyon sang mga suspetsado.
english: The Presidential Anti-Organized Crime Commission (PAOCC) is suspicious of the intentions of the suspects.

text: Suno kay PAOCC Undersecretary Gilbert Cruz, kinahanglan nga padalman pa ang imbestigasyon bangud may mga insidente man sila nga na-encounter sang una nga ang mga ginapatay, ginatiro, ukon gina-kidnap amo ang ginadudahan nga nagadagdag sa mga suspek sa raid ukon sa dakpanay sa POGO hub.#
english: According to PAOCC Undersecretary Gilbert Cruz, the investigation needs to be deepened because they have encountered incidents in the past where those who are killed, shot, or kidnapped are suspected of adding to the suspects in the raid or arrest at the POGO hub.

text: Masami na subong nga aktibo ang aktor nga si Daniel Padilla sa social media indi kaangay sadto nga tago pa ang ila relasyon sang aktres nga si Kathryn Bernardo.
english: Actor Daniel Padilla is now often active on social media unlike when his relationship with actress Kathryn Bernardo was still secret.

text: Sa instagram post ni Kathryn, ginkakibot sang mga netizens ang komento ni Daniel sa diin iya gintawag ang aktres nga “My Woman”.
english: In Kathryn's Instagram post, netizens were shocked by Daniel's comment where he called the actress “My Woman”.

text: Ginpaboran naman ni Kathryn ang komento ni Daniel nga wala na sang iban pa sang may nagapanag-iya sang iya tagipusuon kundi ang aktor.
english: Kathryn, however, favored Daniel's comment that no one else owns her heart but the actor.

text: Wala naman ginpalampuwas sang iloy ni Kathryn kag nag komento nga “My daughter” kag ginsabat naman siya ni Daniel nga “My biyenan”.
english: Kathryn's mother did not hesitate and commented "My daughter" and Daniel replied "My biyenan"

text: Anum nga mga bulawan nga medalya ang natipon sang mga atleta sang Western Visayas sa imbukada nga adlaw sang mga hinampang sa Palarong Pambansa 2025.
english: Western Visayas athletes collected six gold medals on the opening day of the Palarong Pambansa 2025 games.

text: Ini ang nagabutang sa Rehiyon VI sa ikatatlo nga pwesto sa latest medal tally, sunod sa defending champion nga National Capital Region kag sa CALABARZON.
english: This puts Region VI in third place in the latest medal tally, behind defending champion National Capital Region and CALABARZON.

text:
Ang gold medalists sang Region VI (as of broadcast time) amo sanday:

Magluwas nga gold medalist, nakahimo ini sang bag-o nga record nga 45.52 meters nga amo ang nagguba sa nauna nga Palaro record nga 42.86 meters nga gin-set sang tiglawas man sang Western Visayas nga si Airex Villanueva sang nagpasakop ini sa kumpetisyon sa Marikina City sang 2023.
english:
The gold medalists of Region VI (as of broadcast time) are:

Besides being a gold medalist, he set a new record of 45.52 meters which broke the previous Palaro record of 42.86 meters set by Western Visayas representative Airex Villanueva when he participated in the competition in Marikina City in 2023.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga Palaro nga nakabulsa ini sang gold medal kun sa diin gold medalist ini anay sa 100 meter Hurdles Secondary Girls sa Palarong Pambansa 2023 sa Marikina, City; kag gold medalist man sa kapareho nga event sang nakaligad nga tuig nga ginhiwat sa Cebu City.
english: This is the third Palaro that she has pocketed a gold medal where she was a gold medalist in the 100 meter Hurdles Secondary Girls at the Palarong Pambansa 2023 in Marikina, City; and gold medalist in the same event last year held in Cebu City.

text: Nagatiniil lang si Eda samtang naga-compete.
english: Eda was just barefoot while competing.

text: Ini nga 12-anyos nga student-athlete ang naga-eskwela sa Carles Central Elementary School.
english: This 12-year-old student-athlete attends Carles Central Elementary School.

text: Ini man ang iya una nga pagpasakop sa Palarong Pambansa.
english: This is also his first participation in the Palarong Pambansa.

text: Bugal sang Barosbos Elementary School si Cabalfin nga nakadaog man anay sang gold, silver, kag bronze medals sang nagpasakop ini sa Palarong Pambansa sa Cebu sang 2024.
english: Barosbos Elementary School is proud of Cabalfin, who also won gold, silver, and bronze medals when he participated in the Palarong Pambansa in Cebu in 2024.

text: Ang duha gina-coach nanday Leone Tiosayco kag Benedicto Prasas.
english: Both are coached by Leone Tiosayco and Benedicto Prasas.

text: Nagbukas ang Palarong Pambansa 2025 sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte sang Sabado kag opisyal nga magatakop sa Hunyo 2.#
english: The Palarong Pambansa 2025 opened in Laoag, Ilocos Norte on Saturday and will officially close on June 2.#

text: Ginabanta isa ka libo ka mga Pilipino nga nakabase sa Lebanon ang nagpabutyag sang ila kahanda nga magbalik sa Pilipinas sa tunga sang nagataas nga tensyon sa pungsod sa Middle East, suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).
english: Approximately one thousand Filipinos based in Lebanon have expressed their willingness to return to the Philippines amid rising tensions in the country in the Middle East, according to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA).

text: Ginpahayag ni Department of Foreign Affairs Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega nga sa 1,000 ka mga Pilipino, may kabug-usan nga 356 ka mga indibidwal ang napauli.
english: Department of Foreign Affairs Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega said that out of 1,000 Filipinos, a total of 356 individuals have returned home.

text: May yara sang mga 11,000 ka mga Pilipino sa bug-os nga Lebanon, ang iban sa ila wala sang dokumento.
english: There are about 11,000 Filipinos in all of Lebanon, some of them undocumented.

text: Suno kay de Vega, ang mga Pilipino didto indi gid interesado nga maghalin sa Lebanon, amo kon ngaa ang embahada naga-apelar sa ila.
english: According to de Vega, Filipinos there are not really interested in leaving Lebanon, which is why the embassy is appealing to them.

text: Dugang man sang natungdan nga maximum lamang nga 1,000 ka mga Pilipino ang makapauli ukon may indikasyon nga luyag nila magpauli.
english: He added that only a maximum of 1,000 Filipinos can return home or have an indication that they want to return home.

text: 300 sa ila ang nakabalik na, samtang may 700 pa nga nagahulat nga magpauli.
english: 300 of them have already returned, while another 700 are waiting to go home.

text: Ginalantaw man sang ahensya kon ano ang mahimo agud nga makumbinsi ang iban nga Pilipino.
english: The agency is also looking at what can be done to convince other Filipinos.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Embahada sang Pilipinas sa Lebanon sang Biyernes sang gab-i (PH time) nagpagwa sang advisory sa mga Filipino citizens para sa ila nga magbiya gilayon sa Lebanon samtang bukas pa ang airport sa tunga sang tensyon sa tunga sang Lebanon-based Hezbollah kag Israel.
english: The Philippine Embassy in Lebanon on Friday night (PH time) issued an advisory to Filipino citizens to leave Lebanon immediately while the airport is still open amid tensions between Lebanon-based Hezbollah and Israel.

text:
Ginpanugyan sang Embahada sa tanan nga Filipino nationals sa Lebanon nga unahon ang ila kaluwasan kag maghalin sa pungsod “sa labing madali nga panahon.”

Samtang, ang mga indi makahalin sa Lebanon ginhingyo nga mag-evacuate sa mas luwas nga mga lugar sa guwa sang Beirut, South Lebanon, kag Bekaa Valley.
english:
The Embassy advised all Filipino nationals in Lebanon to prioritize their safety and leave the country “as soon as possible.”

Meanwhile, those unable to leave Lebanon have been urged to evacuate to safer areas outside Beirut, South Lebanon, and the Bekaa Valley.

text: Suno kay de Vega, wala na sang mga Pilipino nga nahamtang sa dulunan sang Lebanon sa Israel.
english: According to de Vega, there are no more Filipinos located on the Lebanese border with Israel.

text: Apang, wala pa sa isa ka gatos ka mga Pilipino ang yara sa mga banwa nga nahamtang sa nabagatnan nga bahin sang Lebanon.
english: However, there are less than a hundred Filipinos in the towns located in the southern part of Lebanon.

text:
Mahimo man sila makig-angot sa masunod nga mga numero para sa dugang nga bulig:

Para sa tanan nga OFWs (may dokumento man o wala): +961 79110729

Para sa mga Filipino sa luwas sang pungsod (Mga Dependente nga may Permanente nga Resident Status, i.e., asawa iqama): +961 70858086

Ginpahayag man sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) nga nakahanda sila nga magbulig sa mga Pilipino sa pagbiya sa Lebanon sa tunga sang tensyon sa lugar.
english:
They can also contact the following numbers for further assistance:

For all OFWs (documented or undocumented): +961 79110729

For Overseas Filipinos (Dependents with Permanent Resident Status, i.e., wife iqama): +961 70858086

The Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) also said it is ready to help Filipinos leave Lebanon amid tensions in the area.

text: Padayon pa ang ginahimo nga imbestigasyon sang kapulisan kaangot sa paglapta sang minilyon nga balor sang ligal nga droga sa Western Visayas sa diin ginapahayag nga naghalin ini sa China.
english: Police are still investigating the spread of millions of pesos worth of legal drugs in Western Visayas where they allegedly came from China.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, pinuno sang City Drug Enforcement Unit sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga kagab-i lang P7.9 million nga balor sang shabu ang nakuha sa drug buy bust operation sa Barangay Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head of the City Drug Enforcement Unit of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that last night alone, P7.9 million worth of shabu was seized in a drug buy bust operation in Barangay Tacas, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject amo si Michael Pangcrudo, 30, residente sang Bitoon, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The subject was identified as Michael Pangcrudo, 30, resident of Bitoon, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Nakaagi na ini preso sang tuig 2015 kag nakagwa lang sang 2020.
english: He was imprisoned in 2015 and was released in 2020.

text: Nakuhaan ini sang  kabug-usan nga 1,000 grams sang shabu balor P6.3 million.
english: A total of 1,000 grams of shabu worth P6.3 million were recovered from the suspect.

text: Magluwas diri, gin-turn-over man sini ang 220 grams sang shabu halin sa iya balay balor 1.6 million.
english: He also turned over 220 grams of shabu from his house worth 1.6 million.

text: Ibaligya pa ini kuntani sa mga street level individuals kun wala natigayon ang operasyon.
english: It would have been sold to street level individuals if the operation had not been carried out.

text: Sa subong, preso na ini kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: He is currently in custody and facing charges of violating Republic Act No.

text: 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Nanawagan ang kampo ng religious leader na si Apollo Quiboloy nitong Huwebes sa administrasyong Marcos na hayaan munang magpasya ang mga korte sa Pilipinas kaugnay ng kanyang mga kaso bago gumawa ng desisyon hinggil sa kahilingan ng Estados Unidos para sa kanyang extradition.
english: The camp of religious leader Apollo Quiboloy on Thursday called on the Marcos administration to let the Philippine courts decide on his cases before making a decision on the US request for his extradition.

text: Ayon sa abogado ni Quiboloy na si Atty. Israelito Torreon, a kinikilala nila na nakasaad sa kasunduan sa extradition ng dalawang bansa na nasa kapangyarihan ng Pilipinas kung papayagan ang paglilipat kay Quiboloy, kahit pa nakabinbin o napagdesisyunan na ang kaso laban sa kanya.
english: According to Quiboloy's lawyer, Atty. Israelito Torreon, who they recognize as stipulated in the extradition agreement between the two countries under Philippine jurisdiction if Quiboloy's transfer is allowed, even if the case against him is pending or decided.

text: Base sa impormasyon, naipasa na noong Hunyo sa Department of Justice (DOJ) ang mga dokumentong sumusuporta sa extradition request ng US.
english: According to information, the documents supporting the US extradition request were submitted to the Department of Justice (DOJ) in June.

text: Kinumpirma rin ni Philippine Ambassador to Washington Jose Manuel Romualdez na may opisyal na kahilingan na ang Amerika at nakatakdang magpulong sina US Ambassador MaryKay Carlson at Justice Secretary Crispin Remulla sa susunod na linggo hinggil dito.
english: Philippine Ambassador to Washington Jose Manuel Romualdez also confirmed that the United States has an official request and is scheduled to meet with US Ambassador MaryKay Carlson and Justice Secretary Crispin Remulla next week on the matter.

text: Dagdag ni Torreon, hindi pa natatanggap ng kanilang kampo ang kopya ng naturang dokumento.
english: Torreon added that their camp has not yet received a copy of the document.

text: Bagama’t kinikilala nila ang karapatan ng US na maghain ng kahilingan, sinabi niya na hindi pa kailangan ang provisional arrest dahil wala namang agarang pangangailangan.
english: Although they recognize the right of the US to make requests, he said that provisional arrest is not necessary because there is no immediate need.

text: Matatandaang tinanggihan ng Pasig Regional Trial Court noong Hulyo ang hiling na piyansa nina Quiboloy at mga kasamahan kaugnay ng kasong qualified trafficking for sexual abuse at labor exploitation.
english: It can be recalled that the Pasig Regional Trial Court in July rejected the bail request of Quiboloy and his colleagues in connection with the case of qualified trafficking for sexual abuse and labor exploitation.

text: Bukod dito, humaharap din si Quiboloy sa kasong paglabag sa Republic Act 7610 o Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation, and Discrimination Act sa Quezon City.
english: Quiboloy is also facing charges of violating Republic Act 7610 or Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation, and Discrimination Act in Quezon City.

text: Sa Estados Unidos, nakasampa laban sa kanya ang mga kaso ng conspiracy to engage in sex trafficking, sex trafficking of children, at bulk cash smuggling.
english: In the United States, charges of conspiracy to engage in sex trafficking, sex trafficking of children, and bulk cash smuggling have been filed against him.

text: Nasa FBI most wanted list siya mula pa noong 2021.
english: He has been on the FBI's most wanted list since 2021.

text: Mariing itinanggi ng kampo ni Quiboloy ang lahat ng akusasyon.
english: Quiboloy's camp has denied all the accusations.

text: Kasalukuyang nakakulong si Quiboloy sa Pasig City Jail.
english: Quiboloy is currently detained at the Pasig City Jail.

text: Nag-igrab liwat ang paglaum sang mga Pinoy nga madugangan pa gid ang Olympic gold medal sang Pilipinas.
english: The hopes of Filipinos to add more Olympic gold medals to the Philippines have been reignited.

text: Ginabantayan subong ang gold medal match ukon final na nga hampang sa men’s flyweight sa boxing kun sa diin sulod ang pambato sang Pilipinas, ang 23 anyos nga si Carlo Paalam sang Cagayan de Oro City.
english: The gold medal match or final match in the men's flyweight boxing category is now being watched by the Philippine champion, 23-year-old Carlo Paalam of Cagayan de Oro City.

text: Sa men’s flyweight semi-finals, ginpierde ni Paalam ang iya Japanese nga kasumpong nga si Ryomei Tanaka paagi sa unanimous decision sang mga judge.
english: In the men’s flyweight semi-finals, Paalam defeated his Japanese opponent Ryomei Tanaka by a unanimous decision of the judges.

text: Atubangon ni Paalam sa finals si Galal Yafai sang Great Britain.
english: Paalam will face Galal Yafai of Great Britain in the finals.

text: Si Paalam ang ikaapat nga Filipino boxer nga nakalab-ot sa Olympic finals sunod kanday Anthony Villanueva, Mansueto “Onyok” Velasco kag silver medalist Nesthy Petecio.
english: Paalam is the fourth Filipino boxer to reach the Olympic finals after Anthony Villanueva, Mansueto “Onyok” Velasco and silver medalist Nesthy Petecio.

text: Target subong sang nasambit nga Filipino boxer nga malab-ot ang gold medal achievement sang weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz.
english: The Filipino boxer is now targeting to reach the gold medal achievement of weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz.

text: Sa subong, may mga viral clips sa post-bout moments ni Paalam kay Tanaka kun sa diin gindayaw sang publiko ang sportsmanship kag affection sang Pinoy boxer sa iya nga kasumpong.
english: Currently, there are viral clips of Paalam's post-bout moments with Tanaka where the public praised the sportsmanship and affection of the Filipino boxer to his opponent.

text: Sa video, nakit-an si Paalam nga ginhatagan sang forehead kiss ang iya nga kasumpong matapos gin-anunsyo nga siya ang nagdaug sa semi finals.#
english: In the video, Paalam was seen giving his opponent a forehead kiss after he was announced as the winner of the semi finals.

text: Nakabulsa sang gold medal kag naghimo pa sang bag-o nga rekord sa Palarong Pambansa ang tumandok sang Valderrama, Antique nga si Josh Gabriel Salcedo.
english: Josh Gabriel Salcedo, a native of Valderrama, Antique, won the gold medal and set a new record in the Palarong Pambansa.

text: Si Salcedo sang Antique Vocational School ang nagpangibabaw sa Discus Throw Secondary Boys Finals.
english: Salcedo of Antique Vocational School won the Discus Throw Secondary Boys Finals.

text: Nakahimo ini sang bag-o nga record nga 45.52 meters nga amo ang nagguba sa nauna nga Palaro record nga 42.86 meters nga gin-set sang tiglawas man sang Western Visayas nga si Airex Villanueva sang nagpasakop ini sa kumpetisyon sa Marikina City sang 2023.
english: He set a new record of 45.52 meters which broke the previous Palaro record of 42.86 meters set by Western Visayas representative Airex Villanueva when he participated in the competition in Marikina City in 2023.

text: Ini ang una nga tion nga nakahampang sa Palaro si Salcedo.
english: This is Salcedo's first time playing in the Palaro.

text: Santo sa ginpakigbahin sang Department of Education Western Visayas, handum niya ini kag sang iya amay nga makabig man anay nga Palaro stand-out sa throwing events.
english: According to the Department of Education Western Visayas, he and his father dream of being considered a Palaro stand-out in throwing events.

text: Sang nagdaog si Salcedo sa Laoag, Ilocos Norte, nakit-an nga emosyonal ini samtang ginahakos ang iya Papa nga nag-upod gid sa iya.
english: When Salcedo won in Laoag, Ilocos Norte, he was seen emotional while hugging his father who was with him.

text:
Pormal nga nagbukas ang Palarong Pambansa 2025 sang Sabado, Mayo 24, kag magatakop sa Lunes, Hunyo 2.#

(Photos: DepEd Western Visayas)
english:
The Palarong Pambansa 2025 formally opened on Saturday, May 24, and will close on Monday, June 2.#

(Photos: DepEd Western Visayas)

text: Isa na lang ka daug ang kinahanglan sang Filipino boxer nga si Carlo Paalam kag maka-secure na siya sang gold medal halin sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
english: Filipino boxer Carlo Paalam needs only one win to secure a gold medal from the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.

text: Sa semifinals subong nga adlaw, ginpierde ni Paalam ang hometown bet ukon tiglawas sang Japan nga si Ryomei Tanaka.
english: In today’s semifinals, Paalam defeated hometown bet or Japan representative Ryomei Tanaka.

text: Unanimous ang desisyon sang lima ka mga judges pabor kay Paalam, 30-27, 30-27, 29-28, 30-27, 30-27.
english: The five judges unanimously ruled in favor of Paalam, 30-27, 30-27, 29-28, 30-27, 30-27.

text: Bangud sini, sigurado na subong ang silver medal kag magabanse na si Paalam sa sunod nga round — ang finals sa iya division.
english: As a result, the silver medal is now assured and Paalam will compete in the next round — the finals in his division.

text: Matandaan nga nangin bantog na ang pangalan ni Paalam sang quarterfinals sang amo nga event matapos nga ginlutos niya ang Rio Games gold medalist nga si Shakhobidin Zoirov sang Uzbekistan — isa sa mga ginkabig biggest upset sa Olympiada subong nga tuig.
english: Paalam became famous in the quarterfinals of the event after he defeated Rio Games gold medalist Shakhobidin Zoirov of Uzbekistan — one of the biggest upsets of this year's Olympiad.

text: Sa finals sa Sabado, Agusto 7, mangin kasumpong ni Paalam si Galal Yafai sang Britanya.
english: In the finals on Saturday, August 7, Paalam will face Galal Yafai of Britain.

text: Nakigsapol na ang Department of Finance kay French Ambassador to the Philippines Michèle Boccoz agud diskusyunan ang ‘possible funding’ para sa pila ka mga proyekto nga ginalakipan sang first urban car cable system sa pungsod.
english: The Department of Finance has already met with French Ambassador to the Philippines Michèle Boccoz to discuss possible funding for several projects including the first urban car cable system in the country.

text: Suno kay Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez, nakahanda maghatag sang pinansyal nga suporta ang France pinaagi sa ‘highly concessional loan’ para sa ginpropose nga pinakauna nga urban cable system sa Asya.
english: According to Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez, France is ready to provide financial support through a highly concessional loan for the proposed first urban cable system in Asia.

text: ”France is willing to provide financing support through a “highly concessional loan” for the proposed urban cable system which will be the first in Asia,” pahayag ni Dominguez.
english: ”France is willing to provide financing support through a “highly concessional loan” for the proposed urban cable system which will be the first in Asia,” Dominguez said.

text: Ang nasambit nga 100 million dollar ukon kapin P4.7 trillion nga project ang pending pa for approval sa Investment Coordination Committee.
english: The said 100 million dollar or more than P4.7 trillion project is still pending for approval in the Investment Coordination Committee.

text: Lakip sa amo nga proyekto ang construction sang cable-propelled mass transport system nga may kalabaon nga 4.5 kilometers halin sa Santolan-Eastwood-Pasig.
english: The project includes the construction of a cable-propelled mass transport system with a length of 4.5 kilometers from Santolan-Eastwood-Pasig.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang 2018, nagpatigayon sang feasibility study ang France para sa first urban car cable system nga proyekto sa Pilipinas.
english: In 2018, France conducted a feasibility study for the first urban car cable system project in the Philippines.

text: Ginapatihan nga kaakig kag pagtimalos ang nagtulod sa suspek kun ngaa ginpatay sini ang mag-asawa nga senior citizen sa Barangay Lantangan, Carles, Iloilo.
english: It is believed that anger and revenge motivated the suspect to kill a senior citizen couple in Barangay Lantangan, Carles, Iloilo.

text: Ang mga biktima amo sanday Violeta Bolohabo, 71-anyos kag Jesus Bolohabo, 75-anyos nga lunsay residente sang amo nga lugar.
english: The victims were identified as Violeta Bolohabo, 71, and Jesus Bolohabo, 75, both residents of the same area.

text: Ang suspek naman amo si Wenrey Belasa, 31, residente sang Brgy.
english: The suspect was identified as Wenrey Belasa, 31, resident of Brgy.

text: Bayuyan, Estancia, Iloilo.
english: Bayuyan, Estancia, Iloilo.

text: Sa impormasyon nga nakuha sang Bombo Radyo, ginsiling sang suspek nga may dumot ini sa babaye nga biktima nga ginapahayag nga isa ka surhana bangud suno sa suspek, ginhiwitan sang tigulang ang ginatawag nga boss ni Belasa.
english: According to information obtained by Bombo Radyo, the suspect said he had a grudge against the female victim who was allegedly a surhana because according to the suspect, the old man had beaten Belasa's so-called boss.

text: Nahibaluan nga pauli na ang mag-asawa halin sa gintambungan nga kahiwatan sa plaza sang gintiro sang suspek kun sa diin lunsay dead on the spot ang mga biktima.
english: The couple were returning home from an event in the plaza when the suspect shot them dead on the spot.

text: Nalagyo pa ang suspek apang naaresto sang otoridad sa Barangay Botongon, Estancia, Iloilo sa hot pursuit operation.
english: The suspect fled the scene but was arrested by the police in Barangay Botongon, Estancia, Iloilo in a hot pursuit operation.

text: Preso na ini sa Carles Municipal Police Station kag mahimo magpangatubang sang sampaw-sampaw nga kaso bangud magluwas sa armas, nakuhaan pa gid ini sang marijuana.
english: He is now detained at the Carles Municipal Police Station and could face multiple charges because besides the weapon, he was also recovered with marijuana.

text: Liwat nga ginhingyo sang mga abogado ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC) pre-trial chamber nga gilayon lihokan ang ila petition para sa temporary nga pag-release, isa ka bulan antes ang confirmation hearing sang anay lider the The Hague.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's lawyers have once again asked the International Criminal Court (ICC) pre-trial chamber to immediately process their petition for temporary release, a month before the former leader's confirmation hearing in The Hague.

text: Suno pa sa mosyon, possible indi magtambong si Duterte sa confirmation proceedings.
english: According to the motion, Duterte may not attend the confirmation proceedings.

text: Apang kun kinahanglan, possible man ini nga ipatigayon sa tunga sang videoconferencing.
english: But if necessary, it is also possible to conduct it in the middle of videoconferencing.

text: Dugang pa diri, ginsiguro sang defense team nga pwedi man ini masiguro ang monitoring conditions kag contact restrictions sa tunga sang [REDACTED].
english: In addition, the defense team ensured that it can also ensure monitoring conditions and contact restrictions between [REDACTED]

text: Ginpasakaan na sang kaso nga Robbery sang Special Investigation Task Group ang mga myembro sang “Termite Group Visayas” nga amo ang nagransak sa Iloilo Supermart sa Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The Special Investigation Task Group has filed a case of robbery against members of the “Termite Group Visayas” who ransacked the Iloilo Supermart in Jaro, Iloilo City.

text:
Ang kaso nga Robbery by Use of Force Upon Things ang pormal nga gin-file sa prosecutor’s office batuk sa mga suspek nga amo sanday:

Nahibaluan nga ang robbery ang natabo sang Agosto 27, 2024.
english:
The case of Robbery by Use of Force Upon Things was formally filed in the prosecutor’s office against the suspects who are:

It is known that the robbery took place on August 27, 2024.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, natukiban nga tatlo sa mga suspek ang positibo nga nakilala kag nakit-an na nga nagapatigayon sang surveillance sa area antes pa man ang pagpangransak.
english: Investigation revealed that three of the suspects were positively identified and were seen conducting surveillance in the area before the raid.

text: Nakit-an sa CCTV footage ang getaway vehicle, samtang may isa gid ka puti nga van nga yara sa crime scene kag sa ila billeting location sa isa ka resort sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: CCTV footage showed the getaway vehicle, while there was a white van at the crime scene and at their billeting location at a resort in Iloilo province.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin nga at large ang mga suspek apang lauman nga may mga follow up operations nga patigayunon kag padayon ang intelligence coordination agud matigayon ang mga ini nga madakpan.
english: The suspects remain at large but follow up operations are expected to be conducted and intelligence coordination is ongoing to ensure their arrest.

text: Nagnubo ang kita sang Pilipinas kun sektor sang turismo ang pagahambalan.
english: The Philippines' tourism sector has declined in revenue.

text: Suno kay Virginia Messina, senior vice president sang World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC), humalin sang nagligad nga tuig, nagnubo sa 37 billion dollars ukon P1.7 trillion ang kontribusyon sang turismo sa ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: According to Virginia Messina, senior vice president of the World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC), since last year, the contribution of tourism to the country's economy has dropped to 37 billion dollars or P1.7 trillion.

text: Sa data sang WTTC, nagsarurot man ang gross domestic product (GDP) sang turismo sang Pilipinas sa 41.4 percent bangud sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: According to WTTC data, the Philippines' tourism gross domestic product (GDP) also shrank by 41.4 percent due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Pahayag ni Messina, bangud man sini, nagtuga sang tuman kadako nga halit sa socioeconomic sang pungsod ang pag-untat sang kapin 2 million nga mga trabaho, travel kag turismo.
english: Messina said that because of this, the suspension of more than 2 million jobs, travel and tourism has caused a huge damage to the country's socioeconomic.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, ginalauman nga magsaka sa 48.5 percent ang kontribusyon sang industriya sang turismo sa ekonomiya sang pungsod subong nga tuig, sa tion nga magpadayon ang mobility kag international travel.
english: However, the tourism industry's contribution to the country's economy is expected to rise to 48.5 percent this year, as mobility and international travel continue.

text: Ginaduso ni Batangas 2nd District Representative Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro ang mandatory drug testing sa tanan nga opisina sang gobyerno agud mapabilin ang integridad, accountability, kag pagsalig sang publiko sa iya mga institusyon.
english: Batangas 2nd District Representative Atty. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro mandatory drug testing in all government offices to maintain integrity, accountability, and public trust in his institutions.

text: Suno kay Luistro, dapat mangin role model ang mga public servants kag magmentinar sang mataas nga standards of professionalism bangud ang paggamit sang illegal drugs ang nagahalit sa efficiency, decision-making, kag kredibilidad sang gobyerno.
english: According to Luistro, public servants should be role models and maintain high standards of professionalism because the use of illegal drugs damages the efficiency, decision-making, and credibility of the government.

text: Dugang pa sini nga ang drug testing isa ka preventive kag restorative measure agud maamligan ang interes sang publiko, masiguro ang nagakaigo nga paggamit sang pundo, kag mabuligan ang mga empleyado nga may problema sa substance abuse.
english: He added that drug testing is a preventive and restorative measure to protect the public interest, ensure proper use of funds, and assist employees with substance abuse problems.

text: Ginpasalig man ni Luistro nga ang konstitusyonal nga mga kinamatarung, dignidad, kag katarungan pagatahuron sa pagpatuman sini, kag may yara sang maathag nga mga pagsulundan para sa transparency, equality, kag due process sa pagpatigayon sang proseso.
english: Luistro also assured that constitutional rights, dignity, and justice will be respected in its implementation, and there will be clear guidelines for transparency, equality, and due process in conducting the process.

text: Ilunsyar sang Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) ang 24/7 hotline para sa mga indibidwal nga may problema sa sugal bilang sabat sa panawagan ni Kabataan Party-list Rep.
english: The Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) will launch a 24/7 hotline for individuals with gambling problems in response to the call of Kabataan Party-list Rep.

text: Renee Co.
english: Renee Co.

text: Magabulig ang PAGCOR sa Seagulls Flock Foundation, isa ka NGO nga eksperto sa rehabilitasyon, agud i-train ang mga operator sang hotline.
english: PAGCOR will assist the Seagulls Flock Foundation, an NGO expert in rehabilitation, to train hotline operators.

text: Ang mga matawag ang mahimo nga i-refer sa mga partner rehab centers sang PAGCOR kasubong sang Bridges of Hope, Life Recovery Center, kag Milestone Health and Wellness.
english: Those called can be referred to PAGCOR's partner rehab centers such as Bridges of Hope, Life Recovery Center, and Milestone Health and Wellness.

text: Magluwas pa diri, may ara sang self-exclusion program ang PAGCOR nga may masobra duha ka libo nga naaprubahan sang aplikasyon, kun sa diin ang minimum gaming ban ang isa ka tuig, kag hugot ang proseso antes tugutan nga makabalik sa paghampang.
english: In addition, PAGCOR has a self-exclusion program with more than 2,000 approved applications, where the minimum gaming ban is one year, and the process is strict before being allowed to return to play.

text: Ginganyat ni PAGCOR Chair Alejandro Tangco ang publiko nga idangop sa PAGCOR ang ila nga mga himata nga adik sa sugal para sa nagakaigo nga bulig kag rehabilitasyon.
english: PAGCOR Chair Alejandro Tangco urged the public to turn to PAGCOR for their relatives who are addicted to gambling for proper assistance and rehabilitation.

text: Naga-udyak ang bilog nga Indonesia matapos nakuha na sang ila duha ka atleta ang una nga gold medal sa Tokyo Olympic Games.
english: The whole of Indonesia is cheering after their two athletes won their first gold medal at the Tokyo Olympic Games.

text: Gold medalists sanday Greysia Polii kag Apriyani Rahayu sa badminton matapos ginpierde ang pambato sang China sa final game.
english: Greysia Polii and Apriyani Rahayu became gold medalists in badminton after defeating China in the final game.

text: Ini ang first medal sang Indonesia sa women’s doubles.
english: This is Indonesia’s first medal in women’s doubles.

text: Sa walo ka Olympic medals nga natipon sang Indonesia halin pa sang una, lunsay ini nadag-an sa badminton.
english: Of the eight Olympic medals that Indonesia has collected since the beginning, they have all been won in badminton.

text: Kasunod sini, nagbubo man ang promisa sang cash rewards sa duha ka Olympians; standout man ang pila ka premyo kaangay sang lima ka baka, isa ka meatball restaurant, kag bag-o nga balay.
english: Following this, the promise of cash rewards to the two Olympians also poured in; also standout are some prizes like five cows, a meatball restaurant, and a new house.

text: Suno naman kay Indonesia President Joko Widodo, ang pagdaug sang duha ang makabig na nga regalo para sa independence day sa Agusto 17.
english: According to Indonesian President Joko Widodo, the victory of the two will be considered a gift for independence day on August 17.

text: ILOILO CITY- Indi magnubo sa anom ka tawo ang patay kag tatlo ang pilason sa Israeli strike sa residential building sa Nabatieh city, sa southern Lebanon.
english: ILOILO CITY – At least six people were killed and three others wounded in an Israeli strike on a residential building in Nabatieh city, in southern Lebanon.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma sang Lebanese health ministry.
english: This was confirmed by the Lebanese health ministry.

text: Sa tunga ini sang nagasingki nga tension matapos ang makamamatay nga rocket strike sa Israeli-occupied Golan Heights nga ginbasol sang Israel sa Hezbollah.
english: It comes amid heightened tensions after a deadly rocket strike in the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights that Israel blamed on Hezbollah.

text: Nagbalos ang Israel nga nagresulta sa kamatayon sang top Hezbollah commander sa Beirut.
english: Israel retaliated, resulting in the death of the top Hezbollah commander in Beirut.

text: Ang Hezbollah nangako man nga magabalos sa Israel, kasubong man sa ginhimo sang Iran bangud sa kamatayon sang political chief sang Palestinian Hamas group nga si Ismail Haniyeh sa Tehran.
english: Hezbollah has also vowed to retaliate against Israel, similar to what Iran did over the death of Palestinian Hamas group political chief Ismail Haniyeh in Tehran.

text: Nag-renew sang wedding vows ang veteran actors nga sanday Sandy Andolong de Leon kag Christopher de Leon sa Vietnam.
english: Veteran actors Sandy Andolong de Leon and Christopher de Leon renewed their wedding vows in Vietnam.

text: Suno kay Christopher, malapit 40 ka tuig na nga naga-updanay sila sang iya nga misis sa kasakit kag sa kalipayan apang apisar ano nga problema ang nag-abot sa ila, nagapabilin sa gihapon ang pagpalangga nila sa isa kag isa.
english: According to Christopher, he and his wife have been together for nearly 40 years in pain and happiness but no matter what problems have come their way, their love for each other remains.

text: Ang mag-asawa ang may lima ka mga kabataan nga sanday  Rafael, Miguel, Gabriel, Mariel kag Mica.
english: The couple has five children namely Rafael, Miguel, Gabriel, Mariel and Mica.

text: Gindayaw naman ni Sandy si Christopher bilang maayo nga bana kag amay sa ila mga anak.
english: Sandy praised Christopher as a good husband and father to their children.

text: 𝙄𝙡𝙤𝙞𝙡𝙤 𝘾𝙞𝙩𝙮 — Isa ka daku nga bulig para sa nutrisyon sang kabataan ang ginpatigayon sang Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation, Inc.
english: 𝙄𝙡𝙤𝙞𝙡𝙤 𝘾𝙞𝙩𝙮 — A major donation for children's nutrition was conducted by the Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation, Inc.

text: paagi sa pagdonar sang malapit ₱2 million para sa feeding program sang Iloilo City Nutrition Center.
english: by donating nearly ₱2 million for the feeding program of the Iloilo City Nutrition Center.

text: Ang Deed of Donation ginpirmahan ni Chairman Rogelio Florete Jr.
english: The Deed of Donation was signed by Chairman Rogelio Florete Jr.

text: kag Trustee Enrico Jacomille sang Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation, Inc.
english: and Trustee Enrico Jacomille of Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation, Inc.

text: kaupod sanday City Health Officer Dr. Mary Ann Poli-Diaz kag Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon.
english: with City Health Officer Dr. Mary Ann Poli-Diaz and Vice Mayor Jeffrey Ganzon.

text: Ini nga donasyon magaserbi nga pundo para mapadayon ang programa nga naga-serbi sang masustansya nga pagkaon sa mga kabataan.
english: This donation will serve as funds to continue the program that serves nutritious meals to children.

text: Ginpahayag sang mga opisyales nga ang insakto nga nutrisyon may daku nga papel sa cognitive development kag long-term academic success sang kabataan.
english: Officials said proper nutrition plays a major role in children's cognitive development and long-term academic success.

text: Ang pundo igadiretso sa Iloilo City Nutrition Center nga amo ang naga-implementar sang feeding program sa syudad.
english: The funds will be directed to the Iloilo City Nutrition Center which is implementing the feeding program in the city.

text: Text by: Bombo Ronhel P. Brabanzo
english: Text by: Bombo Ronhel P. Brabanzo

text: Mahimo na makasulod kag makalagaw-lagaw sa Boracay ang mga turista halin sa NCR Plus Bubble.
english: Tourists from the NCR Plus Bubble can now enter and explore Boracay.

text: Santo sa anunsyo sang Malay Tourism Office, ginabaton na ang mga residente halin sa Metro Manila, Bulacan, Cavite, Laguna, kag Rizal umpisa Hunyo 1 tubtob 15.
english: According to the announcement of the Malay Tourism Office, residents from Metro Manila, Bulacan, Cavite, Laguna, and Rizal are now accepted from June 1 to 15.

text: Ang NCR Plus Bubble ang yara subong sa general community quarantine (GCQ) “with heightened restrictions”.
english: The NCR Plus Bubble is currently under general community quarantine (GCQ) “with heightened restrictions”.

text: Kun mahimo nga plain GCQ lang ang NCR Plus pagkatapos sang Hunyo 15, magapadayon ang pagbaton sang mga turista halin sa amo nga lugar.
english: If NCR Plus can be placed under plain GCQ after June 15, it will continue to receive tourists from the area.

text: Apang kun magbalik ini sa mas istrikto nga modified enhanced community quarantine ukon MECQ, posible nga mauntat naman ang leisure movements ukon mga lagaw-lagaw.
english: However, if it returns to the stricter modified enhanced community quarantine or MECQ, it is possible that leisure movements will stop.

text: Mahimo makabisita sa amo nga bantog nga isla ang mga turista halin sa naka-GCQ kag naka-MGCQ nga mga lugar.
english: Tourists from GCQ and MGCQ areas can visit the famous island.

text: Greatest show on Earth man sa gihapon ang Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games apang makabig man ‘hottest on the record’.
english: The Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games is still the greatest show on Earth but it is also considered the 'hottest on the record'.

text: Pinasahi ini nga Olimpyada para sa mga atleta sa bilog nga kalibutan bangud ginpatigayon ini sa pihak sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: This Olympics is special for athletes around the world because it was held despite the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Apang magluwas diri, isa pa ka isyu ang ginakabig biggest concern sang mga tawo: ang tuman kainit nga temperatura halin sang nag-umpisa ang mga hampang.
english: But besides, another issue is considered the biggest concern of the people: the extremely hot temperatures since the games began.

text:
Ang pagsuprer sang mga atleta sa indi kinaandan nga kainit ang naga-lead subong sa isa ka pamangkot: “Ano na ang mangin puturo sang Olympic Games kun padayon pa nga nagainit ang kalibutan?”

Sang nagligad nga Domingo, nangin gold medalist sa men’s triathlon ang Norweigian athlete nga si Kristian Blummenfelt.
english:
The athletes' suffering from the unprecedented heat is now leading to a question: “What will be the future of the Olympic Games if the world continues to warm?”

Last Sunday, Norwegian athlete Kristian Blummenfelt became the gold medalist in the men’s triathlon.

text: 11 segundos ang iya abanse sa atleta nga nagsunod sa iya.
english: 11 seconds ahead of the athlete who followed him.

text: Apisar sang iya phenomenal run, pila lang ka segundos matapos nakalapak sa finishing line, nagsuka si Blummenfelt kag nag-collapse.
english: Despite his phenomenal run, just seconds after crossing the finish line, Blummenfelt vomited and collapsed.

text: Ginpasakay siya sa wheelchair kag gindala sa medical team.
english: He was put in a wheelchair and taken to the medical team.

text: Indi ini ang nagaisahanon nga kaso.
english: This is not the only case.

text: Pinakaapektado sa init amo ang mga nagasapasakop sa triathlon events.
english: Most affected by the heat are those who participate in triathlon events.

text: Nalipong man ang Russian archer nga si Svetlana Gomboeva sa qualifying round, samtang madamo naman nga tennis players ang nagreklamo bangud sa amo nga kondisyon.
english: Russian archer Svetlana Gomboeva also fainted in the qualifying round, while many tennis players complained about the condition.

text: “If I die, will the International Tennis Federation take responsibility?” pamangkot ni Daniil Medvedev, 25 anyos nga Russian player, sa iya hampang sang nagligad nga semana.
english: “If I die, will the International Tennis Federation take responsibility?” asked Daniil Medvedev, 25-year-old Russian player, in his match last week.

text:
“I can finish the match, but I can die.”

Pila sa ginahimo sang mga atleta agud nga makabato sa tuman nga kainit nga panahon amo ang pagbutang sang ice packs sa ila nga panapton, pag-inom sang slushies, kag pagpahulom sa ice-filled paddling pools.
english:
“I can finish the match, but I can die.”

Some of the things that athletes do to cope with the extreme heat are putting ice packs on their clothes, drinking slushies, and soaking in ice-filled paddling pools.

text: Ini nga makeshift solutions sa tuman nga kainit nga panahon amo ang naga-lead pa gid sa dugang nga mga pamangkot: Ngaa ginpili ang Tokyo, Japan bilang host city?
english: It is these makeshift solutions in extremely hot weather that further lead to further questions: Why was Tokyo, Japan chosen as the host city?

text: Labing importante, ano ang mangin kaangtanan sang global warming sa mangin masunod nga Olympiada sa Paris, Los Angeles, kag Brisbane?
english: Most importantly, what will global warming have to do with what will be the next Olympiad in Paris, Los Angeles, and Brisbane?

text: Wasak ang bumper sang pribado nga salakyan matapos makabunggo sa metal railings sa dalan sang General Luna, City Proper.
english: The bumper of a private vehicle was damaged after it collided with metal railings on General Luna Road, City Proper.

text: Ang driver amo si Alyas Jay L, legal ang pang-edaron, negosyante, kag residente sang Lapuz Norte, Iloilo City.
english: The driver was identified as Jay L, legal age, businessman, and resident of Lapuz Norte, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Executive Master Sergeant Jeremy Minerva, Traffic investigator, iya ginpahayag nga papuli na kuntani sa ila puluy-an ang driver halin sa San Joaquin sang nadulaan ini sang control kag nakabunggo sa metal railings sa tunga sang karsada.
english: Police Executive Master Sergeant Jeremy Minerva, traffic investigator, said the driver was returning home from San Joaquin when he lost control and hit the metal railings in the middle of the road.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon sa kapulisan nga napiyungan ang driver.
english: According to police investigation, the driver lost consciousness.

text: Maswerte naman nga wala sang may naagum nga pilas ang driver kag nagpauli nalang samtang ginahulat nga makuha ang salakyan bangud indi ini maliso.
english: Fortunately, the driver was not injured and went home while waiting for the vehicle to be recovered because it could not turn.

text: Kompleto naman sa dokumento ang salakyan.
english: The vehicle is complete with documents.

text: Text by: Bombo Pauline Pillora
english: Text by: Bombo Pauline Pillora

text: Naaresto ng mga pulis ang isa sa pitong suspek na sangkot sa pagnanakaw ng bag ni Commission on Elections (COMELEC) hairman George Erwin Garcia sa isang kainan sa Pasay City nitong Martes ng tanghali.
english: Police arrested one of seven suspects involved in the theft of Commission on Elections (COMELEC) hairman George Erwin Garcia's bag from a restaurant in Pasay City on Tuesday afternoon.

text: Ayon kay Pasay City Police Chief Col.
english: According to Pasay City Police Chief Col.

text: Joselito De Sesto, isang babae na umano’y lider ng grupo ang natunton at nadakip sa isinagawang follow-up operation sa Bacoor, Cavite.
english: Joselito De Sesto, a woman allegedly the leader of the group was tracked down and arrested in a follow-up operation in Bacoor, Cavite.

text: Nabawi rin ng mga awtoridad ang bag ng COMELEC Chief na naglalaman ng ilang personal na gamit gaya ng cellphone at mga ID, ngunit wala na ang perang laman nito.
english: The authorities also recovered the COMELEC Chief's bag containing some personal belongings such as cellphones and IDs, but the money was gone.

text: Patuloy namang tinutugis ang anim pang kasabwat na kabilang sa grupo, na ayon sa pulisya ay matagal nang gumagala sa Metro Manila at karatig-lalawigan gamit ang parehong modus.
english: Six other accomplices in the group, who according to the police have been moving around Metro Manila and neighboring provinces using the same modus operandi, are still being pursued.

text: Dagdag pa ni De Sesto, dati nang nakulong ang mga suspek sa iba’t ibang kaso ng pagnanakaw ngunit paulit-ulit na bumabalik sa ilegal na gawain.
english: De Sesto added that the suspects were previously jailed in various cases of theft but repeatedly returned to illegal activities.

text: Ginbatuan ni gymnastics superstar Simone Biles ang iya kahadlok paagi sa pagbalik sa kumpetisyon sa Tokyo Olympics apang napaslawan siya nga makuha ang Gold Medal sa balance beam competition.
english: Gymnastics superstar Simone Biles fought her fears by returning to competition at the Tokyo Olympics but she failed to win the Gold Medal in the balance beam competition.

text: Nagpangatlo si Biles sa kumpetisyon matapos nga ginpierde siya nanday Guan Chenchen (14.633) kag Tang Xijing (14.233), gymnasts nga lunsay halin sa China.
english: Biles finished third in the competition after being defeated by Guan Chenchen (14.633) and Tang Xijing (14.233), gymnasts both from China.

text: Si Biles, ginakabig sang kadam-an bilang world’s best gymnast, ang nakascore sang 14.000.
english: Biles, widely regarded as the world’s best gymnast, scored 14.000.

text: “It’s been a very long week, it’s been a very long five years,” pahayag ni Biles sa gymnastics center pagkatapos sang event.
english: “It’s been a very long week, it’s been a very long five years,” Biles said at the gymnastics center after the event.

text: Pahayag niya, wala man siya naglaum nga makaangkon sang medalya sa kumpetisyon.
english: He said he did not expect to win a medal in the competition.

text:
“I just wanted to go out there and do this for me, and that’s exactly what I did.”

Nangin mainit ang pangalan ni Biles sang nagligad nga semana bangud nag-withdraw siya sang team gymnastics final.
english:
“I just wanted to go out there and do this for me, and that’s exactly what I did.”

Biles made headlines last week for withdrawing from the team gymnastics final.

text: Mental health concern kag physical safety ang ginpasulabi ni Biles rason nga nag-withdraw siya sa event.
english: Biles said she withdrew from the event because of mental health concerns and physical safety.

text: Adlaw-adlaw ang pag-check sang medical professionals kay Biles.
english: Biles is being checked on daily by medical professionals.

text: May duha pa ka sessions si Biles upod ang sports psychologist samtang yara siya sa Tokyo.
english: Biles has two more sessions with the sports psychologist while she’s in Tokyo.

text: Ginbuyagyag man ni Biles nga napatay ang iya nga tiya kag nabudlayan siya bangud sa natabo.
english: Biles also revealed that her aunt died and she was devastated by the incident.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag ni Biles nga nagsuprer siya sa twisties — ang sensation nga naga-develop sa gymnasts nga posible makapadula sang ila sense of control samtang yara sa hangin.#
english: Earlier, Biles said she suffered from twisties — a sensation that develops in gymnasts that can cause them to lose their sense of control while in the air.

text: Patay ang indi magnubo sa 31 ka tawo, lakip ang anum (6) ka mga kabataan matapos nga nagpatigayon sang airstrikes ang Israel sa Gaza.
english: At least 31 people, including six (6) children, were killed after Israel conducted airstrikes in Gaza.

text: Suno sa Palestinian Ministry of Health, madamo sa mga nasamaran ang kritikal ang kahimtang, kun sa diin halos sa mga biktima ang sibilyan kag may pila nga na-trap sa idalom sang mga naguba nga balay, kag istasyon sang pulis.
english: According to the Palestinian Ministry of Health, many of the injured are in critical condition, with most of the victims being civilians and some trapped under destroyed houses and police stations.

text: Madumduman nga ginsuguran ang ceasefire sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod sang Oktubre, apang nagapadayon gihapon ang mga pag-atake kag tensyon, ilabi na sa bahin sang Gaza.
english: A ceasefire between the two countries was initiated in October, but attacks and tensions continue, especially on the Gaza side.

text: Pahayag naman sang Israel Defense Forces nga ang mga pag-atake ang nagtutok sa Hamas kag Islamic Jihad bilang sabat sa paglapas sa kasugtanan.
english: The Israel Defense Forces said the attacks targeted Hamas and Islamic Jihad in response to violations of the agreement.

text: Sa karun, madamo sang pamilya ang apektado, lakip na ang mga kabataan kag mga katigulangan, nga nagadala sang kahadlok kag tuman nga kabalaka sa komunidad.
english: Currently, many families are affected, including children and the elderly, bringing fear and great anxiety to the community.

text: Makaligad ang halos anom ka bulan humalin sang nagtaliwan ang Taiwanese actress nga si Barbie Hsu sa edad nga 48 bangud sa influenza-related pneumonia samtang nagbakasyon sa Japan, padayon sagihapon ang kalisod sang iya asawa nga si DJ Koo (Koo Jun-yup).
english: Nearly six months after Taiwanese actress Barbie Hsu died at the age of 48 from influenza-related pneumonia while on vacation in Japan, her husband DJ Koo (Koo Jun-yup) continues to suffer.

text: Suno sa mga report, regular nga ginabisita ni DJ Koo ang pantyon ni Barbie sa Chin Pao San Cemetery sa New Taipei, Taiwan, apisar nga naga-ulan ukon grabe ang init.
english: According to reports, DJ Koo regularly visits Barbie’s grave at Chin Pao San Cemetery in New Taipei, Taiwan, despite the rain or extreme heat.

text: Isa ka netizen ang nagkumpirma sang report sang Hulyo 27, matapos gindul-ong ang isa ka tagasuporta ni Hsu nga luyag maghatag sang bulak.
english: A netizen confirmed the report on July 27, after dropping off a Hsu supporter who wanted to give flowers.

text: Sa ila pag-abot, nakita nila si DJ Koo nga nagapungko sang malinong sa isa k foldable chair, naka-itom nga tank top kag naka-kalo, kag ginaantos ang tuman ka init samtang nagabantay sa pantyon sang iya nagtaliwan nga asawa.
english: Upon arrival, they found DJ Koo sitting serenely in a k foldable chair, dressed in a black tank top and hat, and enduring the extreme heat while vigil at his late wife’s grave.

text: Matandaan nga una nga nagkilalahay sanday barbie kag DJ Koo sang 1998 kag nangin mag-partner.
english: Barbie and DJ Koo first met in 1998 and became partners.

text: Nagpakasal sila sang tuig 2022 matapos ang 23 ka tuig nga pagnobyahanay.
english: They got married in the year 2022 after dating for 23 years.

text: ILOILO CITY- Tinguhaan sang Department of Health nga malagas ang wala nalab-ot nga target nga porsyento sang kabataan nga nagaedad 5 anyos panubo nga ma-fully immunized sang 2021.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Department of Health will strive to achieve the unmet target percentage of children under the age of 5 to be fully immunized by 2021.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Daphynie Teorima, Regional Coordinator sang National Immunization Program, iya ginpahayag nga sa target nga 95%, 64.36 lang ang fully immunized nga kabataan sa bilog nga Pilipinas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Daphynie Teorima, Regional Coordinator of the National Immunization Program, said that out of the target of 95%, only 64.36 children are fully immunized in the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Teorima, isa sa mga rason amo ang COVID-19 pandemic nga nagtuga sang disruption sa routine immunization sa pungsod.
english: According to Teorima, one of the reasons is the COVID-19 pandemic that caused disruption in routine immunization in the country.

text: Pahayag niya, sa National Vaccination Days sa Abril tubtob Hunyo, positibo sila nga malab-ot ang target sang kabataan nga ma-fully imunized.
english: He said that during the National Vaccination Days from April to June, they are positive that the target of children being fully immunized will be achieved.

text: Ang National Immunization Program (NIP) ukon kilala man nga Expanded Programme on Immunization amo ang premiere vaccination program sang pungsod nga nagahatag sa kabataan, mga lapsag kag ila iloy, sang access sa routine vaccines nga rekomendado para sa ila edad.
english: The National Immunization Program (NIP) or also known as the Expanded Program on Immunization is the country’s premiere vaccination program that gives children, infants and their mothers, access to routine vaccines recommended for their age.

text: Ini ginalakipan sang bakuna kontra tuberculosis,tetanus, hepatitis, pneumonia, measles kag iban pa.
english: This includes vaccines against tuberculosis, tetanus, hepatitis, pneumonia, measles and others.

text: INDI mangin katingalahan sa subong nga panahon nga ang isa ka indi-Super Typhoon makadulot sang kahalitan kasubong sang isa ka Super Typhoon.
english: IT would not be surprising in today's world that a non-Super Typhoon could cause as much damage as a Super Typhoon.

text: Ina tungod sa pagluntad na sang Climate Change.
english: That's because of the existence of Climate Change.

text: In fact, napamatud-an ini sang Severe Tropical Storm Paeng (international name Nalgae)  ikumparar sa kahalitan nga gindulot sang Super Typhoon Yolanda kag Odette nga nag-igu sa pungsod sadtong 2013 kag 2021.
english: In fact, this was proven by Severe Tropical Storm Paeng (international name Nalgae) compared to the damage caused by Super Typhoons Yolanda and Odette that hit the country in 2013 and 2021.

text: Ang isa ka Severe Tropical Storm, sunu sa Pag-asa, nagadala lang sang maximum nga pwersa nga 89 kms.
english: A Severe Tropical Storm, according to Pag-asa, only carries a maximum force of 89 kms.

text: per hour tubtub 117 kph nga mabatakan lang sang Storm Signal No.
english: per hour up to 117 kph under Storm Signal No.

text: Samtang ang isa ka Super Typhoon may maximum nga pwersa nga sobra 185 kph, nga katulad sang Yolanda nabatakan sang Storm Signal 5 sang Pag-asa.
english: Meanwhile, a Super Typhoon with a maximum force of more than 185 kph, similar to Yolanda, was rated by Storm Signal 5 of Pag-asa.

text: Sunu sa US-based Joint Typhoon Warning Center (JTWC) ang pwersa sang Yolanda (international name Haiyan) nag-average sing 195 miles per hour, ukon 314 kph, nga nagkilala man sini bilang pinakabaskug nga bagyo sa kalibutan on record.
english: According to the US-based Joint Typhoon Warning Center (JTWC), the force of Yolanda (international name Haiyan) averaged 195 miles per hour, or 314 kph, which also recognized it as the strongest typhoon in the world on record.

text: Una nag-igu ang Yolanda sa mga probinsya sang East Samar kag Leyte sadtong Nobyembre 8, 2013, kon diin indi hamak ang kahalitan sini.
english: Yolanda first hit the provinces of East Samar and Leyte on November 8, 2013, where the damage was not negligible.

text: Ang Super Typhoon Odette (international name Rai) una nag-landfall sadtong Disyembre 16, 2021 sa Siargao Island sa southeastern Philippines.
english: Super Typhoon Odette (international name Rai) first made landfall on December 16, 2021 on Siargao Island in the southeastern Philippines.

text: Ang maximum nga pwersa sini, sunu sa Pag-asa, amo ang 165 kph near the center nga may gustiness (pugada) nga 205 kph.
english: Its maximum force, according to Pag-asa, is 165 kph near the center with a gustiness of 205 kph.

text: Gin-report ini sang isa ka international weather station sa pwersa nga 230 kph.
english: It was reported by an international weather station at 230 kph.

text:
***

Ang  Tropical Storm Paeng nagtumbok sang Eastern Visayas sadtong Oktubre 26 padulong sa southern Philippines bag-o naggwa sa pungsod sadtong Oktubre 31, isa ka adlaw bag-o ang Pyesta Minatay.
english:
***

Tropical Storm Paeng pushed Eastern Visayas on October 26 towards the southern Philippines before leaving the country on October 31, a day before the Feast of the Dead.

text: Sa nasiling ta na sa ibabaw, ginpakita sini nga samtang indi man pareho ini ka kusog sang Yolanda kag Odette, nagdulot ini sang daku nga kahalitan sa pungsod kasubong sang isa ka Super Typhoon.
english: As mentioned above, it showed that while it was not as strong as Yolanda and Odette, it caused as much damage to the country as a Super Typhoon.

text: In fact, ini lang nga bagyo sa pungsod nga gin-rekomendar sang NDRRMC agud ibutang sa State of Calamity ang bug-os gid nga pungsod, although wala ini gin-aprubahan ni Presidente BBM tungod kay “localized damages” lang kuno ang natabo.
english: In fact, this is the only typhoon in the country that the NDRRMC recommended to place the entire country in a State of Calamity, although it was not approved by President BBM because only “localized damages” occurred.

text: Ang Bagyo Paeng man ang una nga bagyo nga ang mapintas nga kuko nagkaros gid sang bug-os nga pungsod, nga wala mahimo sang Yolanda kag Odette tungod nanghalit lang ini sila sa limitado nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: Typhoon Paeng was also the first typhoon to devastate the entire country, which Yolanda and Odette did not do because they only damaged a limited part of the country.

text: Matuod, mga 155 lang ka kabuhi ang gin-utas ni Paeng, sa latest count, apang nagdulot ini sang damages nga lapaw sa P2.0 Billion.
english: True, Paeng claimed only about 155 lives, at the latest count, but it caused damages of more than P2.0 Billion.

text: Ang National Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) nag-report man sadtong Nobyembre 1 nga minilyon ka mga pumuluyo ang nahalitan sini kasubong sa nahimo man sang Yolanda kag Odette.
english: The National Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC) also reported on November 1 that millions of people were affected by it as well as Yolanda and Odette.

text: Sa mga nahalitan sang Bagyo Paeng mga 741,777 ka pamilya gid ang na-displace tungod nagub-an sang puluy-an ukon nabahaan sing madalom sa ila mga lugar.
english: Of those affected by Typhoon Paeng, about 741,777 families were displaced because their homes were destroyed or deeply flooded in their areas.

text: Ang Yolanda ya nagpatay gid sang 6,300 ka tawo, although kadam-an sini napatay tungod nagapuyo sa baybayon kon diin gin-igu sila sang wala ginpaabot nga mala-tsunami nga storm surge, nga kon wala ato, indi gid man subong ka damo ang napatay.
english: Yolanda killed 6,300 people, although most of them died because they lived on the coast where they were hit by an unexpected tsunami-like storm surge, which without it, would not have killed so many.
