text: Ang Yolanda nag-displace sang 890,895 ka pamilya kag nag-damage sang mga P18.27 Billion nga infra – dalan, taytay kag iban pa nga structures.
english: Yolanda displaced 890,895 families and damaged about P18.27 billion in infra – roads, bridges and other structures.

text: Ang Odette naman nagpatay sang 405 ka tawo kag nag-displace sang mga 513,000 ka pamilya kag nag-damage man sing binilyon ka pesos nga balor sang palangabuhian sa agrikultura, mga puluy-an kag mga establicimiento, public projects, kag iban pa.
english: Odette killed 405 people and displaced about 513,000 families and also damaged billions of pesos worth of agricultural livelihoods, homes and establishments, public projects, and others.

text:
***

Ngaa amo gid ka mahaliton ang Bagyo Paeng nga kasubong na sa isa ka Super Typhoon?
english:
***

Why was Typhoon Paeng so devastating that it was like a Super Typhoon?

text: Matudlo naton diri ang kabangdanan sa paglala na sang pagbag-o  sang klima sang kalibutan (Climate Change), nga sige-sige man nagapataas sang temperatura sang kalibutan (Global Warming) nga nagatuga sang madamo lang nga problema.
english: Here we can point to the cause of the worsening of climate change (Climate Change), which is also increasing the temperature of the world (Global Warming) which causes many problems.

text: Katulad sang mas mabaskug nga mga bagyo nga tuga sang dugang nga pag-init sang kalalawran, sobra-sobra nga pag-ulan halin sa mas madamo na nga tubig nga ginasuyop paibabaw sang dugang nga init bag-o ipusdak sa kadutaan nga nagatuga sang mas madalom, malaparon kag mabaskug nga pagbinaha-baha, kag amat-amat nga pagtunaw sang yelo sa Antartika kag iban pa nga mga malamig nga lugar nga nagapasaka sang taub sa baybayon kag sang paglugdang sang pila ka isla.
english: Like stronger typhoons caused by increased ocean warming, excessive rainfall from more water that is already absorbed by the increased heat before being released on land causes deeper, wider and stronger flooding, and the gradual melting of glaciers in Antarctica and other ice sheets place that causes the tide to rise on the coast and the sinking of some islands.

text: Tani madeklarar na ang CLIMATE EMERGENCY sa pungsod agud matagaan gid sing lubos nga priority ang pag-atubang sa problema naton sa Climate Change./PN
english: Hopefully a CLIMATE EMERGENCY will be declared in the country so that we can give full priority to addressing our problem of Climate Change./PN

text: Posible nga i-revoke sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) 6 ang licensya ni Former Mayor Badong Divinagracia sang Calinog, Iloilo matapos nga ma-hit and run sini ang 19-anyos nga lalaki nga gintunaan sang kamatayon sini.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) 6 is likely to revoke the license of Former Mayor Badong Divinagracia of Calinog, Iloilo after he hit and run a 19-year-old man that caused his death.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay LTO 6 Director Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II, iya ginpahayag nga bisan wala pa nakabaton sang pormal nga reklamo ang ila opisina angut sa nasambit nga insidente, posible gihapon nga i-revoke ang licensya sang anay alkalde ilabi na nga malayo ang ginluntaran sang insidente kag kun sa diin ini nadakpan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, LTO 6 Director Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II, he said that although their office has not yet received a formal complaint regarding the incident, it is still possible to revoke the license of the former mayor especially since the incident occurred far away and where he was arrested.

text: Suno kay Atty. Geduspan, ang mga hit-and-run cases ginakabig nga negligence of obligation, bangod ginabayaan sang driver ang iya responsibilidad sa biktima.
english: According to Atty. Geduspan said hit-and-run cases are considered negligence of obligation, because the driver abandons his responsibility to the victim.

text: Pahayag sini, bisan ano pa ang rason sang driver sa natabo nga vehicular accident kun makita nga may negligence sa pagmaneho, mahimo ini nga mangin basehan agud hatagan sang show cause order ang driver kag posible man nga ma-revoke ang iya driver’s license.
english: He said that no matter what the driver's reason for the vehicular accident, if it is found that there is negligence in driving, it can be the basis for issuing a show cause order to the driver and possible revocation of his driver's license.

text: Dugang pa sang Director nga ang amo nga insidente nagapakita nga madamo pa gihapon nga mga driver ang kulang sa disiplina sa dalan, bisan may yara na sang mga layi nga ginapatuman ang gobyerno para sa road safety.
english: The Director added that the incident shows that many drivers still lack discipline on the road, even though there are laws implemented by the government for road safety.

text: Words by: Bombo Krylle Melliza
english: Words by: Bombo Krylle Melliza

text: Indi anay makahampang ang guard sang Portland Trail Blazers nga si Scoot Henderson matapos siya nakaangkon sang injury sa iya tuo nga hamstring, rason nga posible siya madula sa sulod sang apat tubtob walo ka semana, suno sa opisyal nga pahayag sang team.
english: Portland Trail Blazers guard Scoot Henderson is temporarily out after suffering an injury to his right hamstring, causing him to potentially miss four to eight weeks, according to an official team statement.

text: Natabo ang injury samtang naga-ensayo siya sa offseason, kabangdanan nga indi siya makaupod sa pag-umpisa sang training camp sang Blazers sa masunod nga semana.
english: The injury occurred while he was practicing in the offseason, causing him to miss the start of the Blazers’ training camp next week.

text: Si Henderson, 21-anyos, ginalauman nga mangin isa sa mga lider sang team sa masunod nga NBA season, ilabi na matapos ang pagsaylo ni Anfernee Simons sa Boston Celtics.
english: Henderson, 21-years-old, is expected to be one of the team’s leaders in the upcoming NBA season, especially after the move of Anfernee Simons to the Boston Celtics.

text: Suno sa record sang nagligad nga season, nakakuha si Henderson sang average nga 12.7 puntos, 5.1 ka assists, kag 3 ka rebounds kada hampang.
english: According to last season’s record, Henderson averaged 12.7 points, 5.1 assists, and 3 rebounds per game.

text: Ginpierde sang Australia ang team sang Argentina sa quarterfinals sang men’s basketball sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics, 97-59.
english: Australia defeated the Argentina team in the quarterfinals of men’s basketball at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, 97-59.

text: Ang resulta sang hampang amo man ang naga-signal sang pagretiro sang basketball legend nga si Luis Scola sang Argentina.
english: The result of the game also signals the retirement of basketball legend Luis Scola of Argentina.

text: Ginakabig nga isa sa greatest basketball athletes of all time ang 41 anyos nga si Scola, kag sang natapos ang hampang nila batok sa Australia subong nga adlaw, nabaton niya ang pagdayaw nga nagakaangay para sa iya.
english: The 41-year-old Scola is considered one of the greatest basketball athletes of all time, and after today's game against Australia, he received the praise he deserved.

text: Nakaangkon si Scola sang standing ovation gikan sa iya mga teammates pati na halin sa mga Australians.
english: Scola received a standing ovation from his teammates as well as from the Australians.

text: Ini na posible ang final game sang iya international playing career.
english: This is likely to be the final game of his international playing career.

text: Nangin emosyonal man si Scola sa bench samtang ginpabutyag sang iya mga teammates ang pagpasalamat sa iya kontribusyon sa hampang.
english: Scola also became emotional on the bench as his teammates expressed gratitude for his contribution to the game.

text: Sang 2004, ginbuligan ni Scola ang Argentina nga daugon ang Estados Unidos sa gold medal match sa basketball sa Athens.
english: In 2004, Scola helped Argentina defeat the United States in the gold medal match in basketball in Athens.

text: Antes ang hampang sang amo nga tuig, ang Estados Unidos ang nakarekord sang tatlo ka asud-asud nga daug, kag ang kadalalag-an sang Argentina batok sa ila amo ang ginkabig isa sa biggest upsets sa Olympic history.
english: Before that year's games, the United States had recorded three straight wins, and Argentina's victory over them was considered one of the biggest upsets in Olympic history.

text: Magluwas diri, si Scola ang may yara man sang decade-long nga NBA career.
english: Besides, Scola also had a decade-long NBA career.

text: Nakahampang siya sa Houston Rockets, Phoenix Suns, Indiana Pacers, Toronto Raptors kag Brooklyn Nets.
english: He played with the Houston Rockets, Phoenix Suns, Indiana Pacers, Toronto Raptors and Brooklyn Nets.

text: Sang 2008, ginkilala siya sa NBA All-Rookie First Team.
english: In 2008, he was named to the NBA All-Rookie First Team.

text: Sang damlag lang, nakahampang man si Scola sa Pallacanestro Varese sang Lega Basket Serie A (LBA) sang Italya.
english: Most recently, Scola also played for Pallacanestro Varese of Italy’s Lega Basket Serie A (LBA).

text: Patay ang 30-anyos nga lalaki matapos gintiro sa Brgy.
english: A 30-year-old man was shot dead in Brgy.

text: Cato-ogan, Pototan, Iloilo.
english: Cato-ogan, Pototan, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Kenneth De Asis, samtang ang ginatudlo suspek amo kanday Alyas Pula kag Alyas Tagi lunsay residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Kenneth De Asis, while the suspects were identified as Pula and Tagi, both residents of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jocelyn De Asis, Iloy sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga nagpanawag ang mga suspek sa ila puluy-an kag ginapangita ang iya bana nga amay sang biktima kag ginpahayag nga ginpakitaan ini ni Alyas Pula sang armas nga nataklos sa iya hawak.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jocelyn De Asis, the victim's mother, said the suspects called their house and were looking for her husband, the victim's father.

text: Didto na kag nagdalagan papalayo si Jocelyn kag nakasulod sa ila puluy-an ang mga suspek apang wala sang mga ini nakita ang amay sang biktima sa baylo, si Kenneth ang ila nakita kag ginlagas.
english: Jocelyn then ran away and the suspects entered their house but they did not see the victim's father instead, they saw Kenneth and chased him.

text: Nakabati nalang ang mga katupad balay sini sang tatlo ka lupok kun sa diin may ara sang gunshot wound ang biktima sa iya ulo.
english: The neighbors heard three gunshots and the victim had a gunshot wound in his head.

text: Pahayag sang pamilya sang biktima, may nakita ini sila nga basiyo 15 tubtob 20 metros gikan sa lawas sang biktima.
english: According to the victim's family, they saw a stain 15 to 20 meters from the victim's body.

text: Wala naman sang ginatan-aw nga motibo ang pamilya sang biktima kun ngaa ini ang gintiro-patay.
english: The victim's family has no motive for the shooting.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga si Alyas Tagi amo ang tag-iya sang duta nga ginatindugan sang ila balay ginabulubanta 30 na ka tuig.
english: He also said that Tagi is the owner of the land on which their house is located for about 30 years.

text: Nagsungka naman si Alyas Tagi kag ara subong sa kustodiya sang Pototan Municipal Police Station samtang padayon nga ginapangita si Alyas Pula.
english: Tagi surrendered and is now in the custody of the Pototan Municipal Police Station while Pula is still being sought.

text: Mas apektado ang negosyo sang mga kababainhan kun ipaanggid sa mga lalaki kasunod sang pagnubo sang ila kita sang nag-umpisa ang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Women's businesses were more affected than men's following the decline in their income during the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Santo sa report sang International Finance Corporation (IFC), nagnubo sa 27 percent ang sales sang women-owned businesses sa Pilipinas humalin sang nagligad nga tuig kasunod sang pandemic-induced economic recession.
english: According to a report by the International Finance Corporation (IFC), sales of women-owned businesses in the Philippines have declined by 27 percent since last year following the pandemic-induced economic recession.

text: Sa mga manugbaligya sa online application nga Philippine marketplace, two-thirds diri ang lunsay mga babaye nga amo ang kalabanan nadulaan sang trabaho sa opisina kag nagventure sa online selling bangud sa economic difficulties tuga sang nagapadayon nga pandemya.
english: Of the sellers in the online application Philippine marketplace, two-thirds are women, most of whom lost their office jobs and ventured into online selling due to economic difficulties caused by the ongoing pandemic.

text: Santo sa report sang 2019, mas mataas ang gross merchandise value sang mga kababainhan kun ipaanggid sa mga lalaki.
english: According to the 2019 report, women have a higher gross merchandise value compared to men.

text: Apang ang average gross merchandise value sang mga negosyo sang mga kababainhan ang nagnubo halin sa 106 percent sang wala pa nag-umpisa ang pandemya sa 79 percent sa tion sang pandemya.
english: But the average gross merchandise value of women-owned businesses dropped from 106 percent before the pandemic to 79 percent during the pandemic.

text: Gintawag ni President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand ”Bongbong” Marcos Jr. called

text: nga isa ka akto sang economic sabotage ang dalagko nga mga maanomaliya kag ghost flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: that the major anomalies and ghost flood control projects in the country are an act of economic sabotage.

text: Suno kay Marcos, kun kinahanglan pasakaan sang kaso ang mga involved sa palpak nga mga proyekto, handa gid ini.
english: Marcos said that if those involved in failed projects need to be prosecuted, he is ready.

text: Ginhalimbawa pa sini ang gin-inspect niya nga reinforced concrete riverwall project sa Purok 4 sa Barangay Piel, Baliuag, Bulacan nga suno sa iya, ehemplo sang falsification of documents bangud base sa records, natapos na ini apang sang iya ginlantaw, wala pa ini nakompleto.
english: He cited the reinforced concrete riverwall project he inspected in Purok 4 in Barangay Piel, Baliuag, Bulacan which, according to him, is an example of falsification of documents because based on records, it has been completed but when he looked at it, it has not been completed.

text: Suno sa president, kun insakto ang pagpatuman sang sini nga mga proyekto, nabuhinan kuntani ang utang sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the president, if these projects were implemented properly, the Philippines' debt would have been reduced.

text: Gin-athag naman ni Marcos nga ang pagpasaka sang kaso ang magadepende sa findings sang legal team nga nagatrabaho sini.
english: Marcos explained that the filing of the case will depend on the findings of the legal team working on it.

text: Sa iya naman paglantaw sa nasambit nga proyekto sa Bulacan, ginsiling sang president nga labaw sa pagkadismaya, tuman nga kaakig ang iya nabatyagan bangud sa palpak nga proyekto.
english: In his view of the said project in Bulacan, the president said that besides disappointment, he felt very angry because of the failed project.

text: Ginkawatan si Comelec Chairman George Garcia samtang nagakaon sa isa ka restaurant sa Pasay City.
english: Comelec Chairman George Garcia was robbed while eating at a restaurant in Pasay City.

text: Natabo ini kahapon sang udto, Agusto 19.
english: This happened yesterday at noon, August 19th.

text: Suno kay Garcia, namutikan niya nga wala na ang iya bag nga nagaunod sang P12,000, cellphone kag mga ID.
english: According to Garcia, he noticed that his bag containing P12,000, cellphone and IDs were gone.

text: Base naman sa kuha sang CCTV, isa ka grupo ang sa likod sang pagsalisi sa iya.
english: Based on CCTV footage, a group was behind the attack.

text: Nagtaas sang 1.4 percent ang revenue ukon kita sang business process outsourcing (BPO) sang 2020 sa pihak sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Business process outsourcing (BPO) revenue increased by 1.4 percent in 2020 despite the COVID-19 pandemic.

text:
Suno kay Rey Untal, Presidente kag Chief Executive Officer sang IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines, nagdangat sa $26.7 billion ukon P1.2 trillion ang kabug-usan nga kita sang ila industriya humalin sang nagpatuman sila sang flexible work arrangements agud masigurado ang padayon nga operasyon sa tunga sang pandemya

Samtang, nagdangat naman sa 1.8 percent ang dugang nga ginhire sang mga BPO companies sang 2020 ukon may kabug-usan nga 1.32 million direct employment sa Pilipinas.
english:
According to Rey Untal, President and Chief Executive Officer of the IT and Business Process Association of the Philippines, the total revenue of their industry has reached $26.7 billion or P1.2 trillion since they implemented flexible work arrangements to ensure continued operations amid the pandemic

Meanwhile, BPO companies hired 1.8 percent more in 2020 or a total of 1.32 million direct employment in the Philippines.

text: “Noong tiningnan po namin ang statistics noong 2020, nakakagulat po at kami po ay lumaki pa rin kahit hindi ganoong kalakihan ang aming pag-grow.
english: “When we looked at the statistics in 2020, it was surprising that we were still growing even though our growth was not that big.

text: I think from a headcount standpoint, lumago po kami ng 1.8 percent and another 1.4 percent po sa revenue,” pahayag ni Untal.
english: I think from a headcount standpoint, we grew 1.8 percent and another 1.4 percent in revenue,” Untal said.

text: Ginpasalamatan man ni Untal ang gobyerno sa pagkilala sa mga BPO employees bilang essential workers, sa diin ginpasugtan sila nga magtrabaho apisar may pandemya.
english: Untal also thanked the government for recognizing BPO employees as essential workers, allowing them to work despite the pandemic.

text: Sa subong, ginahandaan na sang BPO companies ang vaccination sang ila mga empleyado gamit ang 1 million doses sang vaccines nga ginbakal pinaagi sa tripartite agreement kaupod ang national government kag vaccine manufacturers.
english: Currently, BPO companies are preparing for the vaccination of their employees using 1 million doses of vaccines purchased through a tripartite agreement with the national government and vaccine manufacturers.

text: Subong nga tuig, ginapanan-aw ni Untal nga magtaas pa sa 5 tubtub 6.5 percent ang kita sang mga BPO companies.
english: This year, Untal expects the revenue of BPO companies to increase by 5 to 6.5 percent.

text: “So mukhang ang sentimyento ng mga negosyante, at country heads ay positibo ayon sa paglaki ng industriya ngayong 2021.”
english: “So it seems that the sentiment of businessmen, and country heads is positive in terms of the growth of the industry in 2021.”

text: Nagpaandam ang United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF)sa halos tunga sa bilyon ka mga kabataan ang naga-eksperyensya sang extreme heat nga kainit kada tuig — ukon kapin pa — kon ikumpara sa mga tigulang.
english: The United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF)has warned that nearly half a billion children experience extreme heat every year — or more — compared to adults.

text: Samtang ang pagbag-o sang klima padayon nga nagapataas sang temperatura sa bug-os nga kalibutan, isa sa lima ka kabataan — ukon 466 million ka kabataan — ang nagapuyo sa mga nakarehistro nga “at least double the number of extremely hot days every year” kon ipaanggid sa 60 ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: As climate change continues to raise temperatures around the world, one in five children — or 466 million children — live in those that register “at least double the number of extremely hot days every year” compared with 60 years ago.

text: Suno kay UNICEF advocacy chief Lily Caprani, ang mga lawas sang magagmay nga kabataan indi pareho sang magagmay nga mga adults, sila ang mas vulnerable sa tuman nga kainit.
english: According to UNICEF advocacy chief Lily Caprani, the bodies of young children are not like small adults, they are more vulnerable to extreme heat.

text: Nagpaandam man ang natungdan sa publiko ilabi sang mga katalagman para sa mga nagabusong nga mga babayi.
english: He also warned the public especially of the dangers for pregnant women.

text: Dugang pa, ang mga kabataan nagakadulaan sang edukasyon kon ang mga eskwelahan napilitan nga magsirado bangud sang mataas nga temperatura — nga nakaapekto sa indi magkubos sa 80 million ka kabataan sang 2024 tubtob subong.
english: In addition, children lose out on education when schools are forced to close due to high temperatures — affecting at least 80 million children in 2024 so far.

text: ILOILO CITY – Agaw atensyon ang rosy trumpet tree sa Sen.
english: ILOILO CITY – The rosy trumpet tree in Sen.

text: Benigno Aquino Jr.
english: Benigno Aquino Jr.

text: Avenue, Mandurriao, Iloilo City nga kasubong sang cherry blossoms sa Japan.
english: Avenue, Mandurriao, Iloilo City that looks like cherry blossoms in Japan.

text: Ang scientific name sang nasambit nga rosy trumpet tree ang ginatawag nga Tabebuia rosea kag ginakabig nga national tree sang El Salvador.
english: The scientific name of the rosy trumpet tree is Tabebuia rosea and is considered the national tree of El Salvador.

text: Madamu ang mga nagapakuha sang laragway sa nasambit nga rosy trumpet tree nga trending pa sa social media.
english: Many people are taking pictures of the rosy trumpet tree that is still trending on social media.

text: Suno kay Engr.
english: According to Engr.

text: Al Fruto, assistant regional director sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6, ang pagtanum sang nasambit nga tanum ang ginpanugyan sang isa ka private consultancy firm.
english: Al Fruto, assistant regional director of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) 6, said the planting of the plant was suggested by a private consultancy firm.

text: Ini bangud nga ang rosy trumpet tree ang nagapamulak sa tion sang tig-ilinit kag makasarang nga mabuhi sa pihak sang tuman ka init nga tiyempo.
english: This is because the rosy trumpet tree blooms during the summer and can survive in extreme heat.

text: Dakop ang aborsyonista, menor de edad sini nga anak, kag duha ka iban pa sa duha ka separado nga drug buy-bust operations sa Balasan, Iloilo.
english: The abortionist, her minor child, and two others were arrested in two separate drug buy-bust operations in Balasan, Iloilo.

text: Ang una nga nadakpan amo si Alyas Madam kag 15-anyos sini nga anak nga lalaki sa Brgy.
english: The first arrested were Alias ​​Madam and her 15-year-old son in Brgy.

text: Balantian, Balasan.
english: Revenge, Reply.

text: Dakop man sa follow-up operation sanday Alyas Con, 38-anyos, kag Alyas Athan, 37-anyos, sa Brgy.
english: Also arrested in the follow-up operation were Alyas Con, 38, and Alyas Athan, 37, in Brgy.

text: Camambugan, Balasan, Iloilo.
english: Camambugan, Balasan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Renzo Martinez, hepe sang Balasan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ginabanta tatlo ka bulan ang monitoring sa mga nadakpan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Renzo Martinez, chief of the Balasan Municipal Police Station, said the monitoring of the arrested persons has been going on for about three months.

text: Suno kay Martinez, ginahimo ang transaction ni Alyas Madam sa ila balay kag ginagamit ang iya sini 15-anyos nga bata bilang runner.
english: According to Martinez, the transaction was done by Alyas Madam at their house and used her 15-year-old son as a runner.

text: Nakuha sa mag-iloy ang P707,200 nga balor sang ginapasuni shabu.
english: The mother and daughter were recovered with P707,200 worth of suspected shabu.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, sa ila follow-up operation, nakuha ang P494, 363 balor sang ginapasuni shabu gikan kanday Alyas Con kag Athan.
english: He added that in their follow-up operation, P494,363 worth of suspected shabu was recovered from Alyas Con and Athan.

text: Yara subong sa Balasan Municipal Police Station ang tatlo ka mga indibidwal nga legal ang pang-edaron samtang ginturn-over naman sa MSWDO ang menor de edad.
english: The three individuals of legal age are now at the Balasan Municipal Police Station while the minor was turned over to the MSWDO.

text: Naglab-ot sa 4.63 million metric tons ang ani sang humay sa una nga quarter sang 2021.
english: The rice harvest in the first quarter of 2021 reached 4.63 million metric tons.

text: Nalapawan sini sang 9 percent ang rekord sang nagligad nga tuig kag sang 2018.
english: This surpassed last year's and 2018's record by 9 percent.

text: Suno kay John de Leon, director sang Philippine Rice Research Institute, ang rekord subong nga first quarter sang tuig sa produksyon sang humay ang nagpasangkad pa sang ila kumpyansa nga malab-ot ukon malapawan pa ang 20.4 million nga target production para sa 2021.
english: According to John de Leon, director of the Philippine Rice Research Institute, the record in the first quarter of the year in rice production has further enhanced their confidence to reach or exceed the 20.4 million target production for 2021.

text: Pahayag ni de Leon, ang pagtimbuok sang rice production subong na tuig ang bunga sang leksyon nga ila natun-an sang nagligad nga tuig sa diin naapektuhan ang mga pananom bangud sa mga naglabay nga bagyo.
english: De Leon said the increase in rice production this year is the result of the lessons they learned last year where crops were affected due to past typhoons.

text: Bangud sa estable nga supply sang bugas sa pungsod, ginakwestyon man ang motibo sa likod sang pag-apruba ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa pagpanubo sa taripa sang imported rice.
english: Due to the stable supply of rice in the country, the motive behind President Rodrigo Duterte's approval to reduce the tariff on imported rice is also questioned.

text: 𝗚𝗔𝗭𝗔 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗣 —Naglab-ot na sa kapin sa 40,000 ka mga Palestinian ang napatay sa Gaza halin sang ginlunsar sang Israel ang ila inaway batok sa Hamas kasunod sang pag-atake sang grupo sang Oktubre 7 sang tinalikdan nga tuig.
english: 𝗚𝗔𝗭𝗔 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗜𝗣 —More than 40,000 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since Israel launched its war against Hamas following the group’s Oct. 7 attack last year.

text: Suno sa ministry, 40 ka tawo ang napatay sa Gaza sa sulod sang nagligad nga 24 oras, nga nagdala sang kabug-usan nga numero sang mga napatay halin sang Oktubre 7 sa 40,005 – mga isa sa kada 55 ka tawo sa enclave, kon sa diin, 92,401 ang napilasan.
english: According to the ministry, 40 people have been killed in Gaza in the past 24 hours, bringing the total death toll since October 7 to 40,005 – about one for every 55 people in the enclave, whereas, 92,401 have been injured.

text: Kalabanan sang mga napatay mga kababayin-an kag kabataan.
english: Most of the dead were women and children.

text: Ginpahayag sang Israel sang nagligad nga bulan nga nakapatay sila sang masobra 14,000 ka mga combatants sa Gaza halin sang nagsugod ang inaway.
english: Israel said last month that it had killed more than 14,000 combatants in Gaza since the war began.

text: Dugang pa, indi magkubos sa 10,000 pa ka tawo ang nadula kag ginapatihan nga nalubong sa idalom sang mga duta sa Gaza.
english: In addition, at least 10,000 more people are missing and believed to be buried underground in Gaza.

text: Nahibaluan man nga ang nagasaka nga mga numero ang nagahatag sang rason sa adlaw-adlaw nga pag-antos kag malnutrisyon sa Gaza, pagkatapos sang 10 ka bulan nga inaway.
english: It is also known that the rising numbers account for the daily suffering and malnutrition in Gaza, after 10 months of war.

text: Ginalauman naman nga ang ceasefire talks nga nagsugod sang Huwebes, ang mangin epektibo kasunod sang pagpatay sa mataas nga mga tinawo sang Hamas kag militante nga grupo sang Lebanon nga ginasakdag sang Iran nga Hezbollah, rason man nga nagtulod sang liderato sang duha ka organisasyon nga maghimo sang negosasyon.
english: The ceasefire talks, which began on Thursday, are expected to take effect following the killing of senior Hamas figures and the Iranian-backed Lebanese militant group Hezbollah, which also prompted the leadership of the two organizations to hold negotiations.

text: Kumpirmado ng Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) na isa sa mga pangunahing tatalakayin sa nakatakdang bilateral consultation mechanism sa pagitan ng Pilipinas at China ay ang banggaan ng dalawang Chinese vessel sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) confirmed that one of the main topics of discussion in the scheduled bilateral consultation mechanism between the Philippines and China is the collision of two Chinese vessels in Bajo de Masinloc.

text: Ayon kay DFA Undersecretary Theresa Lazaro, kabilang sa mga karaniwang paksa sa mga ganitong bilateral talks ang lahat ng isyu sa South China Sea, kaya’t inaasahang mabibigyang-linaw ang naturang insidente.
english: According to DFA Undersecretary Theresa Lazaro, among the usual topics in such bilateral talks are all issues in the South China Sea, so it is expected that the incident will be clarified.

text: Aniya, ang ganitong mekanismo ang epektibong channel ng komunikasyon ng dalawang bansa.
english: He said this mechanism is an effective channel of communication between the two countries.

text: Samantala, isang linggo matapos ang insidente, nagsagawa ng joint sailing ang mga barkong pandigma ng Pilipinas, Australia, at Canada malapit sa Lubang Island, Mindoro noong Agosto 17.
english: Meanwhile, a week after the incident, Philippine, Australian, and Canadian warships conducted a joint sailing near Lubang Island, Mindoro on August 17.

text: Bahagi ito ng Philippine-Australia Alon Military Exercises.
english: It is part of the Philippine-Australia Alon Military Exercises.

text: Ayon sa Philippine Navy, epektibo ang mga ganitong pagsasanay sa pagbawas ng coercive actions mula sa China.
english: According to the Philippine Navy, such exercises are effective in reducing coercive actions from China.

text: Ipinahayag ni Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad na napapansin nilang nagiging maingat ang kilos ng China kapag may presensiya ng mga foreign warships sa loob ng ating maritime domain.
english: Rear Admiral Roy Vincent Trinidad said they have noticed that China is becoming more cautious when there is a presence of foreign warships within our maritime domain.

text: Gayunpaman, nang tanungin kung dapat bang mas aktibo na ang Navy sa pagtugon sa agresyon ng China, sinabi ni Trinidad na speculative pa ang ganitong premise, at ang desisyon ay nakasalalay sa unified commander.
english: However, when asked whether the Navy should be more active in responding to Chinese aggression, Trinidad said that such a premise is still speculative, and the decision is up to the unified commander.

text: Tiniyak niyang handa ang Armed Forces of the Philippines na magbigay ng suporta kung kinakailangan.
english: He assured that the Armed Forces of the Philippines is ready to provide support if needed.

text: Samantala, nagbabala ang security analyst na si Renato de Castro na maaaring gumanti ang China laban sa puwersa ng Pilipinas upang ipakita na hindi basta-basta mapapahiya ang Beijing.
english: Meanwhile, security analyst Renato de Castro warned that China could retaliate against Philippine forces to show that Beijing cannot be easily humiliated.

text: Ayon sa kanya, may impormasyon na plano ng Chinese Coast Guard na magsagawa ng patrol sa loob ng 12 nautical miles ng teritoryo ng Pilipinas, partikular sa paligid ng Manila Bay.
english: According to him, there is information that the Chinese Coast Guard plans to conduct patrols within 12 nautical miles of Philippine territory, particularly around Manila Bay.

text: Sa kabilang banda, iginiit ng National Maritime Council (NMC) na hindi papayagan ang Philippine Navy na samahan ang Philippine Coast Guard sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: On the other hand, the National Maritime Council (NMC) insisted that the Philippine Navy will not be allowed to join the Philippine Coast Guard in Bajo de Masinloc.

text: Ayon sa tagapagsalita ng NMC na si Alexander Lopez, malinaw ang direktiba ng Pangulo na iwasan ang anumang provocation upang maiwasan ang miscalculation na maaaring humantong sa eskalasyon ng tension
english: According to NMC spokesperson Alexander Lopez, the President's directive is clear to avoid any provocation to avoid miscalculation that could lead to escalation of tensions

text: Gintay-og sang 5.7 magnitude nga linog ang Yilan nga isa ka northeastern county sang Taiwan.
english: A 5.7 magnitude earthquake shook Yilan, a northeastern county in Taiwan.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang central weather administration apang wala pa sang nagsulod nga reports kaangot sa damage.
english: This was confirmed by the central weather administration but no reports have been received regarding the damage.

text: Nag-uyog man mangin ang mga building sa capital nga Taipei.
english: Even buildings in the capital, Taipei, shook.

text: Suno sa otoridad, ginpadayon ang subway services apang ginpahinay lamang bangud man sa amo nga linog.
english: According to the authorities, subway services continued but were slowed down due to the earthquake.

text: Katapusan nga may natabo nga pinakamakahalalit nga linog sa Taiwan sang Abril kun sa diin siyam ka tawo ang patay kag masobra 900 ang nasamaran.
english: The last time there was a devastating earthquake in Taiwan was in April when nine people were killed and more than 900 injured.

text: Ini ang ginkabig biggest earthquake sa amo nga isla sa sulod sang 25 ka tuig.
english: It was considered the biggest earthquake on the island in 25 years.

text: ILOILO CITY- Dako ang pagpati sang pamilya sang Pinoy boxer nga si Carlo Paalam nga masarangan sini nga makuha ang bulawan nga medalya sa Olympics.
english: ILOILO CITY – The family of Filipino boxer Carlo Paalam believes that he can win the gold medal in the Olympics.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Michelyn Mae Paalam, utod ni Carlo, iya ginpahayag nga handom kag sakripisyo ang kapital sang iya utod nga isa sadto ka basurero antes nangin isa ka boksedor sa edad nga siyam ka tuig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Michelyn Mae Paalam, Carlo's sister, said her brother's capital, who was a garbage collector before becoming a boxer at the age of nine, was a dream and sacrifice.

text: Suno kay Michelyn Mae, inspirasyon ni Carlo ang iya pamilya nga apisar nagbulagay ang ila ginikanan, wala man nagakulang ang mga ini nga magsuporta sa ila nga walo ka mag-utod.
english: According to Michelyn Mae, Carlo is an inspiration to her family that despite the separation of their parents, they do not fail to support their eight siblings.

text: Pahayag niya, pagbulig sa pamilya ang iya katuyuan kon ngaa ginsulod sini ang boxing kag amat-amat na ini nga nahatagan sang katumanan.
english: He said that helping his family is his goal why he entered boxing and gradually it has been given fulfillment.

text: Pinagkukomento ngayon ng Kataastaasang Hukuman ang mga ‘respondents’ sa inihaing petisyon ni Atty. Romulo Macalintal patungkol sa postponement ng Barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan Elections 2025.
english: The Supreme Court is now commenting on the respondents in the petition filed by Atty. Romulo Macalintal regarding the postponement of the Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections 2025.

text: Sa ipinadalang mensahe ni Supreme Court Spokesperson Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting, kanyang ibinahagi na inatasan ng Korte Suprema ang Senado, House of Representatives, Executive Secretary Lucas P. Bersamin, at Commission on Elections magkumento hinggil sa petisyon.
english: In a message sent by Supreme Court Spokesperson Atty. Camille Sue Mae Ting, she shared that the Supreme Court has instructed the Senate, House of Representatives, Executive Secretary Lucas P. Bersamin, and Commission on Elections to comment on the petition.

text: Ang naturang kautusan ng Korte Suprema ay kasunod sa isinagawang En Banc session nito kung saan tinalakay ang petisyong partikular sa G.R. No.
english: The said order of the Supreme Court follows its En Banc session where the petition particularly in G.R. No.

text: Maaalalang inihain ni Atty. Romulo Macalintal ang naturang petisyon upang kwestyunin ang nilagdaang batas ni Pangulong Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr.
english: It is recalled that Atty. Romulo Macalintal filed a petition to question the law signed by President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos Jr.

text: na sanhi upang hindi matuloy ngayong taon ang eleksyon o BSKE 2025.
english: the reason why the election or BSKE 2025 will not be held this year.

text: Hiling niya sa kanyang petisyon na magawaran at pagbigyan ng Korte Suprema na mag-isyu ito ng Temporary Restraining Order o TRO para pigilan ang pagpapaliban sa eleksyon.
english: He asked the Supreme Court to issue a Temporary Restraining Order or TRO to prevent the postponement of the election.

text: Binigyan ang mga respondents ng hindi tatagal sa sampung (10) araw upang ibahagi ang kanilang kumento sa Korte Suprema.
english: The respondents were given no more than ten (10) days to submit their comments to the Supreme Court.

text: Gin-arado sang truck ang duha ka mga motorsiklo kag duha pa ka mga salakyan sa New Site, Barangay San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras subong nga hapon.
english: A truck plowed into two motorcycles and two other vehicles in New Site, Barangay San Miguel, Jordan, Guimaras this afternoon.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Kevin Bacongallo, hepe sang Jordan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naghalin ang mga salakyan sa Barangay Alaguisoc kag pakadto kuntani sa Barangay San Miguel sang pag-abot sa tubang sang pulic market sang amo nga banwa, nadulaan sang preno ang truck kag nabunggoan ang ginasundan sini nga duha ka motorsiklo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Kevin Bacongallo, chief of the Jordan Municipal Police Station, said the vehicles were leaving Barangay Alaguisoc and were heading to Barangay San Miguel when they arrived in front of the pulic market of the town when the truck lost its brakes and collided with the two motorcycles it was following.

text: Suno kay Bacongallo, bangud sa impact, nakaagum sang pilas kag gasgas sa tuo nga tiil ang driver sang isa ka motorsiklo.Gilayon man ini nga gindala sa malapit nga ospital kag gindapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: According to Bacongallo, due to the impact, the driver of a motorcycle sustained injuries and bruises on his right leg. He was immediately brought to a nearby hospital for treatment.

text: Nakadesisyon man ang tanan nga mga driver kag tag-iya sang mga salakyan nga maga-areglohanay nalang.
english: All the drivers and owners of the vehicles also decided to settle.

text: Article by: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: Article by: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Diutayan na lang nga maka-secure sang bronze medal ang 21 anyos nga si Carlos ‘Caloy’ Yulo sa final event sang men’s vault sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: 21-year-old Carlos 'Caloy' Yulo almost secured a bronze medal in the final event of the men's vault at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Nagpang-apat si Yulo matapos naka-average score sang 14.716 (14.56 sa first attempt kag 14.866 sa second attempt).
english: Yulo finished fourth with an average score of 14.716 (14.56 in the first attempt and 14.866 in the second attempt).

text: Gold medalist sa amo nga hampang si Shin Jeahwan sang South Korea, silver medalist ang Russia Olympic Committee, kag bronze medalist ang Armenia.
english: South Korea's Shin Jeahwan was a gold medalist, the Russian Olympic Committee was a silver medalist, and Armenia was a bronze medalist.

text: Pagkatapos sang event, nagpasalamat man ang 21 anyos nga Filipino gymnast sa mga nagsuporta sa iya kag sa iya nga team.
english: After the event, the 21-year-old Filipino gymnast also thanked those who supported her and her team.

text: Suno kay Yulo, magabalik siya nga mas makusog na para sa Paris 2024 Olympics.
english: Yulo said he will come back stronger for the Paris 2024 Olympics.

text: Balik sa presuhan ang isa ka 40-anyos nga lalaki matapos siya nga ginreklamo sang iya 61-anyos nga iloy sang paghimulos sa iya.
english: A 40-year-old man is back in jail after his 61-year-old mother accused him of raping her.

text: Natabo ang krimen sa balay sang biktima sa Candijay, Bohol sang Septyembre 27 sang kaagahon.
english: The crime occurred at the victim's house in Candijay, Bohol on September 27 morning.

text: Suno sa iloy, indi lang ini ang una nga bes nga ginhimuslan siya sang iya anak.
english: According to the mother, this is not the first time her son has raped her.

text: Nagpangayo sang bulig ang iloy sa ila barangay kag gindangop ini sa Candijay Police Station nga nagresulta sa gilayon nga pagdakop sa anak.
english: The mother sought help from her barangay and turned to the Candijay Police Station which resulted in the immediate arrest of her son.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sang Septyembre 18 lang nakagwa ang suspek matapos mapreso sang 14 ka tuig sa kaso nga murder.
english: According to the investigation, the suspect was released on September 18 after serving 14 years in prison for murder.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang iloy nga una siya nga ginhimuslan sang 40-anyos pa lang ini.
english: The mother also revealed that she was first raped when she was 40 years old.

text: Suno sa iya, ginapahog man siya sang iya bata nga patyon kun manugid ini.
english: She said her son also threatened to kill her if she told anyone.

text: Sang matabo ang krimen, hubog ang suspek.
english: When the crime occurred, the suspect was drunk.

text: Nasaksihan naman sang anak nga babaye sang suspek ang ginahimo sang iya amay kag nahadlok nga himuon man ini sa iya gani nangisog ang biktima nga mangayo sang bulig sa otoridad.
english: The suspect's daughter witnessed her father's actions and was afraid that the victim would do the same to her.

text: Nagsaka na sa 73 ang na-record sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 nga nagbayolar sa Commission on Elections (COMELEC) gun ban.
english: The Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 has recorded 73 violations of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) gun ban.

text: Nakumpiskar diri ang 73 ka mga armas kag 4 ka mga gun replica.
english: Seventy-three firearms and four gun replicas were seized.

text:
Yari ang breakdown sang mga naaresto sang kada police unit:

Gindayaw man ni PRO 6 Director, Police Brigadier General Jack L. Wanky ang tanan nga mga kapulisan sa ila dedikasyon sa ila trabaho.
english:
Here is a breakdown of those arrested by each police unit:

PRO 6 Director, Police Brigadier General Jack L. Wanky also commended all the policemen for their dedication to their work.

text: Dugang ni Wanky, magaserbe ini nga pahanumdom sa publiko nga apisar natapos na ang eleksyon, magapabilin sa gihapon sa mga dalanon kag magapatigayon sang COMELEC checkpoint ang mga kapulisan sa bug-os nga Western Visayas tubtob June 11, 2025.
english: Wanky added that this will serve as a reminder to the public that although the election is over, the police will remain on the streets and conduct COMELEC checkpoints throughout Western Visayas until June 11, 2025.
