english: Article by: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: Ginkumirpa ni DBM Sec.
english: DBM confirmed Sec.

text: Amenah Pangandaman nga may yara sang “positive development” sa 2023 Performace-Based Bonus sang DepEd teachers.
english: Amenah Pangandaman said there will be a “positive development” in the 2023 Performace-Based Bonus of DepEd teachers.

text: Sa pagkwestyon ni House Deputy Minority Leader kag ACT Teachers party-list Representative Antonio Tinio, naghingyo siya sang kumpirmasyon halin sa DBM kun matuod nga may mayo nga balita para sa mga teachers tuhoy sa ila PBB.
english: When questioned by House Deputy Minority Leader and ACT Teachers party-list Representative Antonio Tinio, he asked for confirmation from the DBM if there is indeed good news for teachers regarding their PBB.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga gindeklarar nga ineligible ang DEPED para sa 2023 PBB bangud sa manubo nga grado sang ila performance indicators.
english: It can be recalled that DEPED was earlier declared ineligible for the 2023 PBB due to the low grade of its performance indicators.

text:
Apang, nag-file sang request for review para ini ang magbag-o.

Suno kay Sec.
english:
However, a request for review was filed for this to change.

According to Sec.

text: Pangandaman, ginahulat nalang ang pirmado nga resolusyon halin sa technical working group agud mapagguwa ang pondo para diri.
english: As a precaution, we are waiting for the signed resolution from the technical working group to release the funds for this.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Tinio nga kuntani himuon nga madasig ang pagproseso sini agud mabaton na sang mga manunudlo ang ila madugay na nga ginahulat nga benepisyo.
english: Tinio said he hopes to expedite the processing so that teachers can receive their long-awaited benefits.

text: Ang paghahain ng senador ng panukalang batas ay kasabay ng pagbibitiw ni Nadia Montenegro bilang political affairs officer VI sa kanyang opisina.
english: The senator's presentation of the bill coincides with the resignation of Nadia Montenegro as political affairs officer VI in her office.

text: Agaw atensyon ang isa ka Mangyan sang ginkuha sini ang iya diploma suksok ang tradisyunal nga bahag sa graduation sini sa kolehiyo sa Iloilo.
english: A Mangyan attracted attention when he took his diploma wearing a traditional bahag at his graduation from a college in Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Anthony Suday, ginpahayag sini nga antes pa man siya naka eskwelaha sa kolehiyo, simple lang ang ila pangabuhi sa ila Tribu Alangan sa Mayba Pag-asa, Occidental Mindoro.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Anthony Suday said that even before he went to college, they lived a simple life in their tribe Alangan in Mayba Pag-asa, Occidental Mindoro.

text: Suno kay Suday, sang elementary, nagalakat lang ini sang duha ka oras padulong sa ila eskwelahan sa Mindoro.
english: According to Suday, in elementary school, he walked only two hours to his school in Mindoro.

text: Bangud nagdako sa kapigaduhon, mismo ang amay ni Suday ang nagtulod sa iya nga makatapos sa pagtuon.
english: Growing up in poverty, Suday's father himself pushed him to finish his studies.

text: Nahatagan naman sang kahigayunan si Suday nga maka-eskwela matapos ginbuligan sang guardian sini nga si Rene Sausa sang nagbisita ini sa  Tribu Alangan sa Occidental Mindoro.
english: Suday was given the opportunity to go to school after his guardian, Rene Sausa, helped him when he visited Tribu Alangan in Occidental Mindoro.

text: Ginpadayon naman ni Suday ang iya sekondarya sa Balasan National High School sa Balasan, Iloilo tubtub makasulod sa kolehiyo sa  Northern Iloilo State University (NIPSC) Batad Campus.
english: Suday continued his secondary education at Balasan National High School in Balasan, Iloilo until he entered college at the Northern Iloilo State University (NIPSC) Batad Campus.

text: Bangud nagdako sa panguma, napili ni Suday ang kurso nga  Bachelor of Science in Agriculture.
english: Because he grew up on a farm, Suday chose the Bachelor of Science in Agriculture course.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Suday ang pinakauna nga myembro sang  Indigenous Peoples (IP) nga nakakuha sang college degree sa bilog nga NIPSC system.
english: Suday is the first Indigenous Peoples (IP) member to obtain a college degree in the entire NIPSC system.

text: Ipasaka buwas nga adlaw ang kaso nga attempted rape batok sa nagtuyo nga maghimulos sa 19-anyos nga pasahero sini sang Mayo 18 sa Brgy.
english: A case of attempted rape will be filed tomorrow against the man who attempted to rape his 19-year-old passenger on May 18 in Brgy.

text: Pulo Maestra Vita, Oton, Iloilo.
english: Maestra Vita Island, Oton, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police sang Oton Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may yara na sang kongkreto nga ebidensya ang talatapan agud ipasaka ang nasambit nga panumbungon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lunelyn Talamillo, deputy chief of police of the Oton Municipal Police Station, said the office already has concrete evidence to file the charges.

text: Suno kay Talamillo, nagsanto ang ila person of interest sa tawo nga amo ang ginpa-verify sa Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 nga nagapanag-iya sang plate number sang motorsiklo nga gingamit sang rider.
english: Talamillo said their person of interest matched the person who was verified by the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Region 6 as the owner of the plate number of the motorcycle used by the rider.

text: Dugang sini nga may tracker team sila agud ma-monitor kag madakpan ang rider pananglitan madagdag na sang korte nga warrant of arrest.
english: He added that they have a tracker team to monitor and arrest the rider in case the court issues a warrant of arrest.

text: Nahibaluan nga na-identify man sang dalaga ang itsura sang rider kag ginkumpormehan man sang testigo nga amo ang nakabulig sa amo nga babaye sang gintuyo ini nga i-rape.
english: It was learned that the girl also identified the appearance of the rider and the witness also confirmed that he helped the woman when she was attempted to be raped.

text: Desidido man ang kampo sang babaye nga ipadayon ang pag-file sang panumbungon.
english: The woman's camp is also determined to continue filing charges.

text: Inihayag ng nakapiit na dating mambabatas na si former Negros Orienal Representative Arnolfo ‘Arnie’ Teves Jr.
english: Former Negros Oriental Representative Arnolfo 'Arnie' Teves Jr.

text: sa senado ang pagiging bukas na maging testigo sa imbestigasyon hinggil sa flood control projects.
english: in the senate the openness to be a witness in the investigation into flood control projects.

text: Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang legal counsel o abogado na si Atty. Ferdinand Topacio, sumulat ang dating kongresista kay Sen.
english: Through his legal counsel, Atty. Ferdinand Topacio, the former congressman wrote to Sen.

text: Rodante Marcoleta, chairman ng Senate Blue Ribbon Committee, upang tumestigo ukol sa katiwalian kanyang nalalaman.
english: Rodante Marcoleta, chairman of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee, to testify about the corruption he is aware of.

text: Base sa liham na isinulat sa pamamagitan ni Atty. Topacio, ang hakbang aniya na ito ay bilang tugon sa imbitasyon ng Senado sa sambayanan Pilipino na makipagtulungan maimbestigahan ang naturang isyu.
english: Based on the letter written through Atty. Topacio, the move is in response to the Senate's invitation to the Filipino people to cooperate in investigating the issue.

text: Ayon pa kay dating Congressman Arnie Teves Jr, ang kanyang ibabahaging testimonya kung mapahihintulutan man ay makapagbibigay ng tulong umano sa naturang kumite hinggil sa mga substandard na flood control projects.
english: According to former Congressman Arnie Teves Jr., his testimony if allowed will provide assistance to the committee on substandard flood control projects.

text: Ang naturang mambabatas ay kumakaharap pa rin sa mga patung-patong na kaso na may kinalaman sa murder, illegal possession of firearms and explosives at iba pa.
english: The lawmaker is still facing multiple cases involving murder, illegal possession of firearms and explosives and others.

text: Siya rin ang umano’y itinuturong ‘mastermind’ sa naganap na pagpatay kay dating Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo.
english: He is also the alleged mastermind of the assassination of former Negros Oriental Governor Roel Degamo.

text: Ginpa-Bombo sang isa ka senior citizen ang pulis nga nangtaya sang pusil sa iya.
english: A senior citizen called the policeman who bet on him.

text: Ang tagreklamo amo si Eduardo Comuelo, 81, nga nagaistar sa Población, Sta.
english: The complainant was identified as Eduardo Comuelo, 81, resident of Población, Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Ang ginareklamo naman ang ginapahayag nga isa ka police major nga assigned sa Maritime Unit 6.
english: The complainant is said to be a police major assigned to Maritime Unit 6.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Eduardo Comuelo, iya ginpahayag nga natabo ang insidente sa Balibagan Este sa amo nga banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Eduardo Comuelo said the incident occurred in Balibagan Este in the town.

text: Suno kay Comuelo, samtang naga-drive ini sang iya salakyan sakay man ang iya asawa, aksidente nga na-sideswipe sang side mirror sini ang side mirror man sang naka-park nga salakyan nga ginapanag-iyahan sang pulis.
english: According to Comuelo, while he was driving his vehicle with his wife on board, his side mirror accidentally sideswiped the side mirror of the parked vehicle owned by the police.

text: Pahayag niya, didto na kag ginlagas ini sang pulis rason nga nagpondo ini kag sang ginkompronta sang pulis nga may ginakungkong pa nga duha ka tuig nga bata, didto na ini gintayaan sang armas sang police major.
english: He said the police chased him and he stopped and when the police confronted him with a two-year-old child, the police major stabbed him.

text: Matapos ang pagbaisay, ginsiling sang pulis nga magakitaay na lang sila sa police station rason nga nagsunod man ang mag-asawa.
english: After the argument, the police said they would meet at the police station so the couple followed.

text: Pag-abot sa police station sang banwa, tuman ang pagkadismaya sang mga ini nga daw wala sang gana ang kapulisan nga mag-akomodar sa ila reklamo bangud nga myembro man sang Philippine National Police ang ila ginareklamo.
english: When they arrived at the police station of the town, they were very disappointed that the police did not want to accommodate their complaint because they were also members of the Philippine National Police.

text: Suno kay Comuelo, ini ang rason kun nga gindangop na lang nila ini sa National Police Commission agud mag-file sang nagakaigo nga panumbungon batok sa ginapahayag nga police major.
english: According to Comuelo, this is the reason why they have approached the National Police Commission to file appropriate charges against the alleged police major.

text: Kun ano kadasig ang pagsikat sang New Zealand transgender weightlifter nga si Laurel Hubbard, amo man sini kadasig ang iya exit sa women’s super-heavyweight competition.
english: As quickly as New Zealand transgender weightlifter Laurel Hubbard rose to fame, so did her exit from the women’s super-heavyweight competition.

text: Nag-overbalance ang 43 anyos nga si Hubbard sa opening weight nga 120kg.
english: The 43-year-old Hubbard overbalanced at the opening weight of 120kg.

text: Sa iya nga ikaduha nga attempt sa 125 kg, invalid ini sandig sa 2-1 majority decision sang referees.
english: In his second attempt at 125 kg, it was invalid based on a 2-1 majority decision of the referees.

text: Napalpak man ang iya nga third attempt sa amo man gihapon nga bug-at.
english: His third attempt at the same weight also failed.

text: Sa pagsulundan sa weightlifting, ma-eliminate ang atleta kun indi siya maka-record sang at least isa ka valid lift sa duha ka parte sang kumpetisyon — ang snatch, kag ang clean and jerk.
english: According to weightlifting rules, an athlete will be eliminated if he or she fails to record at least one valid lift in both parts of the competition — the snatch, and the clean and jerk.

text: Bangud sini, nakabaton si Hubbard sang mark nga DNF (did not finish).
english: As a result, Hubbard received a mark of DNF (did not finish).

text: Antes siya nagbiya sa podium, nagpakita pa siya sang heart sign sa cameras sa palibot.
english: Before he left the podium, he even showed a heart sign to the cameras around.

text: Antes ang kumpetisyon, nangin kontrobersyal ang pangalan ni Hubbard bangud siya ang ‘first openly transgender athlete’ nga nag-compete sa Olympics.
english: Before the competition, Hubbard’s name was controversial as she was the ‘first openly transgender athlete’ to compete in the Olympics.

text: Lalaki si Hubbard sang ginbun-ag siya sang iya nga iloy apang gin-islan niya ang iya pangalan walo ka tuig na ang nagligad.
english: Hubbard was born a boy but changed his name eight years ago.

text: Nagpaidalom siya sa hormone therapy to transition antes nagbalik sa weightlifting, ang sport nga wala na niya ginhampang sa masobra 10 ka tuig.
english: He underwent hormone therapy to transition before returning to weightlifting, the sport he hadn’t played in more than 10 years.

text: Nag-init ang debate sa tunga sang transgender rights advocates kag sang mga kritiko bangud inclusion ini pahayag sang mga naga-suporta sa 43 anyos nga si Hubbard apang unfair naman para sa iban.
english: The debate between transgender rights advocates and critics has been heated because supporters of 43-year-old Hubbard say it is inclusion but unfair to others.

text: Sa bahin sang mga kritiko, ginpahayag nga may unfair advantage si Hubbard bangud sa mga physical attributes nga yara na nga daan sa iya lawas sa mga tuig nga lalaki siya.
english: On the critics' side, Hubbard said he had an unfair advantage because of the physical attributes that were already in his body in the years he was a man.

text: Sa ikaduha nga tion sa sulod sang duha ka tuig, gindeklarar sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga isa ka global public health emergency ang mpox kasunod sang outbreak sa Democratic Republic of Congo kag madasig nga naglapta sa kaiping nga mga pungsod.
english: For the second time in two years, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared mpox a global public health emergency following an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and rapid spread to neighboring countries.

text: Ang deklarasyon ang kasunod man sa pagsinapol sang emergency committee agud nga abisuhan si WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus kun may yara bala sang dala nga public health emergency of international concern ang amo nga disease outbreak.
english: The declaration also follows a meeting of the emergency committee to advise WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus whether the disease outbreak poses a public health emergency of international concern.

text: Makalaton ang mpox paagi sa close contact.
english: Mposi is transmitted through close contact.

text: Masami nga mild ang mga kaso sini nga viral infection apang may yara man sang panalagsahon nga kaso nga makamamatay.
english: Cases of this viral infection are usually mild but there are occasional cases that are fatal.

text: Ang malatnan sini nga balatian ang makitaan sang sintomas sang trangkaso kag pus-filled lesions sa lawas.
english: Those infected with the disease present with flu-like symptoms and pus-filled lesions on the body.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sa Congo, naglapta ini pati sa Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda kag Uganda rason man sang lihok sang WHO.
english: It is known that from Congo, it has spread to Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda and Uganda.

text: Antes sini, ang top public health body sa Africa ang nagdeklarar man sang mpox emergency sa kontinente matapos ang warning nga nagalapta ang balatian sa makaalarma nga kadasigon.
english: Earlier, Africa’s top public health body also declared an mpox emergency on the continent after warning that the disease was spreading at an alarming rate.

text: Bukas na para sa staycation ang 5,986 ka mga rooms ukon hulot sa 13 ka mga hotels sa National Capital Region (NCR).
english: A total of 5,986 rooms in 13 hotels in the National Capital Region (NCR) are now open for staycation.

text: Ini apisar ginpaidalom pa sa gihapon sa general community quarantine (GCQ) ang NCR plus.
english: This is despite the fact that NCR plus is still under general community quarantine (GCQ).

text: Ang NCR plus ang ginabug-usan sang Metro Manila kag mga kaiping nga probinsya sang Bulacan, Cavite, Laguna, kag Rizal.
english: The NCR plus consists of Metro Manila and neighboring provinces of Bulacan, Cavite, Laguna, and Rizal.

text: Suno kay Department of Tourism (DOT) Secretary Bernadette Romulo-Puyat, apisar ginpasugtan na sang Inter-Agency Task Force on Emerging Infectious Diseases ang leisure travel sa idalom sang ginapatuman nga quarantine condition, nagakadapat sa gihapon nga ipatuman ang health kag safety protocols.
english: According to Department of Tourism (DOT) Secretary Bernadette Romulo-Puyat, although the Inter-Agency Task Force on Emerging Infectious Diseases has allowed leisure travel under the enforced quarantine condition, health and safety protocols should still be implemented.

text: “While the IATF allowed our request to permit leisure travel under the current quarantine condition, we would like to remind everyone that the health and safety of our guests and tourism workers remain the utmost priority,” pahayag ni Romulo-Puyat.
english: “While the IATF allowed our request to permit leisure travel under the current quarantine condition, we would like to remind everyone that the health and safety of our guests and tourism workers remain the utmost priority,” stated Romulo-Puyat.

text: Ginpasigurado man ni Puyat nga ang mga hotels ang ginpaidalom sa inspection kag ginpahibalo sa new normal protocols.
english: Puyat also assured that the hotels were subjected to inspection and informed of the new normal protocols.

text: Ang mga guests lang sa sulod sang NCR Plus ang ginapasugtan nga magbook sa mga staycation hotels kag ang mga guests ang nagakadapat nga indi magnubo sa 18 anyos kag indi maglapaw sa 65 anyos.
english: Only guests within NCR Plus are allowed to book staycation hotels and guests must be at least 18 years old and not more than 65 years old.

text: Gin-athag man sang tiglikom nga ang mga staycation hotels ang wala na ginagamit bilang COVID-19 quarantine facilities.
english: The secretary also clarified that staycation hotels are no longer used as COVID-19 quarantine facilities.

text: CALINOG, ILOILO – Gintumod sang Philippine National Police ang banwa sang Calinog, Iloilo bilang potensyal nga “election hotspot”.
english: CALINOG, ILOILO – The Philippine National Police has identified the town of Calinog, Iloilo as a potential “election hotspot”.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, director sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang pagpaidalom sa isa ka lugar sa “election hotspot” ang ginabase sa historical data sang tinalikdan nga October 30, 2023 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Colonel Bayani Razalan, director of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said the designation of an area as an “election hotspot” is based on historical data of the last October 30, 2023 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections.

text: Suno kay Razalan, sang nagligad nga piniliay, nag-inaway ang mga supporters sang mga kandidato sa Cahigon Elementary School sa Calinog sa diin may tiruhay nga natabo.
english: According to Razalan, in the last election, supporters of candidates fought at Cahigon Elementary School in Calinog where a shooting occurred.

text: Sa nasambit nga insidente, pilason ang supporter sang isa ka kandidato sa pagka-barangay captain sang ginluthang matapos ini nagboto.
english: In the incident, a supporter of a candidate for barangay captain was injured when he was shot after he voted.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa tion nga ipaidalom ang isa ka lugar sa “election hotspot”, ini ang mahimo ipaidalom sa kontrol sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC).
english: It is known that once an area is placed under an “election hotspot”, it can be placed under the control of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC).

text: Magabalik sa kumpetisyon sa Tokyo Olympics si Simone Biles, ang ‘greatest gymnast of all time’ kag ang ‘unquestioned face’ sang U.S. Olympic movement.
english: Simone Biles, the ‘greatest gymnast of all time’ and the ‘unquestioned face’ of the U.S. Olympic movement, will return to competition at the Tokyo Olympics.

text:
Sandig sa anunsyo sang USA Gymnastics, maga-compete si Biles sa last event final nga amo ang balance beam nga naka-schedule karon sa gab-i.

Ini ang iya una nga kompetisyon matapos ang iya pag-withdraw sa women’s team final sang nagligad nga semana bangud sang iya problema sa mental health kag physical safety.
english:
According to the USA Gymnastics announcement, Biles will compete in the last event final, the balance beam, scheduled for tonight.

This will be her first competition after withdrawing from the women’s team final last week due to mental health and physical safety issues.

text: Naghimo sang headlines sa bilog nga kalibutan ang pag-isol ni Biles sang nagligad nga event bangud siya ang ginakabig ‘biggest star’ sang Olympyada.
english: Biles' withdrawal from the previous event made headlines around the world because she was considered the 'biggest star' of the Olympics.

text: Sa edad nga 24 anyos, ang amo nga US superstar gymnast amo ang nagapanguna sa United States’ defense sa ila women’s gymnastics team title kag ginalauman kuntani nga madugangan ang iya apat ka bulawan nga medalya nga nadag-an sa 2016 Rio Olympics.
english: At 24 years old, such a US superstar gymnast leads the United States’ defense of its women’s gymnastics team title and would have been expected to add to her four gold medals won at the 2016 Rio Olympics.

text: Ang iya makakilibot nga pagwithdraw sang nagligad nga semana ang ginbasol sa ‘twisties’.
english: His surprise withdrawal last week was blamed on ‘twisties’.

text: Ang twisties amo ang pagkadula sang sense of space kag dimension sang isa ka gymnast samtang yara sa hangin rason nga nagakadula ang kontrol sa lawas kag mahimo ang mga ekstra nga twists kag flips bisan indi man hungod.
english: Twisties are the loss of a gymnast's sense of space and dimension while in the air causing a loss of body control and extra twists and flips can be performed even if not intentionally.

text: Apisar gin-anunsyo ang iya withdrawal sa multiple finals sang Hulyo 27, nagpadayon si Biles sa pag-train kag gin-evaluate sang USA Gymnastics staff.
english: Despite announcing her withdrawal from the multiple finals on July 27, Biles continued to train and was evaluated by the USA Gymnastics staff.

text: Nagpadulong si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr sa Ormoc City agud magbisita sa RM Tan Solar Pump Irrigation Project sa syudad.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. arrived in Ormoc City to visit the RM Tan Solar Pump Irrigation Project in the city.

text: Kaupod sang presidente sa pagbisita si National Irrigation Administration (NIA) Administrator Engr.
english: The president was accompanied on the visit by National Irrigation Administration (NIA) Administrator Engr.

text: Eddie Guillen.
english: Eddie Guillen.

text: Tinutuyo sang P100-million nga proyekto nga patubigan ang 100 ka ektarya sang uma nga ginalauman nga makabenepisyo sa 92 ka mga mangunguma kag ila pamilya paagi sa pagtugot sa ila nga magtanom makaduha ka beses sa isa ka tuig.
english: The P100-million project aims to irrigate 100 hectares of farmland which is expected to benefit 92 farmers and their families by allowing them to plant twice a year.

text: Ang solar-powered irrigation magabulos sa mahal kag indi makahalit sa palibot nga mga bomba sang diesel.
english: Solar-powered irrigation will replace expensive and environmentally friendly diesel pumps.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang RM Tan Solar Pump Irrigation Project kabahin lamang sang 7-Point Strategic Policy Agenda ni Administrator Guillen.
english: The RM Tan Solar Pump Irrigation Project is only part of Administrator Guillen's 7-Point Strategic Policy Agenda.

text: Ini ang ginalauman nga makapasanyog sang renewable energy pareho sang solar power.
english: This is expected to boost renewable energy such as solar power.

text: Ginalauman nga magatubo ang sektor sang agrikultura sa rehiyon paagi sa makabag-o nga teknolohiya sa irigasyon nga ginasuportahan sang gobyerno.
english: The agricultural sector in the region is expected to grow with innovative irrigation technology supported by the government.

text: Makahalawat-hawat ini nga adlaw para sa mga Pinoy ilabi na para sa mga nagahulat nga madugangan pa ang medalya sang Pilipinas halin sa Olimpyada.
english: This is an exciting day for Filipinos especially for those who are waiting for more medals for the Philippines from the Olympics.

text:
Tatlo ang balantayan nga hampang subong nga adlaw:

Kun mapierde ni Paalam si Zoirov, sigurado na ang isa pa ka bronze medal para sa Pilipinas.
english:
There are three games to watch today:

If Paalam defeats Zoirov, another bronze medal for the Philippines is assured.

text: Pamilyar na si Petecio kay Sena bangud napierde na niya ini via Split Decision, 4-1, sang Quarterfinals sang 2019 AIBA World Championships sa Women’s Featherweight Division.
english: Petecio is familiar with Sena as she defeated him via Split Decision, 4-1, in the Quarterfinals of the 2019 AIBA World Championships in the Women’s Featherweight Division.

text: Sang 2020 Asian Olympic Qualification, si Sena naman ang nagpierde kay Petecio.
english: In the 2020 Asian Olympic Qualification, Sena lost to Petecio.

text: May tyansa na subong si Petecio nga sundon ang tapak sang weightlifter nga si Hidilyn Diaz nga amo ang una nga atleta nakasecure sang gold medal para sa Pilipinas.
english: Petecio now has a chance to follow in the footsteps of weightlifter Hidilyn Diaz who became the first athlete to secure a gold medal for the Philippines.

text: Ang sigurado subong amo ang silver medal para kay Petecio APANG KUN madaug niya ang hampang batok sa host country nga Japan, siya ang first female boxer nga makakuha sang Olympic Gold medal para sa Pilipinas.
english: What is certain now is the silver medal for Petecio BUT IF she wins the match against host country Japan, she will be the first female boxer to win an Olympic Gold medal for the Philippines.

text: Magahingyo ang grupo sang mga mangunguma sa Kongreso matapos nagpagwa sang mando ang Malacañang kaangot sa pagpanubo sang taripa sang bugas nga gina-import halin sa iban nga pungsod.
english: The farmers' group will appeal to Congress after Malacañang issued a decree regarding the reduction of tariffs on rice imported from other countries.

text: Suno kay Leonardo Montemayor, board chairman sang Federation of Free Farmers kag anay Secretary sang Department of Agriculture, ginpagwa ang Executive Order 135, duha ka adlaw antes nagbalik ang session sa Kongreso.
english: According to Leonardo Montemayor, board chairman of the Federation of Free Farmers and former Secretary of the Department of Agriculture, Executive Order 135 was issued two days before the session resumed in Congress.

text: Ginpahayag ni Montemayor nga ang nasambit nga tikang ang nagapakita sang indi pagrespeto sa mga tariff-making authority nga amo ang Kongreso.
english: Montemayor said the move shows disrespect for the tariff-making authority, Congress.

text: “Parang kulang ng respeto po sa ating tariff-making authority, na atin pong Kongreso kaya mag-aappeal po kami sa Kongreso.
english: “It seems that there is a lack of respect for our tariff-making authority, which is in Congress so we will appeal to Congress.

text: Siguro pati na rin sa Malacanang,” pahayag ni Montemayor.
english: Maybe even in Malacanang,” Montemayor said.

text: Gin-athag ni Montemayor nga sa subong, estable man ang supply sang bugas sa pungsod.
english: Montemayor explained that at present, the supply of rice in the country is also stable.

text: Wala man suno sa natungdan sang kamatuuran nga ang sa bugas nagahalin ang dugang nga inflation.
english: He said there is no truth that rice is the source of the increased inflation.

text: “Sabi nila para maiwasan ang additional inflation.
english: “They said it was to avoid additional inflation.

text: Wala pong inflation na nagmumula po sa bigas.
english: There is no inflation in rice.

text: As far as rice supply is concerned, stable po tayo .
english: As far as rice supply is concerned, we are stable.

text: Wala po kaming makitang basis.”
english: We don't see any basis.”

text: Naghain si Senador Robinhood Padilla ng panukalang batas na nag-aatas sa lahat ng public officials, kabilang ang pangulo ng Pilipinas, na sumailalim sa annual mandatory drug testing.
english: Senator Robinhood Padilla has introduced a bill requiring all public officials, including the president of the Philippines, to undergo annual mandatory drug testing.

text: Ang paghahain ng senador ng panukalang batas ay kasabay ng pagbibitiw ni Nadia Montenegro bilang political affairs officer VI sa kanyang opisina.
english: The senator's presentation of the bill coincides with the resignation of Nadia Montenegro as political affairs officer VI in her office.

text: Sa ilalim ng Senate Bill No.
english: Under Senate Bill No.

text: 1200, o ang panukalang “Drug-Free Government Act, na layong amyendahan ang Republic Act 9165 o Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002, oobligahin na magkaroon ng annual hair follicle drug test para sa lahat ng mga nasa pamahalaan, mula sa lokal na opisyal hanggang sa mga itinalaga sa mga government-owned and controlled corporations (GOCCs).
english: 1200, or the proposed “Drug-Free Government Act, which further amends Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002, will require an annual hair follicle drug test for all those in government, from local officials to government-controlled corporations and (GOCCs).

text: Bukod sa annual drug test, hinihimok din ang mga kandidato na sumailalim sa voluntary random drug testing sa loob ng 90 araw bago ang araw ng halalan.
english: In addition to the annual drug test, candidates are also required to undergo voluntary random drug testing within 90 days before election day.

text: Sakaling magpositibo sa paggamit ng ipinagbabawal na gamot ang isang opisyal, maaari itong magsilbing basehan para sa administratibong kaso na maaaring humantong sa suspensyon o tuluyang pagkakatanggal sa posisyon.
english: Once an official tests positive for illegal drugs, it can serve as a basis for an administrative case that can lead to suspension or permanent removal from office.

text: ILOILO CITY–Bukas sa tanan nga mga mahuyugon magkuha sang picture ang  Photo Contest sa Dinagyang Festival 2019.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Photo Contest for the Dinagyang Festival 2019 is open to all photographers.

text: Ang photo contest ang natunga sa duha ka mga category sa diin ini ang ginalakipan sang Ati Category kag Festival Category.
english: The photo contest is divided into two categories, the Ati Category and the Festival Category.

text: Sa Ati Category, mahimo nga makakuha sang laragway sa Dinagyang Ati Tribes competition samtang s Festival category naman, mahimo nga magkuha sang laragway sa tanan nga aktibidad sa bilog nga selebrasyon sang Festival kasubong sang Fluvial Parade, Parade of Lights kag iban pa nga aktibidad sang Dinagyang Foundation magluwas sa Ati Tribe competition.
english: In the Ati Category, you can take pictures of the Dinagyang Ati Tribes competition while in the Festival category, you can take pictures of all the activities throughout the celebration of the Festival such as the Fluvial Parade, Parade of Lights and other activities of the Dinagyang Foundation besides the Ati Tribe competition.

text: Suno kay Antonio Rojas, Photo Contest committee chairman, ang deadline sang pagpasa sang pictures ang natalana sa  Pebrero 6, 2019 alas 5:00 sa hapon sa Philippine Red Cross.
english: According to Antonio Rojas, Photo Contest committee chairman, the deadline for submitting pictures is set for February 6, 2019 at 5:00 pm at the Philippine Red Cross.

text: Magabaton sang P50,000 pesos ang champion sa Ati Category samtang P25, 000 naman ang mabaton sang champion sa Festival Category.
english: The champion in the Ati Category will receive P50,000 while the champion in the Festival Category will receive P25,000.

text: Gin-athag naman ni Rojas nga indi mahimo magamit sang mga cellphone camera kag tablets ang mga magapasakop sa Photo Contest.
english: Rojas explained that cellphone cameras and tablets are not allowed for participants in the Photo Contest.

text: Nagkalaguba ang pila ka mga balay sa Brgy.
english: Several houses in Brgy.

text: Zamora Milleza, Iloilo City Proper matapos nga nadagdagan sang sanga sang puno sang lunok.
english: Zamora Milleza, Iloilo City Proper after being added to the branch of a swamp tree.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kagawad Yuri Villanueva sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Kagawad Yuri Villanueva of Brgy.

text: Zamora Milleza, iya ginpahayag nga apat ka pamilya ang apektado kasunod sang insidente.
english: Zamora Milleza, he said four families were affected following the incident.

text: Suno kay Villanueva, ang mga balay ang human sa concrete apang ang sa babaw nga parte sini ang human sa light materials rason nga gilayon nga naguba.
english: According to Villanueva, the houses were made of concrete but the upper part was made of light materials which immediately collapsed.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga maayo lamang nga halos wala sang tawo sa ibabaw nga parte sang balay sang nabali ang sanga.
english: He also said it was fortunate that almost no one was in the upper part of the house when the branch broke.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, ginkakibot na lamang sang mga residente sa lugar ang hinali nga paglagapok sang sanga sang puno sang lunok.
english: He added that residents in the area were surprised when the branch of the swamp tree suddenly fell.

text: Wala naman sang may nasamaran sa amo nga insidente.
english: No one was injured in the incident.

text: ILOILO CITY-Nagpasaka sang kaso ang United Auto Workers Union sa US National Labor Relations Board batok kanday anay US President Donald Trump kag Tesla CEO Elon Musk bangud sa ginaalegar pagpamahog kag intimidasyon sa mga workers.
english: ILOILO CITY-The United Auto Workers Union has filed a case with the US National Labor Relations Board against former US President Donald Trump and Tesla CEO Elon Musk for allegedly threatening and intimidating workers.

text: Ang tikang kasunod sang ginpatigayon nanday Musk kag Trump nga duha ka oras nga pagsugilanon sa social media platform X kun sa diin gindiskusyunan sang mga ini ang tuhoy sa mga workers nga nagabiya sa trabaho agud mag- strike.
english: The move follows a two-hour conversation between Musk and Trump on social media platform X where they discussed workers leaving their jobs to go on strike.

text: Sa idalom sang federal law, ang workers indi mahimo mapahalin sa trabaho bangud lang sa pag- strike, kag ang pagpahog sa ila ang illegal sa idalom sang National Labor Relations Act, suno sa Union.
english: Under federal law, workers cannot be fired just for striking, and threatening them is illegal under the National Labor Relations Act, the Union said.

text: Ang UAW amo ang nagaendorso kay Vice President Kamala Harris sa iya handom nga mangin US president.
english: The UAW is endorsing Vice President Kamala Harris in her bid to become US president.

text: Nakigkita naman si Harris sa mga union officials kag workers sang nagligad nga semana sa Detroit agud pamatian ang ila mga sentimento.
english: Harris met with union officials and workers last week in Detroit to hear their sentiments.

text: Gintawag ni Surigao del Sur 2nd district Representative Accountability Johnny Pimentel nga wala sang kaluoy sanday alleged Davao Death Squad (DDS) implementer kag former Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) General Manager and Vice-Chairperson Retired Police Col.
english: Surigao del Sur 2nd district Representative Accountability Johnny Pimentel called alleged Davao Death Squad (DDS) implementer and former Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) General Manager and Vice-Chairperson Retired Police Col.

text: Royina Garma kag National Police Commission Commissioner Col.
english: Royina Garma and National Police Commission Commissioner Col.

text: Edilberto Leonardo.
english: Edilberto Leonardo.

text: Si Pimentel amo ang nagaserbe nga Vice Chairman sang House Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability nga kabahin sang quad Committee nga naga-imbestigar sa extra-judicial killings sa tion sang administrasyon ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Pimentel is serving as the Vice Chairman of the House Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability which is part of the quad Committee investigating extra-judicial killings during the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ang pahayag ni Pimentel ang kasunod man sang mga nabulgar sa Kamara nga pagsugo nanday Garma kag Leonardo nga pamatyon ang mga nalakip sa “narco list” ni Duterte.
english: Pimentel's statement also follows revelations in the House of Representatives that Garma and Leonardo ordered the killing of those on Duterte's narco list.

text: Lakip na diri ang pagpapatay sa tatlo ka mga Chinese drug lords sa Davao sang 2026 kag kay former Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director kag PCSO board secretary Police Col.
english: These include the killing of three Chinese drug lords in Davao in 2026 and former Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) Director and PCSO board secretary Police Col.

text: Atty. Wesley Barayuga.
english: Atty. Wesley Barayuga.

text: Ginrekomendar man sang mamalidha nga pasakaan sang kaso nga murder sanday Garma kag Leonardo agud mahatagan sang hustisya ang ila ginhimo nga pagpamatay.
english: The lawmaker also recommended that Garma and Leonardo be charged with murder to bring justice to their killings.

text: Duha ka mga hampang gikan sa delegasyon sang Pilipinas ang balantayan subong nga adlaw sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics, the Greatest Show on Earth!
english: Two games from the Philippine delegation will be watched today at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, the Greatest Show on Earth!

text: Pasado 10:00 subong nga aga, magahampang ang Filipino-American nga si Kristina Marie Knott sa Women’s 200 meter-Heat sa Athletics.
english: After 10:00 this morning, Filipino-American Kristina Marie Knott will compete in the Women’s 200 meter-Heat in Athletics.

text: Pasado ‘las singko karon sa hapon, magahampang man si Carlos Edriel Yulo sa Men’s Vault Finals sa Gymnastics.
english: After 5 pm today, Carlos Edriel Yulo will also play in the Men's Vault Finals in Gymnastics.

text:
REDEMPTION

Subong nga finals na sang men’s vault sa gymnastics, tinguhaan ni Yulo nga ma-redeem ang iya kaugalingon matapos ang iya ginakabig disappointing nga performance sa floor exercise sang nagligad nga semana.
english:
REDEMPTION

Now that the finals of the men’s vault in gymnastics are on, Yulo will try to redeem himself after his disappointing performance in the floor exercise last week.

text: Matandaan nga naka-score si Yulo sang 14.733 points kag nagpang-anum sa vault sang nagligad nga hampang rason nga nakasulod siya sa Top Eight kag nakaabanse sa Finals.
english: It can be recalled that Yulo scored 14.733 points and finished sixth in the vault in the previous match, which helped him to enter the Top Eight and advance to the Finals.

text: Apang nangluya si Yulo bangud ika-44 lang siya out of 64 ka mga tagpalasakop sa floor exercise event.
english: But Yulo was discouraged because he was only 44th out of 64 participants in the floor exercise event.

text: Kun matandaan, sa floor exercise event nag-champion si Yulo sang 2019.
english: Yulo won the floor exercise event in 2019.

text: Nangin pigado man ang performance ni Yulo sa rings, parallel bars, horizontal bar, kag pommel horse sang nagligad nga semana apang subong nga finals, nagalaum ang Team Pilipinas kag ang Gymnastics Association of the Philippines nga mas relaxed na nga Yulo ang makit-an sang publiko.
english: Yulo's performance in the rings, parallel bars, horizontal bar, and pommel horse was also poor last week but this finals, Team Pilipinas and the Gymnastics Association of the Philippines hope that the public will see a more relaxed Yulo.

text:
YOUNG CAREER

Target naman ni Kristina Knott nga ma-break ang 23 seconds sa iya pag-compete sa women’s 200 meters heats of athletics subong nga adlaw.
english:
YOUNG CAREER

Kristina Knott is targeting to break 23 seconds in the women's 200 meters heats of athletics today.

text: Heat 7 ukon sa final heat natupa si Knott.
english: Heat 7 or in the final heat Knott fell.

text: Si Knott ang nagtiglawas sa Pilipinas sa 2019 Southeast Asian Games.
english: Knott represented the Philippines in the 2019 Southeast Asian Games.

text: Sa 200-meter event, gin-set niya ang Philippine national record set paagi sa pagdalagan sang may kadasigon nga 23.07 seconds.
english: In the 200-meter event, he set the Philippine national record set by running a time of 23.07 seconds.

text: Ginlapawan niya ang iya kaugalingon nga rekord paagi sa pagtapos sang hampang sa 23.01 seconds sa final nga amo ang rason kun ngaa gold medalist siya sa women’s 200 meters event.
english: She broke her own record by finishing in 23.01 seconds in the final which made her a gold medalist in the women’s 200 meters event.

text: Apang ini nga rekord ang indi pa gihapon makalagas sa Olympic qualifying time nga 22.8 seconds.
english: But this record still falls short of the Olympic qualifying time of 22.8 seconds.

text: Si Knott ang nakadaug man sang gold medal sa 4×100-meter mixed relay event kag duha ka silver medals sa women’s 100-meter sprint kag 4×100-meter relay.
english: Knott also won a gold medal in the 4×100-meter mixed relay event and two silver medals in the women’s 100-meter sprint and 4×100-meter relay.

text: ILOILO CITY–80% na nga handa ang mga competing kag non-competing tribe para sa Kasadyahan sa Dinagyang Festival 2019.
english: ILOILO CITY – The competing and non-competing tribes are 80% ready for the Dinagyang Festival 2019.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Eden Dariada, chairman sang Kasadyahan Festival, ang nasambit nga cultural dance parade ang patigayunon sa Enero 26 sa diin may siyam ka competing tribes samtang may duha ka non-competing tribes.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Eden Dariada, chairman of the Kasadyahan Festival, said the cultural dance parade will be held on January 26 with nine competing tribes while there are two non-competing tribes.

text: Sa subong suno kay Dariada, naka-draw lots na ang tagsa ka tribu tuhoy sa pagpasunod sang ila performance sa tagsa ka judging area.
english: Dariada said each tribe has already drawn lots to match their performance in each judging area.

text: Sa masunod nga semana suno kay Dariada, mahimo na nga matumod kun diin ang mga biletting areas sang tagsa ka tribu.
english: Next week, Dariada said, the billeting areas of each tribe will be identified.

text: Lakip sa mga participating tribe amo ang defending champion nga Hubon Mangunguma sang Manggahan Festival sang Guimaras, Manughabol sang Salakayan Festival sang Miag-ao, Iloilo, Sugilanon Festival sang Roxas City, Capiz, Tultugan Festival sang Maasin, Iloilo, Kaing Festival sang Leon, Iloilo, Pintaflores Festival sang San Carlos City, Negros Occidental, Hambaro Festival sang San Remigio, Antique, Hugyaw Festival sang St.
english: Among the participating tribes are the defending champion Hubon Mangunguma of the Mango Festival of Guimaras, Manughabol of the Salakayan Festival of Miag-ao, Iloilo, Sugilanon Festival of Roxas City, Capiz, Tultugan Festival of Maasin, Iloilo, Kaing Festival of Leon, Ilores City, San Carlos Festival of Negros. Occidental, Hambaro Festival of San Remigio, Antique, Hugyaw Festival of St.

text: Therese MTC Colleges kag may isa pa gid ka tribu halin sa Binirayan Festival sang Antqiue samtang non-competing tribes kag naman ang Panganinaw Festival sang Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISATU) kag MassKara Festival sang Bacolod City, Negros Occidental.
english: Therese MTC Colleges and another tribe from the Binirayan Festival of Antqiue while non-competing tribes and the Panganinaw Festival of Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISATU) and MassKara Festival of Bacolod City, Negros Occidental.

text: Nagpadala na sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang guided missile submarine sa Middle East samtang labi nga nagsaka ang tension sa rehiyon.
english: The United States has sent a guided missile submarine to the Middle East as tensions in the region rise.

text: Suno kay Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin, may yara man sang ginpadala nga aircraft carrier sa amo nga lugar kasunod sang kahangawa nga magasangkad pa ang away sa rehiyon kasunod sang pagpatay sa senior Hezbollah kag Hamas leaders.
english: Defense Secretary Lloyd Austin said an aircraft carrier was also sent to the area following concerns that the fighting in the region would escalate following the killing of senior Hezbollah and Hamas leaders.

text: Ang lihok sang US ang ginalantaw nga pamatuod nga buligan sini ang Israel batok sa anuman nga posible nga pagpang-atake nga himuon sang Iran ilabi na bangud ginsiling ni Austin nga himuon sang Amerika ang kutob sang posible nga tikang para pangapinan ang ila kaalyado.
english: The US move is seen as proof that it will help Israel against any possible attack by Iran especially since Austin said the United States will do everything possible to defend its ally.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginahulat subong kun ano ang himuon sang Tehran bangud sa kamatayon sang top political leader sang Hamas nga si Ismail Haniyeh sang nagligad nga Hulyo 31.
english: Tehran is currently awaiting action over the death of top Hamas political leader Ismail Haniyeh on July 31.

text: Ginbasol sang Iranians ang Israel sa amo nga insidente kag nagpaandam nga magatimalos sila apang wala sang sabat ang Israel.
english: The Iranians blamed Israel for the incident and warned of retaliation but Israel did not respond.

text: Suno naman sa Pentagon kag kay Austin, ang USS Georgia guided missile submarine nga ila ginpadala ang makadala sang 154 Tomahawk cruise missiles nga pwede makaigu sang ila land targets.
english: According to the Pentagon and Austin, the USS Georgia guided missile submarine they sent can carry 154 Tomahawk cruise missiles that can hit their land targets.

text: Ang nagasunod sa submarine amo ang USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group nga may dala nga F-35C fighter jets.
english: Following the submarine was the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group carrying F-35C fighter jets.

text: Ini amo ang magabulos sa isa ka pa barko sang Estados Unidos nga yara na daan sa Middle East.
english: It will replace another US ship already in the Middle East.

text: Magluwas sa atake halin sa Iran, ang ginabantayan pa amo ang kaalyado man sini nga Hezbollah nga isa ka political movement sa Lebanon.
english: In addition to the attack from Iran, its ally Hezbollah, a political movement in Lebanon, is also being watched.

text: Ginalantaw man ang ila pagtimalos bangud sa kamatayon sang ila senior commander nga si Fuad Shukr nga natabo inoras lang gid antes ang assassination sa kay Haniyeh.
english: They are also looking for revenge for the death of their senior commander, Fuad Shukr, which occurred just hours before the assassination of Haniyeh.

text: Nagsaka na sa 17 ang patay kasunod sang pagkatiphag sang isahanon nga landfill site sa Kampala nga amo ang kapital sang Uganda.
english: The death toll has risen to 17 following the collapse of a single landfill site in Kampala, Uganda's capital.

text: Naga-inulan sa amo nga pungsod sa sulod na sang pila ka semana nga amo ang rason sang pag-collapse sang mga basura sang Biyernes nga rason man kun ngaa natampukan ang kaiping nga mga balay kun sa diin nagakatulog amg mga residente.
english: It has been raining in the country for several weeks, which caused the collapse of garbage on Friday, which also caused the neighboring houses where residents were sleeping to collapse.

text: Suno sa Uganda Red Cross, sini lang nga Domingo, nakutkutan ang bangkay sang apat pa ka tawo rason sang pagsaka sang deatl toll sa 17.
english: According to the Uganda Red Cross, just this Sunday, the bodies of four more people were exhumed, bringing the death toll to

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni President Yoweri Museveni nga ginmanduan na sini ang prime minister nga mag-koordinar para nga mapasaylo na ang tanan nga nagapuyo malapit sa garbage dump.
english: Earlier, President Yoweri Museveni said he had directed the prime minister to coordinate so that all those living near the garbage dump could be relocated.

text: Ginsuguran naman ang imbestigasyon kun ano ang gintunaan sang landslide kag may paandam nga may mga tikang nga himuon batok sa mga opisyal nga mapamatud-a nga nagpabaya.
english: An investigation has been launched into the cause of the landslide and there is a warning that action will be taken against officials found to be negligent.

text: Sa amo nga insidente, 14 man ka mga tawo ang na-rescue apang posible pa madugangan.
english: In the incident, 14 people were also rescued but more are likely.

text: Sang 2017, 115 man ang napatay sa Ethiopia bangud sa garbage landslide sa Addis Ababa.
english: In 2017, 115 people also died in Ethiopia due to the garbage landslide in Addis Ababa.

text: Sa Mozambique, 17 man ang nagtaliwan sa kaangay man nga rason sang 2018 partikular na sa Maputo.
english: In Mozambique, 17 people died for the same reason in 2018, particularly in Maputo.

text: ILOILO CITY- Hatagan sang prayoridad sang Iloilo City Government ang mga active vendors nga nagaokupa na nga daan sang mga kiosko kag mga pwesto sa mga merkado publiko sa syudad sa patigayunon nga relocation sa ila.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Iloilo City Government will give priority to active vendors who are already occupying kiosks and stalls in public markets in the city in the relocation of them.

text: Ini sa tion nga umpisahan na ang rehabilitation sang Lapaz Public Market, Mandurriao Public Market kag Arevalo Public Market.
english: This is at a time when the rehabilitation of Lapaz Public Market, Mandurriao Public Market and Arevalo Public Market is about to begin.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Councilor Ely Estante, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong,wala pa sang nakasugtan kon ano naman ang plano sa mga tag-iya sang kiosko nga ginbayaan kag ginpaarkilahan ini sa iban.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Councilor Ely Estante said that at present, no one has agreed on what the plan is for the owners of the kiosks that were abandoned and rented to others.

text: Suno kay Estante, mangin sa mga transients vendors, ginaplano pa kon ano ang himuon sa ila.
english: Estante said even the transient vendors are still planning what to do with them.

text: Sa bahin sang Lapaz Public Market, inisyal nga napilian nga relocation site sa mga vendors amo ang dalan Rizal kag Railway sa diin may yara sang gym nga mahimo gamiton; sa Arevalo, posible nga relocation site ang playground sa plaza; sa bahin sang Mandurriao, padayon pa nga ginatumod ang mangin relocation site.
english: In terms of Lapaz Public Market, initially selected relocation sites for vendors are Rizal and Railway streets where there is a gym that can be used; in Arevalo, the playground in the plaza is a possible relocation site; in Mandurriao, the relocation site is still being identified.

text: Gindugang pa ni Estante nga ginapasiguro man sang Local Economic and Enterprise Office nga wala sang vendors nga ma-displace.
english: Estante added that the Local Economic and Enterprise Office is also ensuring that no vendors will be displaced.

text: Matandaan nga nagpatawag sang pagsinapol ang kumitiba sang konsehal upod sa mga stakeholders kag vendors associations sa Iloilo City agud ma-address ang ila mga concerns angot sa palaabuton nga rehabilitation nga ginalauman nga magasugod sa sulod sang duha ka bulan.
english: It can be recalled that the councilor's committee convened a meeting with stakeholders and vendors associations in Iloilo City to address their concerns regarding the upcoming rehabilitation which is expected to begin within two months.

text: Suno pa kay Estante, katuyuan sang pagrehabilitate sang merkado amo nga maka-compete ini sa mga malls bangod sa merkado,may ayu na, may paaman pa.
english: According to Estante, the purpose of the rehabilitation of the market is to compete with the malls because in the market, there is something good, there is a warning.

text: ILOILO CITY–Emosyonal nga gindumdum sang isa ka director/ film maker ang pagtaliwan sang multi-awarded choreographer nga si Edwin Duero.
english: ILOILO CITY – A director/film maker emotionally remembered the passing of multi-awarded choreographer Edwin Duero.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elvert Bañares, iya ginpahayag nga ginkakibot man niya ang natabo nga pagtaliwan sang iya abyan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elvert Bañares said he was shocked by the death of his friend.

text: Suno pa kay Bañares, masubo ang natabo bangud dako nga kadulaan sa Western Visayas ang pagtaliwan ni Duero ilabi na sa patag sang Dinagyang Festival.
english: Bañares said it is sad because Duero's death is a great loss to Western Visayas especially in the field of Dinagyang Festival.

text: Pahayag pa ni Bañares, daku ang nabulig sa iya sang nagtaliwan nga multi-awarded choreographer bangud nahatagan siya sang kahigayunan nga mangin isa ka commentator.
english: Bañares said the late multi-awarded choreographer helped him a lot because he was given the opportunity to be a commentator.

text: Nagalaum man man si Bañares nga ang legasiya nga  ginbilin ni Duero ang magapadayun kag mangin inspirasyon sang tanan.
english: Bañares also hopes that the legacy left by Duero will continue and be an inspiration to all.

text: Madumduman nga si Duero ang creator sang Dagyaw Theater nga dance company sa sulod sang malawig nga tinuig kag nagdala sang grupo nga makaperform sa nagkalain-lain nga pungsod sa kalibutan.
english: Duero is the creator of the Dagyaw Theater dance company for many years and has brought the group to perform in various countries around the world.

text: Magluwas diri, nangin trainer man si Duero sang Tribu Bola-bola nga nangin champion sa mga nakaligad nga Dinagyang Festival.
english: Besides, Duero also became a trainer of Tribu Bola-bola who became champions in previous Dinagyang Festivals.

text: Samtang, masinadyahon nga tawo ang nagtaliwan nga multi awarded choreographer nga si Edwin Duero.
english: Meanwhile, the late multi awarded choreographer Edwin Duero was a cheerful man.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Evelyn Duero, utod ni Edwin, iya ginpahayag nga masinadyahon kag maayo maghatag snag panugyan ang iya napatay nga utod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Evelyn Duero, Edwin's sister, said her late brother was cheerful and good at giving advice.

text: Nagalaum si Evelyn nga indi malipatan sang publiko ang iya utod.
english: Evelyn hopes that the public will not forget her brother.

text: Nasapwan na lang sa iya kwarto kag wala na sang kabuhi ang multi-awarded choreographer.
english: The multi-awarded choreographer was found dead in his room.

text: ILOILO – Magapatawag ang hearing in aid of legislation ang Sangguniang Panlalawigan natuhoy sa mga nakit-an nga armado nga mga lalaki nga nagparada kaangot sa Fiesta sang Ajuy, Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – The Sangguniang Panlalawigan will convene a hearing in aid of legislation regarding the armed men who paraded in connection with the Fiesta of Ajuy, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 5th District Board Member Atty. Carol-V Espinosa-Diaz, iya ginpahayag nga una na ini nga nagpadala ini sang sulat kay Iloilo Police Provincial Office Director Police Col.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo 5th District Board Member Atty. Carol-V Espinosa-Diaz, he said he had already sent a letter to Iloilo Police Provincial Office Director Police Col.

text: Bayani Razalan agud ma-imbestigaran ang natabo.
english: Bayani Razalan to investigate the incident.

text: Suno kay Diaz, sa patigayunon nga hearing luyag sini nga ipatawag ang Security Agency nga nagpadala sang ila mga armado nga security personnel.
english: Diaz said he wants to summon the Security Agency that sent its armed security personnel to the hearing.

text: Ginpaintindi man sang natungdan nga santo sa layi, indi mahimo magdala sang mga armas ang security personnel kun indi na sakop sang ila area of jurisdiction.
english: He also explained that according to the law, security personnel cannot carry weapons if they are no longer within their area of ​​jurisdiction.

text: Gin-athag man ni Diaz nga wala sang lamod pamolitika ang iya pag-kwestyon sa hitabo.
english: Diaz also clarified that his questioning of the incident was not politically motivated.

text: Apisar napaslawan ang Ilongga boxer nga si Irish Magno nga madala pauli ang isa sa mga medalya sa Tokyo 2020 Olympics, ginbatak niya sa gihapon ang kaugalingon sa paglaom nga indi ini ang pinakaulihe niya nga paghampang sa Olympiada.
english: Although Ilongga boxer Irish Magno failed to bring home one of the medals at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics, he still pulled himself together in the hope that this is not his last Olympiad performance.

text: Si Magno ang tumandok sang Barangay Tamu-an, Janiuay, Iloilo kag labing una nga Filipina boxer nga nag-qualify sa Olympics.
english: Magno is a native of Barangay Tamu-an, Janiuay, Iloilo and the first Filipina boxer to qualify for the Olympics.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Magno, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa suporta sang iya mga kasimanwa nga Ilonggo kag pamilya, nalampuwasan niya ang kasubo sang ginlutos siya sa round of 16 sang women’s flyweight event sang 23 anyos nga Thai nga si Jutamas Jitpong via unanimous decision sang mga judges.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Magno said that thanks to the support of her fellow Ilonggos and family, she overcame the sadness of being defeated in the round of 16 of the women's flyweight event by 23-year-old Thai Jutamas Jitpong via unanimous decision of the judges.

text: Gin-ako ni Magno nga posible gintun-an maayo ni Jitpong ang diskarte niya sa sulod sang boxing ring rason nga nangin madinalag-on ang tiglawas sang Thailand sa ila nga sambuwa.
english: Magno acknowledged that Jitpong may have studied his strategy inside the boxing ring well, which is why the Thai representative was successful in their fight.

text: Gin-ako man niya nga sang tion mismo sang iya kapyerdihan, wala niya napunggan nga mangin emosyonal sa kadismaya sa diin nag-abot sa punto nga ginkwestyon man niya ang iya kaugalingon.
english: He also admitted that at the time of his defeat itself, he could not help but become emotional in disappointment where it came to a point where he questioned himself as well.

text: Sa pihak sini, narealisar sang Ilongga nga indi lamang siya ang naga-isahanon nga boxer nga nagatiglawas sang Pilipinas sa Olympiada.
english: Meanwhile, the Ilongga realized that he is not the only boxer representing the Philippines in the Olympics.

text: Ginpat-od man ni Magno nga indi ini ang iya pinakaulihe nga paghampang sa Olympiada sa diin madamo pa siya sang inug-compete sa mga masunod nga tuig tubtob sa 2024 Olympics.
english: Magno also assured that this will not be his last Olympiada as he will have many more to compete in the coming years until the 2024 Olympics.

text: Nahibaluan nga natalana nga magpauli sa Pilipinas si Magno kaupod ang iban pa nga tiglawas sang pungsod sa Agosto 9 sa diin pagkatapos sang iya mandatory quarantine, magapauli na ang atleta sa iya hometown sa Janiuay, Iloilo.
english: Magno is scheduled to return to the Philippines along with other representatives of the country on August 9 where after his mandatory quarantine, the athlete will return to his hometown in Janiuay, Iloilo.

text: Liwat nga nagkampyon ang Italy sa FIVB Men’s World Championship matapos ginlutos ang Bulgaria.
english: Italy once again won the FIVB Men's World Championship after beating Bulgaria.

text: Nakuha sang Italy ang score nga 25-21, 25-17, 17-25, 25-10 sa atubang sang 16,429 nga mga tumalan-aw sa Mall of Asia Arena.
english: Italy took the score 25-21, 25-17, 17-25, 25-10 in front of 16,429 spectators at the Mall of Asia Arena.

text: Nagbida sa kadalag-an sang Italy si Yuri Romano nga naka-record sang 22 points, 16 kills, lima ka aces kag blocks.
english: Yuri Romano starred in Italy's victory, recording 22 points, 16 kills, five aces and blocks.

text: Nakasulod ang Italy sa Final matapos ginlutos ang World number 1 nga Poland sa semifinals.
english: Italy reached the final after beating World number 1 Poland in the semifinals.

text: Yara sa ikaduha nga pwesto ang Italy sa Pool F nga may yara sang duha ka kadalag-an kag isa pyerde kun sa diin napaslawan sila sa Belgium.
english: Italy are in second place in Pool F with two wins and one loss against Belgium.
